parts.text: Guard Pippi Pinecone has ambient dialogue that clues the observant player on how to initiate this quest.
The Hungry Guard
Guard Pippi Pinecone places a hand over her stomach.
Guard Pippi Pinecone: I'm famished! What I wouldn't do for a sweet treat right about now.
Give Guard Pippi Pinecone 1 x Jelly Cupcake, which you can obtain from completing Mierra's Famed Cupcakes.
You gain experience.
Faction: Defenders of Faelindral +
Guard Pippi Pinecone: Oh, for me? You shouldn't have!
Guard Pippi Pinecone proceeds to devour the cupcake in a two-bite display, then lets out a satisfied huff and pats her stomach.
Guard Pippi Pinecone: Such decadence! Thank you, my friend. I'll never not enjoy one of Mierra's cupcakes. It makes my brother so jealous that I'm able to indulge in such confectionery!
Guard Pippi Pinecone: Oh yes, I have a brother posted in the smallfolk district of Night Harbor, far from the Weald. Do you think that you'll be traveling that way any time soon?

Guard Pippi Pinecone: You see, my brother always complains that there's nothing sweet for him to eat in Szuur. I've always wanted to send my brother a full dozen of Mierra's beautiful cupcakes as a tease- I mean a gift!
Guard Pippi Pinecone pauses.
Guard Pippi Pinecone: Mostly a gift.

Guard Pippi Pinecone: Could you ask Mierra to pack up a dozen for me? Then, if you bring the packed cupcakes to me, I'll write a note telling my brother to compensate you for playing the part of the courier.
Head to Mierra Willowshade near the inn.

parts.say: Could you pack up a dozen of the jelly cupcakes?

parts.text: Mierra Willowshade: A whole dozen?! Sleepers rest, I suppose I could... though you'd still have to provide me with the royal jelly I require for the batch.
Mierra Willowshade: Not to mention the packaging... hmm. If you bring me twelve royal jelly and a satchel from the bag vendor, I should be able to pack everything up for you.
Bring 12 x Royal Jelly and 1 x Satchel to Mierra Willowshade.
You gain experience.
Faction: Citizens of Faelindral +
Mierra Willowshade: I'm impressed that you found so much! Did you locate a secret hive? Hmm, hmm. You might just have to become my main supplier!
Mierra Willowshade: Regardless, let me get this dozen baked perfectly for you!

Mierra Willowshade hums a tune as she sets to work preparing a dozen freshly baked jelly cupcakes. A familiar aroma fills the kitchen as she carefully packages the cupcakes into the satchel and returns it to you.
Mierra Willowshade: Here you are, my friend. I must say, you're probably the biggest fan of my cupcakes! Thank you once again for your business.
You receive Packaged Cupcakes from Mierra Willowshade.
Deliver 1 x Packaged Cupcakes to Guard Pippi Pinecone.
You gain experience.
Guard Pippi Pinecone: Oh, how wonderful! I'm very tempted to keep these cupcakes for myself, but I could never spoil the effort you went through to get these!
Guard Pippi Pinecone: My brother should compensate you well for your travel time as he earns a guard's wage in Night Harbor.
Guard Pippi Pinecone attaches a small note to the package and returns it to you.
Guard Pippi Pinecone: Pete Pinecone is his name. Thank you for doing this for me, friend!
You receive Packaged Cupcakes from Guard Pippi Pinecone.
Delivery
Travel to the Smallfolk District, south of Saltbreeze Park, in Night Harbor and search for Guard Halfsies. You can ask other guards in the area about Pete Pinecone as well.
Guard Greenbiar: Greetings! Please mind your manners in the smallfolk district. We like to keep things peaceful here.
Guard Greenbiar: Pete? I'm afraid I don't know a Pete, nor do we have any pinecones in the desert! Sorry I can't help you, friend.
Guard Leafla: A fair day to you, friend.
Guard Leafla: Pete? Pete Pinecone? Oh! You must be looking for Guard Halfsies. That's what everyone calls him here, since he's half the guard that the rest of us are.
Guard Halfsies: Never you fear when Guard Halfsies is near! I'll kick evil-doers right in their rear!

parts.say: Do you know a Pete Pinecone?

parts.text: Guard Halfsies: That's me, Pete Pinecone! Though I go by Guard Halfsies around here. Not on account of my size, but due to how generously I share half of my shift with my fellow guards!
Hand the Packaged Cupcakes to Guard Halfsies.
You gain experience.
Faction: Smallfolk Alliance +
Guard Halfsies: From my dear sister, Pippi? What a sweetheart, not to mention a sweet tooth! I suppose it runs in the family. Hmm, let's have a taste, shall we?

Guard Halfsies proceeds to devour one of the jelly cupcakes in two bites. He lets out a sigh of delight as he goes in for a second, then a third, and a fourth. Crumbs pepper the halfling's mouth as he gorges himself on eleven of the dozen cakes.
Guard Halfsies: Exquisite! Delightful! Masterworks, all! I cannot thank you enough, my new best friend!
Guard Halfsies takes one final bite of the twelfth cupcake, depositing what remains of the half-eaten morsel into your hand alongside some silver coins.
You receive 5sp from Guard Halfsies.
You receive Half of a Jelly Cupcake from Guard Halfsies.
Guard Halfsies: Here, some coin for your services. If only my cousin knew how to bake such wonderful delicacies, my sweet tooth wouldn't be so starved out here in Szuur!
Guard Halfsies: Oh, my cousin? Violyn is her name. She cooks at the Crimson Oasis over in Sageside these days.

Guard Halfsies: In fact, you should show her that last portion of cupcake as a measure of what she should strive toward! I'm sure she'll be nothing but grateful to receive an example of premium baking to learn from!
Travel to Chef Violyn, who is located at the Crimson Oasis Inn near the North Gate of Night Harbor.
Hand the Half of a Jelly Cupcake to Chef Violyn.
You gain experience.
Chef Violyn stares at the half-eaten cupcake with a look of incredulous outrage. Her face grows red as she crushes what remains of the cake in her fist and tosses it into the cooking oven.
Chef Violyn: That half-hearted, half-brained, half-witted, half-halfling Halfsies! Ooh, if he weren't my cousin I'd thrash him with my cooking iron!
Chef Violyn: He thinks he can tell me how I'm to do my baking? Oh, I'll bake him a batch of extra special cupcakes, you can be sure of that!
Chef Violyn grumbles as she scratches out a list and tosses it along with a grocery basket into your arms.
Chef Violyn: Go fill that grocery basket with the ingredients on the list! I'll make it worth your while, don't you worry. This will be a batch of cupcakes that he never forgets!
You receive Violyn's Grocery Basket from Chef Violyn.
You receive Violyn's Grocery List from Chef Violyn.
A Fiery Treat
Additional information regarding collection of the grocery list items would be beneficial.
Violyn's Grocery List notes the required items, but not where to obtain them. Chef Violyn is not willing to help, either.

parts.say: Where can I find the items on this list?

parts.text: Chef Violyn: I don't have time to direct you where to go, just find those items and bring them back to me as soon as you can!
Chef Violyn scowls as she turns back to her oven and grumbles under her breath.
Purchase 2 x Dried Dragon's Breath Pepper from Spices Merchant in Night Harbor.
Purchase 1 x Baladi from the Mukhtar Brewery in the river pirate tavern.
Purchase 4 x Basilisk Seasoning from An exotic cook in Shallow Shoals.
Purchase 2 x Viper's Kick which can be obtained from the Viper's Kick Recipe quest.
Combine 2 x Dried Dragon's Breath Pepper, 1 x Baladi, 4 x Basilisk Seasoning, and 2 x Viper's Kick in Violyn's Grocery Basket.
Turn in Violyn's Full Grocery Basket to Chef Violyn in Night Harbor.
Faction: Smallfolk Alliance +
Chef Violyn takes a look into the basket as her mouth curls into an insidious grin.
Some of the following dialogue is incomplete and needs correction.
Chef Violyn: Yes, yes, this will do perfectly. Good job, [Player]. With this forgive for even bringing me that half-eaten pile of slop to begin With. Now to get baking...

Chef Violyn is forced to wear a mask as she combines the various ingredients into a thick mixture that stings your nostrils even from a distance. A cloud of pungent smoke billows out from the oven as the "cupcakes" bake that is enough to make your eyes water.
Chef Violyn takes the completed batch from the oven using a pair of tongs, then dumps them into a pouch which already struggles to hold back the steam escaping from the potent cakes.
Chef Violyn: Here, take these back to Halfsies so he can get a taste of real baking.
You receive Violyn's Special Batch of Cupcakes from Chef Violyn.
Chef Violyn: If he survives, bring me what's left of him and you'll get your reward for all the running around you did. Oh, and you just rip up the list I gave you. You shouldn't need it any longer.
Give Violyn's Special Batch of Cupcakes to Guard Halfsies.
Faction: Smallfolk Alliance +
Guard Halfsies: What's this? Ah, so Violyn took it upon herself to learn from the example we sent? Good for her! Let's give these a try and see how she did!
Guard Halfsies opens the pouch and reaches in to grab a cupcake, recoiling slightly at first.
Guard Halfsies: Youch! Oh my, they're still fresh from the oven! What a charming color, as well. I better not waste any more time, then!
You receive Half of Violyn's Cupcake from Guard Halfsies.
Guard Halfsies chuckles softly and quickly brings a piping hot cupcake to his mouth, taking a bite and eating half in a single fearless chomp.

Guard Halfsies chews only once before suddenly going motionless, his face turning a brilliant crimson. He attempts to draw in a deep breath, though it only serves to further fuel the fire within his mouth. Until...
Guard Halfsies belches out a gout of flame that leaves the ends of his own hair singed. He collapses to the floor and passes out, finally taking the nap he had always longed for.
Give Half of Violyn's Cupcake to Chef Violyn.
You gain experience.
Faction: Smallfolk Alliance +
Chef Violyn lets out a hearty cackle as she takes the remains of the cupcake and tosses it into the oven. The pastry explodes in a small puff of flame that causes even Violyn to recoil.
Chef Violyn: Got What he deserved, I hope Halfsies has always had half a brain. He's certainly not as bright as that sister of his. I wonder how she's doing?
Chef Violyn shrugs and tosses a few coins into a wooden tankard.
Chef Violyn: This is for your trouble, some coin and a fine stein that's served me well over the years. You look worn out after all that running around.
Chef Violyn: Maybe you'd like a cupcake?
Chef Violyn grins.
Chef Violyn: Kidding, of course. Thanks again.
You receive 50sp from Chef Violyn.
You receive Stein of Baker's Scorn from Chef Violyn.
The Hungry Guard
Purchase 1 x Satchel from any bag vendor.
Collect 16 x Royal Jelly by killing a wasp drone or a wasp worker in Evershade Weald.
Give Mierra Willowshade 4 x Royal Jelly to complete Mierra's Famed Cupcakes ONCE and obtain Jelly Cupcake. You should have 12 x Royal Jelly remaining.
Give 1 x Jelly Cupcake to Guard Pippi Pinecone.
to Guard Pippi Pinecone.

parts.say: Could you pack up a dozen of the jelly cupcakes?

parts.text: to Mierra Willowshade.
Give 12 x Royal Jelly (it can be stacked) and 1 x Satchel to Mierra Willowshade.
Give Packaged Cupcakes to Guard Pippi Pinecone.
Delivery
Head to Night Harbor
Give Packaged Cupcakes to Guard Halfsies.
Give Half of a Jelly Cupcake to Chef Violyn.
A Fiery Treat
Purchase 2 x Dried Dragon's Breath Pepper from Spices Merchant in Night Harbor.
Purchase 1 x Baladi from Mukhtar Brewery in the river pirate tavern of Night Harbor.
Purchase 4 x Basilisk Seasoning from An exotic cook in Shallow Shoals.
Complete Viper's Kick Recipe twice to receive 2 x Viper's Kick.
Purchase 2 x Black Feather Whiskey from Nerida Thinblade in Night Harbor.
Collect 2 x Szuurian Viper Venom Sac from killing a Szuurian viper in Glass Flats.
Give 1 x Black Feather Whiskey and 1 x Szuurian Viper Venom Sac to Layla Faraj to complete Viper's Kick Recipe.
Give the remaining 1 x Black Feather Whiskey and 1 x Szuurian Viper Venom Sac to Layla Faraj to complete Viper's Kick Recipe a second time.
Place 2 x Dried Dragon's Breath Pepper, 1 x Baladi, 4 x Basilisk Seasoning, 2 x Viper's Kick in Violyn's Grocery Basket and click Combine.
Give Violyn's Full Grocery Basket to Chef Violyn.
Give Violyn's Special Batch of Cupcakes to Guard Halfsies.
Give Half of Violyn's Cupcake to Chef Violyn.
Quest Complete!
Witcher Sayyaad is located in the Necropolis found within Night Harbor. Enter the Necropolis from the south entrance with the purple "Concourse of Souls" banner and immediately turn right.
Witcher Sayyaad: Are you here to slay me?
Witcher Sayyadd chuckles.
Witcher Sayyaad: I suppose not. Well, you appear pure enough.
Witcher Sayyaad: I'm Witcher Sayyaad. I purge the unnatural from this realm. These days it feels like there are monsters around every corner in Night Harbor.

Witcher Sayyaad: A winged terror swoops through the skies at night. We've heard reports of attacks in Saltbreeze Park and other places in the city. Should you encounter this foul beast, slay it and bring me a part of its body as proof.
Kill Night Terror, a level 8 named bat that spawns only at night in the Necropolis Courtyard and Saltbreeze Park areas of Night Harbor.
Night Terror will drop one of three items randomly, which can be returned to Witcher Sayyaad for a reward.
Mantle of Night
Loot Night Terror's Wing from Night Terror.
Return to Witcher Sayyadd and hand him Night Terror's Wing.
You receive Mantle of Night from Witcher Sayyaad.
You gain experience.
Witcher Sayyaad: You felled the beast and lived to tell the tale. Well done. Take this for your efforts.
Tunic of Night
Loot Night Terror's Fur from Night Terror.
Give Night Terror's Fur to Witcher Sayyaad.
You receive Tunic of Night from Witcher Sayyaad.
You gain experience.
Witcher Sayyaad: You felled the beast and lived to tell the tale. Well done. Take this for your efforts.
Necklace of Night
Loot Night Terror's Head from Night Terror.
Give Night Terror's Head to Witcher Sayyaad.
You receive Necklace of Night from Witcher Sayyaad.
You gain experience.
Witcher Sayyaad: You felled the beast and lived to tell the tale. Well done. Take this for your efforts.
These quests can only be obtained as a Deep Elf who started in the city of Ail'Vorith and has completed Ail'Vorith Starter Quest.
After obtaining your Obsidian Shackle, seek out the appropriate House quest based on your character's class.
When you cross the bridge behind the Toilmaster, the building directly across from the bridge is the Obsidian Academy.
The building to the left of the Obsidian Academy is a Military Outpost.
+ Ail'Vorith Class Quests
Archer || Military Outpost || Laren Drin'dar || House Vael'xirith (Quest) || Unknown
Cleric || Obsidian Academy || Zalethra Drezzorith || House Drezzorith (Quest) || Lexicon of Mysteries -> Intermediate Lexicon of Mysteries -> Advanced Lexicon of Mysteries

Comprehension Test
Read the Imbued Parchment you start with as a new character in Ail'Vorith:

You have been spared.

You only exist by the mercy of:

THE ETERNAL QUEEN AND HIGH LISTENER,
QUEEN NALIADRA
The Queen of Corruption, She Who Spoke With
the Shadow, the Immortal Consort of the
Darkness, and the Avatar of Barbhaal

Make no reference to your former house from this point forward, as *it never existed*.
Therefore, you have no privileged beyond the breath you breathe and your ability to *serve
our Queen*.

You have been cast out of Ail'vorith, welcome
only in its Foreign Quarter, as befitting one of 
the shadowless. Any attempt to enter further 
districts will result in your immediate 
extermination. You have been warned.

To prove yourself useful to our Queen and the 
Houses of Ail'vorith, seek the head toilmaster 
outside the city. Find him and present to him 
this writ if you wish to be tested for any worth 
left in you.

*You are now a shadowless nothing*. It is 
your decision as to whether you remain such.
You are looking for Toilmaster Verith or Toilmistress Rallvessa, who are mere feet away from where you spawn as a new character in Ail'Vorith.
Hand Toilmaster Verith or Toilmistress Rallvessa your Imbued Parchment.
Toilmaster Verith: What's this, then?
Toilmaster Verith looks over the writ and then turns to regard you with newfound disdain.
Toilmaster Verith: Yet another shadowless exile comes barking at my quarry for a morsel? Very well.
Toilmaster Verith: I care not for your status so long as you're able to toil for me like any good meat should.
Toilmaster Verith: First you'll have to prove to me that you're not completely blind, deaf or dumb.
Toilmaster Verith: There are crates with pickaxes next to us, open those so-called eyes of yours and look for a pickaxe that isn't broken or damaged.
Toilmaster Verith: You do at least know how to look, don't you?
Toilmaster Verith: Once you find one that isn't damaged, take it. Then bring it here and show it to me.
Toilmistress Rallvessa: What do you want?
Toilmistress Rallvessa reads over the writ and then turns to regard you with newfound disdain.
Toilmistress Rallvessa: Yet another shadowless exile comes barking at my quarry for a morsel? Very well.
Toilmistress Rallvessa: I care not for your status so long as you're able to toil for me like any good meat should.
Toilmistress Rallvessa: First you'll have to prove to me that you're not completely blind, deaf or dumb.
Toilmistress Rallvessa: There are crates with pickaxes next to Toilmaster Verith, look for a pickaxe that isn't broken or damaged.
Toilmistress Rallvessa: You know how to give them a good look, don't you?
Toilmistress Rallvessa: Once you find one that isn't damaged, bring it here and show it to me.
You gain experience.
Using MUD Commands, you will search the nearby crates for a Slave Pickaxe.
A haphazard heap of pickaxes reside within this crate, all of which appear to be broken or worn from use. The crate itself appear to be labeled with a placard that clearly states, "BROKEN".
You take one of the worn pickaxes from the crate labeled "BROKEN". It does not look as though it could survive another strike against the stone.
You receive Broken Slave Pickaxe.
If you hand the Broken Slave Pickaxe to Toilmaster Verith...
Toilmaster Verith scowls at you as he tosses the already broken pickaxe to the ground, shattering it completely.
Toilmaster Verith: Are you blind, or just incredibly stupid?! You need a pickaxe that is NOT broken or damaged if you're to do any toil for me!
Toilmaster Verith proceeds to strike you with the back of his heavy gauntlet.
Toilmaster Verith's Slam hits YOU for 2 points of damage!
Toilmaster Verith: Use your eyes, you useless thing! Take a pickaxe from the clearly labeled crate, if you only knew how to look!
This crate appears to be filled with recently repaired pickaxes, all of which are crude but serviceable. The crate itself is clearly labeled, "REPAIRED".
You take one of the repaired pickaxes. It feels hefty in your grip, but should serve well for the tasks ahead.
You receive Slave Pickaxe.
Hand the Slave Pickaxe to Toilmaster Verith or Toilmistress Rallvessa
Toilmaster Verith: So you're not actually that blind or stupid? How surprising.
Toilmaster Verith tosses the pickaxe back to you.
Toilmaster Verith: If you do have a brain, then I am sure you can guess what is required next of you, yes?
Toilmaster Verith: You will use that pickaxe to toil for me until you've hewed at least one full stack of stone from the old quarry. That is at least twenty rocks worth.
Toilmaster Verith: Return to me with what you gather alongside your pickaxe.
Toilmistress Rallvessa: So you're at least half capable.
Toilmistress Rallvessa tosses the pickaxe back to you.
Toilmistress Rallvessa: If you do have a brain, then I am sure you can guess what is required next of you, yes?
Toilmistress Rallvessa: You will use that pickaxe and bring me a full stack of stone from the old quarry. At least twenty rocks worth.
Toilmistress Rallvessa: Return to me with the stones and your pickaxe.
Mining

Head south from the Toilmaster (the direction he's facing; away from the city) into the water and then right. Follow the wall until you find a small cave with several mining nodes. The nodes will respawn quickly (5-10 seconds) once mined. Place the Slave Pickaxe in your Main Hand slot and right-click the rocks to mine the Stone Ore veins until you have 20 Fragile Quarry Rock.
Hand in a stack of 20 Fragile Quarry Rock and your Slave Pickaxe.

Toilmaster Verith proceeds to toss your pickaxe into the nearby crate labeled "BROKEN". He then deposits the rock you harvested into a neatly filled pack before heaving it to you without warning. You nearly lose your footing at the heft of the bag as it slams into your arms, weighing you down considerably.
Toilmaster Verith: Congratulations! You earned a trip to the foreign quarter.
Toilmaster Verith: Proceed towards the footbridge that leads into Ail'vorith.
Toilmaster Verith: You're to deliver this pack of rock to Supplier Jul inside the supply shop. It's the building directly to your left as you enter the foreign quarter.
Toilmaster Verith: He should have a delivery of sharpening stones that you will bring back here, to me.
Toilmaster Verith: Keep in mind that you are still worthless. You are not permitted to enter any other district of the city, or you'll be disposed of on sight.
Toilmaster Verith: I don't rightly care what happens to you, but I do care about what happens if you lose my shipment, so just do as you're told.
Toilmaster Verith: Now go!
You receive Pack of Stone from Toilmaster Verith.

Toilmistress Rallvessa deposits the rock you harvested into a neatly filled pack before heaving it to you without warning. You nearly lose your footing at the heft of the bag as it slams into your arms, weighing you down considerably.
Toilmistress Rallvessa: Congratulations! You earned a trip to the foreign quarter.
Toilmistress Rallvessa: Proceed towards the footbridge that leads into Ail'vorith.
Toilmistress Rallvessa: You're to deliver this pack of rock to Supplier Jul inside the supply shop. It's the building directly to your left as you enter the foreign quarter.
Toilmistress Rallvessa: He should have a delivery of sharpening stones that you will bring back to Toilmaster Verith across from me.
Toilmistress Rallvessa: Keep in mind that you are still worthless. You are not permitted to enter any other district of the city, or you'll be disposed of on sight.
Toilmistress Rallvessa: I don't rightly care what happens to you, but I do care about what happens if you lose my shipment, so just do as you're told.
You receive Pack of Stone from Toilmistress Rallvessa.
You are encumbered.
You gain experience.
The Supplier
Carry the heavy pack of stone up the hill behind Toilmaster Verith and follow his verbal instructions to find Supplier Jul.
Hand Supplier Jul your Pack of Stone
You are no longer encumbered.
Supplier Jul: Another supply from Vorith? Good. Set it down there, I'll get to it later.
Supplier Jul eyes you up and down a moment. He smiles broadly.
Supplier Jul: As for his sharpening stones, I'm afraid he'll have to wait.
Supplier Jul: The smith has been requisitioned by House Vael'xirith and hasn't felt the need to waste his time with petty stone work, you see.
Supplier Jul: Unless you feel you're up to the task? You exiles are searching for a means to get back into standing with the Houses, are you not?
Supplier Jul: I'll throw in a good word for you to your master.
Supplier Jul: The sharpening stones that Vorith needs are simple enough for a novice to make, and I'll provide you materials and directions to finish the work order.
Supplier Jul: What do you say, will you do it?
Supplier Jul: Wonderful! I don't want to have to deal with Vorith's complaints and you want to get on his good side, so this is a win-win situation for us both.
Supplier Jul produces a satchel and offers it to you, alongside a slip of parchment.
Supplier Jul: Here's a satchel and the recipe to fashion sharpening stones. Take as much rock as you need from the pile next to me. You're going to want enough to craft five stones worth.
Supplier Jul: Once you have the rock you need, take a left out of the shop and head through the gate to the foreign trader's market.

Supplier Jul: At the end of the market you'll find a grinding stone next to the forge that you can use to turn these into proper sharpening stones. You'll need five of them to complete the work order.
Supplier Jul: Place five sharpening stones in that satchel and then seal the container before returning it to me.
You receive Sharpening Stone Satchel from Supplier Jul.
You receive Recipe: Fragile Sharpening Stone from Supplier Jul.
Right click the recipe to learn how to craft Fragile Sharpening Stone.
You have learned a new recipe!
Use your MUD Commands again to search the crate next to Supplier Jul and acquire some Fragile Quarry Rock.
You notice a crate filled with rocks.
You take one of the rocks.
You receive Fragile Quarry Rock.

Repeat this until you have 5-8 Fragile Quarry Rock, as you may fail a couple combines. There is a slight delay between MUD commands, so you may have to wait a few seconds between collecting each rock.
Note that you skill up in Stone Cutting (trivial at 5), so feel free to collect extra rocks.
Grinding (not that kind!)

Once you have your rocks, take a left out of the shop and head through the gate. Proceed through the marketplace and turn right and proceed through the tunnel. At the fork in the tunnel, take the right path. After exiting the tunnel, enter the first building on your right and turn right to find Blacksmith Zorvek and a small grinding wheel next to the forge.
Click on the grinding wheel and create 5 Fragile Sharpening Stone. Place the Fragile Sharpening Stone in your Sharpening Stone Satchel and click Combine to create a Full Sharpening Stone Satchel.
Sharpening Stone Satchel is consumed while crafting.
You craft Full Sharpening Stone Satchel.
Return the Full Sharpening Stone Satchel to Supplier Jul.
Supplier Jul grins.
Supplier Jul: That wasn't so bad, now was it? Granted you were working with quarry rock, and the most those can sharpen are the dull tools that Vorith has his slaves laboring with.
Supplier Jul writes out a receipt and includes it in the package before offering it back to you.
Supplier Jul: There you are, one full delivery of sharpening stones for your master! I included a note inside about how you chipped in.
Supplier Jul: I'm sure Vorith will reward your efforts.
Supplier Jul smiles.
You receive Sharpening Stone Delivery Satchel from Supplier Jul.
You gain experience.
Useless!
Return the Sharpening Stone Delivery Satchel to Toilmaster Verith.
Toilmaster Verith grunts dismissively as you return with the delivery.
Toilmaster Verith: It's about time, exile. About the only thing the meat out here is good for is hewing rock, so a sharp pickaxe is essential.
Toilmaster Verith opens the package and regards the note that was left by Supplier Jul. He scans the message quickly, his features soon hardening into a wicked scowl.
Toilmaster Verith pulls out a stone that you recognize; a stone crafted by your own hand. He clenches it in his fist and the fragile stone crumbles immediately into dust.
Toilmaster Verith: WHAT IS THIS?!
Toilmaster Verith: These stones are completely useless to me!
Toilmaster Verith: I had ordered hardened stones to be used on metal tools, not this worthless dreck!
Toilmaster Verith: Jul's message says that YOU took it upon yourself to make these in his stead? Explain yourself, meat!
Toilmaster Verith: Yes or no, did you make these stones?
Toilmaster Verith: Then you are either a fool or a subservient sap. Perhaps both.
Toilmaster Verith narrows his eyes at you, his expression cooling.
Toilmaster Verith: Jul has undoubtedly kept my commission for himself so that he could profit from it and pass the blame on to a desperate exile like yourself.
Toilmaster Verith: He was counting on me slaying you where you stand. Instead, I shall find out if there is yet a fire for vengeance burning in the embers of your lost soul, meat.
Toilmaster Verith: This will also be a test of your ability. Are you prepared?
Toilmaster Verith: Good. You are to prove if you are proficient enough to survive the caverns of Ail'vorith.
Toilmaster Verith: Venture past the safety of these surroundings and murder the pathetic creatures you find there and fill this satchel with their remnants.
Toilmaster Verith: I require two bone chips, two myconid caps and two deep beetle legs.
Toilmaster Verith throws you a small leather satchel.
You receive Small Leather Hunting Satchel from Toilmaster Verith.
Toilmaster Verith: Should you not survive, then good riddance. If you do manage it, return to me the filled satchel.
Finally, some killing!
Walk down the hill and begin hunting the newbie creatures for the required parts.
Bone Chips are dropped by a decayed skeleton
Deep Beetle Legs are dropped by a small beetle and a deep beetle
Damaged Fungus Cap are dropped by a cave sporeling
When you have all six items, place them in the Small Leather Hunting Satchel in single stacks and click Combine to create Filled Leather Hunting Satchel.
Small Leather Hunting Satchel is consumed while crafting.
You create Filled Leather Hunting Satchel.
Hand the Filled Leather Hunting Satchel to Toilmaster Verith.
Toilmaster Verith takes the satchel and inspects the contents, nodding with satisfaction.
Toilmaster Verith: You yet live? Perhaps there is hope for you to serve after all. Most of the dregs who wash onto my shore are not even fit to cull a simple beetle.
Toilmaster Verith: You also, for better or for worse, blindly follow instructions. Your subservience could be better suited to a House that would put it to use, but that is still to be determined.
Toilmaster Verith produces a writ and adds it into the satchel before sealing it once more and offering it back to you.
You receive Satchel of Questionable Spoils from Toilmaster Verith.
Toilmaster Verith: Bring your spoils to the cook, Vashuk, at the inn inside the foreign quarter.
Toilmaster Verith: This time, do not ask or answer any questions. Simply make this delivery and then return to me when you are finished.
The Cook
Cook Vashuk is a questionable character, and as such is difficult to find.

Head inside the city by crossing the bridge behind Toilmaster Verith. Once inside the main gate, turn right and walk up the stairs into the first building on your left just past the courtyard fountain.
Once you climb up the stairs, enter the small doorway in the back-right of the inn and take the stairs DOWN.
In the far back of the cellar, you will find Cook Vashuk. Hand Cook Vashuk your Satchel of Questionable Spoils.
Cook Vashuk lets out a cackle as he snatches the satchel from your hands.
Cook Vashuk: The scent of spores and death lingers on the exile before me!
Cook Vashuk eagerly looks through the satchel, clawing at the note that was left by Vorith. He scans it with a crazed stare.
Cook Vashuk: Ah, I see, I see! Yes, yes, indeed. So it shall be.
Cook Vashuk: Go now, shoo! Off with you, disgraced one! Go tell your master that it shall be as he wishes.
Cook Vashuk cackles delightfully as he begins chopping the components you brought atop a grisly wooden board.
You gain experience.
A recommendation!
Return to Toilmaster Verith and hail him.
Toilmaster Verith: You return, Good.
Toilmaster Verith: Vashuk is rather mad in the head, you see. He often pays others for near worthless monster parts, but in this case he'll be making a special meal for Jul in particular.
Toilmaster Verith smirks before his stern gaze returns.
Toilmaster Verith: You have proven to be at least marginally competent. Do you still wish to attempt to rejoin the Houses of Ail'vorith?
Toilmaster Verith: Very well. Here is a recommendation stating that you are not, entirely, without use.
You receive Vorith's Recommendation from Toilmaster Verith.
Toilmaster Verith: Bring this to Provost Xan'shorn within the Obsidian Academy. The entrance is the first one that you'll see when you cross the footbridge to enter for foreign quarter.
Toilmaster Verith: He will direct you further towards your...reintegration.
Toilmaster Verith: Be mindful of the shadows this time, meat. Else I find you back in my quarry barking for scraps.
You gain experience.
The Houses

Head back across the bridge and through the gate. In the courtyard, Provost Xan'shorn is to the left in the courtyard as you pass through the gate. He likes to walk in small circles around the left side of the courtyard.
Hand Provost Xan'shorn Vorith's Recommendation.
Provost Xan'shorn frowns as he looks over the letter of recommendation, eyeing you suspiciously.
Provost Xan'shorn: Not often does vorith send me a worthy exile. Perhaps you will be more promising?
Provost Xan'shorn produces a shackle-like bracer that he clasps onto one of your wrists.
You receive Obsidian Shackle from Provost Xan'shorn.

Provost Xan'shorn: I welcome you, shadowless, to the Obsidian Academy. We are willing to instruct those of lesser station who wish to prove their worth to our Queen through blood, blade, and sacrifice.
Provost Xan'shorn: There are seven great Houses of Ail'vorith: Vael'xirith, Varros, Xal'tharn, Hal'kareth, Ith'vayen, Drezzorith, and Velgarrith.
Provost Xan'shorn: Each House has a representative that you can find here in the academy. Speak to them. Find one that resonates with the darkness in your own soul.

Provost Xan'shorn: Learn what you can do to pledge yourself to them to regain your own shadow. Yet know that the Houses are not in alignment. Pledging with one will earn the scorn of others, so make your choice wisely.
Quest Complete!
Follow up quest: Ail'Vorith Class Quests
Additional Lore
Seek out Vaslir Naiyth inside the Obsidian Academy after acquiring your Obsidian Shackle.
Vaslir Naiyth meets your eyes with a penetrating stare. An involuntary shiver runs through your body. There is a touch of something about her gaze that is not of this realm.
Vaslir Naiyth: Karzzul, young aspirant. What brings you to this vaslir of House Varros?
Vaslir Naiyth: Does your ambition lead you towards the path of the vaslir?

parts.say: I seek the path of the vaslir

parts.text: Vaslir Naiyth: Vaslir is the title bestowed on those of us who have successfully bound a being from another plane. It is the signature art of our great house.
Vaslir Naiyth: Members of our house start as junior apprentices and hope to become senior apprentices.
Vaslir Naiyth: From senior apprentices, if their ambition wins out, they advance to leth'vaslir.
Vaslir Naiyth: Finally, those who survive long enough become full vaslir.
Vaslir Naiyth: The head of our house, Archbinder Zaelthir Varros, is the only one with the title neth'vaslir.
Vaslir Naiyth: I see how you ended up an outcast. In Ail'vorith, survival depends on knowing your rivals.
Vaslir Naiyth: Still, it is good that you're learning.

Vaslir Naiyth: House Varros, the Subjugator of the Ebon Realms, has played an important role in our civilization's survival and expansion. Our necromancers and elementalists control powerful minions that serve the Queen as well as any solider of House Vael'xirith.

Vaslir Naiyth: While House Hal'kareth boasts of its research into the Spirals, the demons we've bound give us our own insight into Ach'aron. We know the Sixth Spiral in ways that transcend the clumsy explorations of those wizards and their Hathalian magics.
Vaslir Naiyth laughs.
Vaslir Naiyth: Hil dur ana zehad, Or whatever nonsense it is that they say.
Vaslir Naiyth: Some of us have actually advanced in our understanding of magic since those days.

Vaslir Naiyth: There are other planes beyond this realm. The spirals are among the most important of them. We have fought wars with them in the past, and the demons of Ach'aron, the Sixth Spiral, are now of great service to our empire.
Vaslir Naiyth: Thanks to House Varros, of course.
Vaslir Naiyth smiles smugly.
Vaslir Naiyth: The First City. Across the sea. We were once part of that civilization long ago. Before Calafrey. Before the Shadow blessed us. But those lands are now lost. Our future is here.
Vaslir Naiyth: After the fall of the First City, we came here, to the continent of Aethoril. The elves were one people then, spread across many cities.

Vaslir Naiyth: But then we heard the Shadow's wisdom and descended. Now our empire is greater than Calafrey ever was, and our pathetic cousins struggle to hold onto the merest scrap of what they once had.
Vaslir Naiyth: What backwards cave was your house living in prior to its, apparently well deserved, annihilation?
Vaslir Naiyth sighs and then continues in a patient tone.

Vaslir Naiyth: The Shadow is the voice that led us here, saving us from the Burning Heavens. Our glorious queen, Naliadra, was the last to hear the Shadow's voice. Thus she is the High Listener. Varsa ai Neth'xanl
Vaslir Naiyth: The Burning Heavens was a momentous event. It ravaged the surface while we waited below, growing strong.
Comprehension Test
Hand Imbued Parchment to Toilmaster Vorith or Toilmistress Rallvessa
for a "REPAIRED" pickaxe
Hand Slave Pickaxe to Toilmaster Vorith/Toilmistress Rallvessa
Mining
Head south from Toilmaster Vorith into the water and turn right. Follow the wall until you find the quarry
Mine 20x Stone from Stone Ore veins
Hand 20x Stone and the Slave Pickaxe to Toilmaster Vorith/Toilmistress Rallvessa
The Supplier
Hand Supplier Jul the Pack of Stone
Switch Language to Deep Common
times
Grinding
Head to Blacksmith Zorvek
Create 5x Fragile Sharpening Stone using the Grinding Wheel
Place 5x Fragile Sharpening Stone in the Sharpening Stone Satchel and click combine to make Full Sharpening Stone Satchel
Hand Supplier Jul the Full Sharpening Stone Satchel
Useless!
Hand Toilmaster Vorith the Sharpening Stone Delivery Satchel (not Toilmistress Rallvessa)
Finally, some killing!
Loot 2x Bone Chips from a decayed skeleton
Loot 2x Deep Beetle Legs from a small beetle and a deep beetle
Loot 2x Damaged Fungus Cap from a cave sporeling
Place all six items in the Small Leather Hunting Satchel and click combine to make Filled Leather Hunting Satchel
Hand Toilmaster Vorith the Filled Leather Hunting Satchel
The Cook
Head inside the city into the inn, walk into the basement
Hand Cook Vashuk the Satchel of Questionable Spoils
A recommendation!
Hail Toilmaster Vorith
Receive Vorith's Recommendation
The Houses
Hand Vorith's Recommendation to Provost Xan'shorn
Quest Complete!
Follow up quest: Ail'Vorith Class Quests
Part 1 - Req. Lvl 1 - Scout Courier
Read the Rolled Leafscroll you start with as a new Archer character:

Archer,

The Wyrdguard have taken notice of your diligence and 
keen eye.

Your skills would be a welcome addition to the ranks of
Faelindral's protectors. We humbly invite you to present
this letter to Captain Keyaryn Thornshade who resides
upon Sentinels Terrace.

To reach the terrace, follow the signage past the inn and
toward the stage at the Willows Whisper. Climb the main
ascent behind the stage to reach the Traders Terrace, then
continue up the central ramp and cross the span opposite
the tanner.

The local guard can direct you further should you inquire
with them.

Your gaze shall prove to be a great asset in our upcoming
conflicts, as will the strength of your bow.

                                        Fair shades to you,
                                Commander Elydris Stormbough
Head to Sentinels Terrace, which resides above the Traders Terrace in Faelindral.
Take the Traveler's Lift (where you entered the game). (You can double click on the bell and the lift will come. Double click the bell again to send the lift up.)
Go the the inn, then up, then right (in a right angle). When you see Pine Brightreed go left. (You are now at Traders Terrace)
Go toward the weapons armor sign and take the ramp at the left of Taelin Goldstem.
Take the bridge on your left, go left again and Captain Keyaryn Thornshade will be at the center of the giant trunk.
Give Rolled Leafscroll to Captain Keyaryn Thornshade.
You gain experience.
Faction: Wyrdguard +
Faction: Fellstone Orcs -
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade casually accepts the scroll and unfurls it, his brow raising a touch as hazel eyes quickly scan it and then you, sharp as a hawk.
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: Elydris's new recruit, huh? I suppose that's not the worst news that I've gotten today.
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade tosses you a small satchel that bears the weight of a number of leafscrolls.
You receive Reconnaissance Satchel.
You receive Briefing for Scout Faeweald from Captain Keyaryn Thornshade.
You receive Briefing for Scout Gladebow from Captain Keyaryn Thornshade.
You receive Briefing for Scout Stonebranch from Captain Keyaryn Thornshade.
You receive Briefing for Scout Amber Ward from Captain Keyaryn Thornshade.
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: You'll start off easy, new blood. Show me that those eyes of yours really do work by seeking out the scouts that I have posted around Faelindral.
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: Deliver these new briefings to each of them, then return to me with a bag full of their reports.
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: Should be easy for a sureshot like you, right? Or do you need directions?
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade lets out a sarcastic chuckle.
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: You'll find three of my scouts posted near the bottom of each of the great lifts around Faelindral. They should be easy enough to spot for any with a keen eye.

Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: The fourth scout, Gladebow, has been temporarily posted to Overlook Terrace due to a recently compromised platform infested with spiders. Lucky for you, that's just one span away, past the druids.
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: An entire brood of widow spiders descended from the northern cliffs not long ago. They took over a terrace and seem to be forming a nest within the great tree itself.
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: It's one sticky situation after another with those pests, so we always need to have eyes on them.
Start by heading to Scout Gladebow, who can be found on the platform east of Sentinel's Terrace.
Give Briefing for Scout Gladebow to Scout Gladebow.
You gain experience.
Faction: Wyrdguard +
Faction: Fellstone Orcs -
Scout Gladebow accepts the briefing and offers a curt nod, exchanging it for his report.
Scout Gladebow: Ah, my thanks. You must be new to the Wyrdguard. Give the captain my regards, but try not to let his quips get to you. He can be a bit wry.
You receive Gladebow's Report from Scout Gladebow.
Next, head to Scout Amberward, who can be found at the base of the Keeper's Lift in Evershade Weald.
At the bottom of the Keeper's Lift, turn left and run through the ruins. Before crossing the bridge, turn right and you will see Scout Amberward overlooking a fallen log.
Give Briefing for Scout Amberward to Scout Amberward.
You gain experience.
Faction: Wyrdguard +
Faction: Fellstone Orcs -
Scout Amberward does not seem to respond to your offered briefing at first, leaving your outstretched hand hanging in the air.
Scout Amberward finally snatches the briefing and exchanges it for what must be his report, his gaze remaining fixed upon the forest floor and the ruins in the distance.
You receive Amberward's Report from Scout Amberward.
Next, locate Scout Faeweald, who is located near the base of the Pixie Lift (Druid's Circle). Descend the lift and walk straight off the ramp towards the tree.
Give Briefing for Scout Faeweald to Scout Faeweald.
You gain experience.
Faction: Wyrdguard +
Faction: Fellstone Orcs -
Scout Faeweald accepts the briefing and exchanges it for a report.
Scout Faeweald: Ah, new briefings? Thank you for saving me the trek, and here's my report for Captain Thornshade.
You receive Faeweald's Report from Scout Faeweald.
Lastly, find Scout Stonebranch, who is located near the base of the Traveler's Lift (Newbie Lift).
As you exit the Traveler's Lift, turn right and you will spot Scout Stonebranch near a bush.
Give Briefing for Scout Stonebranch to Scout Stonebranch.
You gain experience.
Faction: Wyrdguard +
Faction: Fellstone Orcs -
Scout Stonebranch accepts the briefing and exchanges it with his report.
Scout Stonebranch: Oh, that time already? Here you go. Nothing much to report down here, aside from some nasty wasps.
You receive Stonebranch's Report from Scout Stonebranch.
Place Gladebow's Report, Amberward's Report, Faeweald's Report, Stonebranch's Report into the Reconnaissance Satchel and click Combine.
You craft Full Reconnaissance Satchel.
Return to Captain Keyaryn Thornshade and hand them the Full Reconnaissance Satchel.
You gain experience.
Faction: Wyrdguard +
Faction: Fellstone Orcs -
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade takes the satchel and begins to leaf through the reports. His countenance hardens as he goes over Amberward's report in particular.
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: That's just great. It seems the orcish threat has grown bolder of late, sending scouts into the lower reaches of Faelindral.
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: You did well getting these reports, though. Take this, it'll help identify you as a novice archer for the Wyrdguard.
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade retrieves a leather wristguard and offers it to you.
You receive Novice Scout Bracer from Captain Keyaryn Thornshade.
Completing this stage of the quest will provide five yellow bars of XP at level 1.
Part 2 - Req. Lvl 1 - Orc Intelligence Gathering
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: I suppose there's no better way to introduce you to the ways of the scout. Care to perform a little counter-espionage?

parts.say: Yes, I love to perform counter-espionage!

parts.text: Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: Aside from being a blight on the land, we're still not sure what the orcs' goal is within Evershade.
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: Briefings like the ones I had you deliver are not unique to the Faelewyn, though.
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: If orcish scouts have been spotted in the Weald, then there's a chance that they're writing and sending their own reports to some... higher authority.
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: That's what I'd like you to find out. Return to Scout Amberward and tell him that you're there to gather intelligence.
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: You're to follow his orders and see if you can determine what the ores' goal is here in the Weald.
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: Return with what you find. If we know what they're after, we can start taking direct action to prevent it.
Return to Scout Amberward, who can be found at the base of the Keeper's Lift in Evershade Weald.
At the bottom of the Keeper's Lift, turn left and run through the ruins. Before crossing the bridge, turn right and you will see Scout Amberward overlooking a fallen log.

parts.say: The captain wants me to gather some intelligence on the orcs.

parts.text: Scout Amberward gives you a piercing look, his eyes scrutinizing your equipment and overall demeanor.
Scout Amberward: If you were sent here to gather intelligence, then you'll have to show me some evidence that you've been accepted as a scout.
Give Novice Scout Bracer to Scout Amberward.
Scout Amberward relaxes considerably upon recognizing your wristguard.
Scout Amberward: Thank the Sleepers. I've been watching the Fellstone movements for days to no avail.
Scout Amberward unstows a satchel from his belt and offers it to you, along with returning your bracer.
You receive Scout's Satchel from Scout Amberward.
You receive your items back from Scout Amberward.
Scout Amberward: Take this satchel. It's about time we strike back. I hope you're ready to take a more... direct approach.

parts.say: I love a direct approach, especially if it means killing!

parts.text: Scout Amberward: Fellstone scouts have been spotted all across the lower Weald, far closer to Faelindral than ever before.
Scout Amberward: Some are carrying odd reports, and I believe we may be able to learn their plans if we can translate them.
Scout Amberward: I've already eliminated a few myself, but we're going to need more of those strange scribbles if we're to have any chance at deciphering their horrendous language.
Scout Amberward: Eliminate as many scouts as it takes to fll the satchel, then return it to me. May your arrows fly true, novice.
Hunt a Fellstone scout in Evershade Weald until you find loot 6 x Unintelligible Writings.
Place the 6 x Unintelligible Writings into the Scout's Satchel in stacks of 1 (one item per slot). Click Combine.
You craft Full Scout Satchel.
Return to Scout Amberward and hand him the Full Scout Satchel.
You gain experience.
Faction: Wyrdguard +
Faction: Fellstone Orcs -
Scout Amberward: You're a keen shot, that's for sure! Well done, novice.
Scout Amberward: The captain won't enjoy the fact that we only have these scriblings, but it's better than nothing. Perhaps he has an idea of who can translate them...
Scout Amberward: I'Il remain here and keep watch over the orc's movements. Return to the Sentinels Gaze as soon as possible.
You receive Full Scout Satchel from Scout Amberward.
Scout Amberward: Fair shades to you, , and thank you.
Return to Captain Keyaryn Thornshade and hand them the Full Scout Satchel.
You gain experience.
Faction: Wyrdguard +
Faction: Fellstone Orcs -
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade empties the satchel onto his desk and pores over the seeming illegible writings.
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: This is what they're carrying out there? Wonderful.
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: I suppose I should've expected as much... trying to gather intelligence from creatures that don't have any brains to begin with.
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: You did well though, . This at least proves that you area capable of striking a number of moving targets.
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade gathers up the papers and tucks them into the satchel then offering it to you.
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: You're getting the real scout experience now. How do you about even more paperwork?
You receive Full Scout Satchel from Captain Keyaryn Thornshade.
Part 3 - Req. Lvl 4 - Translating Orcish
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: There's a researcher who spends her time in the Heartwood Archives deciphering ancient texts. Fairgrove. A kind girl, but rather timid.

Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: She's aided the Wyrdguard in the past, so deliver these writings to her and see if she can make heads or tails of this gibberish. I'll send word ahead so that you don't spook her.
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: The sooner we know their meaning the better. You have my leave to assist her in any way you can. Who knows, maybe you can shoot some books off the top shelves for her.
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: The Heartwood Archives is maintained by the Preservers, just above the city bank. There's plenty to learn there if you have a thing for ages past.
Locate Researcher Fairgrove, who is located in the Heartwood Archives above the bank in Faelindral.
Give Full Scout Satchel to Researcher Fairgrove.
You gain experience.
Faction: Wyrdguard +
Faction: Fellstone Orcs -
Researcher Fairgrove blinks and looks up from the tome as you offer her a satchel full of orcish text.
Researcher Fairgrove: O-oh, Were you sent by Captain Thornshade? He sent word that you w-would be arriving soon. Are these really w-written in the language of the orcs? F-fascinating...

Researcher Fairgrove trails off as she begins sorting through the writings, seemingly unperturbed about the leathery parchment they are scratched upon. She examines the crude symbols with curious gaze.
Researcher Fairgrove furrows her brow in thought as she takes a quill and circles two symbols appear on the leathery parchment, before offering it back to you.
You receive Sheaf of Circled Symbols from Researcher Fairgrove.
Researcher Fairgrove: Tell me, do you r-recognize anything about these particular... s-symbols?
Review the Sheaf of Circled Symbols item description, which will note "A page of seemingly illegible symbols, two of which have been circled.

Researcher Fairgrove: You see the two symbols that I've circled there on the parchment? They, uhm... t-they look familiar to me, but it would be prudent if you could... v-verify something for me first.
Researcher Fairgrove: I believe I've seen a s-symbol just like this one etched into the bark of the smaller conifer trees near the Wyrdgate.
Researcher Fairgrove: Could you t-travel to the gate and take a look at the trees until you find one with symbols? Then inspect them c-closely so you can compare them to the one on that page.
Researcher Fairgrove: Once you've confirmed the s-symbols to be the same, return the page to me. I'll g-go over these writings in the meantime. T-thank you, and I... I hope this isn't a bother.

Researcher Fairgrove: O-oh, the Wyrdgate? It... it's an important location of natural power. Druids are able to utilize them as a sort of... a-anchor point, from what I understand, when they guide themselves or others through the Wyrding.
Researcher Fairgrove: You should be able to f-find it just at the bottom of the northern lift, which leads into f-fae territory. It's the l-longest, tallest lift ride in all of Faelindral.
Researcher Fairgrove: The Wyrding is ever-mysterious! I b-believe there's a wonderful tome here in the Heartwood Archives if you w-want to learn more about it.
There are no mud command responses when searching for a Wyrding tome, and Telaldrin the Wanderer does not respond to prompts about it.
Go past the Archer guild to the Pixie lift and take it down. Go left past the circle of glowing mushrooms to the tree near the ramp up. Stand next to the tree.

The smaller trees of Evershade Weald seem to be thriving, despite being overshadowed by the great elderspires. The lower bark of this particular conifer is entirely concealed in a twisting net of rich vines and ivy.
The heavy coverage of vines prevents any chance of observing what may or may not be etched onto the bark of this tree. You would have to pull the vines away to get a better view.

You carefully pull away a section of the vines, just enough to glimpse what was hidden underneath. Etched into the bark of the tree, you reveal a series of old, oddly symmetrical markings that have long since healed over with thick scabs of hardened sap.
You receive Handful of Ivy.
Missing information regarding the Handful of Ivy if you return this to the researcher instead of the Sheaf of Confirmed Symbols.

Closer examination of the odd marks reveals that they are not ordinary wounds, but rather an intricate series of elaborately carved symbols. These ancient signs must be the ones you came here to investigate.

After a more thorough examination, and with a little luck from your keen gaze, you locate a series of symbols that almost perfectly match the one that Researcher Fairgrove circled on the parchment. It is certain that she will want to hear about this.
After this emote, your Handful of Ivy merges with the Sheaf of Circled Symbols to become the Sheaf of Confirmed Symbols.
You receive Sheaf of Confirmed Symbols.
Return to Researcher Fairgrove and hand her the Sheaf of Confirmed Symbols.
You gain experience.
Faction: Wyrdguard +
Faction: Fellstone Orcs -
Researcher Fairgrove widens her eyes as you explain to her how the symbols matched up.
Researcher Fairgrove: S-so it's true? What could it mean that the ores are r-reporting symbols that are near the Wrydgate itself? Surely they could n-not have gotten so close.
Researcher Fairgrove: They're c-clearly using a different script than what is presented trees, but p-perhaps they're also researching something to do with the Wyrding?
Researcher Fairgrove chews her lower lip nervously.

Researcher Fairgrove: H-here, take this bag. I now have an idea of what I can look for with these illegible texts, but I'll n-need you to help me once more in g-gathering some rather, uhm. morbid items.
You receive Research Assistant's Bag from Researcher Fairgrove.
Researcher Fairgrove: It I-relates to the second symbol that I recognized in these orcish texts. imagine you've h-heard of the various undead that have risen from the ruins lately?
Researcher Fairgrove: Among them are old elven skeletons from before the calamity. These skeletons are u-under the influence of a wicked magic that stinks of the... t-the Spirals
Researcher Fairgrove: I need you to destroy some of the old skeletons and s-see if you can find evidence of m-magical runes etched into their bones.

Researcher Fairgrove: If I can c-compare those runes to the writings that you've brought me, I m-may be able to piece something t-together. Fill the bag with a-at least four examples, and I'll w-work on things here while you, umm... d-do your thing.
Kill an old elven skeleton until you loot 4 x Rune-Etched Bone.
Place the 4 x Rune-Etched Bone in stacks of 1 into Research Assistant's Bag and click Combine.
You craft Full Research Assistant's Bag.
Give Full Research Assistant's Bag to Researcher Fairgrove.
You gain experience.
Faction: Wyrdguard +
Faction: Fellstone Orcs -
Researcher Fairgrove: Ah, P-perfect timing! I just finished going over the o-orcish writings that you brought me. Now if my hunch is correct...
Researcher Fairgrove runs a trained eye across the bones and runic etchings used to raise the dead from their slumber. She frowns and a nervous breath escapes her lips.

Researcher Fairgrove: It's as I f-feared. I cannot yet translate this orcish script, but there are c-clear correlations between the runes that were forced upon our ancestors and the s-scouting reports that were being written about the Wyrdgate.
Researcher Fairgrove takes a deep breath and pens out a hasty note. She offers it to you and meets your gaze, her timid demeanor becomes serious and all signs of her former stutter temporarily cease.

Researcher Fairgrove: You must bring this to your captain at once. These undead are not raising out of mere circumstance, but because of a plot by the orcs. To what end, I do not know, but the Wyrdguard must be warned not to tarry with the undead disturbance!
You receive Hastily Written Note from Researcher Fairgrove.
Return to Captain Keyaryn Thornshade and hand them the Hastily Written Note.
You gain experience.
Faction: Wyrdguard +
Faction: Fellstone Orcs -
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade narrows his gaze as you offer the note to him, scanning it quickly. He clicks his tongue and scowls.
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: The undead are just a distraction? Hmm...
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: She makes a bold claim, but I have a feeling Fairgrove knows what she's talking about. She's a gentle soul, and not one to get worked up over something that isn't serious.
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade stows the note into his tunic and withdraws a small arrowhead token. He perches it on his thumb and flicks it toward you.

Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: You earned a little upgrade to that gear of yours, scout. Take this token, along with your scout bracers, to Craftguard Vinebrow and see if he can fix you up with something sturdier.
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: You'll find him in the armory, here in the Sentinels Gaze. Once you're kitted out, return here and let me know when you're ready for the next step.

Faction: Fellstone Orcs -

Craftguard Vinebrow expertly weaves a reinforcement through the bracer, then applies a protective coating. It is not long before he offers back a bracer that looks brand new.

Craftguard Vinebrow: There you are. Now this is worthy of a true scout of the Wyrdguard!

Return to Captain Keyaryn Thornshade.

parts.say: I am ready for the next step!

parts.text: Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: Yeah? Let's take a look at your scout bracer, in that case. We'll see if you're up to the task.

If you are too low of a level, you will see this prompt (verified as a level 7 Archer 2026-10-02):
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: Hmm... still needs some working in, I think. Come back and show me again once I can see some bowstring wear on that bracer.

If you are level 8 or higher (verified 2026-10-02):
You receive your items back from Captain Keyaryn Thornshade.
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: Looking good, scout. You wear that bracer well. I suppose you're ready to hear about our plan of action.

Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: I've already sent word to the other captains about the undead distraction and how the orcs are the real threat. That doesn't mean we can simply ignore the undead presence, however.

Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: Powerful remains from ancient Calafrey have already taken over structures outside the Ruinwatch, and if we focus all our efforts on the orcs, that still leaves the undead free to harass other citizens or travelers.

Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: So we're the ones who are going to do clean-up duty. Shooting skeletons isn't exactly an efficient use of regular arrows, though, so I believe it's time we enlist some spiritual aid.
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: Take this note to Moon Dances; he's one of Whisperers of the Preservers. I've sent word ahead of your arrival, but chances are the spirits already told him as well.
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: He can hear things others cannot, so hopefully he's heard a trick or two we can use to eliminate the undead threat.
You receive Note for Moon Dances from Captain Keyaryn Thornshade.

Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: Ruinwatch is an outpost terrace on the perimeter of Faelindral. It's connected via bridge to the site of an old Calafreyan ruin. Scout Amberward is keeping eyes on it from his position, if you recall.
Locate Moon Dances inside of the Balanced Branch (shaman guild) of Faelindral.
Hand Note for Moon Dances to Moon Dances.
You gain experience.
Faction: Preservers +
Faction: Wyrdguard +
Moon Dances: I was expecting your arrival, young scout. From my understanding, you and the good Captain Keyaryn are searching for a means of expulsing the undead from the nearby ruins, yes?
Moon Dances: A noble goal, and one that the spirits of the forest would gladly aid you in.
Moon Dances: Though the spirits are often aloof and highly independent. You will need to have them working in unison to disrupt the unnatural process that is animating the ancient dead.
Moon Dances: For that, you will need to bring them together in the clay receptacle. You must find and take a sample of the four key elements that make up our great forest.

Moon Dances: If you believe you know the four locations where the primordial spirits congregate, the I beseech you to seek them out. Otherwise, I can provide some clue as to where might find the samples you seek.
Moon Dances: When you are finished, return your filled receptacle to me.
You receive Forest Spirit Receptacle from Moon Dances.
Moon Dances will give you a mortar and pestle to fill with 4 pure elemental samples.
You can ask Moon Dances for further clues and clarification on where to find each of the samples.

parts.say: Where would I find samples of the four key elements?

parts.text: Moon Dances: There are four elemental spirits, and thus four locations where you must look for a suitable sample. Which one do you seek? The spirit of air, fire, earth, or water?

parts.say: Where is the location of the air elemental?

parts.text: Moon Dances: The spirits of the air surround us daily, though it is within the boughs of the trees where they are the most rich and vibrant.
Moon Dances: Enter the lift to the upper tiers of Faelindral and look amongst the boughs. It is there that you shall find a sample in its purest form.

parts.say: Where is the location of the fire elemental?

parts.text: Moon Dances: The spirits of flame burn brightest within the night sky, when they stand out starkly against a darkened canopy.
Moon Dances: You will have to capture a faefly that burns with the spirit of moonfire, and there is only one location I know of where they descend low enough to reach.

Moon Dances: You must travel up the cliffs to the south, high above the pass that leads to Keepers Bight. There, you will ind a small ruin where the faeflies often descend at night, basking in the open moonlight.
Moon Dances: Capturing one may require forceful coercion, as the flames that burn within the faeflies are both fickle and ferocious if not tamed.

parts.say: Where is the location of the earth elemental?

parts.text: Moon Dances: The earthen spirits are often utilized by the druids of the Circle of Spores, who reside beneath the city of Faelindral.

Moon Dances: Looking in the deepest reaches of their caves should reveal a location where you can take an enriched sample for your receptacle. Perhaps you will find it in one of the many fungal circles where they perform their experiments.

parts.say: Where is the location of the water elemental?

parts.text: Moon Dances: The spirits of water will always follow the flows and currents that weave their way throughout the forest.
Moon Dances: Follow the path toward their final destination at the end of the great river, and should you look there, you will find a suitable sample of their spiritual presence.
You can collect each sample by being in the proper location and inputting the MUD command
The air sample is found in the nonfunctional Temple Lift that leads into the upper tiers. (THIS IS A TEMPORARY LOCATION. PLEASE UPDATE AFTER THE UPPER TIER IS ADDED INTO THE GAME)
From Moon Dances, cross the bridge towards Rangers Rest. Take the short bridge to the left of Rangers Rest. The Temple Lift should be directly to your right. Enter the lift.

The lift to the upper tier is rich with the scent of fresh air produced by the towering elderspire trees. All around you, you can perceive the calm, subtle motions of the forest as it sways in the everlasting breeze born of such lofty heights.
You feel this would be a suitable location to take a sample for your receptacle.
You open the receptacle and hold it aloft for a moment, allowing the spirits of the area to waft inside and infuse its housing with the richness of pure air.
You receive Sample of Air.
For the next sample locations, refer to the map thumbnail on this page.
The earth sample is found inside a mushroom ring inside Sporehaven Karst (Shroom Cave on the Evershade Weald map).
ENTER THIS LOCATION DURING THE DAY. The myocid mobs will become HOSTILE between 6 PM and 5 AM.
From the air sample location, return to the Newbie lift, take it down and follow the path north to the river.
Cross the bridge over the river and turn right. Follow the river and enter the mushroom cave.
Halfway through the left side of the mushroom cave is a circle of mushrooms and several myocid NPCs.
The bowels of Sporehaven Karst are the very definition of earthiness, with millennia-old compressed stone mingling with freshly sprouted fungus and mushrooms that cling to the ancient surfaces.
You feel this would be a suitable location to take a sample for your receptacle.

You gather a small handful of stone, dirt, and spores, carefully pouring them into your receptacle. It seems a simple gesture, yet an unseen weight bears down on you, making the act feel all the more significant.
You receive Sample of Earth.
The water sample is found at the waterfall at the end of the river near the Newbie lift (marked as Dead End on the Evershade Weald map).
From the earth sample location, exit the cave and follow the river to the end.
Once you've reached the waterfall, jump into the water between the opposing boulders before the waterfall. Be careful not to fall.
The river roars as it tumbles into the Twilight Sea, drowning out nearly all other noise. The currents here pick up considerably, both in volume and in force.
You feel this would be a suitable location to take a sample for your receptacle.

You carefully dip the receptacle into the rapids, collecting a portion of the wild torrent. The sheer pressure of the flow threatens to wrench the container from your grasp, but you manage to wrest it back from the river and seal it with your newfound sample.
You receive Sample of Water.
The fire sample is found by killing an annoyed faefly after using the
MUD command near the old Calafray ruins while it is night time.
From the water sample location, head north towards the Newbie lift while hugging the cliff on your right.
Eventually, you will reach some ruins swarmed with wasps (labeled as Bees on the Evershade Weald map).
Behind the ruins is a ramp up the cliff. Take this ramp and continue south until you cross the bridge near the Keeper's Bight zone line.
There are occasionally a handful of level 8 and 9 orc patrols that walk along this ledge if there are no players camping their spawn points below.
After crossing the bridge, follow the path until you reach a cluster of 3 orcs with another ramp to their right. Hug left while you carefully circle around the orcs.
As you climb the next ramp, hug the left wall tightly to avoid the aggressive orcs. At the end of the path, you will find a small ruin resembling a broken spire surrounded by four pillars.
Any time after 6pm,
near the spire and use
to force an annoyed faefly to spawn, which cons yellow at level 8.
DO NOT ATTEMPT THIS BETWEEN 3 AM AND 6 AM IN-GAME TIME. a twisted fae patrols up this ramp and through the ruins and will easily kill a level 8 archer in one or two hits.
Shattered ruins mark this location as part of the old Calafrey Empire. The remains lie here, weathered and worn, their history and purpose lost to time and neglect.
The next emote only appears between 6 PM and 5 AM server time.
A swarm of faeflies have descended here during the night, dancing among the ruins and basking in the light of the moon and stars above.
an annoyed faefly buzzes tauntingly as it hovers in the air, just out of reach.
You open the receptacle and attempt to coax a faefly into it. The fly buzzes past you aggressively, zipping out of reach and refusing to cooperate peacefully.
If an annoyed faefly has already spawned but not been killed during the evening, you will still see this emote, but the faefly will not spawn.
an annoyed faefly, if not killed, will path down the ramp, through the orcs, and across the bridge before despawning.
an annoyed faefly flares violently as it zips toward you, testing their resolve!
Kill an annoyed faefly and loot Docile Faefly. This is the sample of fire.
an annoyed faefly sputters and falls as its brightness dims slightly, appearing to be tamed.
You loot Docile Faefly.
Note - if another Archer has recently killed an annoyed faefly, you will see this emote instead:
You cannot seem to coax another faefly close to the ground at this time.
This is the same emote you will get if you try to coax a faefly during the daytime.
Place Sample of Earth, Sample of Air, Sample of Water, and Docile Faefly into Forest Spirit Receptacle and click Combine.

You gain experience.

Faction: Wyrdguard +
Moon Dances: Your keen senses are not wasted among the scouts of Evershade, my friend. It is a blessing to be able to perceive the unseen.
Moon Dances: Now allow me a moment to discuss with these spirits what they must do.

Moon Dances carefully opens your receptacle and begins to murmur soft whispers into it. He holds what seems to be an imperceptible conversation with the samples that you have collected, before closing the box and offering a warm, wizened smile.
Moon Dances: The spirits are quite agreeable to your cause, young scout, and shall aid you accordingly.
Moon Dances: They are to join you throughout the remainder of your task. You can call upon them to enhance the strength of your bow with the ability to ward off unnatural creatures.
Moon Dances returns the receptacle to you, which now seems to be buzzing with excitement.
Moon Dances: Captain Keyaryn will wish to hear of your progress. Bring the receptacle to him and he shall instruct you of your next course of action.
Moon Dances: Spirits watch over you, young scout.

Captain Keyaryn Thornshade examines the receptacle and carefully runs it alongside his bow. The spirits within hum in excitement as the weapon begins to glow.

Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: Moon Dances does not disappoint. This should help you considerably, scout. Shamans have the uncanny ability to speak the language of the spirits, and it seems like they might be just as eager to rid the forest of the undead as we are.
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: Which is great, because you're about to be sent into the hornet's nest. Figuratively, of course. I have nothing against the wasps.

Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: You're going to make your way to the ruins outside of Ruinwatch and cleanse them of the risen Calafrey soldiers. Common skeletons may be there as well, but your targets are specifically the risen military of the old empire.
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: You should be able to call on the spirits to empower your weapons, but they'll only respond to you while you're near the desecrated Calafreyan ruins.
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: They'll help you reduce the skeletons to nothing more than necrotic ash. I'm going to need to see at least ten piles of the ash to know that the deed's been done.
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: That's not all, though. We've had sightings of some sort of robed figure in the area as well.

Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: I wish I could tell you more. Scout Amberward has eyes on the ruins and made the report.

Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: On your way there, you could stop by and ask him about the robed figure. If they're the ones responsible for raising the undead, then you have my full permission to pursue and eliminate them.
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: Bring back ten piles of ash and I'll be happy. Bring me the ash along with evidence of this robed figure's involvement and I might just kiss you.
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: Again... figuratively speaking. No offense. Just get out there, scout, and make me proud.

parts.say: What can you tell me about the robed figure?

parts.text: Scout Amberward: Good to see you again, . You're investigating the robed figure I mentioned in my report? I'm glad they sent someone competent to look into things.
Scout Amberward: I'll tell you all that I know so far. I'm not certain if this figure is involved in the raising of the undead, but they only seem to arrive under the cover of nightfall.
Scout Amberward: They don't have the build of an orc, so I'm not convinced that it's one of their kind.
Scout Amberward: I've never spotted the figure entering or leaving the area, so they can either employ invisibility magic or have some other means of blending in with the undead in the area.
Scout Amberward: Unfortunately, that's all I have to offer you. If you do find any evidence of this figure's involvement, be sure to bring it to the captain.
Scout Amberward: Good hunting, scout.

The Calafreyan ruins are located south of Scout Amberward. Follow the two bridges to the south. On the last bridge before you enter the ruins, you will be able to use your Blessing of the Forest Spirits.

Blessing of the Forest Spirits, when clicked near the Calafreyan ruins, will give your player a buff which gives auto attacks a chance to proc holy damage which only works inside the ruins of old Calafrey.
The captain will ask you to venture to the ruins and collect 10 Necrotic Ash as well as proof of a mysterious robed figure's involvement.

Necrotic Ash is dropped by Calafreyan humanoids in the ruins, such as a Calafreyan archer, if your character has the buff provided by the Blessing of the Forest Spirits applied when the mob is killed.
Once you collect the ash you need to head into the ruins in the evening to find the robed figure. (see video link at bottom of page).
In the back of the ruins, your character will spot something via an emote text in chat.
Your keen gaze spots a mysterious sigil etched onto a stone in a small clearing of leaves and pine needles.
The sigil looks strangely familiar to you, and as you move closer to examine it, a robed figure appears from out of the shadows!
