a black rat sniffs up at you, recognizing your scent from the guild.
a black rat: Friend? Elian?
a black rat stands up on his hind legs, sniffing at you.
a black rat: You're looking for Elian as well? Oh no... He never came back when he went with the scary men.
a black rat skitters about in a circle, then stands up again, sniffing the air.
a black rat: Yes, scary men, smell was strange... like you, but not like you. Do not know where went, but dogs might know.
If you hail Whiskey (and possibly Patches)
Whiskey looks up at you, wagging his tail.
Whiskey: Hail, and well met! How can this humble hound be of service? I hope no trouble is afoot?
Whiskey: Looking for some scary men?
Whiskey: Well, there are some different types of scary people who pass through the harbor, some of them men, some of them not...
Whiskey: Whom, pray tell, are you looking for, someone in particular?
Whiskey: Ah, the beastmaster... Yes, I know of him, he often gave me pets when he came by. Such a nice young man. I haven't seen him since he went with those... intimidating travelers.
Whiskey sighs like any other dog.
Whiskey: Oh, I do believe, I overheard one of their names... Yorias, I believe. Yes, I last smelled the man somewhere on the other side of the harbor...
Whiskey: Do be careful! I must say, I do not like the cut of that particular man's jib!

Head to the Eastern Harbor (Large Harbor) and slightly inland until you see a little creek with some a watersnakes. We will follow this path east until right after we pass the smith on the right. There should be Yorias outside of the building on the left hand side.(advice - Open the city map and find the main entrance to the “The Bends” district — you need to approach its main gate.
At the spot where the two Watchmen are standing, turn around and stand with your back to them.)
Yorias looks at you with disdain, spitting on the ground before speaking.
Yorias: Whaddayou want?!
Yorias shrugs at you.
Yorias: Who's that?! What does he look like?!
Hand the Sketch of Elian to Yorias
Yorias takes the parchment from you, looking at it with a sneer.
Yorias: Haven't seen this runt, or his little rat, either.
You receive your items back from Yorias.
(Can probably say anything here to be honest)
Yorias snarls at you.
Yorias: Enough of your questions, runt!.
Yorias: I'm tired of you trying to interfere in my business! Time to die, punk!
Yorias: Bet you wish you left me alone, huh?!
After Killing Yorias, you will receive a Severed Ponytail and a Skintaker's Note. We will be taking these both to Leila Ghasem in the Seekers of the Lost Eye.
Turn in the Severed Ponytail, Skintaker's Note, and Crumpled Sketch of Elian together to Leila Ghasem
You gain experience.
Leila Ghasem takes the ponytail from you, sniffing it.
Leila Ghasem: That's Elian's scent alright... The poor lad...
Leila Ghasem: What did that man say to you before you killed him? Something about Skintakers?
Leila Ghasem clasps her hands together.

Leila Ghasem: This isn't good. The Skintakers are a group of people who follow the teachings of the Spiral, or so it is said. They do not commune and live with beasts, as we do, but instead, they seek the fast path to power
Leila Ghasem takes a deep breath.
Leila Ghasem: This is not the last we hear of them. However, you've done good work today, avenging Elian...
Leila Ghasem: Here, take this as a token of our appreciation.
You receive Beast Adept's Tunic from Leila Ghasem.
Moon Dances is located near the Shaman Spell Merchant at The Balanced Branch, which is only reachable from the Ranger/Beastmaster Platform.
Moon Dances offers you a serene bow.
Moon Dances: I greet you. I am called Moon Dances, though I am afraid that my namesake is not so true these past nights.
Moon Dances: I would often dance along with the songs of the spirits during the moonlight. Lately, however, the nights are filled with anguished cries instead of song.
Moon Dances: The spirits of the Weald are distraught... Frightened even.
Moon Dances: Unnatural things have been called upon in the Weald. Undead now roam the forest floor, and their very presence upsets the balance.
Moon Dances: Would you help me in bringing an end to these creatures most foul?
Moon Dances offers you a bow once more, this one out of gratitude.
Moon Dances: I will perform a rite of cleansing to put the spirits of the fallen to rest, should you bring me enough of their remains.
Moon Dances: I can part with some small tokens of appreciation for every five bone chips you bring me.
Find and hunt skeleton mobs such as a rotting skeleton in Evershade Weald. You can often times find Bone Chips on vendors in Faelindral as well.
Give 5 x Bone Chips to Moon Dances.
Moon Dances: Thank you for purging the land of another undead menace. I'll dispose of these remains.
You gain experience.
Faction: Preservers +
Moon Dances accepts the offered bone chips and stores them safely away.
Moon Dances: You have my humble thanks. I shall see to performing the rite, so that these fallen spirits are put to proper rest.
You receive Tattered Cloth from Moon Dances.
Squire Ryland is located inside of the Wayfarers Hospice in Night Harbor near the Paladin class trainers. Enter Wayfarers Hospice and take the first door on the right, then turn right.
Squire Ryland: Hello there. Have you come seeking salvation?
Squire Ryland: Very well, stranger. If you're looking to prove yourself, I have a simple task for you. That is, unless you're too experienced.
Squire Ryland: Excellent. We can always use some help cleaning up the weaker undead that roam the gates. They lack aggression during the day, but at night, they attack unsuspecting travelers.
Squire Ryland: We can't risk them being used in a more sinister plot. Bring me any of their bone chips so that we may destroy their haunted remains.
Kill skeleton mobs which drop Bone Chips. You will need sets of 5 x Bone Chips for each turn-in.
Give 5 Bone Chips to Squire Ryland.
Squire Ryland: Thank you for purging the land of another undead menace. I'll dispose of these remains.
You gain experience.
Faction: Penitent Knights of the Hospice +
If you hand less than 5 Bone Chips...
Squire Ryland: While noble of you, I've requested that you turn over at least five bone chips so that I can see to their proper disposal.
Note: There may be a follow-up quest with Sir Leon Kardek or Sir Allan Fortir - more information is required.
Squire Ryland: Too experienced, eh? Then you should speak with Sir Allan or Sir Leon. These brave paladins not only saved my life, but they are great and holy men.
Perhaps a certain faction standing with the Penitent Knights of the Hospice is required?
Bree Weatherstoll is located in the halfling camp west of the quarry in Sungreet Strand.
Bree Weatherstoll: Hi there youngling. You seem to have wandered away from home.
Bree Weatherstoll: Stay with us a while if you like, eat some potato stew with blessings from the Warrenmother. Fayma provides for all of her children.
Bree Weatherstoll smiles at you warmly.
Bree Weatherstoll: Fayma Warrenmother? She's an old soul. For many generations Fayma has watched over and provided for her younglings.
Bree Weatherstoll: She's even watching over us now.
Bree Weatherstoll: Please take no offense by it. Fayma sees all the races of the world as her younglings.
There is some missing dialogue here...
Bree Weatherstoll: We halflings have long sought out the ancient home of our people. It's our greatest hope that the desert of Szuur may have some answers.
Bree Weatherstoll: Recently, a passing farmer took shelter from a storm here and came across these ancient halfling bones.
Unclear if there is further dialogue here.
In the middle of the camp a pot with cooking stew can be found.
Using MUD commands, you can learn a bit more detail about the camp...
Here, a small gathering of halflings scurries about the camp with excited energy.
The outer edge is lined with colorful tents, and crates and boxes are scattered haphazardly between them.
From the center of the camp, the savory aroma of stew wafts up from two cast iron pots over the fire.
Toward the eastern wall, a partially dug alcove catches your eye. Within the shadowed recesses, something ivory gleams faintly.
You can also take some Stew as suggested by Bree Weatherstoll earlier in your conversation with her.
You receive Halin Hearty Stew.
Any further emotes here?
The halfling bones discovered by the passing farmer that Bree mentions are in an alcove nearby.
You can again
at the bones to learn more about them.
In the partially dug alcove, the faint glow of torchligh reveals the skeletal remains of an ancient halfling, their fragile bones cradled by the desert sand.
The skull, smaller, rounder and pronounced brow ridge, bear the markings of an ancient halfling, its jaw slightly agape as if in silent protest against time.
It seems to gaze longingly towards the pot of stew bubbling in the camp, as though the desire for one last meal lingers even in the afterlife.
The ribcage, partially buried, jugs out like the curved petals of a withered flower.
You can pour the Halin Hearty Stew on the skeleton with MUD commands.
Pick up the Halin Hearty Stew so it is on your cursor, and then type:
You pour the hearty stew onto the drooping jawbone of the halfling skeleton. It runs through the bones and drips onto the ground.
The stew is wasted, but you feel mildly satisfied with yourself.
Unclear if there is any further dialogue here...
does not yield any results.
At some point during the night, Bree Weatherstoll wanders over to the halfling remains and mentions something about ruins.
Missing dialogue.
Bree Weatherstoll: To the north, there is a quarry.
Bree Weatherstoll: West of the quarry is a winding path that leads up the ruins of Tel Ekir.
Bree Weatherstoll: It's been long suspected to have once been home to Halin people. We intend to go there soon.
Bree Weatherstoll looks at you sternly, her eyes unmoving.
Bree Weatherstoll: If you go there and happen to find any artifacts of halfling make, please bring it to me.
More information is required...
It is possible there are undiscovered /mud command responses inside of Tel Ekir which further the progress of this storyline.
Additionally, there are known factions that can be gained within Tel Ekir which unlock further dialogue with various NPCs within the zone and may be key to continuing this storyline.
Reward: Scroll: Burning Bones
After completing the Necrolyte's Pouch Quest

parts.say: take the list of charred procurements

parts.text: to bones. He will give you a new letter describing the items needed, Bones' List of Uncommon Necrotic Procurement.
20 Scorched Skeletal Remains (Talking to Cordellius is optional)
Hail Cordellius Hollmion in Spellbinders of the Spire
He will tell you that they are from skeletons killed via the Flameburst spell.
15 Burnt Bone Chips (Talking to Pedram is optional)
Hail Pedram at the School of the Fourfold Path
Pedram: Hail, Adventurer. I'm Pedram, assistant to the Tams.
"Pedram lifts his head from a swirl of dancing cinders, his expression serene."
Pedram: Ah...not mere ash.Not what you find in a hearth or the pit of pyre. You seek a flame that remembers.
Pedram: Campfire, torchlight, forge heat...these flames are bereft of soul, fed by the spent remnants of life. But elemental fire...it's fire that lives, fire that hungers. It's not kind.

parts.say: where can I find elemental fire?

parts.text: Pedram smiles faintly, more reverant than pleased.
Pedram: Yes. Elemental fire is not tool. It's a presence...a spirit, if you will. It speaks in crackles and sizzles, and devours without pause.

Pedram: Many will call upon spirits for light, war, or spectacle. Few truly understand what they bind, and fewer still survive when the bond breaks...when reverence is forgotten, and fire takes back what it's owed.
Pedram leans closer
Pedram: The bone chips you seek must be seared by such a fire. Not summoned, but enraged...by a fire spirit untethered.

parts.say: where can i find an untethered fire spirit?

parts.text: Pedram lowers his voice, eyes reflecting a flicker of emotion.
Pedram: There is one. Bound long ago within an ancient crypt by rites of the dead. It was enslaved through force, not honor, and it burns still with fury unspent.
Pedram: Now it's surrounded by it's necromantic keepers, once masters of their craft, now minions to the very spirit they sought to command.
Pedram: It's flames do not simply consume, they rage...they scar. They mark bones with the burn you require.
Pedram straightens and gestures towards the school's tall shelves.

Pedram: Before you go stumbling through ash and wrath, learn the tale. Seek the book titled Deference to the Flame; a Tale of Ash and Sorrow. It rests amongst the southern stacks, with our other teachings.
Pedram: May you find what you seek...and survive the meeting.

Presumably the elemental being referred to is either a flame elemental or the Skyseer in Ancient Crypt. To be confirmed. The book is in the bookcase to the left of the door to Pedram's room as you enter.
5 Blackened Fish Bones
Hail A Fishwife in Saltbreeze Park
Eventually she will tell you to talk to Jasmerin

She will tell you to go and see Chef Violyn at the Crimson Oasis (Inn with red drapes) near the north gate. Violyn will tell you that to make blackened fish bones you need either 1x Flux (alchemy) and 1x Fish Bones, or 8x Fish Bones. Blackened Fish Bones recipe trivials at 5 Cooking.
1 Singed Skull
hail Rallin Wizentrop at the Academy of Arcane Inquiry
eventually he will mention Drazllin
Enter Sungreet Strand and make your way to the Beetle Caves near the Quarry. On a small ledge near the bottom is a pile of gnome bones.
then
. Fight Blazed Revenant, a level 18-19 undead. Loot Singed Skull.
Return all items to Bones, including the Bones' List of Uncommon Necrotic Procurement

This quest has a prerequisite. Player needs to complete the Wizard starter quest part 1, before Jabir will provide quest. Player must provide proof of being part of the Academy before Jabir Ilhamar will accept the burnt out lightstones.
Say What aobut Viridon?
Jabir Ilhamar: No We haven't found Viridon... but thank you for your concern.
Jabir Ilhamar: I do have another task for you, however. The Academy is in need of burnt out lightstones. If you could bring me four, it would be of great value to us.
Jabir Ilhamar: You'll find wisps floating about the Shaded Dunes.
Jabir Ilhamar nods to you with a worried glance.
Turn in four burnt out lightstones to Jabir Ilhamar.
Jabir Ilhamar holds the burnt out lightstones in his cupped hands.
Jabir Ilhamar: Oh! Very good indeed! The Academy thanks you.
You gain experience.
This quest is repeatable.
Missing initial dialogue from Mercenary Captain Hulg.
Kill Nerguk found in the quarry below the watch tower.
Nerguk will sometimes drop Intricate Ale Mug.
Bring the Intricate Ale Mug to Mercenary Captain Hulg for your reward.
Missing turn-in dialogue, exp, faction, coin, etc.
Cheikho is at the hunters camp on the eastern side of the large, rocky mound separating the smuggler area from the oasis with the ghouls. You can see the camp from the beach.
Cheikho: Hail to you, friend!
Cheikho: We're hunting the nearby beach for crocodiles. If you have meat or skins for us, we're happy to purchase them. We also have some goods for sale. Take a look!
Cheikho: Yes, down along the shoreline. But take care... this area has more dangers than just the crocodiles.
Cheikho: Look around friend! How did you make it this far without dying?
Cheikho laughs.

Cheikho: There's undead just over the dunes to the northeast, smugglers to our west, and giant scouts prowling around at night... and to top it all off, there's a particularly large and hostile croc wandering about named Chompers.
Cheikho: You'd best take care when running around here.
Cheikho: Yeah, Chompers. Nasty feller. I bet his hide would make one heck of a tunic, though.
Chompers is a level 16 crocodile which will spawn randomly along the beach.
Kill Chompers and loot Chomper's Hide.
Return to Cheikho and give him 1 x Chomper's Hide.
Missing turn-in dialogue, exp / faction hits.
You receive Chompers' Hide Tunic from Cheikho.

quests.title: Cinder Beetle Armor Quests
classes: ARC BRD BST CLR DRU FTR INQ MNK PAL RNG ROG SHD SHM SPB

parts.text: As a general tip, you can often find Cinder Beetle Carapace, Cinder Beetle Legs, and Cinder Beetle Gland for sale on the Blacksmith and Cook vendors across Night Harbor.
Total materials for a full set:
7x Cinder Beetle Legs
11x Cinder Beetle Carapace
1x Cinder Beetle Mandible
1x Cinder Beetle Gland
3x Cinder Beetle Blood
1x Giant Cinder Beetle Eye
3x Cinder Beetle Serrated Mandible
2x Charcoal
1x Copper Dagger
1x Crude Fish Oil
1x Twilight Bay Rum
2x Resin
Cinder Beetle Shield
Knowing Hult Beetlewrangler is a master craftsman of fine beetle parts, you inquire about crafting armor from cinder beetle shells you've encountered during your travels.
Hult Beetlewrangler: Woah, ho there, adventurer. Ya looking for work or wares? No matter, ol' Hul's got somethin for ya either way.

parts.say: Can you make anything with cinder beetle parts?

parts.text: Hult Beetlewrangler: Cinder beetles, boss? Ol' Hult's never had the opportunity to try his handiwork with one of them beetle shells.
Hult Beetlewrangler: Tell ya what, hand me one of 'em cinder beetle shells and a cinder beetle leg and we'll see what ol' Hult can do with 'em.
Give Hult Beetlewrangler 1x Cinder Beetle Carapace and 1x Cinder Beetle Legs
Hult Beetlewrangler takes the shell and legs and begins to work on them.
Hult Beetlewrangler: Well, this is gonna... oh no.
Hult Beetlewrangler: No wait, I can make this work. Hold yer camels. Just need ya to be a little more patient.
Hult Beetlewrangler: There we go. All done.
Hult Beetlewrangler: I'm afraid this is the limit of my beetle craftin' skills. If ya got more cinder parts to spare, ya might want to try the master blacksmith in the Night Market.
Hult Beetlewrangler gives you a Cinder Beetle Shield and recommends you speak to a master blacksmith.
Cinder Beetle Boots
The master blacksmith only works at night (spawns at 6 PM in-game time). He is located in front of the Blacksmithing building in the Night Market.

parts.say: Hult mentioned you could craft armor with cinder beetle parts?

parts.text: a master blacksmith: Cinder beetles? You must've been talking to ol' Hult.
a master blacksmith: There was a time when Hult and I used to make a few armor pieces from whatever was on hand, back when the iron supply was low. Cinder beetle armor was one of those.
a master blacksmith: If you bring me a cinder beetle shell and two beetle legs, I might be able to put together a nice pair of boots for you. No promises though.
Give a master blacksmith 1x Cinder Beetle Carapace and 2x Cinder Beetle Legs
a master blacksmith: Well I did say I'd give it a go, didn't I?
a master blacksmith breaks the shell in half and rounds it out, his skilled hands shaping it masterfully.
a master blacksmith: Seems I've still got it. Here you go. These boots should keep you warm on cold nights in the desert.

a master blacksmith: If you're ever interested in more cinder armor pieces, let me know. Smiths from all over Night Harbor come by all the time. They might share recipes they've picked up out in the wilds.
You gain experience.
You receive a pair of Cinder Beetle Boots from a master blacksmith. You can inquire if any recipes have been shared with him recently to continue the quest.

parts.say: Have any other Smiths shared their recipes with you?

parts.text: a master blacksmith: Since you're so eager, you should go see Sielah Zefir in the Black Feather Bazaar.
a master blacksmith: A while back, he mentioned that he tried to make a helm once.
a master blacksmith: ...He didn't say if he was successful or not, though.
Cinder Beetle Helm
Weaponsmith Sielah Zefir is located in the Black Feather Bazaar. He tells you that he can make you a helm for 2 cinder battle shells, 2 cinder battle legs, 1 charcoal, 1 copper dagger and 1 mandible.

parts.say: A master blacksmith mentioned you tried to make a cinder beetle helm?

parts.text: Weaponsmith Sielah Zefir: Interested in cinder beetle armor, eh?
Weaponsmith Sielah Zefir: Yes, I once had a helm that I fashioned from cinder beetle pieces.
Weaponsmith Sielah Zefir: I sold it some time ago to one of the watchmen. I could make you one if you have the pieces I need.
Weaponsmith Sielah Zefir: If my memory serves me right, I'll need two cinder beetle carapaces, two cinder beetle legs, and a cinder beetle mandible.
Weaponsmith Sielah Zefir: Be careful handling the mandibles. The serrated sort are especially nasty... I prefer not to use those.

Weaponsmith Sielah Zefir: On top of the beetle parts, I'll need two extra pieces of charcoal for the helm. Cinder shells are fire-resistant and hard to work with, so my forge will need to be blazing hot for this to work.
Weaponsmith Sielah Zefir: Those are just the materials for construction... now, let's talk payment.
Weaponsmith Sielah Zefir: How about you throw in a copper dagger to make it worth my trouble, Deal?
The Cinder Beetle Mandible is a rare drop off a cinder drone in Sungreet Strand
Hand Weaponsmith Sielah Zefir 2x Cinder Beetle Carapace, 2x Cinder Beetle Legs, 2x Charcoal, 1x Copper Dagger, 1x Cinder Beetle Mandible.
You gain experience.
You receive Cinder Beetle Helm and 10x Black Feather Arrow that may be used in another quest. ((more information required))
Sielah Zefir mentions he does not like working with serrated mandibles. He recommends you visit Shipwright Benlink for the greaves. ((more information required))
Cinder Beetle Greaves
Shipwright Benlink is located behind some crates on the docks in Southwest Night Harbor (located near "a first mate" and "a sailor").

parts.say: Do you know anything about cinder beetles?

parts.text: Shipwright Benlink: Cinder beetles from out in the quarry? I've actually happened upon a method to fashion some formidable greaves from their tough hides.
Shipwright Benlink: Their shells even block Eth's rays when you can't escape her, like out on the high seas.

parts.say: Would you fashion a pair of greaves for me?

parts.text: Shipwright Benlink: I suppose I could spare a moment to craft you some, so long as you're able to get me the parts required.
Shipwright Benlink: I'll need three cinder beetle carapaces, two cinder beetle legs, and a mandible... a serrated one. I'll also require a special tanning agent.

parts.say: Can you tell me about the special tanning agent?

parts.text: Shipwright Benlink: Despite looking like metal, I've always found that cinder shells mold better if they're treated like hardened leather.
Shipwright Benlink: Dilshad Abolfazl at the tannery could mix up a tanning agent for you if you bring him a cinder beetle gland and some cinder blood.
Visit Dilshad Abolfazl, who is located at the Tannery in Night Harbor near the West Gate Bank. Hand him 1x Cinder Beetle Gland and 1x Cinder Beetle Blood.

Dilshad Abolfazl: What's this? Heh, the last time Benlink had me make some of this was when I owed him from my gambling debts... though if you're bringing the parts, I suppose there's no harm. One moment.
Dilshad Abolfazl mixes the glad and blood with a fine powder, producing an oily liquid with a bright orange hue.
Dilshad Abolfazl: Here you are. Let Benlink know that fortune's going to smile upon me during our next game!
You receive 1x Cinder Tanning Agent from Dilshad Abolfazl.
Give Shipwright Benlink 3x Cinder Beetle Carapace, 2x Cinder Beetle Legs, 1x Cinder Beetle Serrated Mandible, 1x Cinder Tanning Agent
Shipwright Benlink takes the parts and wastes no time getting to work.

Shipwright Benlink heats the resistant carapaces and forms them into plates, stretching the mandible to create a waistline of sorts. He weaves the legs between each plate to hold them together, then coats them in a tanning agent, which draws out their color and gives them a fine sheen.
Shipwright Benlink: There you are, one pair of cinder beetle greaves! I always enjoy working with this stuff, though, not as much as Huda. They say he could make an entire ship out of beetle shells!
You receive Cinder Beetle Greaves from Shipwright Benlink.
Cinder Beetle Breastplate
Seek out Master Shipwright Huda in the Night Harbor docks. He is located just south of the Teleporter to Sageside standing next to the hull of a ship, near the Carpentry Trainer.
Master Shipwright Huda: Fair winds to you, traveler. A great day for a sail at sea, don't you think?

parts.say: Do you know anything about cinder beetles?

parts.text: Master Shipwright Huda: Cinder beetles? Why, yes, of course! Ever since I was a young boy, I'd use beetle carapaces as makeshift toy boats and float them out on the harbor.
Master Shipwright Huda: I always dreamed of making a full-sized craft out of their shells... but I could never find one large enough. I did manage to make an impressive breastplate, at least.

parts.say: Can you make me a breastplate?

parts.text: Master Shipwright Huda: Ah, that caught your attention, did it? Well, I suppose I could craft you one if you sought out all the proper pieces.
Master Shipwright Huda: For the breastplate, I'd need four cinder beetle carapaces, two of their serrated mandibles, a giant cinder beetle eye, as well as a special varnish.
Master Shipwright Huda leans in close and whispers.
Master Shipwright Huda: Most people try to work the shells like steel, when really they're more like the wood of a ship!
Master Shipwright Huda: For that reason, I use a varnish that's made up of two parts resin, two parts cinder blood, one part fish oil, and some Twilight Bay rum!
Master Shipwright Huda: Old Hult at the Sojourner camp knows how to make the varnish. Just bring him the proper ingredients.
Make a trip to Hult Beetlewrangler and hand him 2x Resin, 2x Cinder Beetle Blood, 1x Crude Fish Oil, 1x Twilight Bay Rum

Hult Beetlewrangler: It's been an age since I made any o' this for Huda! He's the reason I made my first bowl, he is. Gonna make his own ship one day, and ol' Hult is gonna cross the sea on a beetle's back!
Hult Beetlewrangler proceeds to mix the resin, oil, and cinder blood together to form a rich and dark varnish. He guzzles down the rum and lets out a loud belch.
Hult Beetlewrangler: Oof, that hits the spot! Thanks for the rum, boss. You tell Huda that his brother's makin' a big name for himself out here wit' the locals!
You receive 1x Cinder Varnish from Hult Beetlewrangler.
Hand Master Shipwright Huda 4x Cinder Beetle Carapace, 2x Cinder Beetle Serrated Mandible, 1x Giant Cinder Beetle Eye, 1x Special Varnish
Master Shipwright Huda: You've gone and done it... wonderful! I'll get right to work.
Master Shipwright Huda: This shouldn't take long. In fact, I've been looking forward to your return!

Master Shipwright Huda handles the carapaces masterfully, shaping them into protective plates and adorning the eye at the center of the chest. He coats the breastplate with varnish, and the color immediately pops, shining brighter than before.
Master Shipwright Huda: Here you are, friend. A fine piece, if I do say so myself. Thank you for allowing me to hone my skills. It's been far too long since I last dreamt of beetles.
You receive Cinder Beetle Breastplate from Master Shipwright Huda.
Part 1
Read Formal Note you start with as a new Cleric Character:

To whom it may concern,

The Wayfarers Hospice is in need of charitable souls who are gifted with a healing touch.

Please bring this note and your interest to Thibald
Burlond at the Hospice, located in the Travelers
Ward to the north of the city's Western Gate.

Should you find yourself lost, ask one of the guards.
They have likely received our treatment before.

May your journey be blessed.

-The Penitent Knights of the Hospice
Hand Formal Note to Thibald Burlond in the Wayfarer's Hospice north of the West Gate
You gain experience.
Thibald Burlond reads the note, then gives you a welcoming nod.
Thibald Burlond suddenly stands upright, puffing his chest slightly.
Thibald Burlond: Welcome to the Wayfarers Hospice. I am Grand Master Thibald Burlond of the Penitent Knights of the Hospice.
Thibald Burlond: We accept the assistance of all who aid the less fortunate and suffering, regardless of tehir background or beliefs.
Thibald Burlond pauses for a moment, meeting your eyes with his.
Thibald Burlond: We have an impeccable reputation within this city and with its leadership. All we ask is that you do not sully it.
Thibald Burlond: Now, take the note you've given me upstairs to Jiselle Heyley. She will guide you from here.
You receive Formal Note from Thibald Burlond.
Hand Formal Note to Jiselle Heyley upstairs.
You gain experience.
Jiselle Heyley takes the note and carelessly discards it.
Jiselle Heyley: I heard the Grand Master from here, no need for this!
Jiselle Heyley reaches into a pouch on her belt and retrieves a coin, then hands it to you.
Jiselle Heyley: As Thibald said, welcome to the Hospice. It's a kindness you pay us in being here. Thank you.
Jiselle Heyley makes a sweeping gesture with an open hand.
Jiselle Heyley: As you look around, you'll find that we spend most of our time comforting those at their journey's end, particularly those without better means, families, or friends.

Jiselle Heyley: Clerics can alleviate most ailments, but there's no cure for age... at least, none that my conscience will allow me to pursue, lest we find ourselves consorting with the likes of necromancers!
Jiselle Heyley: Well... let's focus on what we can do. Take this and show it to Dalinder. He's in his laboratory.
You receive Penitent Knight's Coin from Jiselle Heyley.
Hand Penitent Knight's Coin to Dalinder Grammanoot downstairs.
Dalinder Grammanoot briefly inspects the coin before leaning forward and sniffing you.
Dalinder Grammanoot: Just getting into town? We do have bathhouses here, you know. Use them if you're going to be coming in here regularly.
Dalinder Grammanoot grabs a bag from a neatly organized pile.
Dalinder Grammanoot: Let's get started. Take this bag. Take your coin. Do not put the coin in the bag. Put the coin in your pocket. Fasten the bag firmly. Do not lose it.

Dalinder Grammanoot: Jiselle is a wonderful human, but they call her gentle for a reason. She has a soft heart... especially for critters. Unfortunately, the work that Milli and I do can occasionally call for hearts, glands, bile ducts, venom sacs, and the like. So, spare her the details, eh?
Dalinder Grammanoot: For now I'm running low on snake venom sacs... but not the fully developed ones, just the immature kind. Fill the bag for me, and I'll go see if Millicent needs anything.
Dalinder Grammanoot: Be careful out there. I hope to see you again soon.
You receive Penitent Knight's Coin from Dalinder Grammanoot.
You receive Dalinder's Bag from Dalinder Grammanoot.
Head to the West Gate Noob Yard and kill a snakes until you receive 6 Immature Snake Venom Sacs. Alternatively you can buy them.
Combine the 6 Immature Snake Venom Sacs in Dalinder's Bag to receive a Bag of Venom Sacs
Return to Dalinder Grammanoot and hand in your Bag of Venom Sacs
You gain experience.
Dalinder Grammanoot: Splendid, thank you!
Dalinder Grammanoot sniffs the air.
Dalinder Grammanoot: Hmm... clearly that was hard work, given the heat and all.
Dalinder Grammanoot sizes you up, then pulls a finely folded tunic off one of the stacks.
Dalinder Grammanoot: You can change into this, though maybe wait until after you've bathed.
Dalinder Grammanoot: Millicent said she needs a few items as well. Here's her list.
Dalinder Grammanoot returns to his work.
You receive Dalinder's Tunic from Dalinder Grammanoot.
You receive Millicent's List from Dalinder Grammanoot.
Part 2 Millicent's List
Read Millicent's List
Items Needed
- Moondew Moss (Often grows in or around wells and is visible at night)
Hint: Investigate the Well outside of the West gate, use the
command,then
command which allows you to acquire the moss.
- Cantharadin (Just bring me 2 Blister Beetle Gland and I'll process them)
Hint: Blister Beetles only spawn during the day time hours.
- Bat Bile from a diseased bat ( Intact Diseased Bat Bile Duct )
Hint: Investigate the area behind the gate through the Red Mantle Keep. Also may be found in the ruins outside of the West Gate, before the entrance to the Tomb of the Last Wyurmsbane.
Once all items have been gathered, return to Millicent Domaire in the Wayfarer's Hospice north of the West Gate.
Hand Millicent's List, Dalinder's Tunic, 2 Blister Beetle Gland, the Intact Diseased Bat Bile Duct, and the Moondew Moss to Millicent Domaire
You gain experience.
Millicent Domaire gathers everything and hands you a fresh tunic.
Millicent Domaire: There we go. I appreciate the assistance.
Millicent Domaire appears distracted for a moment, her eyes fixated on empty space.

Millicent Domaire: I'm... I'm sorry, where are we? Ah, yes... the tunic. Don it, and keep the coin Jiselle gave you on your person. We have a lot of new people arriving these days, so you can use it to indicate your association with the Hospice.
Millicent Domaire: I'm sure I'll need your assistance again soon. In the meantime, please take the opportunity to get to know everyone here.
Millicent Domaire smiles at you and returns her work, though seemingly distracted..
You receive Penitent Knight's Tunic from Millicent Domaire.
Part 1 - The Offering
This part is the same for Cleric, Necromancer, and Shadow Knight.
Starting note in inventory:
Wake, dreamer. The Master has called you into his service. Salvage your meager ambitions and seek the Temple of Ygorath. Deliver this note to Soren Akedd and make the offering.
Hand in the note to Soren Akedd.
Soren Akedd: You have done well to come when called NAME. This is the House of Ygorath, which you may call home, if you are deemed worthy to carry out his work.
You gain experience.
Your faction standing with The Trembling Hand got better.
If you didn't hand him the note, you can still start this quest as so:
Soren Akedd: You appear before me as you were in my nightmare, NAME.
Soren Akedd: Nightmares are visits from Ygorath, gifted upon all the fearful of this land. It was my nightmare that called you here to begin his work.
Either way, you can ask about the work.
Soren Akedd: It is the work of trembling hands to raise both the living and the dead upon his altar. It is for their salvation as much as our own.

Soren Akedd: Many souls walk Eth-up practicing feints of valor, but Ygorath's wisdom knows bravery to be a thin sheen upon a bottomless terror. We must usher them into his kingdom with right fear in their hearts.
Soren Akedd: This you must do, Cleric, whether by sign or by sword. If you pass the test.

Soren Akedd: The rabble carry fear in their blood and their bones. Ours are bourne by Ygorath. This is your test: take this effigy to the chapel and make of it an offering. Place your effigy upon the altar and receive Ygorath's blessing. Return with what remains.
You receive Strange Effigy from Soren Akedd.
Soren Akedd: But I must warn you... cast your gaze downward and look not upon the visage of Ygorath.
Go out the front of the building and take a left. The chapel is very close and has a red glow inside. Go inside, walk all the way up to the altar in front of the statue and
A simple clay bowl rests upon the altar. You dare not raise your gaze any higher, lest you behold the statue looking over the chapel.
Pick up the Strange Effigy in your inventory so that it's on your cursor, then
As the effigy leaves your fingers, it turns to ash without flame.
You receive Offering Bowl.
Take the Offering Bowl back to Soren and hand it in to him.
Soren Akedd: Your eyes are open. Take this drape and rise a new servant of Ygorath.
You gain experience.
Your faction standing with The Trembling Hand got better.
Your faction standing with The Dreaming Dawn got worse.
You receive Tattered Ephod from Soren Akedd.
Soren Akedd: Now go, and do his work. Should you need guidance look for Sister Marwen attending her duties at the chapel.
Part 2 - The Unworthy
Sister Marwen is on the porch of the chapel. She is a cleric trainer.
Sister Marwen: Well met. Spreading the word of Ygorath is not for the faint of heart. Will you accept the duties required of you?
Sister Marwen: We shall see. There are those who shirk their duties.
Sister Marwen stares at you with wide, unblinking eyes.

Sister Marwen: Sometimes the unworthy linger, hoping to regain entry to the temple. Go to the mortuary that overlooks the water and look for those who have abandoned their calling. many still wear the drape of the temple. Reclaim no fewer than four robes and return them to me in this box.
You receive Robe Box from Sister Marwen.

If you head out the tunnel that leads to the city, the unworthy you are looking for are both high and low on the waterfront where the tunnels come out: a craven neophyte, a failed knight, an unworthy aspirant.
Kill them until you get Stained Servant's Robe x4.
Combine them in the Robe Box to get the Full Robe Box.
Hand the Full Robe Box in to Sister Marwen.
You gain experience.
Your faction standing with The Trembling Hand got better.
Sister Marwen: Our duty is to give and to take as Ygorath commands. Take this shield and bear it proudly, no matter what you are called upon to do.
You receive Splintered Servant's Buckler from Sister Marwen.
If you hail her again she says to come back later.
Sister Marwen: Attend to your duties, young one. Return when you are stronger.
Part 3
At level 8 Sister Marwen has the next step for you.
Sister Marwen: Your faith in Ygorath strengthens your resolve, Cleric. Look for Lady Tabitha in the temple and offer her your services. She is an alchemist of some repute.
Lady Tabitha is in the morgue (same building as Soren).
Lady Tabitha hums to herself.
Lady Tabitha: Oh, here's a new on. Who sent you to me? Or have you become a nuisance of your own volition?
Lady Tabitha: Indeed! Each somehow less promising than the last, it seems. No matter. If you can furnish the ingredients I require, I will endorse your aspiration.
Lady Tabitha: Poison and antidote are cut from the same cloth, Cleric. Go and collect as many snake venom glands as this will carry.
You receive Snake Gland Pouch from Lady Tabitha.
Lady Tabitha: Undamaged, if you please.
Need to fufill the Snake Gland Pouch with 8 Deepscale Venom Gland drop from Deepscale Slitherer
Hand Full Snake Gland Pouch you get after the combine
You gain experience.
Your faction standing with The Trembling Hand got better.
Lady Tabitha says I thank you, Cleric. The work continues. Give this letter to Sister Marwen as a sign of your progress.
You receive Alchemist's Reference Letter from Lady Tabitha.
Hand Alchemist's Reference Letter to Sister Marwen
You gain experience.
Your faction standing with The Trembling Hand got better.
You receive Alchemist's Reference Letter from Sister Marwen
Sister Marwen: Splendidly done. Give me the alchemist's letter along with the shield of our order to receive a blessing.
Give both : Alchemist's Reference Letter and your Splintered Servant's Buckler
You gain experience.
Your faction standing with The Trembling Hand got better.
Sister Marwen says Walk in fear, Cleric.
You receive Worn Servant Buckler from Sister Morwen
This quest starts at a shifty gnome, a vendor located in a ruined building just outside of Night Harbor west gate.
a shifty gnome: What can we do for each other, friend?
a shifty gnome: So... you're looking to help a gnome with something?
a shifty gnome: Hmm... You know... I might have some work for you.
a shifty gnome: How about this... I'll give you this pack and you fill it with cloth scraps.
a shifty gnome: Are you interested?
a shifty gnome: Wonderful! Bundle it up once it's full, so you don't lose any scraps.
You receive Shifty's Scrap Pack from a shifty gnome.
Obtain 6 x Cloth Scraps, which can be looted from various humanoid mobs such as ashira or skeletons.
Equip Shifty's Scrap Pack, and place 1 x Cloth Scraps in each slot of the bag and click Combine.
Hand the Bundled Scraps to a shifty gnome for your reward.
a shifty gnome: Splendid! Thank you for the bundle. Here take this as a gesture of my appreciation.
Tattered Cloth=
You receive Tattered Cloth from a shifty gnome.
Pouch=
You receive Pouch from a shifty gnome.
You gain experience.
Maude is located in East Dock, at the top of the stairs opposite the raft, turn left into the casters area
Maude Astarace: What is it?
Maude Astarace: The Delvestone and Deepcut quarrel over rocks, and I wish to know why. Their petty conflict is our good fortune, since the mining company will pay us to reclaim their crystals.
Maude Astarace: Venture into the Darrowdwell mine above the citadel and fill this box with crystals from the Deepcut miners.
"In truth, I care not how you acquire these crystals."
cackles gleefully.
this can be skipped by saying: "research next to her"
Maude will then give you a 8 slot bag
the crystals can be obtained from Darrowdwell mine up in the rafters it is a group area levels 3-5
on obtaining all 8 dull crystals, combining, and returning to Maude:
Maude Astarace opens the box and rummages through it.
Maude Astarace: What is this?
Maude Astarace: These are not diamonds, nor sapphires, nor even jaspers. Lusterless rocks, all!
Maude Astarace: I suppose you have earned some coin for your part. The miners can have their rocks, but something is amiss. Take this to the paymaster along with your guild signet.
Maude Astarace: I do not believe for a moment that the Delvestone would spill their blood or their coin for those worthless rocks. I require your assistance once more, .

Maude Astarace: I must have a sample of whatever mineral lies at the heart of this territorial squabble. Deepcut, Delvestone, Darrowdwell. These are insignificant. Find the thing they fight and die for.
Maude Astarace: Do this, and I will reward you personally.
pt 2 - Find the thing they fight and die for
Handing in Faintly Glowing Crystal obtained from the Deepcut Miners to Maude Astarace she gives you a walking Stick, maybe something to do with ELE/ENC starter quest?
Maude Astarace cackles gleefully.
Maude Astarace: Oh, yes. Something lingers within this crystal... but what? I shall find out. I thank you, . You are most useful. Run along now, for I have much work to do.
Seek out Wyrdguard Oakenpine, who is located across the bridge from the Tanner building in Faelindral.
Wyrdguard Oakenpine offers a firm nod as he greets you.
Wyrdguard Oakenpine: Well met, . Be cautious should you choose to venture into the southeastern cliffs of the Weald. There have been more and more reports of orc sightings as of late.
Wyrdguard Oakenpine: Their entry into the Weald remains a mystery, as both the Wyrdguard and Keepers work to combat the incursion.

Wyrdguard Oakenpine: I am prepared to offer a bounty to any who would aid in the culling of the Fellstone ranks. I will provide some spare gear from the garrison in exchange for any orcish left ear that is brought to me.
Wyrdguard Oakenpine: If you are interested in the bounty, you will be rewarded for every left ear you bring me.
Wyrdguard Oakenpine: Do not waste your effort on the smaller scouts, as they are no true threat. The Fellstone warriors and above are to be your quarry.
You can find Fellstone orcs all over Evershade Weald. The most common early level variant is A Fellstone warrior. Kill several orcs until you have one or more Left Orc Ear.
Hand in 1 x Left Orc Ear to Wyrdguard Oakenpine.
Wyrdguard Oakenpine accepts the grisly token with a smug smile and a nod of satisfaction.
Wyrdguard Oakenpine: Another bounty claimed, well done. Would that I could see their entire blighted presence purged from the beauty of Evershade. Here is your reward.
The above sentence is accurate in-game as of 2026-10-01.
You gain experience.
Faction: Wyrdguard +
Faction: Ardent Keepers +
Faction: Fellstone Orcs -
You receive Tattered Rawhide from Wyrdguard Oakenpine.
Seems to be dialogue missing here. How did we get to this conversation?
Is this a class restricted quest based on previous work done for Njau Hansou?
Njau Hansou is located on the upper deck of the Spellbinder's Spire in Night Harbor.
Njau Hansou: This is not all, however. Are you prepared to receive your other tasks?

parts.say: I am prepared to receive my other tasks.

parts.text: Njau Hansou: Wonderful.

Njau Hansou: I also need you to investigate an ashira camp on the way to the smugglers. I have heard reports that they are attempting to raid the smugglers' camp... I am interested in their intentions. Please bring me any evidence you find.
Njau Hansou glances around before continuing.
Njau Hansou: Again, if you see any inquisitors engaging in suspicious activities, please make note of it. I know it is unlikely, but...
Njau Hansou: ...Do not misunderstand, the inquisitors are our allies. We have received reports that cultists ambushed several of Petra's recruits in the city, which has caused such suspicion.

Njau Hansou: When you are walking about, keep an eye out for movement in the shadows. Should you discover any of these cultists, engage them immediately. It would be of great interest if you could recover anything that might hint at their origins.
Njau Hansou: Keep in mind, this task is separate from your work at the camps.
Kill a cultist in the basement of The Shaded Bloom Inn and loot a Cultist's Insignia Ring.
Return to Njau Hansou and give them the Cultist's Insignia Ring.
You gain experience.
Njau Hansou examines the ring, then places it in his belt pouch.
Njau Hansou: Excellent work. I thank you for bringing this to me. With some thorough investigation, we shall soon know of the cultists' origins.
Njau Hansou: The Spire thanks you.
Any faction hits? Follow-up?
Give 2 Blacktide Orc Earings to Captain Harkan Saafir or his placeholder a landing lieutenant.
You will receive Vial of Snaring Poison and 5 silver as your reward.

Researcher Fairgrove is located slightly above the bank (just a few meters) in the Heartwood Archives. Take the ramp just outside of the bank and use the platform that wraps around the other side of the tree.
Researcher Fairgrove seems to be heavily engrossed with a thick tome of ancient leafpress. She acknowledges you with a nervous stutter.
Researcher Fairgrove: Ah, h-hello, yes. You'll have to e-excuse me, I'm terribly busy with all these... w-writings!
Researcher Fairgrove: O-oh yes, have you not heard? Fellstone scouts have been spotted roaming the Weald and... and w-writing things!
Researcher Fairgrove: T-terrible things, no doubt. I'm doing what I can to a-aid the Wyrdguard by attempting to d-decipher their script, but it's so... s-so very alien.
Researcher Fairgrove: B-be that as it may, I w-would... still greatly appreciate any additional writings of theirs to study, should you happen to come a-across them in your journeys.
Collect Unintelligible Writings from a Fellstone scout in Evershade Weald, then hand them in one at a time to Researcher Fairgrove.
Researcher Fairgrove: T-thank you very much for your assistance! The m-more of these writings I can study, the... the closer I believe I am to uncovering their meanings.
Researcher Fairgrove: It i-isn't much, but here is a little something for going o-out of your way for me.
You gain experience.
Faction: Defenders of Faelindral +
Faction: Citizens of Faelindral +
Faction: Fellstone Orcs -
You receive 25 copper from Researcher Fairgrove.
You receive Partially Translated Report.
The Partially Translated Report is used in Ranger Starter Quest (Faelindral).
This quest begins in the Underdocks eastern district inside the build directly across from the landing raft by speaking with Traven Keldress.
Traven Keldress: Hello there! You look like you're capable of assisting us with some of the bounties we've posted, but choose wisely. We don't want anyone underprepared.
Traven Keldress: There is a standing bounty for the hands of Deepcut bandits, if you are brave enough to face them. Or stupid enough to try. All are welcome!
Traven Keldress: Bring me six Deepcut bandit hands to collect the bounty from our paymaster, Elara.
Turn in six Deepcut Bandit's Hand to Traven Keldress
You gain experience.
Faction: The Descendian Order +
Faction: Citizens of Underdocks +
Traven Keldress: Bravo, >! Give this receipt to Elara to collect your reward.
You receive Deepcut Hand Bounty from Traven Keldress.
Turn in the Deepcut Hand Bounty to Elara Venn, located next to Traven Keldress.
Elara Venn: Here is your reward, >. There are shops across the water if you'd like to spend it!
You gain experience.
You receive 8 silver from Elara Venn.
Was changed to 4 silver per hand in some time recently. (10/06/2026)

quests.title: Diseased Wolf Pelts for Baewyn Mossfang

parts.text: Seek out Baewyn Mossfang, located in the Beastmaster's guild in Faelindral.
Baewyn Mossfang: Hello, friend. Do not let the fierceness of my sister discourage you from visiting the Den. She is right to be upset as she is.
Baewyn Mossfang: Many of the Weald's great wolves have fallen prey to a terrible malady, beset upon them by foul magic.
Baewyn Mossfang: There are many that we cannot cure in time before they throw themselves at travelers or guards.

Baewyn Mossfang: Their hides then rot and decay, spreading the sickness further. Would that I could descend to the forest floor myself, but my duties keep me here and there is no one to go on my behalf.

parts.say: I could go on your behalf.

parts.text: Baewyn Mossfang: Would you be willing to go? I would be indebted to you, .
Baewyn Mossfang: If you are forced to put down any of the mad wolves, bring their infected hides to me for purification. They will be of no use to you for craft or sale otherwise.
Locate and kill a rabid wolf in Evershade Weald to obtain Diseased Wolf Pelt.
Give 1 x Diseased Wolf Pelt to Baewyn Mossfang.
You gain experience.
Faction: Ardent Keepers +
Baewyn Mossfang mutters a solemn prayer to the spirits of the wild, running his palm across the disease-riddled pelt and cleansing it of its sickness.
Baewyn Mossfang: You have my appreciation for this, . My sister is on the hunt for the source, but we must always do what we can to prevent the spread of illness.
Baewyn Mossfang: Please, accept this as a small measure of my gratitude. I am also able to provide cleansing to you if the illness has taken hold.
You receive 75 copper from Baewyn Mossfang.
Initial hail conversations and breadcrumbs are missing here.
Kill all three taskmasters from the Quarry below Foreman Stonehammer.
Each taskmaster will drop a whip. When all three whips are collected, they can be handed in to Foreman Stonehammer.
Kill the Taskmasters!
Kill Taskmaster Feeka and Loot Feeka's Whip.
Kill Taskmaster Gitch and Loot Gitch's Whip.
Kill Taskmaster Urka and Loot Urka's Whip.
Return to Foreman Stonehammer and hand him Feeka's Whip, Gitch's Whip, and Urka's Whip.
Foreman Stonehammer: By Trem's golden beard, you've done it! Good on ya! May their coffers be ever empty!
Foreman Stonehammer: Here, take this as payment. Trem favors the fortunate.
You receive Stone Sack from Foreman Stonehammer.
You receive 10 silver from Foreman Stonehammer.
Faction hits?
Foreman Stonehammer: I've been watchin' them from the ridge. I now know who's leadin' their operations. If you've still got the strength left, we can put them outta business for good.
Foreman Stonehammer: It's a fortunate thing that our paths crossed. Trem despises unfinished work, and we ought t' see this through to the end.
Foreman Stonehammer points out toward the middle of the quarry.
Foreman Stonehammer: Up there, at the summit, is the Onyx Outlaw camp. I've seen the one they all fear... their overseer.
Foreman Stonehammer: No one dares look him in the eye. He's the one holding power over 'em all. He's the one we need to take down.
Foreman Stonehammer: While you were dealin' with the taskmasters, I saw the overseer send out a messenger. Whatever his message was, it's irrelevant. What matters is our message.
Foreman Stonehammer: Go to the summit. Kill the overseer. Bring me his head, and I'll make sure it's disposed of.
Foreman Stonehammer: When his little friends arrive and see what's befallen their operation, they'll know they're not welcome here, and the rest of the hang will scatter to the winds..
Find a goblin overseer on the top of the tallest pillar, and kill him.
Loot the Head of the Overseer from a goblin overseer.
Return to Foreman Stonehammer and hand him Head of the Overseer.
Foreman Stonehammer: Priase the gods! Trem's heavy purse clinks loudly this day!
Foreman Stonehammer: I'm sure the Onyx Outlaws will know it wasn't personal, it's just business.
Foreman Stonehammer: With the overseer gone, the others won't be far behind. Take this, and know you've done a great deed for the Church of Trem.
You receive Stonehammer Maul from Foreman Stonehammer.
Faction hits? EXP? Money?
1 full Yellow Bubble (at what level?)
Earlier in the dialogue, the Foreman mentions the overseer sending out a messenger. Perhaps the Onyx Outlaws storyline continues elsewhere...?
Part 1 - Req. Lvl 1
Read Rolled Leafscroll

CynderR,
We have sensed the draw of the Wyrdgates within your gaze, young one.
We would welcome you to join the ranks of the Wyrdguard in our mission to protect our kin from unseen threats and see them safely across the whole of Aêthoril.
Seek out High Gatekeeper Sylvarya Starviel within the Sentinel's Gaze; our garrison upon Sentinel's Terrace. You'll find it one platform over from the Fae Lift, or across from the Trader's Terrace.
Present to her this letter, and she shall begin your guidance and help you take your first steps towards navigating the penumbral paths.
Fair shades to you,
Commander Elydris Stormbough
1. Ring the bell and take the lift up and make your way to the 'Upper Tier'.
You can find Sylvarya Starveil in the un-named half house on the 'Upper Tier'
Hand Rolled Leafscroll to Sylvarya Starveil.

Sylvarya Starveil accepts the offered letter with a knowing smile and a gentle bow. Her wizened gaze does not settle on yours but instead drifts past your shoulder, as though addressing someone behind you. : Sylvarya Starveil says, "I greet you, whispered one, I am Sylvarya Starveil, the High Gatekeeper of the Wyrdguard,"
Sylvarya Starveil: I am delighted to be the first to welcome you into the Sentinel's Gaze.
Sylvarya Starveil takes your hand in hers and gently places a simple phial into your open palm, her fingers closing around both your hand and the phial.

Sylvarya Starveil: You have been summoned here by our leader, Elydris, because of your promising connection with the spirits of nature. Are you prepared to take the first steps toward becoming a gatekeeper?

parts.say: im prepared to take the first steps

parts.text: Sylvarya Starveil: As a gatekeeper of the Wyrdguard, your role will be to both support and transport your allies through the Wyrdgates.
Sylvarya Starveil: You will find one such gateway here in Evershade Weald, at the base of the northernmost lift that leads toward the caverns inhabited by fae.

Sylvarya Starveil: Your first task will be to help nourish and maintain this gateway. Pour the contents of the phial I gave you into the very center of the circular formation of toadstools that you find there.
Sylvarya Starveil: Once you have poured an offering from the phial, you must then exhibit a moment of patience as you await... a response.
You receive Simple Phial from Sylvarya Starveil.

2. take the lift down at the neighboring platform from where you speak to Sylvarya (Note: guard Galen is standing by the lift; this is not the newbie lift you start at. It is marked as the Pixie Lift on the Faelindral map), and stand in the center of the circle of toadstools
Note: you can see the ring of mushrooms from the platform Sylvarya Starveil is on if you run around it and look at the ground down below if you have trouble finding it
“/pour toadstools (while holding the Simple Phial from Sylvarya)” Note: you need to be right in the center, turn in circles and move to the center and keep trying
You receive Empty Phial.

You pull the stopper and pour out the contents of the phial. Liquid which appears to be simple spring water is swallowed up greedily by the surrounding toadstools, soil and fallen needles. Now all that remains is to await any sort of response... Nothing appears to change so far aside from the odd sensation of being tugged towards the center of this ring of toadstools. You continue to wait patiently...

Your patience is at last rewarded as the pull you feel towards the center of the Wyrdgate grows stronger. A point of light forms at the center of the Wyrdgate; what appears to be the very beginnings of a portal!

The point of light grows no larger than a coin, out of which begins to pour a slow deluge of murky water. This strange fountain must be the reaction that Sylvarya mentioned that you need to take a sample of and return to her.
(while holding the Empty Phial)
You receive Strange Reaction Phial.
You use your now-empty phial to collect a sample of the eerie reaction and press the stopper back into the neck of the bottle.

As soon as you've collected what you need, the small portal from which the water had cascaded closes and stems the flow. The remains of the fountain seep into the forest floor, leaving the Wyrdgate in it's natural, serene state,
4. take the lift back up and return to Sylvarya Starveil.
give the Strange Reaction Phial to Sylvarya Starveil.
You receive Novice Icon of the Gatekeeper.
Sylvarya Starveil holds the phial up to the light and swirls its murky contents. You perceive the faintest furrow of her brow before she returns her attention to something just over your shoulder,

Sylvarya Starveil: I thank you for this, CynderR. We must always be vigilant in our efforts regarding the Wyrdgates, for though they are undoubtedly a great asset to our people, they could also prove to be a great vulnerability if left unchecked.
Sylvarya Starveil: I cannot yet explain the results of your efforts to you, but you have at least taken the first step toward becoming a gatekeeper.
Sylvarya Starveil: Only one who is capable of viewing the Wyrding could have seen this reaction take place, and thus I present to you this icon to symbolize your rank as a novice.
Sylvarya Starveil: I would also have you sent on another task, should you choose to accept it.
Novice Icon of the Gatekeeper
Part 2 - Req. Lvl 1
UPDATE!! Sylwine Brightspirit is not in the Inn. She is in the Well of Order. As the quests states.
You receive Strange Reaction Phial from Sylvarya Starveil.
Sylvarya Starveil: Maintaining the Wyrdgates is our primary responsibility, but it is also our duty to protect our fellow Wyrdguard from any who would see them harm.

Sylvarya Starveil: As gatekeepers, we are the ones who bring them into the fray, embolden them through our magics, mend their wounds, and call upon nature's own wrath to lash out against those who oppose us.

Sylvarya Starveil closes her fist, which briefly alights with a brilliant flame that seems to swirl with majestic faerie hues of red, blue, and violet. She snuffs out the demonstration shortly afterward.

Sylvarya Starveil: Take the phial that you filled earlier to an ally of ours in the Preservers, Sylwine Brightspirit is a brilliant alchemist who currently heads the Well of Order, and she may have some insight as to what it now contains,
Head to the Well of Order, Sylwine Brightspirit is in the front room on the way to the 'Lower Tier'.
Hand Strange Reaction Phial to Sylwine Brightspirit.
You receive Reagent Bag from Sylwine Brightspirit.
Sylwine Brightspirit blinks in surprise as you hand her the strange phial,
Sylwine Brightspirit: From the High Gatekeeper herself? Well, I'd best take a look right away!
Sylwine Brightspirit: Ah, from the looks of that symbol, you're a novice among the gatekeepers. Would you be willing to do me a small favor while I look over the phial?
Sylwine Brightspirit hands you a small bag with various separated pockets, each for carrying different reagents.
Sylwine Brightspirit: The shop is running a little low on some of the more popular reagents. Normally, I have Preservers running around doing this for me, but you have some free time, right?
Sylwine Brightspirit: I need you to find me two royal jellies, two bat wings, and... maybe a couple of bone chips, just in case.
Sylwine Brightspirit: You can put them all in that reagent bag and secure it once you're done. I should have this phial sorted out by the time you return. Thanks in advance!
Sylwine Brightspirit immediately turns her attention to the phial,
Kill a black bat for Bat Wing, a wasp drone for Royal Jelly and a rotting skeleton for Bone Chips.
Combine two Royal Jelly, two Bat Wing, and two Bone Chips in the Reagent Bag.
You receive Full Reagent Bag.
Hand Full Reagent Bag to Sylwine Brightspirit.
You receive Note of Results.
Sylwine Brightspirit looks to be in a dour mood when you arrive, but the sight of your full reagent bag brightens her spirits.
Sylwine Brightspirit: Oh, great, you're back! I thought you might have been that awful rogue who just dropped off a horrible-smelling concoction for me to sort through.
Sylwine Brightspirit: These are fine specimens... and all neatly organized as well! You have my thanks, and, I hope, some answers for your High Gatekeeper.
Sylwine Brightspirit offers you a rolled leafnote.
Sylwine Brightspirit: I put all my findings into that note, but I had to use most of the substance to get any clear results. Where did you say you found that stuff, anyway?
Sylwine Brightspirit: Oh never mind, it's not important. I also included a very important reagent as a measure of thanks for your assistance. I think Sylvarya will appreciate it.
Sylwine Brightspirit: Stop by again if you ever need some potions
the note reads:

High Gatekeeper,
The sample size delivered was quite small, but I was able to determine the source of thedisturbance.
Floral traces corroborate with similar samples that we've received from the Reekbog by our scouting parties. 
The magical nature is also similar to the corrupting presence of the Spiral. 
I hope that you haven't discovered this in the Weald? Please keep me advised.
Spirits preserve you.
-Sylwine
head back to Sylvarya Starveil and give her the Novice Icon of the Gatekeeper and the Note of Results.
You receive Scroll Minor Frostbite and Aspirant Icon of the Gatekeeper.
Sylvarya Starveil: Another task well done. And here you thought they would not succeed.
Sylvarya Starveil gently chuckles to no one in particular. It is clear she was not addressing you with her comment.
Sylvarya Starveil: It appears that Sylwine thought quite highly of your assistance as well. This particular reagent is nigh impossible to find out here in the Weald.
Sylvarya Starveil opens the softly glowing pouch, retrieving what appears to be a preserved beetle eye that emits a glow akin to softly burning embers.
Sylvarya Starveil: Take this eye and scribe this scroll. You shall be able to call upon the embers that reside in the heart of all faeflies to both sear and hinder your foes.
Sylvarya Starveil: I have also taken the liberty of enhancing your icon, as you have proven to be quite resourceful. I believe that you will make a wonderful gatekeeper with the proper guidance.

Sylvarya Starveil: You are now free to explore the Weald for a time, but when you feel you are ready, you may present your icon to Commander Elydris Stormbough as a sign that you have gained my approval,
Rewards:
Scroll Minor Frostbite
Aspirant Icon of the Gatekeeper
Experience
Part 3 - Req. level 4+
Hand Aspirant Icon of the Gatekeeper to Commander Elydris Stormbough.
Commander Elydris Stormbough: Sylvarya speaks highly of your potential, young Gatekeeper. I am glad to have the chance to meet and introduce myself.

Commander Elydris Stormbough: I am Elydris Stormbough, Commander of the Wyrdguard. I have the honor of being a Gatekeeper, much like yourself. Our ability to bring our allies to and from the fields of battle is an invaluable tactic.
Commander Elydris Stormbough: It is a tactic that we must ingrain into younger Gatekeepers as soon as possible. Do you believe that you are ready to learn our ways?
Commander Elydris Stormbough: Then I entrust the delivery of an important letter to you, aspirant. Return to Sylvarya and tell her that you are ready to see the paths.
Commander Elydris Stormbough: You will be guided through the Wyrding itself and witness firsthand what Gatekeepers are capable of.
Commander Elydris Stormbough: Once through the paths, you shall deliver the letter to a human woman named Almina. She shall provide you the means of returning to the Weald.
Commander Elydris Stormbough: Go now, aspirant, and may the shades of the Weald protect you.
She hands you Druidic Leafscroll
Say to Sylvarya Starveil "I am ready to see the paths"

parts.say: I and ready to see the paths

parts.text: Sylvarya Starveil: The commander must have high hopes if she sent you to see the pathways so soon. So be it.
Sylvarya Starveil: Allow me to tether your soul to this place, so that you may use it as an anchor point to return to the Weald.
Sylvarya Starveil: I shall then open a gateway through which you may enter the Wyrding for the first time.
Sylvarya Starveil: Make sure that you have your letter with you. You are to return any response to me when you arrive back in the Sentinels Gaze.
Sylvarya Starveil: Let me know when you are prepared.
Sylvarya will bind your soul.
Sylvarya will teleport you to the Sungreet Strand Druid ring.
Hand the letter to Almina Weepingwind.
Almina Weepingwind: You're an aspirant of the Wyrdguard, yes? I'm Almina of the Circle of Scarce Rains. I welcome you to our grove here in Sungreet Strand.

Almina Weepingwind: Our two orders often exchange correspondence within these sacred places, as they are natural waypoints for those who traverse the penumbral paths. Was that your first time? You look a little queasy!
Almina Weepingwind: You can bring this letter back to your High Gatekeeper, and that scroll should teach you how to return along the same pathways you used to get here.
Almina Weepingwind: Of course, you can always remain here or visit Night Harbor, though the path is quite dangerous being this close to Tel Ekir... so I'd not advise it unless you're confident.
Almina hands you a letter and the Scroll Gate.
Gate to Evershade Weald and hand the letter to Sylvarya.
Sylvarya Starveil: Welcome home, aspirant! Not many can navigate the paths so easily for their first time, though you seem to have had no such trouble.
Sylvarya Starveil: In time, you will learn to bring yourself and others through many such gateways. For now, you will only be able to use the ones that you designate for your own soul.
Sylvarya Starveil: I see you also made contact with the Circle of Scarce Rains. Their current leader was once a resident of Evershade Weald. She would have made a promising Gatekeeper.
Sylvarya Starveil: While our two groups are venturing very different paths, it always helps to have allies who share a love for the balance and the natural order.
Sylvarya Starveil: Now then, the commander will be eager to hear of your return. Go to her and show this token as proof that I have received Almina's response.
Sylvarya hands you Druidic Token.
Hand the token to Commander Elydris Stormbough.
Commander Elydris Stormbough: How was your first foray through the paths, young one? It will not be long before you are able to carry entire scouting parties through the Wyrding.
Commander Elydris Stormbough: That is for a future day, however. For now, we have more pressing matters here at home that require your direct attention.
Commander Elydris Stormbough: Our archers are currently out countering the orc spies, while our fighters fend off the warriors that descend from the cliffsides.
Commander Elydris Stormbough: It shall be your duty to assist our forces by countering the fell magics they utilize through shamanistic rituals.

Commander Elydris Stormbough: Take this satchel and fill it with the broken idols of Fellstone shamans. They attempt to aid their forces from the back lines, but that is where our moonfire can still strike.
Commander Elydris Stormbough: I would advise you to seek out fellow Wyrdguard or other adventurers in your efforts. Return to me once you have sufficiently quelled the orcs' supporting ranks.
Commander Elydris Stormbough: And do not hesitate to utilize your newfound ability to traverse the Wyrding, should the need arise.
She hands you Vine-Strapped Satchel.
Kill a Fellstone shaman until you have x4 Broken Shaman Idol. Combine those in the satchel and receive Full Vine-Strapped Satchel.
Hand the satchel to Commander Stormbough.
Commander Elydris Stormbough: You have performed admirably, young gatekeeper. A force is nothing without proper support, and you have isolated the orcs from theirs.
Commander Elydris Stormbough: These idols reek with the stain of the Spirals, even when broken. Bring them to Sylvarya so that she may continue her investigations.
Commander Elydris Stormbough: Thank you again, [name]. We shall call upon you again soon, I am sure.
She hands you the satchel. Take it to Sylvarya.
Sylvarya Starveil: The instruments of orc rituals carry with them a corruption that lingers, even after their destruction.
Sylvarya Starveil: I will do what I can to cleanse these idols and see if they align with the other elements we have uncovered so far, but you have done well for the Faelewyn today.
Sylvarya Starveil: Please accept these gloves as a measure of thanks, [name]. One cannot be too careful in the handling of such dangerous idols.
Sylvarya Starveil: You may continue to aid those of the Weald for now. I will have one final task for you once my investigations have concluded.
She hands you Sap-Stained Gloves.
Rewards:
Scroll Gate
Sap-Stained Gloves
Experience
If you hail her, she will say the follow:
Sylvarya Starveil: Continue to aid those of the Weald until you feel you are ready to learn more of the Wyrding. Upon such a time, return the gloves to me so that I may gauge your progress.
Part 4 - Req. Level 8+
Hand Sap-Stained Gloves to Sylvarya. She will return them.
Sylvarya Starveil: Your connection to the natural world has grown stronger, aspirant. Verses of your strength sing from you like wind through the reeds.
Sylvarya Starveil: The gloves are yours to keep, of course, though you will also need this lodestone if you are ready to assist in my investigations.
She hands you Lodestone.
Sylvarya Starveil: You have been aiding me from the start, if you were not already aware.
Sylvarya Starveil: The reaction from the Wyrdgate due to the phial you poured, the study of its contents by Sylwine, as well as the message received from Almina of the Circle of Scarce Rains.
Sylvarya Starveil: All were related to a theory of mine; and, upon studying the orcish idols that you last brought me, I have finally reached a conclusion.
Sylvarya Starveil: I can say with confidence that there is a second Wyrdgate located within the Weald. One that is under the control of our enemies.
Sylvarya Starveil: This may be how a portion of their forces have entered the Weald undetected, and as Gatekeepers, it falls on us to close it.
Sylvarya Starveil: Will you use your gifts to aid us in this endeavor, aspirant?
Sylvarya Starveil: If the orc forces have somehow opened a second gate, it means they have enlisted aid from someone capable of connecting to the Wyrding... a feat their kind is incapable of.
Sylvarya Starveil: First we must find the location of this gate, after which we must deal with its creator.

Sylvarya Starveil: I recommend camouflaging yourself with nature's embrace and scouring the areas of Evershade upon which the orcs have made their presence known. Avoid the undead if you choose to do this, as their unnatural gaze can pierce our shrouds.
Sylvarya Starveil: Search for any signs of a circular formation. It need not be a circle of toadstools such as our own gate. Theirs could be made of flowers, stones, or any other natural phenomenon.
Sylvarya Starveil: Once located, you are to place the lodestone within the center of the circle to attune it to its last used destination.
Sylvarya Starveil: Return the attuned lodestone to me once you have done this, and may the shades of the Weald protect you, [name].

Go to the orc valley and make your way to the ramps that lead up from near the spires that spawn skeletons and rabid dogs just near the road out of the zone. Go up the ramp and then turn left. Head to the end of the road on the cliff and you'll see a moss archway drawn onto the cliff face. This is the moss circle.
While standing near the moss circle and with the lodestone on your cursor,
You receive Attuned Lodestone. ***After about 10 seconds three orcs will spawn - run or Gate.
Hand the attuned lodestone to Sylvarya.
Sylvarya Starveil: What do you think? Yes. Yes, I believe so as well.
Sylvarya Starveil: It is as we feared.
Sylvarya Starveil: Not only is there a second, active Wyrdgate, but this one has made two distinct connections between the mires of the Reekbog and the shadows of the Deep.
Sylvarya Starveil: It would be unwise to draw a conclusion from that alone, but the fact remains that we must sever this connection if our forces are to have any hope of reclaiming the cliffs.
Sylvarya Starveil: I entrust this task to you, aspirant, as with your abilities, you should have no trouble temporarily sealing the gateway. You must, however, employ the proper method.
Sylvarya Starveil: Any individual could simply tear away the moss, but this would only provide a short respite. The one who created the gate could return to renew it in short order.

Sylvarya Starveil: What we require is a solution capable of removing the moss completely from the stone and preventing its regrowth. I can create such a solution for you, but I need you to bring me the venom sac of both a wasp and a Mezzatrian widow spider.
You need to kill wasps and spiders for Wasp Venom Sac and Widow Venom Sac. Hand these to Sylvarya.
NOTE: The venom sacs are often found on Cooking Supplies or shady merchants.
Any spider named Mezzatrian can drop it. They can be found on the platform across the broken bridge. (across the fallen log, up the ramp, behind the waterfall, follow bridges)
She hands you Searing Solution.
NOTE: If you fail this part of the quest, simply hand Sylvarya more venom sacs for another solution.
Sylvarya Starveil: Here is the solution you require. Pour this upon the moss to destroy it, but be cautious. Such interference with the gateway is sure to spare the ire of the one who created it.
Sylvarya Starveil: That is the plan, of course. Once you have drawn out the interloper, you must subdue them to prevent them from ever conjuring another Wyrdgate.
Sylvarya Starveil: Lastly, and most importantly, you must place the attuned lodestone once more into the center of the destroyed gateway to seal off the Wyrding completely.

Sylvarya Starveil: Return to me with the used lodestone, as well as any evidence of your victory against the orcs' hired hand. Should you require more of the solution, you will have to fetch me another wasp and widow venom sac.
Go back to the moss circle and, with the solution on your cursor,
After about 10 seconds Muleda Murktoe will spawn. He is a level 13 Druid and casts Lesser Heal, Burning Embers, and Moon Ember.
NOTE: Given that he drops a Reekbog Focus and, noted by Sylvarya's dialogue later, Muleda will likely become a Troll once they are implemented.
Kill Muleda and loot Reekbog Focus.
Stand close to the moss circle and, with the Attuned Lodestone on your cursor,
You receive Used Lodestone. After 10 seconds you'll be teleported to Shallow Shoals as part of the moss gate collapsing.
Return the Used Lodestone and Reekbog Focus to Sylvarya.

Sylvarya Starveil: A druid of the Reekbog was aligned with the orcs? A frightening development, though not entirely surprising. The trolls are notorious survivors, and there could be dozens of reasons as to how they found themselves doing the bidding of the Fellstone Clan.
Sylvarya Starveil: Regardless, you have proven yourself a true Gatekeeper, [name]. You have protected the Weald and safeguarded the pathways just as one should.
Sylvarya Starveil: Here, a token. Brind this along with your aspirant icon to Commander Elydris Stormbough.
Sylvarya Starveil: It is time you are recognized as a full member of the Wyrdguard.
Sylvarya Starveil: We thank you, Gatekeeper [name].
She hands you Druidic Token.
Hand the Druidic Token and Aspirant Icon of the Gatekeeper to the Commander.
Commander Elydris Stormbough: The High Gatekeeper informed me of your mission, [name]. This token must mean that you have returned triumphant. Well done!
Commander Elydris Stormbough: We are honored to have a talent such as yourself among the ranks of the Wyrdguard.
Commander Elydris Stormbough: You have proven yourself beyond the measure of an aspirant and are hereby recognized as Gatekeeper [name]. I present you with this icon as a symbol of your status.
Commander Elydris Stormbough: Faelindral sings to your accomplishment!
She hands you Icon of the Gatekeeper.
Part 1 - Reagent Run - Req. Lvl 1
Read Earth-Stained Note. As a new Druid character in Night Harbor, you will start with one in your inventory.

Greetings wanderer,

The Circle of Scarce Rains invites those in tune 
with nature to gather at our headquarters in 
Saltbreeze Park, located in the center of Night 
Harbor, below Highpoint Terrace and its Great 
guild Hall.

Kindly deliver this note to Rolan Talmula if you 
wish to learn more about our order.

To find your way, remember that our sun, Eth, 
shines its life-giving rays from the east to the west, 
while the ruthless waves of the Twilight Sea crash 
upon the desert sand to the south.

May the merciful Krivea watch over you.
Head to Saltbreeze Park in Night Harbor. The druid guild is the southern building inside of Saltbreeze Park.
Inside of the druid guild, seek out Rolan Talmula. Rolan tends to wander around between the entrance balcony and the first floor.
Give Earth-Stained Note to Rolan Talmula.
You gain experience.
Rolan Talmula squints at the note, then looks up to you with a warm smile.
Rolan Talmula: Ah, you must be the new initiate. Thank you for bringing this note to me. We shall begin your training at once.
Rolan Talmula sizes you up for a moment before handing you a tunic.
You receive Worn Circle Tunic from Rolan Talmula.
Rolan Talmula: As you may already know, one of our duties here at the Circle of Scarce Rains is to maintain the delicate balance we have created here at the gardens.
Rolan Talmula: Nature is not static, it moves like a river. Our goal is not to dam the river, so to speak, but to make sure that we have a place next to it.

Rolan Talmula: Your first task is to collect reagents for the senior members of the guild and learn about the balance of nature while you are at it. Take this sack, fill it with eight bat wings, then collect a fire beetle eye, and bring them back to me.
You receive Sack for Bat Wings from Rolan Talmula.
Head to either West Gate or North Gate and begin hunting A desert bat and a fire beetle.
You can also find a desert bat outside The Concourse of Souls and the Druid Guild in Saltbreeze Park.
You will need 8 x Bat Wing and 1 x Fire Beetle Eye. Killing bats should give you sufficient levels to solo a fire beetle for the eye.
Alternatively, you may find Bat Wing and rarely Fire Beetle Eye for sale on various cooking merchants across Night Harbor, sold by other players.
