Place 8 x Bat Wing in your Sack for Bat Wings and click Combine to create Sack of Bat Wings. The bat wings can be stacked for the combine.
Return to Rolan Talmula and give him your Sack of Bat Wings along with a Fire Beetle Eye.
If you only hand in one item, you get some additional flavor text.
If you only hand in the eye...
Rolan Talmula: It looks like you have found the fire beetle eye, and a fine one at that! However, where is the bag of bat wings? You were tasked with gathering those as well, initiate.
You receive your items back from Rolan Talmula.
If you only hand in the sack of bat wings...
Rolan Talmula: Oh, you have the bat wings. Wonderful. Do you have the eye as well, or perhaps it is in your bag, and you forgot to give it to me?
Rolan Talmula smiles knowingly.
You receive your items back from Rolan Talmula.
Handing Rolan both the fire beetle eye and sack of bat wings...
You gain experience.
Faction: Circle of Scarce Rains +
Rolan Talmula clutches the bag in his gnarled fingers, counting out the bat wings.
Rolan Talmula: ...four pairs and the eye. Very good, you have done well.
Rolan Talmula nods approvingly.
Rolan Talmula: We druids have a duty not just to life, but to death as well. You would do well not to be squeamish about bloodshed, it is part of the natural order.
Rolan Talmula: Krivea teaches us that gratitude for all life is important. We should thank any creature that gives its life, from the tiny insect to the giant beast, whether plant or animal.
Rolan Talmula mutters an incantation over the fire beetle eye.
Rolan Talmula hands you the eye, along with a wooden token.
You receive Blessed Fire Beetle Eye from Rolan Talmula.
You receive Wooden Circle Token from Rolan Talmula.
Rolan Talmula: I have blessed the eye. You, too, will learn this skill in time. Now, go and present the wooden token to Calaada.
Rolan Talmula: Yes, of course. Calaada is on the top floor of the guild, overlooking Saltbreeze Park with her companion, Oakheart.
The next part of this quest requires you to be level 5.
Part 2 - Offerings - Req. Lvl 5

Head inside the Druid Guild. Inside, walk up the ramp in the back of the building two floors. On the second floor, turn left after climbing to the top of the ramp BEFORE the balcony and enter another doorway with a ramp to the third floor. Exit this room to the balcony to find Calaada Acaciathorn at the end of the balcony.
If you are not level 5 or higher when turning in the token...
Calaada Acaciathorn looks at the token, then back to you.
Calaada Acaciathorn: It would seem that you've been training, initiate, but this task requires someone a little more seasoned. Return to me when you're a little more experienced.
Calaada Acaciathorn returns the token with a warm smile.
If you are level 5 or higher when turning in the token...
Calaada Acaciathorn turns over the token in her palm, inspecting it.
Calaada Acaciathorn: Well, it would seem that you've been training. Rolan told me about your work with the bats.

Calaada Acaciathorn: I'd like to formally welcome you to the Circle of Scarce Rains. Our order hasn't been welcoming new members for some time, but our council decided that hiding away in our guild hall wasn't the best way to enact Krivea's will.

Calaada Acaciathorn: The Circle has mostly kept to itself, but I don't believe we should stand idly by while people suffer. Nature encompasses all, and it would behoove us to serve our citizens, just as we cultivate nature.
Calaada Acaciathorn nods as she scratches a notch into the back of the token.
Calaada Acaciathorn: Take this to Aaliyah, she should have another task for you.
You receive Notched Circle Token from Calaada Acaciathorn.

parts.say: Tell me about the Circle of Scarce Rains.

parts.text: Calaada Acaciathorn: The Circle of Scarce Rains has been an integral part of Night Harbor since its founding. It's our duty to bless the fields, so that even in this harsh place, life can flourish.
Calaada Acaciathorn: The merciful Krivea is the patron goddess of the Circle of Scarce Rains. Please feel free to make an offering at the shrine in the lower level of the guild.
Head down one level and locate Aaliyah. She is often found standing near a group of a trainee druid.
Give Aaliyah the Notched Circle Token.
Aaliyah excuses herself from the class as she takes the token.
Aaliyah: Calaada must have sent you. Welcome to the Circle!
You gain experience.
Aaliyah claps her hands enthusiastically.
Aaliyah: We're beholden to this land and its people for many of our duties. Considering that you're not as seasoned as some of the druids here, a task befitting an initiate seems appropriate.
Aaliyah fumbles through her waist pouch.

Aaliyah: Here. Head west, outside the city gates. You'll see a collection of wayshrines along the road toward the Shaded Dunes. Travelers often place candles in the shrines, along with offerings to the guardian spirits that reside within them. Collect the latter in the offering bag and bring them back to me.
You receive Silken Offering Bag from Aaliyah.
Aaliyah: Good luck initiate!
Aaliyah returns her attention to the class.
Aaliyah: Wayshrines can be found all across Aethoril. Travelers often place candles in them, supposedly to appease the spirits who live inside.
Aaliyah chuckles to herself.

Aaliyah: Those of us who tend the roads often collect the offerings from these shrines, not for any material benefit, mind you. There's a certain magic imbued in them that we offer to our goddess, Krivea.
Aaliyah: Life on the road has a mysterious magic to it. I'm sure the Sojourners can attest to this.
Aaliyah: The Sojourners? They're nomads with strong ties to ancient tradition. They protect nature and the spirits of the land, similar to us druids.
Aaliyah: Each Sojourner clan belongs to a frus, or Beast Lord, who presides over them as their patron spirit.
Aaliyah clasps her hands in front of her.
Aaliyah: I hope this information was helpful to you.
Head towards West Gate. Along the roadway leading out from West Gate, you will spot three shrines.
You will need to use
command on each of the 3 shrines followed by
or
. Afterwards, you will have 2 offerings and 1 note.
While you are outside West Gate, be sure to kill A large rat for 1 x Raw Rat Meat for later in the quest. You can often find some for sale on a shifty gnome nearby as well.
Using MUD commands, begin investigating shrines.
Shrine #1:
A crude wayshrine sits along the path, meant to guide travelers at night and provide a place for wayward spirits to rest. Some offerings have been left in front of it.
You gather up the various offerings.
You receive Humble Offering.
Shrine #2:
A crude wayshrine sits along the path, meant to guide travelers at night and provide a place for wayward spirits to rest. Some offerings have been left in front of it.
You gather up the various offerings.
You receive Meager Offering.
Proceeding to the third shrine, you will note something abnormal...
Shrine #3:

A crude wayshrine sits along the path, meant to guide travelers at night and provide a place for wayward spirits to rest. Usually, offerings are left in front of it, but this time, there is only a small note.
Be sure to use
for this shrine...
You gingerly take the note from the shrine.
You receive Crudely Written Note.
Reading the note drops some clues as to its writer. Bearing a signature of "milham" and mention of a dog named Willy, enter West Gate and turn left.
Run past the West Bank and enter the Sojourner's Camp area of Night Harbor. Turn left and walk towards Wayfarers Hospice (Cleric / Paladin guild hall).
Before entering Wayfarers Hospice, turn right and follow the building until you find Milham the Mad and Willy located to the right of the guild hall.
Give Crudely Written Note to Milham the Mad.
Milham the Mad: What's this...?
Milham the Mad looks over the paper before a gap-toothed smile spreads across his face.
Milham the Mad: So, one with a warm heart will help Milham? I have borrowed, yes, for Willy. Please, help! He's been bitten!
Milham the Mad: He won't eat his help! Maybe if you put it in his favorite meat... rat... like they do with the kings...?
You receive Willy's Medicine from Milham the Mad.
Milham the Mad: Meat... meat from the jackals won't do... must be rat, yes, his favorite is rat.
Place 1 x Raw Rat Meat inside Willy's Medicine and combine to create Willy's "Treat".
If you forgot to obtain 1 x Raw Rat Meat before, you can hunt rats outside of West Gate, or buy one from a greedy halfling or a cook nearby.
Be prepared for combat with buffs and full health before turning in Willy's "Treat".
You will need to run to a nearby zone line to avoid killing Willy, as doing so will result in negative faction hits within the city.
When ready, give Willy's "Treat" to Willy.
Willy sniffs your hand for a moment, its tail wagging lazily as it languorously reaches for the food, snatching it up in its mouth.
Willy suddenly starts convulsing, its mouth beginning to foam as it bares its teeth and attacks you!
You receive Sample of Willy's Spittle from Willy.
Make a run for a zone line to drop agro from Willy.
Afterwards, return to Milham the Mad and give him Sample of Willy's Spittle.
Milham the Mad: Willy! No! My sweet boy!
Milham the Mad buries his face in his sleeve, sobbing loudly.
Milham the Mad hiccups, his cheeks and nose red, before reaching a trembling hand into his robes and handing you the offerings.
You receive Returned Offering from Milham the Mad.
Milham the Mad: Thank... thank you. I need an eternity alone now.
You receive Sample of Willy's Spittle from Milham the Mad.
Place the Humble Offering, Meager Offering, and Returned Offering inside the Silken Offering Bag and click Combine to create Bag of Circle Offerings.
Return to Aaliyah at the druid guild in Saltbreeze Park.
Hand Aaliyah the Bag of Circle Offerings along with Sample of Willy's Spittle.
If you only hand in Bag of Circle Offerings...
Aaliyah: Ah, the offerings!
Aaliyah looks at you inquisitively.
Aaliyah: Is something wrong? Did you find something else?
You receive your items back from Aaliyah.
If you only hand in Sample of Willy's Spittle...
Aaliyah looks at the vial with a puzzled expression.
Aaliyah: Do you have the offerings as well?
You receive your items back from Aaliyah.
Handing in both Bag of Circle Offerings and Sample of Willy's Spittle...
Aaliyah takes the offerings with a nod, then squints at the vial.
Aaliyah: Where did this come from?
Aaliyah swirls the vial in her hands.
Aaliyah: From a sick hound, here in the city? That's not good... the disease has already made its way here...
Aaliyah: Quickly, bring the vial to Almina. She's stationed in Sungreet Strand, at the druid rings. She'll know what to do.
You receive Sample of Willy's Spittle from Aaliyah.
Aaliyah pauses a moment before seemingly remembering something, then hurriedly thrusts a package into your hands.
Aaliyah: Tanna made you a new pair of boots for collecting the offerings. You can wear them on your journey to Sungreet Strand... Be careful out there.
You receive Halfling-Made Boots from Aaliyah.
Faction: Circle of Scarce Rains +
You gain experience.
The next stage of this quest requires level 15+.
Part 3 - Req. Lvl 15-17
This section needs further improvement, formatting, and any additional notes such as exp or faction hits and item links.

1) Travel to the druid rings in the south end of Sungreet Strands, same place as your level 16 teleport spell. (A bit after the quarry on your left, head right towards the coast to a copse of trees near a large boulder.)
Hand the Sample of Willy's Spittle to Almina (you are given Imbued Circle Coin)
Almina Weepingwind looks over the bottle.
Almina Weepingwind: Another sick animal... and Aaliyah told you to come to me with this urgently? Hm, this is worrying indeed.
Almina Weepingwind lets out a deep sigh.
Almina Weepingwind: This disease isn't natural, I'm afraid.
Almina Weepingwind: We need to track the source of these horrific acts, or it could affect us all... and even reach the city!
Almina Weepingwind: Search for clues throughout the mountain ranges and near water sources.
Almina Weepingwind: While you look, hold this coin in your palm. It's imbued with a spell that makes it heat up when you're near a strong , tainted source.
Almina Weepingwind: If you find anything, come back to me immediately.

2) Travel to the northwest in SGS to the cliff / ramp up. Follow it past the three towers and bridge towards the garrison / fort where the Pyrmos mercenaries are. Through the fort access the aqueducts (looks like tiny bridge for carrying water) and travel it to the end where two mercenaries stand guard.
As you approach the Gateway to the aqueducts, the metal coin in your possession begins to heat up considerably! This must be what Almina wanted you to find.
You receive Searing Circle Coin.
You may wish to Souldbind here as you will be back.
3) Head back to Almina and turn in the coin.
Almina Weepingwind takes the coin in hand and flinches slightly, conjuring a sphere of water to help cool down the imbued coin.

Almina Weepingwind: It appears that you have successfully tracked down the source of the disease, though I cannot begin to fathom how the aqueducts could have become tainted when they are so heavily guarded.
Almina: Someone, or something, must be capable of slipping past the Pyrmos mercenaries unnoticed.
Almina: We will also be barred access, as the governor has hired the Pyrmos to keep any of the local factions away from such an important piece of Night Harbor's power struggle.
Almina Weepingwind chews her lower lip and then withdraws a sheaf of parchment, scribbling out a note and offering it back to you.
Almina: We will simply have to appeal to the morals of one of the mercenaries posted there. Did you encounter a guard posted at the aqueduct gates themselves?
4) Head back to the same place, and at the end of the aqueducts two mercenaries stand guard, one named. The named is Foldja. Hand her the note and she will hand you back a note.
Mercenary Foldja: Uh? What's this, then?
Mercenary Foldja unfolds the message and scans it quickly, frowning. She rolls up the parchment and returns it to you.
Mercenary Foldja: Sounds like your Almina friend already knows that I can't let you inside, but you're also lucky that you brought this to me instead of someone else.
Mercenary Foldja: The Pyrmos would take offense to any notion that we're failing in our duties, but being stationed at the gateway means I've heard the things that crawl around in the night.
Mercenary Foldja: There are eerie chants and cackles from the crags here at night. Very goblin-like cackles, if you get me.
Mercenary Foldja: I can assure you that nothing gets through this gateway, but I wouldn't be surprised if those Muggrah scamps found a hidden passage on the other side of the mountain.

Mercenary Foldja: The Bloodynose clan nearby are too scrawny and occupied with their war against the ashira clans, while the Muggrah camp just beyond our keep is always under our watchful eye, so I wouldn't be worried about that one.
Mercenary Foldja: No, if I were a betting woman, I'd say that the goblins on the other side of the mountain in the Glass Flats were the ones scaling the cliffs and being a nuisance.
Mercenary Foldja: You can go tell your Almina friend that I said as much.
5) Head back to Almina. Target here and
, earn your satchel, and prepare for Glass Flats goblins.
Almina Weepingwind: Goblins? What motivation would they have to infect the city's water supply? The goblin clans are typically drawn toward acts of greed, not sheer malice.
Almina Weepingwind pauses to ponder for a moment before shaking her head and taking back the letter, handing you a leather satchel in its place.

Almina Weepingwind: That will have to be an investigation for another day, I suppose. If the goblin shamans truly are scaling the mountains and infecting the city's water with their magics, we'll need to create a remedy to counteract it.

Almina Weepingwind: The Muggrah shamans and spiritualists derive their power from covetous forces that they link to their personal possessions. You will have to relieve the shamans of a number of these possessions, so that I can develop a counteragent to deliver back to Night Harbor.

Almina Weepingwind: Take this satchel and do what you must to fill it with the shaman's trinkets. I am not sure what they currently use, be it beads, fetishes, or some other token, but you must fill the satchel all the same.
Almina Weepingwind: Return the filled satchel to me as soon as you can!
6) Head to Glass Flats and kill goblin shamans and spiritualists.
You will want to be level 16 or so and in a full group.
From SGS, enter GF, turn immediately left, and look for goblin camps.
You need to farm 6 Shiny Pyrite Coin
Fill satchel with 6 coins and combine.
Hand in to Almina.
Almina Weepingwind takes a look inside the satchel and raises her eyebrows.
Almina Weepingwind: Coins? I suppose I should not be surprised, given the goblins' beliefs.
Almina Weepingwind: You did well, . Allow me a moment to confer with the spirits on how to best counter this form of magical disease.

Almina Weepingwind closes her eyes as a rush of wind and sand sweeps through the circle of standing stones. Your own connection to natural forces allows you to perceived the faint whispers of Szuur conversing with the skilled druidess, who then suffuses her power into a conjured sphere of floating water and douses the satchel of coins.

Almina Weepingwind continues to concentrate as the cloying sickness that once permeated the satchel begins to abate. Almina nodes and deposits what remains of her conjured sphere into an open flask, then offers it to you.

Almina Weepingwind: Bring this back to Aaliyah so she can treat the waters flowing in from the aqueducts. This is only a temporary solution, but it should at least be sufficient in preventing any further spread of the disease into Night Harbor.
Almina Weepingwind: Thank you, , and may Krivea guide your journey.
You will receive Almina's Remedy. Take this back to Aaliyah.
Aaliyah: You're back! What did I tell you? I knew Almina would know what to do!
Aaliyah: I'll see that this remedy gets delivered straight to the aqueduct's tenders. How bizarre that the goblin clans were involved in all of this.
Aaliyah: We may have to look further into that another day, but for now, you're due for a reward for all your efforts.

The Pinwheel quest is the beginner quest for elementalists, obtained after turning in their starter note to their guild master. The quest takes the player throughout Night Harbor.
Introduction
Upon turning in a humble note to Tenebrim Tam inside The School of the Fourfold Path:
Tenebrim Tam turns to you gruffly, assessing your[sic] a moment, before his expression cracks into a broad smile.
Your faction standing with School of the Fourfold Path got better.
Tenebrim Tam: Welcome to the School of the Fourfold Path! I take it you are here because you wish to train as an Elementalist with our school, no?
Tenebrim Tam claps his broad hand across your shoulders as a boisterous laugh escapes his lips.

Tenebrim Tam: Here at the school, we learn not just about how to use the magic of the elementals, but also to find harmony in our relations with them. As a new member to our school, I would like to present you with our belt!
You receive Fourfold Sash from Tenebrim Tam.

Tenebrim Tam: That belt marks you as a member of our school, and as you increase in rank, we will add emblems to it. Do our guild proud. With that out of the way, I have a task for you, as part of your training.
Tenebrim Tam claps his hands together, and suddenly, several items appear in them with a flash!

Tenebrim Tam: You are to go about the city and provide offerings to some of our invisible helps. Take this pinwheel, it will spin when you are in the presence of a hungry Djinn, in places of proper elemental resonance. You need not do anything with it, it will spin all on its own. Djinn are often housed inside of objects of art, such as statues, because they do not have a physical form. When you find them, place some incense for them from this box. They will offer you a token of their appreciation in the form of a pearl. Place the pearls in this bag, and return it alongside the pinwheel, your belt, and the box. There are four pearls in all to find - one for earth, water, wind, and fire.
You receive A Pinwheel from Tenebrim Tam.
You receive A Box of Elemental Incense from Tenebrim Tam.
You receive Small Velvet Bag from Tenebrim Tam.

ing around you notice:

Do not be startled, <character>, but you have a choice to make, and time is of the essence.

Do you register as a practitioner of mind magic, as the law requires, and then face a lifetime of scrutiny and obedience to some faceless bureaucracy?

Or do you maintain your anonymity, seek out the aid of like-minded beguilers, and chart your own course?

The choice is yours, though we advise you to pursue the latter.

Deliver this note to Master Wincog at his curious goods shop. You'll find it along the long flight of stairs that connects Sageside to Saltbreeze Park. Look for the sign.

And a word of caution: he may not look like much, but as all enchanters know - never trust your eyes.

Vaclav: ...Oh! You gave me your key, you'll need that back.
You receive Silver Key of Candor from Vaclav.
Vaclav: Now... where was I? Ah, yes! The House of Candor is a distributed collective, which means you can find us throughout the realms of Aêthoril.
Vaclav: To preserve our order and, thereby, our personal safety, we excel at acquiring knowledge, making deals, and generally being indispensable.
Vaclav: We can be quite persuasive, so the House has often been called upon to assist with important negotiations... or to gather information to gain the upper hand in such matters.

Vaclav: Do not worry! If you have more of a taste for flash and danger, there's ample opportunity to assist bold adventurers heading into the hither or dither. Personally, though, I'll have none of that. I'd prefer to simply sit here and read.
Vaclav: While we're on this topic. You should speak with Jaakima. He needs assistance with something or other. Just show him the key.

Head downstairs from Vaclav at the top of the tower. Jaakima can be found on the this floor. Exit the tower and turn left, Jaakima is inside the first door on the right. Give him the Silver Key of Candor.
Jaakima: Welcome! It's nice to see a new face.
Jaakima laughs heartily.
Jaakima: That's a joke. We're enchanters, we constantly see new faces... even on the same people.
Jaakima: If Vaclav just sent you, then you probably need more practice before you can assist us. Once you're ready, speak with the twins, Pau and Piia. They'll likely have a job for you.
Jaakima: Oh, and be sure to keep the key with you at all times. You never know when you'll need it.
You receive your items back from Jaakima.
Head down one flight of stairs and you will find Piia and in a room on this floor. Give Piia the Silver Key of Candor.
Piia rolls the key in her palm.
Piia: Very well, if you're ready to assist us, let's get to it.
Piia: First of all, here's your key back.
Piia: We've learned of a shipment arriving via some smugglers who operate from a cove west of the city.
Piia: Pay them a visit. Look inside their tents to see if you can find a small, ironbound crate. However, if you do find it, don't open it. It's very dangerous.

Piia: It's bound for a person of great importance here in the city, so it's likely to be well-hidden until they're ready to smuggle it in. Be sure to inspect anything that seems out of the ordinary within those tents.
Piia: Once you've retrieved it, bring it to Jamee Langris. You'll find him where the bards meet to perform in the Night Market.
Piia: Good luck.
You receive your items back from Piia.

This next part can be done during the day and night. It can be done while invisible, although a smuggler may come and investigate - you can easily run out whilst still invisible. Head to the Smuggler's Camp in Shaded Dunes and enter the second tent from the East. Use
to receive the following message:
Old fishing nets lie inconspicuously piled in the corner of the tent.
Use
to receive the following message:
As you push the nets aside, you discover an ironbound wooden box hidden beneath.
You receive Ironbound Wooden Box.

Head back to Night Harbor and go to the stage in The Night Market. Jamee Langris can be found behind the stage. Give him the Ironbound Wooden Box. (Note you must have your Silver Key of Candor on you or he will ask for identification)
Jamee Langris looks both startled and impressed by the box you have given him.
Jamee Langris: Oh dear, this is quite a surprise! The twins must have sent you.
Jamee Langris: I wasn't certain whether the rumors of its existence were true, but we'll find out soon enough.
Jamee Langris bows slightly.
Jamee Langris: My client will be very, very pleased. In return, please accept this gift to take to Piia.
You receive Finely Wrapped Gift from Jamee Langris.
Head back to the Enchanter guild and give Finely Wrapped Gift to Piia.
Piia claps her hands with joy.
Piia tears open the wrapping to reveal a leatherbound book.
Piia: Well done! Jamee said he'd be able to find this for me. It's a study of human behaviour under stress, written by the physicians of Lymian. Pau and I are quite eager to learn.
Piia: In exchange, I offer you this.
You receive Braided Crystal Ring from Piia.
Piia: Please accept it as a token of my appreciation.
Piia: Take care now, though do visit later. I may have another favor to ask of you.
Braided Crystal Ring
MAGIC UNIQUE NODROP
Slot: NECK FINGER
Class: ENC
Race: ALL
INT: +2 CHA: +1
HP: +5
A ring fashioned from delicate strands of crystal woven together.
Weight: 0.1
Size: TINY
Part 2b - Req. Lvl 1 (Vauquelin path)
If you hand in to Registrar Vauquelin instead of back to Master Wincog:
You gain experience.
Your faction standing with House of Candor got worse.
You receive Rough Cut Robe from Registrar Vauquelin.
Registrar Vauquelin: Ah, I see…
Registrar Vauquelin clears his throat.
Registrar Vauquelin: You have made the lawful choice to register as an enchanter of Night Harbor.
Registrar Vauquelin dutifully writes your name in the large book before him.
Registrar Vauquelin: There, now you are properly registered.
Registrar Vauquelin: You are required by law to wear this robe, as it signifies your registration status with the authorities. Do not dispose of it.
Registrar Vauquelin: Futhermore, you are only permitted to scribe a selection of approved spells. Should you encounter any unsanctioned spell usage, please report it to the Spellbinders at once.
(At this point you can either take the robe to Master Wincog, or keep the Rough Cut Robe robe.)
Upon handing the Rough Cut Robe to Master Wincog:

Master Wincog: Smart choice. As you likely know, being an unregistered enchanter isn't exactly an easy life... But as long as they think you're only capable of party tricks, they tend to leave you alone.
Master Wincog: Now, since you went and registered, you'll need to make an effort to regain the trust of House Candor.
Master Wincog: How about you run some errands for me so that my dear friend Nerlbus can take a break? When you're done, I'll put in a good word for you.
Master Wincog inspects your old robe and lets out a chuckle.
Master Wincog: They're still using that same old scrying spell to track registrants. It's highly inaccurate and easy to remove.
Master Wincog quietly mutters an incantation.
Master Wincog: Here, put on this bag along with your disenchanted robe. Also, take these items for delivery.
Master Wincog: Once you've got them on, let me know that you're ready to go. When you're done, return the filled bag and your robe to me.
(At this point, refer to Part 2a where you reply to Master Wincog.)
Part 3 - Req. Lvl ?
NEED INFO
This quest has two parts, both are dependent on the time of day within the game.

Part 1 of the quest in Shaded Dunes starts at 6 PM game time. If you complete Part 1, the Night Harbor version of Head Researcher Aashir will spawn and remain up until 6 AM game time. He will promptly despawn in Night Harbor at 6 AM. Requiring you to re-complete Part 1, in order to complete the reward turn in. It is recommended to complete Aashir's Journal before completing Part 1 of the quest.

Head Researcher Aashir is only up during the day time. He spawns at 6AM game time and will be attacked by the risen skeletons when they spawn at 6PM game time. Head Researcher Aashir is lower level than the risen skeletons so they will kill him, requiring you to wait until 6PM the next day. If you hail Head Researcher Aashir during the day he will dismiss you.
Completing Aashir's Journal
In Shaded Dunes around the entrance to Ancient Crypt, risen skeletons and cultists spawn promptly at 6 PM game time and will despawn at 6 AM game time. They are on a 7 minute respawn timer.
Kill a cultist until you have looted the following items:
Aashir's Journal
Aashir's Journal Page 4
Aashir's Journal Page 17
Aashir's Journal Page 37
Aashir's Journal Page 42
Aashir's Journal Page 70
Aashir's Journal Page 76
Equip Aashir's Journal into an open bag slot. Add each journal page and click Combine to create Aashir's Journal.
Part 1
Locate Head Researcher Aashir near the Ancient Crypt zoneline in Shaded Dunes.
This can only be started after 6:00 PM game time once the risen skeletons have spawned nearby.
Head Researcher Aashir: Help, get me out of here!

parts.say: I will help escort you out of here.
I will help escort you out of here.

parts.text: After a brief delay, Head Researcher Aashir will start walking through the ruins towards Night Harbor. He does not provide any additional speech at this point of time.
You are to escort him to the far end of the ruins, killing anything along the way. There can be upwards of 3-4 Risen Skeletons attacking him at once.

Plan for a small group to assist in keeping the Risen Skeletons off of Head Research Aashir. If Head Research Aashir dies while being escorted, you will need to wait until 6:00 PM game time the following in-game day to try again.
If there are any Risen Skeletons in the area, Head Researcher Aashir will rush to attack them.
When you have reached the northern end of the ruins, Head Researcher Aashir will stop moving and he will give a brief statement.

Head Researcher Aashir: I thank Tilustra for your assistance! I can make it alone from here. Please go check on my men, then meet me at the tent overlooking the excavation site for the old tomb near Night Harbor.
Head Researcher Aashir will then depsawn from Shaded Dunes and spawn in Night Harbor, on the cliff overlooking the tunnel entrance to Tomb of the Last Wyrmsbane.
Part 2
You will find Head Researcher Aashir on the cliff overlooking the tunnel entrance to Tomb of the Last Wyrmsbane only after a player has completed Part 1 of this quest.
Head Researcher Aashir: H-h-hello... M-my apologies, I'm still trying to calm down after escaping the attack on our dig site.

parts.say: What were you doing at the dig site?

parts.text: Head Researcher Aashir: We've been researching one of the old ruins in the Shaded Dunes. The location is quite interesting, but unfortunately, I lost my journal during the attack.
Head Researcher Aashir: Yes! I likely lost it as I fled. It contained all of my research notes... I'll pay handsomely for it's return.
There is likely some dialogue missing here...

Head Researcher Aashir: I've heard reports of cultists int he nearby hills and stories of foreign cultists making their way into Night Harbor recently. How are we supposed to work in these conditions?
Give Aashir's Journal to Head Researcher Aashir.
You gain experience.
Faction: SCEAS +
Head Researcher Aashir snatches the journal from your hands.
Head Researcher Aashir: You've found my journal! I can't believe this... what amazing luck!
Head Researcher Aashir: You have my eternal gratitude for this. It's not much, but please take this.
Head Researcher Aashir unhooks the hoop form his ear and gives it to you.
You receive Aashir's Earring from Head Researcher Aashir.
Needs actual quest text
Preparation
Are there any breadcrumbs leading up to this, or are these random events which lead to a discovery?
Kill Nizar al-Harith in Sungreet Strand and loot his Bloodied Sickle.
You will need access to a player who has the Grain Cellar Key to open the gates to the room which Fariha bint Nizar is in.
Getting the Shawl
Kill the mobs in the alter room to spawn Fariha bint Nizar. The mobs in the room will attack Fariha bint Nizar. Placeholder is a priestess of Kravvin.
Once Fariha bint Nizar is spawned, turn in the Bloodied Sickle to Fariah.
You receive Fariha's Shawl from Fariha bint Nizar.
Once Fariah gives the Shawl, she will despawn and spawns another NPC who is KOS.
What is the NPC who spawns after turn-in? Faction hits? exp?
Part 1
Read Rolled Leafscroll you start with as a new Fighter Character:

To whom it may concern,

Your martial skill has been noted by the Wyrdguard, and we would be honored to have your strength added to our own.

New protectors are needed now more than ever in this turbulent age, when corruption abounds and shadows threaten the Weald from all sides.

We invite your to bear this letter to [[Captain Vaelric Ironbark]], who resides within the Sentinels Gaze garrison. 

To reach the garrison, follow the signage past the inn and toward the stage ar the Willows Whisper. Climb the main ascent behind the stage to reach the Traders Terrace, then continue up the central ramp and cross the span opposite the tanner.

The local guard can direct you further should you inquire with hem.

                                         Fair shades to you,
                                -Commander Elydris Stormbough

Step by step way : To reach the garrison, take the lift. You can double click on the bell and it will come down. Double click again for it to go up. Go left to the the inn, go up right, right (in a right angle), when you see Pine Brightreed go up left. You'll be on the Traders Terrace, go toward the weapons armor sign and take the ramp on the left of Taelin Goldstem. Take the bridge on your left, go left in the Sentinels Gaze and Captain Vaelric Ironbark will be inside.
Hand Rolled Leafscroll to Captain Vaelric Ironbark in the Sentinels Gaze
You gain experience.
Your faction standing with Wyrdguard got better.
Your faction standing with Fellstone Orcs got worse.
Captain Vaelric Ironbark accepts the scroll and offers you a curt nod. His gaze is stern and piercing as he seems to immediately size up your worth in a heartbeat.
Captain Vaelric Ironbark: Good. The Wyrdguard are in need of strong arms. I'm glad that you've answered the call.
Captain Vaelric Ironbark: I would induct you immediately if I could, but first, we must make sure you're capable of arming yourself before I can entrust you to the field.
Captain Vaelric Ironbark turns your note around and scrawls something on the back before handing it back to you.
Captain Vaelric Ironbark: Take this note to Craftguard Vinebrow at the garrison forge. He'll instruct you further. Dismissed..
You receive Scrawled Leafscroll from Captain Vaelric Ironbark.
Hand Scrawled Leafscroll to Craftguard Vinebrow a few meters away.
You gain experience.
Your faction standing with Wyrdguard got better.
Your faction standing with Fellstone Orcs got worse.
Craftguard Vinebrow snatches the note and scans the contents quickly. Nodding, he trusts a small kit into your hand while gesturing toward the nearby weapon racks.
Craftguard Vinebrow: Take this kit and grab yourself a used blade from the rack, recruit. The Wyrdguard don't carry rusted filth onthe the field.
Craftguard Vinebrow: Once you've chosen a blade, place it in the kit along with the bar of wax to bring out the blade's luster. Show it to me once you've finished.
Craftguard Vinebrow: I'll be here if you have any questions.
You receive Sharpening Kit from Craftguard Vinebrow.
You receive Wasp Wax Bar from Craftguard Vinebrow.
Come closer to the racks and use
You receive Patinated Elven Blade.
Put together the Patinated Elven Blade and the Wasp Wax Bar in the Sharpening Kit.
You receive Tarnished Elven Blade.
Give the blade to Craftguard Vinebrow for the next step.
Craftguard Vinebrow holds the blade aloft and gazes down its length, inspecting your work. After a short moment, he offers a grunt of satisfaction and returns the blade to you.
Craftguard Vinebrow: Your bevel could use some work, but that will comme with practice. You've managed to deburr the edge, and that's the most important part.
Craftguard Vinebrow: A burr folding over the edge of a blade can easily form a chip. A chip can lead to a fragile blade, and a fragile blade can lead to death.
Craftguard Vinebrow: Now, take your weapon and show it to Captain Ironbark. Inform him that you're ready to set out... and don't forget to maintain your equipement!.
You receive Tarnished Elven Blade from Craftguard Vinebrow.
Give the blade to Captain Vaelric Ironbark for the next step.

Captain Vaelric Ironbark accepts the offered blade and gives it one crisp, precise strike through the air. The blade almost hums after being handled by the veteran captain. He then offers it back to you.
You receive Tarnished Elven Blade from Captain Vaelric Ironbark.
Captain Vaelric Ironbark: Well done. You've chosen yourself a suitable weapon. I'm confident now that I can send you to the forest floor.
Captain Vaelric Ironbark: Are you ready for your first assignment ?
You says, "I am ready."
You receive Pouch for Skulls from Captain Vaelric Ironbark.
Captain Vaelric Ironbark: Take this pouch. Descend to the forest floor and rid it of the undead that have recently made a presence there.
Captain Vaelric Ironbark: If you can fill the bag with their shattered skulls, you'll have taken your first step toward becoming a true Wyrdguard and protecting the Weald from unnatural threats.
Captain Vaelric Ironbark briskly salutes you before offering one last piece of advice.
Captain Vaelric Ironbark: ...And don't venture into the ruins, young one. Too many have tried.

From here on, you have two choices. Go back to the starting lift (do not take the lift close to the quest npc) and drop 4 Shattered Skull from Rottings Skeletons roaming in the zone. Or buy them and fuse them in the bundle. Then, give it back to Captain Vaelric Ironbark.
Captain Vaelric sighs in relief as you return with the filled pouch of skulls. He sets it aside with a nod.
Captain Vaelric Ironbark: I was dreading that I may have sent a young warrior to their doom, but you've shown that you can look after yourself out in the Weald.
Captain Vaelric Ironbark: I can now confidently issue you this emblazoned chain as a sign of your induction as a novice of the Wyrdguard.
You receive Novice Chain of the Wyrdguard from Captain Vaelric Ironbark.
Captain Vaelric Ironbark: When you have a little more experience in the field, report yourself to Commander Elydris Stormbough and display your chain shirt to her.
Captain Vaelric Ironbark: She'll proceed with your induction and likely assign you a new task. Shades protect you. Dismissed, novice!
Part 2
(Level 4 is needed) Give your Novice Chain of the Wyrdguard to Commander Elydris Stormbough
Commander Elydris Stormbough inspects the state of your chainmail and nods approvingly. She returns it to you, alongside a rolled note.
Commander Elydris Stormbough: Allow me to introduce myself. I am Elydris Stormbough, Commander of the Wyrdguard, and I humbly thank you for adding your strength to our own.
Commander Elydris Stormbough: As you have no doubt noticed out on the field, the presence of undead and orcs has become egregious. They must be contended with.

Commander Elydris Stormbough: Our scouts are already looking into their source, while the druids counter their foul magic. I am assigning all available fighters to combat this presence through force of arms.
Commander Elydris Stormbough: Are you willing to participate on the front lines?
Commander Elydris Stormbough offers a satisfactory nod.
Commander Elydris Stormbough hands you a note.

Commander Elydris Stormbough: Take the note I have given you to Craftguard Vinebrow. I believe you have already been acquainted, yes? He is to help you improve the weapon that you found in the armoury.

Commander Elydris Stormbough: Once you have had your weapon worked on, return to me for further instruction. If you misplaced your weapon, you will have to inform Vinebrow. Though I pray you do not have to.
Give the note to Craftguard Vinebrow.
Craftguard Vinebrow accepts the note and gives it a quick glance, acknowledging the message with a firm nod.

Craftguard Vinebrow: I hope you've learned by now how important it is to have a proper weapon! Though it appears the commander would like to see you wielding something that isn't just a polished edge.
Craftguard Vinebrow: I think I know what your blade needs, but we're currently running low on ore for smelting. Would you be able to help get me some supplies?
Craftguard Vinebrow: I'll need about four copper bars and two cloth scraps for what I have in mind. Mine it, buy it, smelt it... I don't care how you get it.
Craftguard Vinebrow: Just get everything into that satchel and pack it up neatly before returning to me, along with your blade.
Combine four Copper Bar and two Cloth Scraps in the satchel and hand it back to Craftguard Vinebrow with the Tarnished Elven Blade.
Craftguard Vinebrow: Hmm, good. This should be enough. Give me one moment while I stoke the forge.

Craftguard Vinebrow separates your blade from the hilt and begins heating the worn steel until it becomes molten. He inspects the metal curiously, then gives it a few strikes with his hammer and lets out a grunt of satisfaction.

Craftguard Vinebrow proceeds to similarly heat the copper and incorporate it into your blade, folding the two metals together into an alloy. He then quenches the revitalized blade and reassembles the hilt, wrapping it in the cloth.
Craftguard Vinebrow: Very interesting. You found this in the weapon racks, did you? That steel doesn't normally fuse so well with copper.

Craftguard Vinebrow: I'd love to experiment further with it, but I'm not about to leave one of our young fighters without a blade. Here, you can bring this back to the Commander to show her your equipped.
Craftguard Vinebrow: And don't lose this one! I feel like we can do more with it when the time is right.
Craftguard Vinebrow hands you the Bronzed Elven Blade.
Hand the Bronzed Elven Blade to Commander Elydris Stormbough.
Commander Elydris Stormbough examines your blade and offers a satisfied nod.
Commander Elydris Stormbough: A curious alloy, but that is a discussion for another time. What matters now that it is able to strike at the enemy force quickly and efficiently.
Commander Elydris Stormbough: Here, take your weapon back, along with this satchel.

Commander Elydris Stormbough: You will be part of this strike, fighter. Our fighters have been tasked with engaging the orcish encampments that have sprung up along the southeastern cliffs. Are you ready to participate in the assault?
Commander Elydris Stormbough: Fellstone forces have hidden themselves amongst the cliffs and ruins, so we have not been able to determine their precise location from the heights of Faelindral.

Commander Elydris Stormbough: We suspect they have a talented scout leader who is helping keep their emplacements concealed. You are to locate these camps and assault them until you have drawn out this leader of theirs.
Commander Elydris Stormbough hands you a satchel.
Commander Elydris Stormbough: Fill the satchel with the belts of their warriors, then return it to me along with the scout leader's head and your novice chain.
Combine four Fellstone Warrior's Belts in the satchel to form Full Satchel of Orc Belts and hand it to Commander Elydris Stormbough along with Scout Leader's Head and Novice Chain of the Wyrdguard.
Commander Elydris Stormbough checks the satchel's contents and confirms the orcish equipment, alongside the trophy head. She nods.
Commander Elydris Stormbough: An impressive feat for a novice, well done. The orcs will dare not forget this strike when they attempt to match themselves against the might of the Wyrdguard.
Commander Elydris Stormbough: I had this prepared for you, fighter, as the news of your victory was forseen. Wear it with pride.
You receive Striker's Chain of the Wyrdguard from Commander Elydris Stormbough.

Commander Elydris Stormbough: You are dismissed for now; however, you should take this opportunity to practice your dance with that weapon. I am certain that Vinebrow would be interested in seeing it once it has endured a few more deployments.
Part 1 - Req. Lvl 1
Read Notice of Recruitment you start with as a new Fighter Character:

Recruit:

You are to deliver this note to Fedamius Steele III
in the Steel Talons Garrison to begin your training.

He can be found observing the courtyard from his 
post on the wall above.

If you get lost, ask a guard. Any guard worth their
salt will know his name.

And be quick about it.

-Steel Talons Recruitment
Head to the Steel Talons Martial Academy on the Southwest side of Night Harbor and hand in your Notice of Recruitment to Fedamius Steel III
You gain experience.
Fedamius Steele III: Speak quickly, and don't mince your words.
Fedamius Steele III glares at you before reading the note.
Fedamius Steele III: So, you want to join the Fighter Corps of the Steel Talons? Hmph... you and a few hundred others. What makes you special?
Fedamius Steele III considers you again.
Fedamius Steele III: We'll see if you have what it takes soon enough... Go speak to my sister, Lurinda. Give her your note.
Fedamius Steele III: Now get moving.
Head down to the courtyard and hand in your Notice of Recruitment to Lurinda Steele
You gain experience.
Lurinda Steele: By Porbor's shriveled organ, we've got another one! You would-be recruits are stumbling in faster than copper coin falling from a drunkard's pouch!
Lurinda Steele sizes you up.

Lurinda Steele: But you might not be a complete waste of time. Speaking of a waste of time, take your note to my son Elrind to file. He'll complete your registration at the academy so you can start your training.
Lurinda Steele: While you're at it, tell him to give you the research he's supposed to have finished for me.
Lurinda Steele: You'll find him in the academy's library - if he's not skulking about the entrance to the garrison's tavern again.
Lurinda Steele: MOVE!
Lurinda Steele motions you away.
Head into southern entrance to the academy and hand in your Notice of Recruitment to Elrind Steele
You gain experience.
Elrind Steele widens his eyes in awe.
Elrind Steele: My, don't you look mighty.
Elrind Steele quickly dons a serious expression as he scans the note deliberately.
Elrind Steele: You're wanting to complete your registration at the academy, then. I'm sure you're eager to start your training.
Elrind Steele: Unfortunately, it might be weeks before I can file your application. Mother has tasked me with important research, so I'm very busy. Unless...
Elrind Steele: Maybe we can help each other. If you gather the items for my research, I can expedite your registration. How does that sound? Truth be told, I'd rather stay in the library anyway.
Elrind Steele: Here's the list of items, as well as some charcoal and parchment for the frottage.
You receive Elrind's List from Elrind Steele.
You receive Charcoal from Elrind Steele.
You receive Parchment from Elrind Steele.
Head out the west gate to kill a rotting skeletons, a snakes, and a fire beetles
Keep killing until you receive a Skeleton Jawbone, a Snake Fang, and a Fire Beetle Eye. Alternatively you can buy them.
Then head towards the stone pillar outside of the cave to Wyrmsbane.
when you are standing next to the pillar to receive Frottage of Inscriptions
Return to Elrind Steele and hand him the Frottage of Inscriptions, Skeleton Jawbone, Snake Fang, and Fire Beetle Eye
You gain experience.
Elrind Steele accepts the items with reverence.
Elrind Steele: Welcome to the Steel Talons. I'll file your papers with the others under Status - Currently Alive
Elrind Steele: Here is the research that my mother requested. You're also more than welcome to discard the list I previously gave you, as you'll no longer need it.
Elrind Steele: Come back some time, maybe we'll find a way to help each other again... unless your status changes, of course
You receive Elrind's Research from Elrind Steele.
Return to Lurinda Steele and hand her Elrind's Research
You gain experience.
Lurinda Steele: What took yo uso long? Did Elrind send you on one of his scavenger hunts? Never mind. Don't keep me waiting again.
Lurinda Steele: Take this tunic. It will identify you as one of our trainees.
Lurinda Steele: We practice in the garrison, but true training occurs in the field. And this is where the Steel Talons excel.
Lurinda Steele: That's why our most promising members are sought after by the Night Harbor Guard or the Red Mantles.

Lurinda Steele: The Ashira have been harassing the city's borders and this is as good as an opportunity as ever to support the efforts of the Night Harbor Guard and the Red Mantles, and to distinguish yourself as a competent member of the Steel Talons.
Lurinda Steele: Fill this pack with proof of your assistance in culling the Ashira menace. Their warriors' bracers will do. Let our archers tend to their scouts.
You receive Steel Talon Trainee Tunic from Lurinda Steele.
You receive Lurinda's Pack from Lurinda Steele.
Part 2
Return to Lurinda Steele and hand her Combined 6 Ashira Warrior Bracers
You gain experience.
Lurinda Steele: Things have been moving quickly in Night Harbor lately. Both the City Watch and the Red Mantles are taking recruits all recruits we can muster.
Lurinda Steele: You're not quite there yet, but clearly you have potential. Keep up the good work.
Lurinda Steele: Take this note and your tunic to Fedamius. You're getting a promotion.
Receive Lurinda's Note
Return to Fedamius Steel III and hand him Tunic and Lurinda's Note
You gain experience.
Fedamius Steel III: Hmph... if Lurinda thinks you're worth promoting, then maybe there's more to you than I initially thought.
Fedamius Steel III looks genuinely pleased.
Fedamius Steel III: Take this and wear it with pride. You've earned it, recruit.

Fedamius Steel III: Now, while you've got some downtime, visit the towers along the city's western wall and make yourself known to a captain. It's good for our candidates to get to know their future leadership.
You receive Steel Talon's Recruit Breastplate from Fedamius Steel III.
It is safe to discard Elrind's List.
Delilah is located just outside the left (west) entrance to the newbie area in the Underdocks, standing next to the Guards at the gate.
Delilah: Hi!
Delilah looks around frantically.
Delilah: Have you seen a small and incredibly cute turtle?
Delilah: I have a pet deepshell turtle named Amari.
Delilah: He is usually always by my side, but today, he has decided to wander off.
Delilah: My Pa told me that I could not go past the guards, ever!
Delilah: Could you help me and go find him?

parts.say: I will help you find Amari

parts.text: Delilah: Thank you! Thank you!
Delilah: He is very fond of mushrooms so I would start your search there. I can see a bunch from here.
Delilah: I would go look but I can't. It's too dangerous for me.

Head just ahead and to the left of where Delilah is facing. Exiting the left gate to newbie zone, locate the Green mushroom on the wall towards the Northwest. You will find a small pond with green mushrooms surrounding a a friendly undercap
Standing beside this pool of water is a friendly-looking myconid.
a friendly undercap smiles at you, while holding a small turtle under his arm.
a friendly undercap gently rubs the turtle on the head.
a friendly undercap points to a stack of bone chips near his leg.
Hand a friendly undercap 4 unstacked Bone Chips
a friendly undercap hugs the turtle.
a friendly undercap hands the turtle to you.
You receive Amari from a friendly undercap.
Hand in Amari to Delilah.
Delilah: Amari! I have missed you so much.
Delilah: Never run off like that again!
Delilah: When I first found Amari as a small turtle, he was near a giant, old shell.
Delilah: I have no use for it.
Delilah: Please accept it as a token of my gratitude.
You receive Giant Turtle Shell Shield from Delilah
You gain experience.
Your faction standing with Citizens of Underdocks got better.
Foreman Stonehammer is located on a platform in the north west corner of the quarry in Sungreet Strand, near Sister Elara.
Needs initial dialogue on hail and breadcrumbs.
Foreman Stonehammer: Dhug is one of mine. I mean, he's on the payroll, but we go a ways back.
Foreman Stonehammer: Findin' him shouldn't be too difficult. He'll be easy to spot for one, he's a dwarf, and he's always wearing his lucky charm 'round his neck.
Foreman Stonehammer: The last thing he told me was that he wanted to check out some glint along the north side of the quarry. Find him and send him back to me.
Foreman Stonehammer: If he tries to refuse, let him know I'll dock his pay!
More details required...

quests.title: Fizzle Screwtape's Critical Research
classes: ARC BRD BST CLR DRU FTR INQ MNK PAL RNG ROG SHD SHM SPB

parts.text: Fizzle Screwtape: Who are you, now? Did Tariq send you? I can complete this assignment without oversight, thank you very much.
Fizzle Screwtape: My research is critical to the future of the Silver Ledger, Dwarf. I must find... well, never you mind that.
Fizzle Screwtape: I do have a task that needs doing, however... if you wish to make yourself useful.
Fizzle Screwtape: There's an island across from the harbor that's infested with basilisks. Vile creatures, and much too large. Scour the island and bring back and objects that may aid my research.
proceed to swim to the island directly across from the docks - in the centre of the island is a giant skeleton"
type
at the skull"
The sun-bleached bones of a giant lie scattered in the sand.
type
Sand falls away from the skull's empty cavity as you lift it from the sand. It is heavy and awkward to hold.
proceed to swim back to Fizzle Screwtape and Give Fizzle Screwtape 1x Giant Skull.
Fizzle Screwtape barely lifts the skull in his dainty hands.
Fizzle Screwtape: What am I to do with this? A giant's skull... adolescent, by the looks of it. You can keep it, Dwarf.

Fizzle Screwtape: You're still alive, at least. My previous assistants didn't fare quite as well. Now, get back out there and find something of real worth. I don't care if you have to exterminate every single basilisk to do it. In fact, that might be for the best.
proceed to swim back to the island with the basilisks and kill until you find a rare drop artifact off of a basilisk"
*Note that basiliks cannot be slowed, stunned, charmed.*
swim back to Fizzle Screwtape and Give Fizzle Screwtape 1x Bile-Drenched Artifact."
Fizzle Screwtape mumbles to himself as he examines the much-encrusted object.
Fizzle Screwtape: This might be something, Dwarf, but we can't determine its worth while it's in this condition. I need to clean it with the right implement.
Fizzle Screwtape: Perhaps a sea sponge will do a trick. Hold on to this for now. Find a suitable sponge so that we may continue.
Give Fizzle Screwtape 1x Pristine Sea Sponge and 1x Bile-Drenched Artifact.
Fizzle Screwtape: Aha! So you found one. Nevermind how you got it.
Cheikho: Look around friend! How did you make it this far without dying?
Fizzle Screwtape scrubs the artifact furiously with the sea sponge. As the much and grime slough off, you begin to see strange markings upon the object.
Fizzle Screwtape: See these markings, Dwarf? Like whirlpools. I've seen them before, but I can't recall...
Fizzle Screwtape: Please, fetch me Luum's Giant Glossary from the shelf.
climb up the ladder to the top book shelf"
These shelves are dedicated to history books.
You carefully retrieve the book from the shelf.
receive 1x Luum's Giant Glossary.
give Fizzle Screwtape 1x Luum's Giant Glossary.
Fizzle Screwtape mutters as he flips through the pages of the old tome.
Fizzle Screwtape sighs.
Fizzle Screwtape: It's as I thought. Worthless.
Fizzle Screwtape: I'm afraid your time has been wasted, Dwarf. This artifact is of no use to me.
Fizzle Screwtape: Take the artifact and this report to Tariq. Should you ever find anything of real value, you know where to find me.
receive 1x Fizzle Screwtape's Report.
receive 1x Horn of the Sea.
go outside and upstairs to Tariq the Revealer"
Give Tariq the Revealer 1x Fizzle Screwtape's Report and 1x Horn of the Sea.
Tariq the Revealer: A valuable object, no doubt, but I'm afraid my underling is correct. We have no use for it. You may keep it for yourself, or return it to its rightful owner.
Tariq the Revealer: These markings indicate that the horn belongs to those whose kingdoms once rose from the depths of the ocean... the Sealords.
Tariq the Revealer: Upon the island where you found this artifact stands a ruined pedestal. Place the horn upon it. If one of the Sealords wishes to claim it, you may be rewarded for your trouble.
Tariq the Revealer: Do keep in mind that the Sealords are creatures of the depths. They're likely to spurn the light of Eth.
Swim back to the far side of the island where there is a ruined pedestal in the sand."
A simple pedestal emerges from the sandy shore.
This must be done at night.
The waters begin to stir...
This spawns a giant named Ngakepoto from the water.
give Ngakepoto 1x Horn of the Sea.
receive 1x Sea Giant's Handkerchief.
Leatherworker Vex: You breathe still? Good. Most who come here are already food for what lurks in the shadows.
Leatherworker Vex: I am Vex. I stitch what the Deep provides into something that keeps you alive longer.

parts.say: What is something that could keep me alive longer?

parts.text: Leatherworker Vex: Do you seek protection or purpose? I can give you both if you care to aim above the rest.
Leatherworker Vex: In the caves of the Deep one race has thrived the most. They grow in darkness, they consume death, and they do not break. The myconids.
Leatherworker Vex: Bring me the intact parts of the mature ones, and I will stitch them into armor that protects your flesh.
Leatherworker Vex: I can fashion a coat, leggings, helm and boots.
Fungal Coat
Leatherworker Vex: For the coat, I require three perfect fungus caps, two strong fungus hyphea, and one perfect fungus stem.
Leatherworker Vex: The cap forms the plates, the hyphea binds them, and the stem reinforces the spine.
Hunt a cave myconid and loot 3 x Perfect Fungus Cap, 2 x Strong Fungus Hyphea and 1 x Perfect Fungus Stem. Hand these items to Leatherworker Vex.
Leatherworker Vex takes the items and carefully layers the caps, weaves the hyphea through them, and reinforces the seams with the stem. The armor pulses faintly with bioluminescence.
Leatherworker Vex: It is done. Wear it well. The Deep recognizes its own.
You receive Fungal Coat from Leatherworker Vex.
You gain experience.
Faction: House Velgarrith +
Faction: Citizens of Ail'Vorith +
As a Level 6 Deep Elf Archer on 2026-09-21, my faction for House Velgarrith was set to almost full Indifferent, and I gained 1 blue bar of faction with Citizens of Ail'vorith.
Fungal Helm
Leatherworker Vex: For the helm, I require two perfect fungus caps and one strong fungus hyphea.
Leatherworker Vex: The caps shield the skull, and the hyphea cushions the brow. Do not bring damaged caps; they will crack under pressure.
Hunt a cave myconid and loot 2 x Perfect Fungus Cap and 1 x Strong Fungus Hyphea. Hand these items to Leatherworker Vex.
Leatherworker Vex takes the items and molds the caps into a dome, lines the interior with hyphea, and seals the edges. The helm glows softly.
Leatherworker Vex: Your head and mind are now shielded. Do not let the whispers in.
You receive Fungal Helm from Leatherworker Vex.
You gain experience.
Faction: House Velgarrith +
Faction: Citizens of Ail'Vorith +

As a Level 6 Deep Elf Archer on 2026-09-21, I gained one full bar plus one blue bar from Indifferent to Amicably with House Velgarrith, and I gained a tenth of a blue bar of faction with Citizens of Ail'vorith.
Fungal Leggings
Leatherworker Vex: For the leggings, I require two perfect fungus stems, two strong fungus hyphea, and two perfect fungus volva.
Leatherworker Vex: The stems form the greaves, the hyphea allows movement, and the volva protects the knee.
Hunt a cave myconid and loot 2 x Perfect Fungus Volva, 2 x Strong Fungus Hyphea and 2 x Perfect Fungus Stem. Hand these items to Leatherworker Vex.
Leatherworker Vex accepts the items and shapes the stems into greaves, binds them with hyphea, and caps the knee with the volva. The leggings flex silently.
Leatherworker Vex: This should allow you some protection while still being able to move quietly.
You receive Fungal Leggings from Leatherworker Vex.
You gain experience.
Faction: House Velgarrith +
Faction: Citizens of Ail'Vorith +

As a Level 6 Deep Elf Archer on 2026-09-21, I gained one full bar plus one blue bar from Indifferent to Amicably with House Velgarrith, and I gained a tenth of a blue bar of faction with Citizens of Ail'vorith.
Fungal Boots
Leatherworker Vex: For the boots, I require two perfect fungus volva and two strong fungus hyphea.
Leatherworker Vex: The volva forms the sole, and the hyphea wraps the ankles. Silent tread is the gift of the fungus.
Hunt a cave myconid and loot 2 x Perfect Fungus Volva and 2 x Strong Fungus Hyphea. Hand these items to Leatherworker Vex.
Leatherworker Vex takes the items from you and flattens the volva into soles, then wraps the hyphea around the ankles, and stitches the seams. The boots make almost no sound when set down.
Leatherworker Vex: Tread softly, the Deep rewards silence.
You receive Fungal Boots from Leatherworker Vex.
You gain experience.
Faction: House Velgarrith +
Faction: Citizens of Ail'Vorith +
Any further breadcrumbs when a full set is acquired...?
This quest is currently only available for Deep Elf characters who start in Ail'Vorith.

Barkeep Glior: Blast and bother, another shipment's gone missing!
Barkeep Glior: Twas supposed to be a regular run from here to the Wreck of the Wanderer. Word is, it just vanished outta thin air...
Barkeep Glior: Duval's got his cutlasses out over it. If you can find out what happened, he'll owe you a favor. Just Tell him I sent you and ask about the Ghost Haul.
Go speak to Crowne Duval, up in Captain Jonas Cossa's tent.
Crowne Duval: Hand over your finest treasures and the Cossa pirates will let you sail under our protection.

parts.say: Glinor told me to ask you about the Ghost Haul.

parts.text: Crowne Duval: Ah, so you know that damn haul disappeared?! Captain will have my skin if I don't find out what happened quickly.
Crowne Duval: Care to lend a hand?
ll lend a hand."

Crowne Duval: I can't leave my post right now, so please travel to the Wreck of the Wanderer, straight north of here beyond the Landing. You can't miss the shipwreck, it has a very high mast still rising from the waters. It's where the deal was to take place.
Crowne Duval: Find what's happened there!
Head out to Zaedin's Landing. Head north and there will be a shipwreck near a cluster of rocks.
reveals - This shipwreck appears quite recent. The area is littered with broken crates and bottles, telltale signs of a struggle. Could not figure out a prompt that worked to give more information.
Nearby is Castaway Island. Enforcer Gritjaw spawns within the bungalow on the island. Kill him and loot Crate of Stolen Spices.
Take Crate of Stolen Spices back to Crowne Duval.
Crowne Duval: Excellent, it still smells fresh!
Crown Duval: So some new guys are out there thinkin' they can steal our stuff? Captain needs to hear about it.
Work in progress
6/21/26 - no follow-up noted with any prompts used. Appears to be a faction reward only.

Acquire Warped Scale from a warped fae near druid mushroom circle in Evershade Weald. This item doesn't always drop. a warped fae always spawns at 2AM game time. It will path to the Glinting Hollow zoneline and despawn if left untouched.

Acquire Twisted Scale from a twisted fae up the ramp near the broken undead ruins by the Keeper's Bight zoneline. This item doesn't always drop. a twisted fae always spawns at 3AM game time. It will path to the Glinting Hollow zoneline and despawn if left untouched.

This quest begins in the Underdocks western district inside an inn on the southern rise by speaking with Innkeeper Farda.
Innkeeper Farda: I have good food and safe rooms. Coins are paid up front for a stay or a meal. And keep your animals outside.
Innkeeper Farda: That includes Goblins.
Innkeeper Farda: They make a mess and only cause trouble. I don't work to lose money.
Innkeeper Farda: The dining room is on the second floor. Just head up those stairs behind me and you will smell the food at the top.
Innkeeper Farda: Take a look for yourself. Downstairs rooms if you have fewer coin and upstairs if you have more.
Innkeeper Farda: And do not mind the current layout. The building next door was a... recent acquisition

parts.say: Tell me about your recent acquisition

parts.text: Innkeeper Farda: The tenants next door fell on hard times. I took on their debt and now this entire building is mine.
Innkeeper Farda doesn't have much else to share. Head upstairs and chat with Barkeeper Tull.
Barkeeper Tull: Yes, hail to you too. I haven't much time since I'm ferrying plates up and down these stairs all day.

parts.say: Why are you ferrying plates up and down these stairs all day?

parts.text: Barkeeper Tull: It wasn't so bad before Farda kicked those gnomes out of the unit next door. The kitchen used to be so close, but more rooms to sleep means more coins to keep, so now I'm burning my legs going up and down all day.
Barkeeper Tull: Bad business that. But Farda had her eye on that unit for a while.
Barkeeper Tull: They always thought they could make it big bringing shroom wood above ground but... well, we see how that went.
Tull does not provide much more information, but he does respond to inquiries about his colleagues.
Barkeeper Tull: She owns this inn. Not much humor in her, but she keeps me well employed.
Head outside into the adjacent building and speak with Chef Brigit
Chef Brigit: Are you lost? You don't look like a new server. This is my kitchen and I don't need you sneaking a taste of my meals.
Chef Brigit looks you up and down, unimpressed.
Chef Brigit: Why don't you go in the other entrance and talk to Farda. She can help you.
Chef Brigit: She runs this place. If you need a room, go speak with her. And don't try to bargain with her or she'll raise the prices on you.
Chef Brigit waves her hands at you in an impatient gesture.
Chef Brigit: Off with you now, shoo!
Chef Brigit: Where is that rascal? I have three meals waiting to go upstairs.
You can return to Barkeeper Tull and he responds to an inquiry about Brigit, but doesn't share anything else.
Barkeeper Tull: You'll find her in the kitchen. I try not to spend much time there. It gets too hot for me.
More information is required
Find Takalea Scaletender, located at the tannery in Faelindral.
Takalea Scaletender: Fair shades to you, friend! Have you come to explore the ways of tanning and hide? It's rewarding trade that will have you learning about every facet of Aethoril's beasts.

parts.say: I have come to explore the ways of tanning and hide.

parts.text: Takalea Scaletender: Everything you need to learn the basics of leatherworking should be here at the tannery, from workstations to supplies. Just don't inhale too many fumes from the tanning vats!
Takalea Scaletender: Oh yes! From the thick hide of a monstrous grizzly, to the supple skin of a desert serpent; leatherworkers are capable of taking nature's protection and making it our own.
Takalea Scaletender: Why, even my own attire was fashioned from the scales of young drakelings.
Takalea Scaletender: Caught your attention, did it?
Takalea Scaletender: I've found that drakeling scales have a remarkable protective qualities for their size. I imagine it has to do with their inherent magical nature.
How do we know to ask about materials here?
Takalea Scaletender: That depends... which piece are you interested in? I can fashion boots, a cloak, pants, or a coat for you out of green drakeling parts.
How do we know to ask about the Poison Ducts here?

Takalea Scaletender: The ducts can be rather rare, but they're also quite important for the larger pieces I can make. The poisonous secretions can be turned into a lacquer that gives the scales a real luster!
Green Drakeling Scale Coat
Need dialogue from Takalea here.
Turn in 6 x Green Drakeling Scale, 2 x Green Drakeling Wing, 4 x Green Drakeling Hide, 1 x Green Drakeling Poison Duct to Takalea Scaletender.

Faction: Defenders of Faelindral +
Faction: Citizens of Faelindral +
Takalea Scaletender: Incredible! You really must have put a dent in the drakeling population down there, huh? Let me get to work right away.
Takalea Scaletender expertly fashions the drakeling parts into a beautiful coat that glistens with green scales.
Takalea Scaletender: Here you are friend! I hope it protects you as much as it does me.

Takalea Scaletender carefully fashions the hide and scales into a sturdy green cloak.
Takalea Scaletender: There all done! No adventurer should go without a reliable cloak on their shoulders. It's all yours friend.

Takalea Scaletender carefully fashions the drakeling parts into a set of durable pants.
Takalea Scaletender: There, one set of drakeling scale pants! May they serve you well friend.

quests.title: Growing Threat of the Sangrel Fist

parts.text: Reeve Thurston Winter is located in a building in the center of Penshaw Village. His building is tan stone with a minaret and Red Mantle banners, similar to what you'd find in Night Harbor.
Reeve Thurston Winter: Greetings. I am Reeve Thurston Winter, charged with keeping order in Penshaw.
Reeve Thurston Winter: These are hard times, and what peace we have left is easily broken. We have opened our doors to outsiders willing to help us face a growing threat.
Reeve Thurston Winter: The Sangrel Fist has become a scourge on our roads and farms. They are ruthless thieves emboldened by their numbers, who prey on honest folk who can scarcely defend themselves.
Reeve Thurston Winter: We cannot allow this to continue. Seek them out and then their ranks. They wear red wraps upon their hands. Bring me four as proof.
Head off to kill A Sangrel striker and related mobs until you collect 4 x Sangrel Fist Wraps.
Where are these located relative to the quest giver?
Return to Reeve Thurston Winter and hand him 4 x Sangrel Fist Wraps.
Reeve Thurston Winter: You certainly did your part. Well done. The Sangrel Fist has brought enough fear to this village. Perhaps they'll think twice before entering our gates.
Reeve Thurston Winter: Every bandit brought down is one less threat to our farms and homes.
Reeve Thurston Winter: Take this sigil. Carrying it authorizes you to privileged information, should be needed to defend Penshaw.
You receive Sigil of Inquiry from Reeve Thurston Winter.
Any exp or faction hits?
You can now speak with Detective Brunsworth, located close to Reeve Thurston Winter, to continue the storyline...
Detective Brunsworth: Hail, Adventurer, and well met. I have heard good things about your services in Penshaw.
Detective Brunsworth: I was sent here to investigate the growing threat of the Sangrel. Their numbers have sharply increased as of late. Perhaps you would be willing to dig a little further for us?

parts.say: I will dig a little further.

parts.text: Detective Brunsworth: Very good. We know little of what binds these cult bandits together.
Detective Brunsworth: This type of organization requires leadership. Go to their camps and search for clues. Whether found among their belongings or taken from those who carry them matters little.
Is there more dialogue that can be exposed to explain the rites in the next step?
There are four rites that need to be collected and returned to Detective Brunsworth.
Sangrel Rite I is found off Sangrels at the small sangrel camp next to the poachers.
Need notes on what mobs to kill, directions, etc.
Sangrel Rite II is found of shady farmers at the shady farm.
Need notes on what mobs to kill, directions, etc.
Sangrel Rite III is found in a tent in the large sangrel camp, you will need to use mud commands.
Inside of the tent with the crate...
Where is this tent?
You receive Sangrel Rite III.
Need MUD emotes and responses here.
Sangrel Rite IV is found off sangrels at the large sangrel camp.
Need notes on what mobs to kill, directions, etc.
Return to Detective Brunsworth.
Give Sangrel Rite I, Sangrel Rite II, Sangrel Rite III, and Sangrel Rite IV to Detective Brunsworth.
Detective Brunsworth: How interesting... This text seems to be written in an old tongue.

Detective Brunsworth: We will need an expert to translate its meaning. The abbey outside of Penshaw is home to scribes versed in forgotten tongues. Seek their aid, and when you return with their translation, present your sigil as well so you may be properly rewarded.
Any exp or faction hits for this turn-in?
You receive Sangrel Rites: Volume I - IV from a scribe of Detective Brunsworth.
Brunsworth will direct you to a scribe of Tilustra in the large church to the south of Penshaw.
a scribe of Tilustra: This... is not a devotional text of any tradition we preserve here. I dare not read such things aloud.
You receive Sangrel Rites: Volume I - IV (Translated) from a scribe of Tilustra.

a scribe of Tilustra: Tilustra teaches us that knowledge is meant to illuminate, not corrupt. This text ties selfish desire to divinity... a disturbing teaching, indeed. Take care with whom you share it. There are many easily drawn to such doctrine.
Return to Detective Brunsworth and give him your Sigil of Inquiry and Sangrel Rites: Volume I - IV (Translated).

Detective Brunsworth: This appears to be doctrine... a structure set of rites meant to be memorized by initiates of this cult. It attracts the sort who would rather blame fate than earn an honest living.
Detective Brunsworth: This is no reason to assume any truth in it. If Eyzin has followers, it is because he is persuasive, or because he understands how to manipulate desperate men.

Detective Brunsworth: Their success is far more likely to be practical than divine. Spies within the town, watches along the roads, or a vantage point over our docks. That is where we find answers, not in fire and ash.
Detective Brunsworth: I will gather further intelligence. This investigation is not concluded.
Detective Brunsworth: For now, you have proven capable. Take this. It is a sigil for one worthy of your skill, granted in recognition of your diligence.
You receive Sigil of Honor from Detective Brunsworth.
Any exp hits? Faction hits? Follow-up breadcrumbs from nearby NPCs?
Foreman Stonehammer is located on a platform in the north west corner of the quarry in Sungreet Strand, near Sister Elara.
Needs initial dialogue on hail and breadcrumbs.
Foreman Stonehammer: The miners are already grumbling that there's not enough chow.
Foreman Stonehammer: Hmmm, I think I have an idea that will solve one of our problems and fill our bellies at the same time.
Foreman Stonehammer: Yes, we need more food. I've had to portion out our rations since the shipment is late... but I think I've got an idea that could help us out...
Foreman Stonehammer: Have ya ever had steam crab legs fresh out of the harbor? Delicious aren't they?
Foreman Stonehammer: Well, I've been think'... maybe, just maybe, these cinder beetles are kinda like those crabs.
Foreman Stonehammer: Bring me six tender beetle legs and I'll try cookin' them up for the crew.
Foreman Stonehammer: You know how to tell if the legs will be tender, don't ya?

parts.say: How will I tell if they'll be tender?

parts.text: Foreman Stonehammer: Yes, Yes, it must be tender meat. Old meat is too tough.
Foreman Stonehammer: I'd look for cinder beetles that are younger... smaller... the hardest workers in the swarm. Their legs will have plenty of meat on 'em.
Kill a cinder worker in the Quarry below and loot 6 x Tender Beetle Legs.
Give Foreman Stonehammer 6 x Tender Beetle Legs.
Foreman Stonehammer: Yes, this will do perfectly. Wait here a moment.
Foreman Stonehammer tosses the tender beetle legs into a pot of water.
Foreman Stonehammer stires the pot as the water begins to boil.
Foreman Stonehammer pulls a bright red beetle leg from the pot, cracks it open, and...
Foreman Stonehammer begins to eat the succulent white meat.
Foreman Stonehammer: This is delicious! Ya ought t' try it. Here, and a few copper for your troubles.
You gain experience.
You receive 2x Boiled Beetle Legs from Foreman Stonehammer.
Missing any faction hits or coin gained.
On the docks of Keeper's Bight, in the last ship, you'll find Captain Hale.
Captain Hale: You've picked a fine day to be poking around. You might be able to help me, though. We're in a bit of a bind.
Captain Hale: The storm that blew through last night shook part of the cargo load loose, and the Harbormaster's already been warning us that if we don't recover it, it'll be a disaster.

Captain Hale: We're waiting on our equipment to arrive to we can retrieve it, but my crew feels uneasy about what's been lurking down there. I can't blame them. We all saw their shadows gliding through the waves.

Captain Hale: There's no mistaking it. Great bight sharks have been circling the shallows. Regardless, the cargo was heavy and wouldn't have floated too far. Whatever went over would've settled on the seabed just offshore.
Captain Hale: We estimate we've lost at least five creates. If you're willing to brave the water and bring them back, I'll see you paid for the trouble.
Captain Hale has asked for your assistance recovering five lost crates of goods from the bottom of the bay beneath the dock, which were lost in a recent storm.
The Salvaged Cargo Crate are resting on the bottom of the ocean. These are collected using MUD commands.
Additionally, the crates have a cooldown before they can be looted by another player. You will need to use the MUD
command to confirm if a crate is lootable before attempting to pick it up.
Be mindful, as there are several a great bight shark swimming around the bay, which are level 20-30 and aggressive.
If the crate cannot be looted...
You are in Keeper's Bight.
If the crate can be looted...
A crate rests on the seabed with its cargo still intact.
You wrench the cargo free from the crate, taking everything you can carry.
You receive Salvaged Cargo Crate.
Once you have 5 crates, return to Captain Hale.

Captain Hale: Good work, ! Anything left out there will be split or dragged out by tomorrow. You saved what could be saved. Here, as promised, take this for doing us a solid favor. My crew already looks relieved."
You receive 20 silver from Captain Hale.
Faction: Langsdorfian League +
Faction: Red Mantles +
Faction: Village of Penshaw +
This quest starts at the conclusion of the Ail'Vorith Starter Quest after you receive your Obsidian Shackle.
House Acceptance
Zalethra Drezzorith is located in the Obsidian Academy upper floor. From the bridge and gate into the Foreign Quarter, enter the building straight ahead with caster trainers and go upstairs.
Zalethra Drezzorith: Power and strength, directly leads to standing.
Zalethra Drezzorith: We may be here serving the Shadow and Gods, but it's politics that moves this place.
