Zalethra Drezzorith: Our House is the one that unites Ail'vorith with its beliefs. While we follow the Queen, our dedication lies with the dark gods.

Zalethra Drezzorith: Your shadow is dim, all but extinguished, exiled from a lesser house that was like a flea on a dog's back. Show me your mettle. Solve a minor problem I am dealing with and I will look upon you favorably.
Zalethra Drezzorith: Some castaways, like yourself, deemed themselves important.
Zalethra Drezzorith: Started assembling and gathering arms. Chanting throughout the day and night, praying to lost gods.
Zalethra Drezzorith: To find them, cross the bridge to exit the Foreign Quarter.
Zalethra Drezzorith: From there, turn right and head down the shoreline.
Zalethra Drezzorith: Head past the sporelings and you will find a cave. And within that cave these miscreants.
Zalethra Drezzorith: Strike down these upstart cultists. Show no mercy. Bring me their flesh. Fill this bag with their eyes. You can keep their tears.
Zalethra Drezzorith: Do this or die trying. It matters not to me or my House.
You receive Small Burlap Pouch from Zalethra Drezzorith.

Cross the bridge and turn right at the Toilmaster. Follow the water's edge until your reach a cave full of cultists. Kill an angry cultist, an agitated cultist, a cultist priestess to collect 7 Cultist Eye to fill the bag.
Combine the container into Filled Burlap Pouch and return it to Zalethra Drezzorith.
Zalethra Drezzorith cackles wickedly with delight.
Zalethra Drezzorith: Not bad for an outcast.
Zalethra Drezzorith: You are new in your faith so I would like to present this book to you for further study.
Zalethra Drezzorith: Take this letter and scurry along to House Drezzorith. May the gods provide strength and ruthlessness to your actions.
You gain experience.
You receive Lexicon of Mysteries from Zalethra Drezzorith.
You receive Letter for Alarys from Zalethra Drezzorith.
Faction: House of Drezzorith +
Faction: Citizens of Ail'vorith +
Faction with House of Drezzorith increased to High Indifferent
Faction with Citizens of Ail'vorith increased to High Amicably
Goblin Samples

Alarys Drezzorith is located in a building in the main city of Ail'Vorith, 4th floor, south side... just southeast of the high level Paladin and Cleric trainers. You can see it on the left side standing on the main bridge leading into the city.
style="background:#F5F0E8;padding:10px;"|
Hand Alarys Drezzorith your Letter to Alarys.
Alarys Drezzorith: You've seem to have impressed Zalethra with your dealings against the cultist uprising.
Alarys Drezzorith looks at you coldly.
Alarys Drezzorith: Our house and it's members are of high value in this city.
Alarys Drezzorith: We help and heal the militia, lead the masses to their gods, and coax others on their journey to the Shadow.
Alarys Drezzorith: My lord holds dominion over subjugation. The act of bending others to your will.
Alarys Drezzorith: I have a task. Are you interested?
Alarys Drezzorith: There is a band of Deep Gnomes, across the bridge, conducting experiments on goblins.
Alarys Drezzorith: Reports indicate that they are utilizing secretions from the fungus men on goblin suubjects.
Alarys Drezzorith: This leads to hallucinations, weakening of will, and eventual domination.
Alarys Drezzorith: Seek them out. Gather samples of this concoction.
Alarys Drezzorith: Bring them back to me in this box that will hold the samples.
You receive Empty Sample Box from Alarys Drezzorith.
Alarys Drezzorith: I do not care how you acquire them.
Alarys Drezzorith: Through guile, deception or outright violence. It matters not to me or our house.
Alarys Drezzorith: Go and remember who your serve.
Alarys Drezzorith: For in remembering, you may yet survive for a time longer.
Kill a Deepgulp warrior, a Deepgulp scavenger, a Deepgulp hunter, a Deepgulp berserker to collect 6 Sample of Mind Control Substance and combine them to create Full Sample Box.
(Alternately, you can complete the Thanetal's Samples quest handing in 1 Deep Ale and 10 silver to acquire 6 Sample of Mind Control Substance.)
Hand Full Sample Box to Alarys Drezzorith.
Any faction hits? EXP?
Alarys Drezzorith looks at you intently.
Alarys Drezzorith: I am surprised that you have returned. And so soon.
Alarys Drezzorith: Excellent. Our alchemists can now analyze this mixture and improve upon it.
Alarys Drezzorith: You have done well for a small, insignificant thing.
Alarys Drezzorith: Continue to work hard and your standing may improve.
Alarys Drezzorith calls for a runner. He hands them a box and you hear him whisper something about House Xal'tharn into their ear.
Alarys Drezzorith nods in your direction.
Alarys Drezzorith: Hand me your prayer book so that I may update it.
Hand Lexicon of Mysteries to Alarys Drezzorith.
You receive Intermediate Lexicon of Mysteries from Alarys Drezzorith.
Any faction hits? EXP?
Alarys Drezzorith: I'd like to introduce you to our benefactor. His name is Tal Drezzorith.
Alarys Drezzorith: If you offend him in any way, he will snuff you like a fly.
Alarys Drezzorith: Seek him out and make yourself known.
Continuation - Part 2
Tal Drezzorith is located in the building next to Alarys Drezzorith, directly across from the cleric/paladin guild
Hand the Intermediate Lexicon of Mysteries in to Tal Drezzorith.
Alarys Drezzorith receives your book, flips to a page and writes down several items.
Alarys Drezzorith: I would like you to report to Marshal Xyvher for your next assignment.
You receive Advanced Lexicon of Mysteries from Tal Drezzorith.
Any follow-up breadcrumbs?
This quest starts at the conclusion of the Ail'Vorith Starter Quest after you receive your Obsidian Shackle.
Part 1 - ?
Myal Vehear is located in the Obsidian Academy, 2nd floor.
Myal Vehear closes the ebon colored book that she is reading and slowley turns her gaze to you.
Myal Vehear: And who do we have here? A fresh and eager mind, ready to explore the mysteries of the Planes?
Myal Vehear: The world is but one connected through space to the Planes and Spirals.
Myal Vehear gazes through you, as if peering into the void beyond.
Myal Vehear: I have been taked with seeking out knowledge of the Spirals. Would you like to assist?
Myal Vehear: I would like to supplement my research with that of the Deep gnomes dwelling outside of Ail'vorith.
Myal Vehear: Take this binder. Seek them out and retrieve six of their research pages for me to consider.
Myal Vehear: Consider your actions wisely. By completing this assignment you will pledge yourself to House Hal'kareth.
More information is required...
This quest starts at the conclusion of the Ail'Vorith Starter Quest after you receive your Obsidian Shackle.
Part 1 - A Letter of Recommendation - Req. Lvl 1
Amarah Ith'vayen is located in the front left corner of the first floor of the caster hall in the Obsidian Academy.
Amarah Ith'vayen: House Ith'vayen gathers bits and bobs from all over to provide intelligence to our Queen and the Great Houses.
Amarah Ith'vayen: If an upstart group of exiles needs to be spied upon, we are called.
Amarah Ith'vayen: When a minor House needs to blackmailed to comply, we are up to the task.
Amarah Ith'vayen: Need someone dead and buried, never to be seen again? That's us.
Amarah Ith'vayen: Just don't expect to be able to prove it was us.
Amarah Ith'vayen laughs loudly.
Amarah Ith'vayen: So my pretty kulzzann, do you want to complete a task for me and start earning a seat at our fine table?
Amarah Ith'vayen: Go out and gather myconid parts for us. We use them in various alchemical concoctions and our supply is running low.
Amarah Ith'vayen: Bring me back eight of these and I might think about you for more than a fleeting moment in time.
Amarah Ith'vayen: OH! Tell me when you are ready to go, because I've been dying to try out my new wand.
Amarah Ith'vayen: It is probably safe.
Amarah Ith'vayen: And just like that you are there.
Amarah Ith'vayen: Or a pile of goo!
You do not have to use the teleport to complete the quest.
You are teleported out of the city and to the left across the bridge, up the ramp and to the right (most of the way to the zone safe point).
Upon turning in eight Myconid Parts:
Amarah Ith'vayen: Delightful, just delightful.
Amarah Ith'vayen places the myconic parts on the table behind her.
Amarah Ith'vayen: You're going places. Where those places are is for you to decide. I'm going to provide you with a letter of introduction to House Ith'vayen.
Amarah Ith'vayen: Go see my brother, his name is Aleyz Ith'vayen. Tell him his sister said hello and to watch his back.
Amarah Ith'vayen grins ominously.
You receive a Letter to Aleyz.
You receive a Cloth Belt of Runes.
You receive a Leather Belt of Runes.
You gain experience.
Part 2 - A Letter of Recommendation - Req. Lvl 1
Begins when you turn in a Letter to Aleyz to Aleyz Ith'vayen inside the main city.
Aleyz Ith'vayen: Hah! The nerve of that woman.
Aleyz Ith'vayen: I should have strangled her while she was in the crib as a babe.
Aleyz Ith'vayen: Let me have a look at you.
Aleyz Ith'vayen looks at $n closely.
Aleyz Ith'vayen: There is not much to work with but I shall try.
Aleyz Ith'vayen: I need you to gather some ingredients for one of my projects.
Aleyz Ith'vayen: Bring me one fire elemental stone, three samples of ooze and one whitefish.
Aleyz Ith'vayen makes a sweeping motion.
Aleyz Ith'vayen: Go now and be quick about it.
Bring one Fire Elemental Stone, three Sample of Tainted Water and one Whitefish to Aleyz.
Aleyz Ith'vayen takes the items and approaches his workbench.
Aleyz Ith'vayen: I will mix the ooze you gathered with equal parts water and ammonia.
Aleyz Ith'vayen mixes the items together in a large decanter.
Aleyz Ith'vayen: Next I will heat the mixture in a fire stoked with the fire elemental stone.
Aleyz Ith'vayen places the decanter on top of a large burner and reinforces the flame with the stone.
Aleyz Ith'vayen: Give it a few minutes to heat and combine.
Aleyz Ith'vayen waits several moments and then removes the heated mixture.
Aleyz Ith'vayen: I need most of this for a project that the House assigned me, but I can spare a bit for a personal errand.
Aleyz Ith'vayen fillets the fish and then slathers it in the mixture. He begins to roast it on the burner.
Aleyz Ith'vayen: It smells delightful.
Aleyz Ith'vayen: Are you ready for one more mission?
Aleyz Ith'vayen: Take this cooked fish back to my sweet sister
Aleyz Ith'vayen: Place it nearby without being noticed.
Aleyz Ith'vayen: She never could pass up a meal.
Aleyz Ith'vayen: Return to me once the mission is complete and let me know that the fish has been delivered.
You receive a Roasted and Poisoned Fish.
Return to Amarah Ith'vayen. Stealth behind her and use the MUD commands
Looking around, you notice a table full of documents nearby. You should be able to place the fish here for her to notice.
While holding the Roasted and Poisoned Fish use the MUD command
More information is required...
This quest starts at the conclusion of the Ail'Vorith Starter Quest after you receive your Obsidian Shackle.
Part 1 - Goblin Scalps

Laren is located in the Military Outpost with the melee class instructors. From the bridge and gate into the Foreign Quarter, enter the building across, second on the left (not the bank tunnel). He is on the right, near back of the room.
Laren Drin'dar: Few may join the ranks of the Eternal Martyrs. Have you some skill with blade or bow?

parts.say: I definitely have skill with bow!

parts.text: Laren Drin'dar: Every soldier must be ready for the day when all the Ail'trist are called to war.
Laren Drin'dar considers you for a moment.

Laren Drin'dar: The lesser houses diminish our people by clinging to their fruitless names and petty holdings. If you can prove yourself a true Archer of the Ail'trist once more, I will grant you leave to enter the city as a conscript of House Vael'xirith.
Laren Drin'dar: I would not take you into battle today, were the Enemy at the gate. But every capable soldier will be needed in the days to come.
Laren Drin'dar: Goblins infest the reaches of the Deep. Look for their breeding grounds in the east. Bring me the scalps of their young, enough to fill this pouch.
You receive Scalp Pouch from Laren Drin'dar.
Laren Drin'dar: Do not underestimate them.
Go kill a bunch of goblins and return.

Laren Drin'dar: Ah, a pleasant sight. You have proven to me that you can wield a weapon, and that is more than can be said of many. If you will pledge your fealty to the high lord, Ral Vael'xirith, you may be permitted to enter the city among our ranks, though you will hold no rank or title until it is earned.
Laren Drin'dar: Will you pledge to serve the great house of Vael'xirith?
Laren Drin'dar: It is a sacred oath, Player. When you are called to serve, you shall have a chance to prove your mettle. Until then, you may wear this tunic, which was worn by one who fell in battle.
Laren Drin'dar: You have not seen enough battles, Ranger. Return when you are stronger and you may be of further service to House Vael'xirith.
Faction hits? Follow-up? Reward? Related NPCs?
This quest starts at the conclusion of the Ail'Vorith Starter Quest after you receive your Obsidian Shackle.
Part 1
Vaslir Naiyth is located in the Obsidian Academy. As you enter the academy, she is located near the stairs in the back of the room on the right.
Vaslir Naiyth meets your eyes with a penetrating stare. An involuntary shiver runs through your body. There is a touch of something about her gaze that is not of this realm.
Vaslir Naiyth: [Player], young aspirant. What brings you to this vaslir of House Varros?
Vaslir Naiyth: Does your ambition lead you towards the path of the vaslir?
Vaslir Naiyth: All Airtrist must have ambition if they wish to survive, let alone thrive. We are not like zor'thez cousins, content to frolic in their woods or sit pompously on their mountain.
Vaslir Naiyth shows you a macabre smile.
Vaslir Naiyth: As you have yourself, it is kill or be killed.
Vaslir Naiyth: The work of House Varros can break a lesser mind. Let's put to a little test.
Vaslir Naiyth: There are many species of fungi here in the Deep. I seek a specific kind. Do you think you could find a patch for me? Or is that task beneath you?
Faction: House Varros +
Vaslir Naiyth: Excellent. Those oafs in House Vael'Xirith might care only about your prowess in battle, but in House Varros, we value mental strength.
Vaslir Naiyth: Those with weak minds soon find themselves unraveled by the dark realms that we explore.

Vaslir Naiyth: Here's a test of your perspicacity. There's a book on the shelves next to me, Thelyen's Encyclopedia. It is the most complete compendium of the flora of the Deep. Find the page on Vhelzzil's Vow and tell me what power causes these mushrooms to grow.
Vaslir Naiyth: Go on—look at the bookshelf and open the encyclopedia.
(you need to do
after looking at the bookshelf behind her)

You page through to the entry for Vhelzzil's Vow. It contains a sketch of the mushroom and a detailed description of its appearance. The passage also explains that these mushrooms feed on the remains of beings that were once animated by necromancy. The mushrooms take about a week to appear on the remains of the undead.
You gain experience.
Faction: House Varros +
Vaslir Naiyth gives you the first genuinely warm smile you have seen from her.
Vaslir Naiyth: Indeed. This particular species is nourished by the necromantic energies that linger after an undead body has been disanimated.
Vaslir Naiyth: The anarchic wilds beyond the walls of the Foreign Quarter are rife with walking skeletons that have been dispatched by ambitious young Airtrist such as yourself.
Vaslir Naiyth: Go there and find remains old enough for Vhelzzil's Vow to have sprouted. Put a handful of the mushrooms in this pouch and bring it back to me.
You receive Naiyth's Mushroom Pouch from Vaslir Naiyth.
Collect the mushrooms from the fallen skeleton corpse in the noob yard under that big lit mushroom.
and
Next, she tells you to go collect a "special corpse"

Head out to the noob area and go south like you did when you mined the rocks; go a bit past, and you will find a "Mournful Outcast" (not the Wrathful Outcast, i think thats the SK one, keep going past him, the Mournful Outcast is a little further down). Kill the Mournful Outcast; they will drop a corpse item. take this back to her.

Last part: once you hand in the corpse, she will give you those dried mushrooms you just picked for her. She will hand you a mortar and pestle; grind the mushrooms twice (the first time is coarse, the second is fine). She wants them finely ground. Then return the mortar and pestle, along with the finely ground mushrooms, and you're done. Welcome to House Varros. Here are your introductory letter to Vaslir Vharkith, and a slightly used, but washed set of white robes; now get out.
You can now cross the bridge into the city without getting killed by the guards.
Part 2
Vaslir Vharkith is located near the top of Ail'Vorith proper, next to some other Vaslir NPCs.
Hand in the note to Vaslir Vharkith.

Note: To find this guy, from the FQ, run across the bridge into the city proper. Turn right inside the city gates, go down until you see the bank. Face the bank entrance. Behind you is a large vaulted tunnel opening that leads to the city's interior (docks area); go through it. At the end of the tunnel, turn right and stop. On your right is a building with a teleporter. The ramp is a few steps down the walk; it's dark, and the ramp is easy to miss. Take the teleporter up. Once up top, you will see the octagonal castle-looking place as you walk out of the teleporter building. Turn and look over your right shoulder, and there is a steep incline. go up. Once that levels off, another ledge and buildings are just in front of you. Vharkith is up there. There are two ramps, left and right; pick your path, head up top there, and smack him in the mouth with that letter. Let him know he sucks for wasting 8 hrs of my life walking around the city looking for him.
You gain experience.
Vaslir Vharkith tosses the letter aside without reading it. He speaks in a nasally drawl.

Vaslir Vharkith: Hmm... another hopeful apprentice, is it? Excellent, that last fool Naiyth sent me got herself torn apart by elementals. Or was it vivisected by deep gnomes? It's hard to tell one apprentice from another.
Vaslir Vharkith: So let's see what what we have to work with.
Vaslir Vharkith looks you up and down with disinterested disdain.
Vaslir Vharkith: Well you're a weak looking thing. Do you believe one such as yourself can be of service to me, a vaslir who has dared to speak the Winding Words only to come out stronger?

Vaslir Vharkith: Hmm... so you know how to cleave yourself to power. Good. There may be some honor in helping your ascent. But if you want the patronage of the great Vaslir Vharkith, you will need to prove you are more than just a good judge of character. Let's see how far that ambition can take you.
Vaslir Vharkith: How would you feel about a little quid pro quo? And in the process we will test your mettle a bit.
Vaslir Vharkith: Good. I had a slave, a young Faelewyn, who was going to be used in a summoning. Ah, I had the most exquisite excruciation planned for him: it would have been perfect!
Vaslir Vharkith: Sadly, the creature proved uncommonly clever and escaped while I was at a seminar hosted by the neth'vaslir himself.
Vaslir Vharkith grins at you smuggly.
Vaslir Vharkith: Yes, I am a student of the immortal head of our house himself! Now you are realizing just how beneficial it will be for you to serve one with my connections.
Vaslir Vharkith: To that end, you shall find this escaped slave. Don't bother bringing him back alive. The requisite conjunction for the summoning has passed.
Vaslir Vharkith makes a gesture of acceptance and then straightens his robe.
Vaslir Vharkith: However, there is the matter of some notes which that zor'thez stole from me. Reports are that he was headed towards the Great Cavern Sea. Find him and bring the notes back to me.
Vaslir Vharkith: Do this and you shall have earned my patronage. Hunt well, young one!
Find the Escaped Slave
The escaped Faelewyn slave Vaslir Vharkith is referring to is Laeran Birchshade, a male Wood Elf found near the Great Cavern Sea.
Directions to Laeran Birchshade:
From the entrance to the area, travel south toward the Great Cavern Sea, passing the cultists and continuing toward the waterfall.
Once near the Great Cavern Sea, keep the cavern wall on your left and continue following it. Invisible Deepgulp Goblins can be encountered along this route.
Continue following the wall until you see a small island with Laeran Birchshade standing on it.
Warning: There is an invisible Thug near Laeran which is KOS and may attack unexpectedly. See Invisibility is recommended while approaching the island if available.

Although Laeran Birchshade cons as "Ready to attack", he does not attack on sight. He may either be killed for Vharkith's Research Notes or spoken with instead. Speaking with him also begins a separate optional quest involving the Birchshade Family Bracelet. See Laeran Birchshade for details.
Obtain Vharkith's Research Notes from Laeran Birchshade and return them to Vaslir Vharkith.
Part 3
Return Vharkith's Research Notes to Vaslir Vharkith.
Vaslir Vharkith: My research!
Vaslir Vharkith grabs the pages from you greedily.
Vaslir Vharkith: Senior was sure you'd get yourself killed like the others.
Vaslir Vharkith begins looking over his newly recovered notes.

Vaslir Vharkith: Now, I don't suppose you know what essairyl is? Of course you don't. You'll have to start knowing these things if you expect to become a senior apprentice. Run along to Vaslir Maryn and tell her I need another flask of it.
Vaslir Vharkith: Give her this in exchange.
You receive a bag of Corpse Dust from Vaslir Vharkith.
Speak with Vaslir Maryn
Take the Corpse Dust to Vaslir Maryn.
Vaslir Maryn is located near Vaslir Vharkith in the upper area of Ail'Vorith, standing beside the large fountain. Vaslir Kiannes is also located nearby.
Vaslir Maryn: Karzzul, apprentice. I trust you have a good reason for interrupting my research?
Vaslir Maryn: Corpse dust, is it? I assume that means the idiot sent you and that he needs more essairyl.
Vaslir Maryn: I'm afraid I used up the last of my stock on yesterday's binding.
Vaslir Maryn: You'll have to talk to Vaslir Kiannes... unless you feel like gathering more essences for me.

At this point there are two confirmed routes for obtaining Flask of Essairyl. You may gather elemental essences for Vaslir Maryn, or speak with Vaslir Kiannes and complete his water-sample task instead. You only need to complete one route.
Route A: Gather Essences for Vaslir Maryn
Continue speaking with Vaslir Maryn about the essences.

parts.say: I will gather essences for you.

parts.text: Vaslir Maryn: Yes, we elaborate essairyl from the essences left behind when an elemental is destroyed.

Vaslir Maryn: If you wish to hone your skills somewhat, I suggest traveling beyond the walls of the city and hunting down elementals in the southern part of this cavern. A rogue group of summoners has established a presence there. The type of elementals they are summoning are ideal sources reagents.
Vaslir Maryn: Kill them and harvest four air and four earth essences. Give them to me along with the corpse dust.
Gather the Elemental Essences
You need to collect:
4 Air Essences
4 Earth Essences
Only the Air and Earth elementals are needed for this step. Water elementals can also be found around the shores near Ail'Vorith proper, but they do not provide the essences Maryn requests.
Directions to the elementals:
Travel toward the bridge leading into Ail'Vorith proper.

At the bridge, before you go across to Ail'Vorith proper, turn left/south follow the path which leads to Miral the Dark Elf to and jump down into the moat/water. Swim toward the southern wall of the cavern.
Continue along the south side of the cavern. Air and Earth elementals can be found in this area, along with ghosts and other creatures.
Kill Air and Earth elementals until you have collected four Air Essences and four Earth Essences.
There are also Water elementals along the shoreline surrounding the city. Make sure you are hunting Air Elementals and Earth Elementals for this quest.
Return to Vaslir Maryn
Return to Vaslir Maryn with:
4 Air Essences
4 Earth Essences
the Corpse Dust given to you by Vaslir Vharkith
Hand the essences and Corpse Dust to Vaslir Maryn.
Vaslir Maryn: You return and with the essences. That is a welcome surprise, although competence while in the service of the idiot may not work in your favor.
Vaslir Maryn begins feeding the essences into a series of tubes and glass receptacles. After some time she fills a flask with a silvery liquid and hands it to you.
Vaslir Maryn: You are a promising young elementalist. In the future, should you desire to work for a competent instructor, you know where my laboratory is.
Vaslir Maryn: May you hear, kulzzan.
You receive a flask of Flask of Essairyl from Vaslir Maryn.
Route B: Earn Essairyl from Vaslir Kiannes
Instead of gathering elemental essences for Vaslir Maryn, speak with Vaslir Kiannes.
Vaslir Kiannes is located near Vaslir Maryn and Vaslir Vharkith in the upper area of Ail'Vorith, near the fountain.
Vaslir Kiannes: Karzzul, varsa ai Neth'xan! What brings you to me today?

parts.say: Can you help me get essairyl?

parts.text: Vaslir Kiannes: You want essairyl? I need it for my bindings, and you are obviously not ready to perform a binding of your own.
Vaslir Kiannes laughs heartily.

Vaslir Kiannes: I assume you are one of our dear Vharkith's pawns. He's always sending you poor fellows to ask for the fruits of our labor. I assume you are hoping to trade us some corpse dust for the essairyl, as usual.
Vaslir Kiannes makes a disapproving sound in his throat.
Vaslir Kiannes: Well, I'm afraid my price has gone up. If you want to please your master, you'll have to earn my essairyl.
Vaslir Kiannes: There are a group of deep gnomes near the northern edge of our great cavern. They are conducting experiments on the impurities in the water there.
Vaslir Kiannes nods his head approvingly.
Vaslir Kiannes: Industrious little fellows. Almost a shame to dispose of them. Quite useful, they can be. Yes, indeed. Quite useful.
Vaslir Kiannes: But research needs as they say. Research needs. Bring me some of their water samples. Ten should be enough for my current project.
Vaslir Kiannes: Give me the samples along with the corpse dust, and you'll have your essairyl.
Gather the Water Samples
Travel toward the northern edge of the Great Cavern and locate the deep gnomes conducting experiments on the water.
You need to collect:
10 Sample of Tainted Water
Corpse Dust
This is an alternative to gathering Air Essences and Earth Essences for Vaslir Maryn. You do not need to complete both routes.
Once you have collected ten water samples, return to Vaslir Kiannes with the samples and the Corpse Dust.
Continue the House Varros Quest
After obtaining Flask of Essairyl from either Vaslir Maryn or Vaslir Kiannes, return it to Vaslir Vharkith to continue the quest.
This quest begins in Ail'Vorith in the Obsidian Academy courtyard by talking with Apprentice Esveth. Esveth is located directly across from the academy under a light post.
Apprentice Esveth: Karzzul, I am Apprentice Esveth. My master, Vaslir Naiyth, has tasked me with acquiring raw materials for House Varros.
Apprentice Esveth: I will pay you for ghoul skin, stacks of bone chips, and, of course, corpses.
Bone Chips
Upon handing 1x Bone Chips to Apprentice Esveth...
Apprentice Esveth inspects the bone chip.
Apprentice Esveth: It is of usable quality. However, I only pay for entire stacks. That means 20.
Upon handing 20x Bone Chips to Apprentice Esveth...
Apprentice Esveth inspects the bone chips.
Apprentice Esveth: Yes, we can make use of these. Here is your reward!
You gain experience.
Faction: House Varros +
You receive 25 copper from Apprentice Esveth.
As a level 6 Deep Elf Archer, I received an eighth of a blue bar of experience and 1.25 blue bars of faction with House Varros, setting me to 'indifferent' with House Varros.
Ghoul Skin
More information is required...
Corpses
The corpses Apprentice Esveth is referring to are the Sullen corpse and Mournful Corpse from the deep elf exiles.
Upon handing in either 1x Sullen corpse or 1x Mournful Corpse to Apprentice Esveth...
Apprentice Esveth inspects the corpse.
Apprentice Esveth: This is suitable for our work. Here is your pay
You gain experience.
Faction: House Varros +
You receive xx copper from Apprentice Esveth.
More information is required...faction amount? Copper amount?
This quest starts at the conclusion of the Ail'Vorith Starter Quest after you receive your Obsidian Shackle.
Part 1 - Req. Lvl 2
Xilonen Velgarrith is located upstairs in the martial trainer building
You: “Hail, Xilonen Velgarrith.”
Xilonen Velgarrith: “Karzzul. Looking to become an exile no longer?”
Xilonen Velgarrith: “The House Velgarrith can give you that chance, so long as you’re willing to prove yourself.”
You: “prove myself”
Xilonen Velgarrith: grins wide, revealing a set of charred black teeth.
Xilonen Velgarrith: “Eager, are we? Good.”
Xilonen Velgarrith: “As you’ve no doubt noticed, House Velgarrith is the only reason exiles like yourself are even given the chance to regain your former shadow.”

Xilonen Velgarrith: “We are the Hand of the Deep. A hand that is not afraid to dirty itself, so long as we can profit from it. That includes manipulating and dealing with the x’arana; the lesser races.”
Xilonen Velgarrith: “To that end, I’m going to give you a little test.”
Xilonen Velgarrith: pulls out a plain-looking shell that carries a soft, luminescent interior. He tosses it over to you.
Xilonen Velgarrith: “You ready?”
You receive Cracked Shell from Xilonen Velgarrith.
You: “i am ready”
Xilonen Velgarrith: grins.
Xilonen Velgarrith: “Good.”
Xilonen Velgarrith: “Your goal is to turn that useless shell into something worth at least one whole silver piece. Not an impossible task for someone shrewd and competent.”
Xilonen Velgarrith will give you a [Cracked Shell]
Xilonen Velgarrith: "Travel the foreign quarter and find a merchant who's willing to take or trade that worthless shell in exchange for something of more value."
Take the cracked shell to Cook Vashuk.
Cook Vashuk inspects the shell with one eye much larger than the other.
Cook Vashuk: Splendid! Such fine luster! Fit for the Queen in all Her glory!
Cook Vashuk: What do I have to trade for such a fine piece? Hmm. Ah!
Cook Vashuk grabs an old, rusted cleaver and offers it to you.
Cook Vashuk: A fine blade to pay for such a fine shell. The Shadow blesses me this day!
You receive [Rusted Cleaver] from Cook Vashuk.
Take the [Rusted Cleaver] and hand it in to Xilonen Velgarrith.
Xilonen Velgarrith narrows his eyes.
Xilonen Velgarrith: You think this is worth at least one silver piece? Not even close, exile.
Xilonen Velgarrith: You're going to need to try harder than that to earn a profit around here. Or maybe you're just not Velgarrith material.
You receive your items back from Xilonen Velgarrith.
Kulzzara inspects the cleaver with a look of disgust.
Kulzzara: Where did you find this hunk of scrap? Listen, I can tell that you're desperate, so I'll cut you a deal.
Kulzzara produces a shoddy dagger which she offers to you.
Kulzzara: A client dropped this off earlier. Apparently the blade is hot, meaning it was recently used in an assassination.
Kulzzara: I don't want Xal'tharn inspectors breathing down my neck about it, so it's all yours and no longer my problem.
Kulzzara: Now get lost!
You receive Shoddy Dagger from Kulzzara.
Xilonen Velgarrith spins the dagger on a finger and then hands it back to you.
Xilonen Velgarrith: Not quite there yet, exile. I'd say it might be worth half a silver on the best of days. I'm sure that you can do better.
You receive your items back from Xilonen Velgarrith.
Supplier Jul eyes the dagger sharply.
Supplier Jul: You know what? I think I do have a use for something like that.
Supplier Jul: Here. In exhange you can have...
Supplier Jul produces a spool of spider's silk.
Supplier Jul: Hard to come by in these parts, but I'm willing to part with it to get my hands on a useful blade right about now.
You receive Spool of Spider Silk from Supplier Jul.
Xilonen Velgarrith gauges the silk and offers a begrudging shrug.
Xilonen Velgarrith: Not an impressive haul, but I suppose this does meet the threshold I set for you. If only just.
Xilonen Velgarrith: I probably shouldn't have expected too much from someone straight out of the quarry, but I think you're still capable enough to be honed into something more potent.
Xilonen Velgarrith: So with that said, are you ready to move on to the second part of your test?
Xilonen Velgarrith grins.
Xilonen Velgarrith: What, did I forget to mention this was a two-parter?
Your faction standing with House Velgarrith got better.
You say in Deep Common, "move to the second part of the quest"
Xilonen Velgarrith shrugs casually.
Xilonen Velgarrith: You've shown that you have at least some drive and guile, but the Hand of the Deep must also be able to maintain a firm hold over what is ours.
Xilonen Velgarrith: Velgarrith mercenary forces rival that of any other military, so part two is a much more straightforward one: a test of your combat ability.
PART 2:
Xilonen Velgarrith: Our smugglers have been complaining that the thresher population near the harbors of the foreign quarter have been disrupting their routes.
Xilonen Velgarrith: Show me that you can brave the waters of the Deep and bring me four juvenile thresher fins.
Xilonen Velgarrith: And try not to become just another floating corpse.
Kill Juvenile Sharks - in water around the bridge for foreign district etc. Loot Juvenile Shark Fin (inspect notes thresher)
Hand four (4) in - non stacked works
Xilonen Velgarrith: So it turns out that you both have a brain and a strong arm. Good
Xilonen Velgarrith: Less vermin disrupting our trade means more profit. I think you'll fit in nicely
Xilonen Velgarrith writes out a quick note and hands it over to you.
Xilonen Velgarrith: Bring this to my cousin, Vhalrek, down in our harbor stronghold. You won't be able to miss his grin.,
Xilonen Velgarrith: If you're going to be part of House Velgarrith, you'll need to learn the tunnels beneath the goreeign quarter eventually.
Xilonen Velgarrith: That will be your next test.
- Find Vhalrek Velgarrith - located in the tunnels down below, he is the Shadow Kight skill trainer, near the Shadow Knight spell vendor.
Hand in your 'Dark Note'
Vhalrek Velgarrith looks over the note and offers a chuckle.
Vhalrek Velgarrith: My cousin has an eye for talent, or so they say. I suppose I will see for myself soon enough.
Vhalrek Velgarrith: It seems that your efforts have earned you a position as a low ranking member of our great House Velgarrith.
Vhalrek Velgarrith: Congratulations, you are an exile no longer.
Vhalrek Velgarrith: You will wear our colors and as such be one of our representatives, though expect no fanfare if you are to enter the city.
Vhalrek Velgarrith: Many still view ours as the Bastard House due to our dealings with foreigners.
Vhalrek Velgarrith smirks and tosses you a bundle containing a purple cloak.
Vhalrek Velgarrith: It is a moniker we gladly accept, given our strength.
Vhalrek Velgarrith: Now, I can provide you with instruction if you wish, else you are free to make your own profits for a time.
Vhalrek Velgarrith: We will have use of you should you stay alive long enough.
-You will get "Frayed Cloak of House Velgarrith - 2AC +2STR +1INT all/all - Back Magic NoDrop"
You can now enter the city proper - guards will con disdain
More information is required...
This quest starts at the conclusion of the Ail'Vorith Starter Quest after you receive your Obsidian Shackle.
Part 1 - Lvl 1+
Klavel Sul is located in the Obsidian Academy with the melee class instructors. From the bridge and gate into the Foreign Quarter, enter the building on the left and head to the back of the room.
Klavel's introduction text varies depending on your class, but the conversation is identical after the introduction line.
Klavel Sul: Exiles sing of lost houses and pray to dead gods. Whom would you call master?
Klavel Sul: The cenobites of House Xal'tharn serve the Dark Queen above all else. Her wrath and her pleasure are our only desires.
Klavel Sul: The monks of House Xal’tharn carry out the Queen's will with iron staves and iron hearts.

parts.say: Do you have a task for me?

parts.text: Klavel Sul: Fragments of the dead roam the western shore of the city. They are the accursed remnants of lesser houses who dared betray their Queen. Destroy them and fill this satchel with six of their skulls.
You receive Remnant Satchel from Klavel Sul.

Klavel Sul: Boats pass the west shore of Ail'vorith on their course to the sea. Cross the bridge into the city at your peril, for the guards will not suffer an exile to pass the gates. You must take a different path.
The mobs needed for the next step are levels 8-11
Swim around the west of the city where elementals and various skulls patrol the west island shores. Kill a separated skull and a spectral remnant to collect 6 Lost Skull to fill the bag.
Combine the container and return it to Klavel Sul.

Klavel Sul: So it is done. Pity not the dead who chose the path of desolation. The Dark Queen's rule is absolute. Those who waver shall be cast into the pits of the Shol'tar, and those who challenge her sovereignty shall be cast into oblivion.
You gain experience.
Klavel Sul: Swear your allegiance to the Queen, and you may be permitted to enter the city as a servant of House Xal'tharn.

parts.say: I swear allegiance to the Queen!

parts.text: You gain experience.
You receive Xal'tharn Pendant from Klavel Sul.
You receive Simple Chestwrap from Klavel Sul.
Klavel Sul: You have entered into the service of the Avatar of Barbhaal, Naliadra the Eternal. House Xal'tharn may call upon you to carry out her will, and you must answer under pain of death.
Faction hits? Any follow-up breadcrumbs?
Hult Beetlewrangler is located in the rear of the Sojourner Camp in Night Harbor. He can wander a short distance from his tent throughout the day.
Hult Beetlewrangler: Woah, ho there, adventurer. Ya lookin for work or wares? No matter, ol' Hult's got somethin for ya either way.

Hult Beetlewrangler: Well, if ya were from 'round here, ya'd know Hult's got the best bowls all 'long the Twilight Coast. Though, if ya ain't from 'round here, or either way I reckon, what ya need to know is I need me some beetle shells.

Hult Beetlewrangler: Yep, beetle shells make dang fine bowls, they do. See, a beetle shell's got the most perfectly natural shape and sturdiness for makin' bowls, and Porbor knows ol' Hult can make somethin' outta anythin'.
Hult Beetlewrangler: So, go out in them dunes over yonder and wrangle me at least two of 'em! When ya get back, ol' Hult'll see 'bout gettin' ya somethin' nice for yer troubles.
Hunt a fire beetle and Loot 2 x Fire Beetle Carapace.
Give Hult Beetlewrangler 2 x Fire Beetle Carapace.
You gain experience.
You receive Hult's Beetle Bowl from Hult Beetlewrangler.
Hult Beetlewrangler: Ho, welcome back, friend. Seems yer a dang fine beetle wrangler. Ya've done good by Hult, so take one o' these here beetle bowls. It ain't much, but I reckon it'll serve ya well.
Part 1
Read Rune-Etched Note you start with as a new Inquisitor character:
Hail, apprentice.
Master Jaffar Jhaym awaits your arrival at the Spellbinders Spire in Sageside. You'll know you're close when you see the wizard tower looming overhead.
Use the translocation devices beneath the tower to reach the academy grounds. Once there, you'll likely find Jaffar atop the Spire.
Your desire for advancement is well-served by Jaffar's tutelage. The academy he has built is highly regarded within Night Harbor, and he employs only the finest instructors.
If you lose your way, consult the nearest guard and inquire about the Spire's location.
Godspeed!

Head to the wizard tower east of the North Gate. Take the teleporter to the first floor and go through the portal labeled "Spellbinders Spire". Head to the top of the tower with spellbinder guards around it to find Jaffar Jhaym. He is at the very top of the Spellbinders Spire.
Hand Rune-Etched Note to Jaffar Jhaym.
You gain experience.
Jaffar Jhaym examines your note and then smiles broadly at you.
Jaffar Jhaym: Very well met! You have arrived safely, and I am indeed who you seek. Welcome to the Spellbinders Spire!
Jaffar Jhaym: The desert grows more dangerous by the day, so you have arrived none too soon.
Jaffar Jhaym: I am sure we will get better acquainted in the days to come, but you must be tired, so I’ll delay your introduction to your trainer no longer.
Jaffar Jhaym: As an aspiring inquisitor, you will be under the tutelage of Petra Gyle.
Jaffar Jhaym: Deliver your note to her, and she will get you started.
Jaffar Jhaym bows slightly and smiles at you.
You receive Rune-Etched Note from Jaffar Jhaym.
Head down the spire and hand your Rune-Etched Note to Petra Gyle.
You gain experience.
Petra Gyle takes the note.
Petra Gyle: Hmm...
Petra Gyle snatches the note form your hands and skims it briefly, her fierce gaze peering over top of the parchment as she appraises you.
Petra Gyle: So you wish to be an inquisitor of the spire, do you? You'll have to prove to me you have the mettle to take on such a responsibility.
Petra Gyle: Magic is a powerful, yet extremely dangerous talent. Especially when used by those who collude with, or seek to benefit from, corrupted forces.
Petra Gyle: Our role as inquisitors is to protect our colleagues from such forces, while also routing out corruption before it has a chance to take hold.
Petra Gyle pulls out a small key and offers it to you, while also posing a simple question.
You receive Spellbinder's Cell Key from Petra Gyle.
Petra Gyle: Are you prepared to take on this role?
Petra Gyle: We shall see if there's truth to your words, or if they ring hollow.
Petra Gyle: Descend to the bottom floor of the Spire and use the key I've given you to enter the confinement cells. We've captured a number of cultists that have yet to reveal to us their intentions.
Petra Gyle scowls and practically spits at the word cultists.
Petra Gyle: Even a novice like yourself should have the aptitude to force them to talk.
Petra Gyle: Speak to the Inquisitor Selpha outside the cells should you have any questions regarding interrogation, then return to me with anything you uncover, along with the key to the cells.
Head down to the confinement cells, hold your Spellbinder's Cell Key, and click the cell door next to Inquisitor Selpha.
Cast Torment on one of the prisoners three times; they will then tell you about a secret pocket in their cloaks.
There will be a table with some knives on it in the room outside. Use
at the table, then
, then
, then
. Give it to Inquisitor Selpha.
Inquisitor Selpha: What's this? You found this hidden within one of their cloaks? Hmm...
Inquisitor Selpha: You'd best show these to Petra right away. The spike carries a malevolent aura that she may be able to unravel, along with the meaning behind that blank note.
Return to Petra Gyle, and give her the Mysterious Rolled Note, the Mysterious Iron Spike, and the Spellbinder's Cell Key.

Petra Gyle pockets the key and gives the spike an intense stare. She then retrieves a strangely glowing stone from her possession and runs it across the spike's surface, causing the image of the object to shift and waver like a mirage.
Petra Gyle mutters a curse under her breath as she shifts the stone across the surface of the parchment next. She clicks her tongue before returning her attention to you.
Petra Gyle: You did well to bring these finds to me, [Player], while also proving that you have the resolve to be a true inquisitor.
Petra Gyle: Take this, it will serve as a symbol that you're now a member of our order. You'll need it, along with this seer stone, if you're to look further into these matters.
Petra Gyle: Tell me, [Player], are you familiar with the Tarellian Seer Stones?
Petra Gyle: The seer stone that I've given you is magically imbued. It enables us to see through minor illusions and masking spells, which is how you'll use it to thwart the cultists.
Petra Gyle: These so-called spikes have been revealed to scrying anchors. They would allow anyone attuned to them to view, and potentially overhear, anything in their vicinity.
Petra Gyle: I've also used the power of the Tarellian Seer Stone to dispel the illusion concealing what information the note contained.
Petra Gyle: It appears that out Easthymnite guests have been directed to discreetly affix these spikes at various locations throughout Night Harbor, likely in an effort to spy and sow discord.
Petra Gyle: So now, [Player], to continue your investigations you must make a choice.

Petra Gyle: Your first option is to pursue the cultists that have been sent to plant these spikes, either by following them or discerning the clues revealed in the note about their intended locations. For this, you'll need the note.

Petra Gyle: The second option is to track down and eliminate the individual who is attuned to the spikes, so that even if they're planted, they'll remain nothing more than a potential snag on someone's clothing. To do this, you'll require the spike.
Petra Gyle: As this is your first investigation, I leave the choice to you, [Player].
Petra Gyle: Note or spike?
Choose the Note Path
Choose the Spike Path
Note Path
Petra Gyle: Very well, the note is yours.
You receive Revealed Cultist Note.

Petra Gyle: There are three travelers from Easthymn who've caught our eye at the Shaded Bloom Inn. You'll recognize them by their black garb and the thin silver chains they wear around their waists. Identify them and follow them.

Petra Gyle: Two of them have been reported to wander the streets, making brief stops at nondescript locations. With the seer stone, look closely at the areas where they stop. You're to pull out any spikes they affix to these locations.
Petra Gyle: You may be able to use the note to discern the locations yourself without having to following them, if you're keen enough.

Petra Gyle: The third traveler never leaves the inn, but we're not sure why. Follow him as well, but if he doesn't affix the spikes anywhere... take them from him. The spire authorizes the use of force, once he is out of sight of the locals.
Petra Gyle: Fill the bag with each unique spike, combine it, and then return it to me, along with the seer stone.
You receive Tarellian Seer Stone from Petra Gyle.
You receive Small Leather Bag from Petra Gyle.
Head to the Shaded Bloom Inn near the west gate.
Make sure you equip the Tarellian Seer Stone before you begin these steps.
The three an Easthymnite travelers that you are meant to follow/assassinate spawn near the side street entrance door of the inn.

One of them will walk to the basement behind the bar. Follow him to the basement and kill him for 2 unique Ornately Carved Iron Spikes. Keep in mind that you need all 6 unique spikes so you cannot pick up more than one of the same type.
You DO NOT need to follow the remaining two Easthymnites—go to each of the four locations shown below and type
. You can use
to make sure you're in the right location first if you desire.
An an Easthymnite traveler will walk towards the Blacksmith in Night Market.
Follow this one to an alley.
When he inspects the wall,
A small iron spike is embedded in the wall. It looks like you could pull it free.
You pull the iron spike from the wall.
This map indicates all three locations with red circles:
The second an Easthymnite traveler will head towards the Night Market and stop at two of the locations:
In Night Market Between Baker and Butcher 1:
In Night Market Between Baker and Butcher 2 (Spike Location):
Night Market Gilded Claw Brazier:
Like the second, a third an Easthymnite traveler will walk out the main entrance of the inn. They will once again visit two of the spike locations:
Brazier at crossroads behind western bank:
Brazier at right side of entrance to Saltbreeze Park:
Combine the 6 Ornately Carved Iron Spikes in your Small Leather Bag to receive a Small Bag of Spikes.
Head back to Petra Gyle.
Hand the Tarellian Seer Stone and Small Bag of Spikes to Petra Gyle.
You gain experience.
Petra Gyle: Well done. You've returned, so I must assume you were able to trail them safely.
Petra Gyle pauses for a moment and squints at you.
Petra Gyle: Oh, did you get into a tussle?.
Petra Gyle laughs.
Petra Gyle: Seems you can handle a more direct challenge then.
Petra Gyle hands you two small bags.
Petra Gyle: We're tasked with tracking down and dealing with mages, wizards, and other arcane filth. However, we are also charged, at times, to deal with adversaries of a more spiritual nature.
Petra Gyle: Seek out two camps in the desert to the west. There are shamans amongst the Ashira. Gather medicinal herbs from them to replenish the first pouch.

Petra Gyle: You'll find a group of smugglers along the coast. They work for Jens Vermahn, so take care to engage them during the day. Gather whatever leafy filth they're using to heal themselves in the second bag.
Petra Gyle: Now go.
You receive Ashira Herb Pouch from Petra Gyle.
You receive Filthy Leather Herb Pouch from Petra Gyle.
You receive Tarnished Spellbinder Cuirass from Petra Gyle.
Spike Path
Petra Gyle nods, handing you the spike.
Petra Gyle: The spike is yours, then.
Petra Gyle: If you're going to find out who has attuned themselves to the spike, you'll need the assistance of another member of our order.
Petra Gyle: Bring the spike to Spellbinder Kharash. I imagine he'll be in the archives on the bottom floor, opposite the hallway where you found the containment cells.
Petra Gyle: He's an expert at unraveling divination magics and will be able to help you trace its origin.
Petra Gyle: Good hunting, [Player].
You receive Cultist's Iron Spike from Petra Gyle.
You receive Tarellian Seer Stone from Petra Gyle.
Give the Cultist's Iron Spike to Spellbinder Kharash.
Spellbinder Kharash inspects the spike and quickly frowns.
Spellbinder Kharash: You bring me a cursed object, inquisitor. I sense foul magics tied to it... divine in origin. Likely a dark gift granted by a malevolent benefactor.
Spellbinder Kharash: Let us not waste time with further details. I will retain the spike here and prevent those who are attuned to it from scrying its location, or potentially, overhearing our plans.
Spellbinder Kharash: In the meanwhile, take this bag. You must fill it With the components I need to trace the magic of the spike back to its source.
You receive Spellbinder's Bag from Spellbinder Kharash.
You gain experience.
Spellbinder Kharash: Good of you to ask.

Spellbinder Kharash: The components I need to seek this foe rely on the vision of those who scour the sands. You must acquire the eye of a bat, a fire beetle, a dune scarab, a spiderling, and a crypt scarab.
Spellbinder Kharash: I will also need a mirror to reflect the gaze back to its source. I believe Haredi sells such trinkets to other students of the academy in the Grand Library.
Spellbinder Kharash: Once you have an of the eyes and the mirror, combine them in the bag and return it to me. I Will then conduct the ritual to reverse the attunement Of the spike.
Haredi is in the library. Once in the library, take the teleportation platform in front of you. You'll see Haredi to the left. Buy a Pocket Mirror from him.
Combine a Fire Beetle Eye, Bat Eye, Spiderling Eye, Scarab Eye, Crypt Scarab Eye, and Pocket Mirror in the Spellbinder's Bag to craft Full Spellbinder's Bag.
Give the Full Spellbinder's Bag to Spellbinder Kharash.
You gain experience.
Faction: Spellbinders of the Spire +

Spellbinder Kharash: Well done, recruit With this, I can refocus the vision of the desert creatures and reflect the sinister gaze on this scrying device back to its source. Allow me a moment to redirect this foul magic.
Spellbinder Kharash withdraws the spike he had been safeguarding and begins his ritual.
Spellbinder Kharash takes the spike and pierces it through one of the eyes, then another, and another, until an four are speared upon the nail like a grotesque form of street

Spellbinder Kharash then murmurs out a low, guttural chant as he points the skewered set of eyes toward the mirror, invoking his magic upon them. A bright flash fills the corner of the archives and temporarily blinds you!
Spellbinder Kharash stands before you as your vision readjusts, offering you the spike.
Spellbinder Kharash: Take it, [Player]. I have reversed the attunement of the object and directed the eyes to assist you in locating the cultist leader.
Spellbinder Kharash: There is now one final thing you must do.
You receive Revealing Iron Spike from Spellbinder Kharash.
Spellbinder Kharash: Before you depart, you must be sure to bring your Tarellian Seer Stone with you.
Spellbinder Kharash: It is capable Of removing illusions and can be used to unmask those attempting to hide their true selves. They must simply touch the stone.

Spellbinder Kharash: When you are ready, proceed down to the Northern Gate. While standing beneath it, focus your will into the spike and it shall conjure an eye that will lead you to the cultist scryer.
Spellbinder Kharash: If an eye does not immediately appear, the villain may be momentarily out of sight. Simply wait a short moment before trying once again.
Spellbinder Kharash: When an eye appears, follow it. After that, you must use your own judgment on how best to deliver the Spellbinder's justice to your foe.
Spellbinder Kharash: Bring anything you find from you investigation back to Petra, as my part here has concluded. May Tilustra illuminate path, inquisitor.
While standing just outside the Northern Gate, right-click your Revealing Iron Spike to summon an Eye of Kharash.
The Eye of Kharash will spawn and run towards Farmer Lubern. Be prepared to fight a level 5 encounter.
Follow the eye or just make your way to Farmer Lubern. He is in the second enclosed area of farms on the right as you leave the north gate.
Give Tarellian Seer Stone to Farmer Lubern and he will transform into Lubern the Heretic.
Lubern the Heretic: No! How did you...?
You receive Tarellian Seer Stone from Farmer Lubern.
Lubern the Heretic: Your blood will serve as a sacrifice for Kravvin!
Kill Lubern the Heretic and loot Lubern's Scrying Orb.
Return to Petra Gyle.
Give Petra Gyle Lubern's Scrying Orb, Tarellian Seer Stone, and Revealing Iron Spike.
Faction: Spellbinders of the Spire +
Petra Gyle: Well done. It seems you may have what it takes to be a real inquisitor after all.
Petra Gyle pauses for a moment and squints at you.
Petra Gyle: Oh, did you get into a tussle?.
Petra Gyle laughs.
Petra Gyle: Seems you can handle a more direct challenge then.
Petra Gyle hands you two small bags.
Petra Gyle: We're tasked with tracking down and dealing with mages, wizards, and other arcane filth. However, we are also charged, at times, to deal with adversaries of a more spiritual nature.
Petra Gyle: Seek out two camps in the desert to the west. There are shamans amongst the Ashira. Gather medicinal herbs from them to replenish the first pouch.

Petra Gyle: You'll find a group of smugglers along the coast. They work for Jens Vermahn, so take care to engage them during the day. Gather whatever leafy filth they're using to heal themselves in the second bag.
Petra Gyle: Now go.
You receive Ashira Herb Pouch from Petra Gyle.
You receive Filthy Leather Herb Pouch from Petra Gyle.
You receive Tarnished Spellbinder Cuirass from Petra Gyle.
Part 2
Combine six Ashira Medicinal Herbs in the Ashira Herb Pouch. Ashira Medicinal Herbs do not stack, but they can be traded.
Combine six Pungent Healing Herbs in the Filthy Leather Herb Pouch. Pungent Healing Herbs do not stack, but they can be traded.
Hand the filled Ashira Herb Pouch and Filthy Leather Herb Pouch to Petra Gyle.
You gain experience.
Petra Gyle: Fantastic Work. We've been using these herbs to formulate a better understanding of how to disrupt the enemy's healing magics.
Petra Gyle: The spiritual nature of Ashira magic is more challenging to understand, but Jens' rats appear to be using simple alchemy. We'll know soon enough.
Petra Gyle: Well, young recruit, you're proving to be quite the find. I've got one last task, then we'll let you get some rest.
Petra Gyle: I've just been made aware of a powerful, yet still up-in-coming wizard, in league with Jens. He can occasionally be found in a small house in the Bends.
Petra Gyle: You're to kill him and bring me his head. Pack it in this bag so you don't draw any unwanted attention.
You receive Rune Covered Black Silk Bag from Petra Gyle.
Part 3
Head to the Bends part of Night Harbor. There is a teleporter just before the north bank that will take you to the shipyard area. Take the teleporter and go left to get to the Bends.
Look for Sahir Muzalal (level 16); a possible spawn location is the ground floor of the first building cluster on the left. A mercenary magus is the placeholder.
Kill Sahir Muzalal and loot his Bloodied Wizard Head.
Place his Bloodied Wizard Head into Rune Covered Black Silk Bag and click on combine.
Head back to Petra Gyle and hand her the filled Rune Covered Black Silk Bag.
You gain experience.
Petra Gyle takes the bag from you, looking at it with disgust.
Petra Gyle: Good work. He was on his way to becoming a powerful adversary, so it benefits us to be rid of him.

Petra Gyle: For now, consider yourself well on your way down the proper path. Continue to explore the city and familiarize yourself with the people here. If you run into anything suspicious, come back to me. Otherwise, get some rest.
Petra Gyle plucks a small talisman from her waistband and hands it to you.
Petra Gyle: And keep this with you.
You receive Spellbinder's Inquisitor Talisman from Petra Gyle.
This quest starts with hailing Rais Alyssum.
Rais Alyssum: Hello, may I interest you in one of my fine handcrafted instruments? I carry everything that a young instrumentalist might need to enhance his beginnings as a performer.
Rais Alyssum clears his throat and puffs out his chest.
Rais Alyssum: Everything in life is a performance. Eth-ur is our stage. Now you have to ask yourself, will you play the lead? Or are you content to continue as supporting cast?

Rais Alyssum: Excellent! A vibrant storyteller needs purpose, humility, and of course; experience. Why don't we start with something a little.. philanthropic? First you can start by bringing light to those in the dark of Night Harbor. Return to me when you feel you've brightened the spirits of the less fortunate.
Scattered across Night Harbor are A beggar. Purchase 3 Weak Beer from A barkeep and trade one individually to each a beggar and
to brighten the spirits of the less fortunate.
***You must have an instrument equipped to use the /Play feature***
a beggar: Alms for the poor?
Hand a beggar 1 Weak Beer and use the /Play lute command.
a_beggar_1: Thank you for the drink, but can you keep it down you're scaring the tourists away!
a_beggar_2: Ahhh my ears! I've heard better music coming from the stables at the Sojourner camp!

a_beggar_3: Wow, I cannot tell you how long it has been since I have felt kindness and compassion. What a beautiful melody, bless you kind stranger. I found this while rummaging through the Night Market and something compelled me to hold onto it, just give me a moment to find it.
a_beggar_3 pats his pockets and then anxiously searches through his bags. A_beggar_3 says 'Now where did I put that, oh here it is!'
You receive a Broken Mandolin from a_beggar_3.

a_beggar_3: Now it may not be in the best condition, but please take this as a token of my gratitude. I'm sure a bright young Bard like yourself can find a way to restore it back to a working condition.
Return to Rais Alyssum and hand him the Broken Mandolin.
Upon turning in the Broken Mandolin:
Rais Alyssum holds the broken mandolin in his hands and studies it intently.

Rais Alyssum: Well would you look at that! Sometimes kindness really does pay off! Let's see what we have here.. Ah yes, a polished mahogany body, with beautiful trim work on the headstock. A shame the condition that it's in. I could repair it for you, but I would need some additional materials and of course a fee.
Rais Alyssum looks you up and down with a mischievous gleam in his eye.

Rais Alyssum: Come closer and take a look at these three strings. They are salvageable, but I will need five more. The silk of a large spider should do the trick. Now for the tailpiece.. we could use stone, but lets try for something a little more elegant and special. I've heard the performers outside talk of a translucent beetle roaming the dunes to the west. A piece of his carapace will work perfectly.
Rais Alyssum: Oh and don't forget about the fee. After all, this is a lesson in helping the less fortunate. Ten silver pieces sounds fair, don't you think?
Head to the Shaded Dunes and kill Large Spiders until you have 5 Large Spider Silk. Obtain a Piece of Translucent Beetle Shell from a giant translucent beetle. Return with them to Rais Alyssum.
Upon turning in 5
and
and 10 silver pieces:
You gain experience.
Rais Alyssum excitedly fashions together the tailpiece and tightens the strings.
You receive a Restored Mandolin from Rais Alyssum.

Rais Alyssum: I knew you had the heart of a performer in you. As promised here is the restored mandolin. Now go and set the stage for your adventure! Oh and before I forget.. when another Bard becomes envious of my artwork, send him my way. Just don't mention the fee.
Rais Alyssum winks at you.
This quest starts with hailing Mar'Tem.
Where is the quest giver located in the zone?
Mar'Tem: Hail, Yes, I speak your language, though I am the only one in our gathering who does.
Mar'Tem: We mean no harm to your kind. In fact, we are the ones who fear harm. We have fled to this shelter to escape the hunters tracking us.
Mar'Tem: The undead here have done well to keep them in the tunnel but it is only a matter of time before they come for us.
Mar'Tem: A group of us were able to flee the Skri'Var taskmasters before they could cause us to degenerate.
Mar'Tem: We escaped here, but if the hunters leave, we will eventually make our way out of this place and return to our village.
Mar'Tem: Or, if you can force them away, we would also be grateful. Just bring me proof that you have dealt with them.

Mar'Tem: The Skri'Var were once like us Mur'Hua. But those with bad spirits wander away from our people and devolve into what you see here. We take care of each other, and we love to explore and create. They are selfish and kill and steal.
Mar'Tem: They can force us to become like them by isolating us from each other, torturing us, and making us cannibals like them.

Mar'Tem: Once this process beings, our spirits change and our minds give way. We serve them, protect them, and become like them. So, take care if you see any Mur'Hua among them. They are already likely lost.
Mar'Tem: We come from a small village on a lake deep below the surface... but I do not know you well enough to tell you more.
Need more information regarding dialogue here
Venture out and kill Tora'Galdo.
Loot his Head of Tora'Galdo and return to Mar'Tem.
Upon turning in the Head of Tora'Galdo Mar'Tem responds:
Mar'Tem: It is a shame that one of our own can cause so much death and hardship. We are immensely grateful for this act of kindness.
Mar'Tem: Please take this as a small token of my gratitude. It may help you, should you encounter more of my people.
You receive Small Mur'Hua Trinket.
More information needed. Faction hits? EXP? Coin?
Suspected to be a second quest available once you have completed the first.

quests.title: Landing Loop Quest
classes: ELE ENC INQ NEC SHD SPB WIZ

parts.text: Part 1 - Raging Elements Investigation
Go to the top of the lighthouse of Zaedin's Landing in Shallow Shoals to find Nadim Al-Saraf.
To get to him you need to get past the locked gate. Go to the inn and say [I am here to help] to Barkeep Zahra to get Zaedin's Landing Fort Key when you have enough faction of Zaedin's Corsairs.

If you can't get the key, there are several rooms beside the locked gate along the ramp, go up the ramp and jump through the window to bypass the gate. You need to be a small-sized race to do that, or you need to find someone to shrink you twice.
If Nadim is not up, kill A Syndicate channeler that roams on the top of the lighthouse to spawn him.
Ask Nadim about the [lighthouse], then tell him [I can help]. He will ask you to find out why elements around this island are growing unstable.

Go to the back of the island and kill A raging elemental until you get 4 Tainted Elemental Core, turn in those to Nadim, he will give you Note from Nadim and tell you to go find Captain Harkan Saafir.
Part 2 - Goblin Raids
Captain Harkan Saafir is halfway to the lighthouse where you reach the first iron gate. Turn left and go upstairs to find him in the room.
A landing lieutenant is his PH and also accepts quest items.
Turn in the note and he mentions that there are goblins raiding Zaedin's Landing.
Every 9 pm, several goblins spawn on a small island which lies south of Zaedin's Landing and will head to attack the islanders. And if rain falls at the time, Skizzak Darkrain also spawns.
Kill Skizzak and loot Command Scroll.
Turn in the scroll to Captain Harkan Saafir / a Landing lieutenant, he'll instruct you to take the scroll to Tariq the Revealer who roams in south side of the buildings on the 2nd floor.
Give him both the Command Scroll and Note from Nadim, then go back to Nadim with the Command scroll.
To turn in the scroll to Nadim you'll receive a new Note from Nadim. Take it to Captain Harkan Saafir / a Landing lieutenant , and you are tasked to scout the goblin island for clues.
Part 3 - Goblins in the Ruins
Now go to the goblin island, it's to the northeast of Zaedin's Landing.
You will spot a river inside the island once you get there.
Take left to the tunnel, find an entrance underwater on your left . It leads you to a cave with two houses.
Enter the house that with no door by climbing up or jumping through the window (if small-sized race) and get to the room stacked with crates.
There is a book behind them. Get close and use
to get Hidden Note.
Part 4 - Ritual of the Orcs
Hand the Hidden Note to Captain Harkan Saafir / a Landing lieutenant, he then wants you to decrypt the note with Tariq's help.
Go to Tariq and give him the Hidden Note to receive the Decrypted Note.
Give Decrypted Note to Captain Harkan Saafir / a Landing lieutenant, then give it to Nadim.
Nadim will refresh Note from Nadim in your inventory and task you with killing Witchlord Kruurgal to disrupt the rituals.
Kruurgal spawns in a tower within Black Shoals Fortress, north of Zaedin's Landing. A Witchguard corruptor is PH
Kill Kruurgal and bring Head of Kruurgal the Witchlord to Nadim along with Note from Nadim.
You receive 10 gold from Nadim Al-Saraf.
You receive Landing Loop from Nadim Al-Saraf.
Part 1 - Clothes Delivery
Find a wash maiden (during daytime hours only) in Night Harbor inside the Bath house which is west of Night Market near the West Gate.
a wash maiden stops folding laundry to consider you a moment with tired eyes.
a wash maiden: Hail to you, lily. Forgive me if I don't stop. Laundry waits for no one, and it's piled high today.
a wash maiden: It's an endless job and few offer to help. I suppose I can't complain, though. Trust in Trem they say.
a wash maiden: Help? Oh... no, no. I manage. Always have. That's kind of you to offer, lily. Truly kind.
a wash maiden pauses for a moment, glancing up at you.
a wash maiden: But... if you truly mean it...
a wash maiden looks away from you shyly.
a wash maiden: I'm unaccustomed to asking strangers for favors. But lily, if you're offering...
a wash maiden finally meets your eyes.
a wash maiden: I don't want to be a bother, but I could use the help. So let's make this deal...

a wash maiden: Could you get these deliveries to my customers? They tend to pay extra to get their clothing delivered to them, as they're quite busy with their own jobs. You can keep any extra coin they hand you.
a wash maiden: And bring me their laundry. They always have more laundry to do.
a wash maiden: Do this for me, and though I have little in the way of coin, I can at least give you a clean shirt or robe. I'll even dye it in your favorite color.
a wash maiden: Are we in agreement, lily?
a wash maiden: Great! Take this basket and these clean clothes.
a wash maiden: There's three deliveries to be made...
a wash maiden: Steinn the stonemason is awaiting the arrival of his work shirt.
a wash maiden: Layith the troubadour wants her favorite cloak to use in the play.
a wash maiden: And Iskandar, who's still on guard duty, will need his pantaloons.
a wash maiden pauses, almost apologetically.
a wash maiden: Just... take the clothes to where they belong. When you come back with their laundry, we'll settle our deal.
a wash maiden smiles.
a wash maiden: Byrthia remembers kindness. Always does.
You receive Byrthia's Laundry Basket from a wash maiden.
You receive Stonemason's Shirt from a wash maiden.
You receive Damsel's Cloak from a wash maiden.
You receive Patrol Pantaloons from a wash maiden.
Find Mason Steinn in Night Harbor in the temple against the cliff between Sojourner's Camp and the Tannery. Follow the road north until you reach the temple.
Mason Steinn turns to you, a cloud of stone dust following him. He is bare-chested beneath a heavy leather apron, his arms crossed more out of habit than comfort.
Mason Steinn: What're you after? Block, lime, chisels? If it's stonework, say it plain.
Mason Steinn shifts slightly, clearly aware of the draft.
Mason Steinn: And make it quick, if you can. Temple wind's got no respect for old bones.
Give Mason Steinn the Stonemason's Shirt:
Mason Steinn blinks when he sees the shirt, then lets out a relieved huff as he takes it.
Mason Steinn: By the stone! That's sight for sore eyes.
Mason Steinn puts it on immediately, rolling his shoulders as if settling armor.
Mason Steinn: You've my thanks. Truly.
Mason Steinn reaches under the workbench, producing a bundled sack of grimy clothes and presses it into your hands along with a few coins.
Mason Steinn: Five copper there. Give her this and my thanks.
Mason Steinn lowers his voice just a touch.
Mason Steinn: And do me a kindness... tell Byrthia to go lighter on the wheat paste next wash. It keeps the seams stiff, but itches like a nest of ants once I start sweating.
Mason Steinn tugs at his beard.
Mason Steinn: She's a good washer, though. Best in the city. I'll not hear otherwise.
You gain experience.
Your faction standing with Citizens of Night Harbor got better.
Your faction standing with Merchants of Night Harbor got better.
Your faction standing with Smallfolk Alliance got better.
You receive Steinn' Dirty Laundry from Mason Steinn.
You receive 5 copper from Mason Steinn.
Find Layith Kharem in Night Harbor up a ladder in Glimmermoon Hall behind the performance stage in Night Market.
Layith Kharem: Oh! Hi there.
Layith Kharem turns with practiced grace, already smiling as if she is on stage.
Layith Kharem: Yes, yes, of course. One moment.
Layith Kharem produces a small parchment and signs it with an elaborate flourish.
Layith Kharem: There you are. Do spell my name correctly if you tell the story later.
Layith Kharem studies you, chin lifted.
Layith Kharem: Were you hoping to catch tonight's performance, or have you come to simply admire?
You receive Layith's Autograph from Layith Kharem. (Unknown if related to Laundry Day quest)
Give Layith Kharem the Damsel's Cloak:
Layith Kharem gasps softly as she see the cloak, her hands dramatically pressed to her chest.
Layith Kharem: Thank the stars!
Layith Kharem takes it at once, inspecting the fabric with sharp, practiced eyes. A beat passes, then she smiles radiantly.
Layith Kharem: Perfect. Absolutely perfect.
Layith Kharem softens a little, looking at you anew.
Layith Kharem: You're a dear. Truly.
Layith Kharem presses a silver coin into your hand without hesistation.
Layith Kharem: For your trouble... and your timing.
Layith Kharem tilts her head in a conspiratorial manner and produces a small, neatly tied bundle.
Layith Kharem: And if you'd be so kind... you may return these to the washer maiden.
Layith Kharem: The one and only Layith's bespoke stockings! Handle them with care and use unscented oils only, understand?
Layith Kharem pauses briefly before donning a smile that suggests she has already forgotten the inconvenience.
Layith Kharem: Now, if you'll excuse me, my audience awaits!
You gain experience.
Your faction standing with Citizens of Night Harbor got better.
Your faction standing with Merchants of Night Harbor got better.
Your faction standing with Azure Veils got better.
You receive 1 copper from Layith Kharem.
You receive Layith's Soiled Stockings from Layith Kharem.
Find Guard Iskandar in Night Harbor in front of the large palace gate at the east end of Saltbreeze Park.
Guard Iskandar inclines his head slightly, eyes never fully leaving the park grounds.
Guard Iskandar: State your business, if you please. Only government officials are permitted beyond this point.
Guard Iskandar remains vigilant. A bead of sweat runs down his temple, but his stance never wavers.
Guard Iskandar: No trouble today, I trust.
Guard Iskandar allows himself a small, polite smile.
Guard Iskandar: If you're lost, I can point you the right way.
Give Guard Iskandar the Patrol Pantaloons:
Guard Iskandar sees the pantaloons and takes them swiftly, folding them once and sliding them into his pack as if they were part of his kit all along.
Guard Iskandar quickly produces a wrapped piece of gear, along with two coins.
Guard Iskandar: You have my thanks.
Guard Iskandar leans in to you, his voice dropping just enough to speak words only for your ears.
Guard Iskandar: Please... my padded loin guard... needs washing.
Guard Iskandar pauses as a faint, sheepish breath can be heard through his nose.
Guard Iskandar: If you would... see it back to Byrthia.
Guard Iskandar straightens at once, his gaze forward again.
Guard Iskandar: Now... move along citizen, if you please.
You gain experience.
Your faction standing with Citizens of Night Harbor got better.
Your faction standing with Merchants of Night Harbor got better.
Your faction standing with City Watch of Night Harbor got better.
You receive Iskandar's Padded Loin Guard from Guard Iskandar.
You receive 2 copper from Guard Iskandar.
In Byrthia's Laundry Basket: Combine Steinn's Dirty Laundry, Layith's Soiled Stockings, and Iskandar's Padded Loin Guard create a finished laundry basket. Give it to Byrthia.
A wash maiden sets the basked down with a heavy thump, then looks at you with tired eyes and a grateful smile.
A wash maiden: You've done more than carry cloth today. You helped an old ogre keep her promises.
A wash maiden nods.
A wash maiden: That matters. Words matter. Keeping your word matters a lot in cities like this one. A few words from the right person can change lives.
A wash maiden rummages beneath the wash table and produces a small rolled parchment sakk, worn smooth from handling.
A wash maiden: Speaking of words and promises...this here's a sakk. Good as tender with merchants in Night Harbor. This one is for tailoring services.
A wash maiden turns it over in her palm.
A wash maiden: I was going to choose something for myself. Thought I might need it.
A wash maiden presses it into your hands instead.
A wash maiden: But I think it'll suit you better than it ever would me.
You receive a note, Crude Tailoring Saak

It reads 'Upon receipt of this sakk, the Bank of Night Harbor commands the tradesman recipient to award the sum of five silver to the bearer for acts of service in the tailoring trade. This sakk is valid only within Night Harbor.'
A wash maiden pauses.
A wash maiden: Now there's a choice you have to make, lily.
A wash maiden crinkles her eyes with a knowing look.
A wash maiden: Do you want a shirt or a robe?
Part 2A, if you want a shirt
Go to the tailor's shop with the loom in Night Harbor. Give Noura the Tailor the Crude Tailoring Sakk that you got from the wash woman.
Noura the Tailor: Oh! Well now. I haven't seen one of these in a while.
Noura the Tailor: Aye, this is good. It's a tradesman sakk endorsed by the Bank of Night Harbor. It covers the labor for a shirt commission just fine.
Noura the Tailor: Hmm,that's a shame.
Noura the Tailor: The sakk pays for my hands and my time and I'll honor that gladly. But the materials...you might as well hang on to that sakk until I can get more in.
She gives you back the note.
Noura the Tailor: You see, I'll need six crude silk scraps. I don't know when I'll get more in the shop. Maybe come back later.
(I went back later and gave her the note again.)
Noura the Tailor glances at the sakk and gives a small approving nod.
Noura the Tailor: Aye, this is good. It's a tradesman sakk endorsed by the Bank of Night Harbor. It covers the labor for a shirt commission just fine.
Noura the Tailor folds it neatly and hands it back to you rather than taking it.
Noura the Tailor: But hold on for it now. A shirt is not stitched from promises along. I will need six crude silk scraps for the cloth, the backstrap loom to work them proper, and...
Noura the Tailor's expression softens.
Noura the Tailor: ...and my uncle's house key returned to me. Bring me those, along with the sakk, and I will see the shirt made.
Noura the Tailor: Come back when you have them all together. Then we shall make something worthy of the trouble.
You receive your items back from Noura the Tailor.
Noura the Tailor lets her gaze drift for a moment.
Noura the Tailor: I used to gather it from cobweavers when I was a girl. My uncle was a boatwright. He had a place down my the harbor with old beams, salt in the air...and tiny spiders everywhere.
Noura the Tailor slowly drops her smile.
Noura the Tailor: He passed a few years back. I've not had the heart to go rooting through the place since.
Noura the Tailor looks back at you with a hopeful glint in her eyes.
Noura the Tailor: If you're willing to check the old house for crude silk, let me know. Six crude silk scraps is all I need.
You say 'I will check the old house.
Noura the Tailor gives you a reassuring nod while handing you a bronze key from behing the fabric rack.
You receive Bronze Boatwright's Key from Noura the Tailor.
Noura the Tailor: Head out of the market and go east until you get to the entrance of Saltbreeze Park, but don't enter the park. Instead, head south toward the harbor.

Noura the Tailor: Once you get to the harbor, bear just a little right, and my uncle's house will be on the left at the small dry dock. There should be no one living there, but if a vagrant has moved in, grab a watchman.
Noura the Tailor: Remember, I need six crude silk scrap. Bring them back with your sakk, and I'll have your shirt stiched soon thereafter. Oh, you will need this also.
Noura the Tailor gives you a small loom.
You receive Backstrap Loom from Noura the Tailor.
Noura the Tailor: Use this to combine four crude silk webs to make the scraps Give this back to me when you have them made.

To find her uncle's house, go left from Saltbreeze Park, following the sign. When you get to the end of the road, you'll be facing some barrels and boxes. Go to the right of that building.
