Just around the corner on the left is a door with anchors on either side. Hold the key on your cursor and click on the door.
There is a child's diary which can be picked up, which is on the bench next to the stove. Use the /take book command. It is unrelated to the Laundry Day quest.
You will find 4 cobweaver hatchlings and a cobweaver spider. They are lvl 1 (?), not KoS but social. Loot 24 Crude Spider Silk. Combine 4 at a time in the loom until you have 6 Crude Silk Scraps.
Return to Noura the Tailor and give her the Bronze Boatwright's Key, the Backstrap Loom, the original note, and the silks (stacked).
You gain experience.
Your faction standing with Citizens of Night Harbor got better.
Your faction standing with Merchants of Night Harbor got better.
Noura the Tailor takes in the bundle of material with wide eyes, already testing the crude silk's strength between her nimble fingers.
Noura the Tailor: Well now! You truly went and found them. Excellent!
Noura the Tailor drops her gaze briefly to the old key. She hesitates, then clears her throat.
Noura the Tailor: Thank you for returning this to me. My uncle was a kind man. I was very young when he passed away. My aunt passed not too long after that.
Noura the Tailor: I was brought to the Wayfarers Hospice and raised by Sojourners. The key was given to me later by the priests of Relle.
Noura the Tailor sets the key aside carefully, before clapping her hands once with renewed brightness.
Noura the Tailor: Right then! The sakk covers my labor and you've brought the materials. Stand back just a moment. Let me see what we can make of this.

Noura the Tailor mounts the silk upon the backstrap loom, working the threads with suprising speed. The soft rasp of fiber sliding through fiber fills the shop. After a short while, she lifts a freshly sewn garment from her work table.
Noura the Tailor: There we are. One crude silk shirt. It's dirty and won't turn any heads in Highpoint Terrace, but it'll serve you well enough.
Noura the Tailor folds it neatly and hands it to you.

Noura the Tailor: All you need to do now is wash it. Head down to the water in the harbor, near my uncle's house. There are some scullery maidens washing and drying the clothes. Tell them Noura sent you, and they'll show you what you need to do next.
You receive Dirty Crude Silk Shirt from Noura the Tailor
Part 2B if you want a robe:
Go to Mira Gables, who is in a building near the north gate. Hail her.
Mira Gables: Yes? How may I help you?
Give Mira Gables the Crude Tailoring Sakk note.
Mira Gables takes the sakk and weighs it in her palm, assessing it with sharp eyes. She nods once, satisfied.
Mira Gables: I will honor it.
Mira Gables turns and glides her fingers over the hanging robes and folded bolts, considering the fabrics. After a moment, she stops.
Mira Gables: No.
Mira Gables: The sakk, of course, is for the work, not the weave.
Mira Gables: Crude silk, not the fine kind scholars preen over, mind you. Common silk. Resourceful, durable, and resilient, much like those priests of Porbor.
Mira Gables searches through her materials and produces a small stack of crude silk.
Mira Gables:  I have six crude silk scraps here, but will need twelve to finish a robe.
Mira Gables places the sakk in your hand.
Mira Gables: Keep the sakk for now. Since my crude silk stock is low, you will have to wait until I find more.
Mira Gables lifts her brown slightly at the word.
Mira Gables: Yes. Crude. Specifically, crude silk scraps.
Mira Gables: Crude silk comes from cobweavers. You know, the tiny spiders no bigger than my thumb. Hardly a challenge for a slayer such as yourself.
Mira Gables rolls her eyes, her gaze then drifting toward the distant harbor.

Mira Gables: There is an old house where you might find some. It is abandoned now. The owner passed long ago, and no one has been there in years. It is likely crawling with cobweavers, though, it was locked the last time I passed by.
Mira Gables:  I knew the family once...well, I was a friend of the girl who lived there.
Mira Gables pauses, then shakes her head slightly.
Mira Gables: Never mind. That was long ago.
Mira Gables: If you wish to check out the house, let me know. Otherwise, just return later when I have more crude silk in stock.
Mira Gables briefly hesitates at your words.
Mira Gables: Oh...you want to check out the house?
Mira Gables: When I was a girl, I stayed there often with my friend. We used to gather cobweaver silk from the attic. We made clothes for our dolls from it. Poor sticthes, but we were proud of them.
Mira Gables pauses a moment, as if debating whether she should go on.
Mira Gables: ...But there is a curious barrel along the side of the building, under a torn awning. Always was.
Mira Gables meets your eyes.
Mira Gables: The lid hides a small door we used to sneak through. I think they put it there as a way to cover the hole in the wall without pinching he purse.

Mira Gables: We would slip inside at night, then head down to the water to swim in the harbor. If her uncle caught us...well, he never did. He slept like a Scarwood bear in winter and we were quiet as mice.
Mira Gables allows herself a faint, fleeting smile.
Mira Gables: Good luck. I will see you when you get back. Oh, I almost forgot! You will need this.
Mira Gables hands you a small loom.
You receive a Backstrap Loom
Mira Gables: Use this to combine four crude silk webs to make the scraps, then return it to me when you have them made.
(Follow the directions in Part 2A to find the house.)
There are several crates and barrels along the side of the house. One is on its side. If you
the barrel, it say [insert text, I don't remember.] Then

. Then crouch in front of the barrel to be teleported into the house. Kill cobweavers and combine the crude silk thread they drop in the backstrap loom until you have 6 crude silk scraps. Return to Mira Gables.
Give Mira Gables the six crude silk scraps, the note, and the backstrap loom.
Mira Gables gathers the crude silk scraps in her hands.
Mira Gables: Yes...these will do nicely. Strong fibers.
Mira Gables accepts the sakk, the six crude silk scraps, and the backstrap loom without ceremony, her expression steady and unreadable
Mira Gables: Good. Everything is in order.
Mira Gables wastes no time, mounting the crude silk upon the loom with swift, efficient movements.
Mira Gables: This will only take a minute or two.
Mira Gables gets to work. The soft pull and snap of tightened threads fills the room. After some time, she cuts the finished garment free and gives it a brisk shake.
"Mira Gables says "There. A crude silk robe,"
Mira Gables folds it and hands it over to you.

Mira Gables folds it neatly and presses it into your hands.

Mira Gables: All you need to do is wash it. Down by the water in the harbor, near the boatwright's house, there are some scullery maids working, washing and dying the clothes. Tell them Mira sent you. They will show you what you need to do next.

Riham: If she sent you, then you've cloth that needs color. But dye will not take to dirt.
Riham: Wash the silk first. I have soap for sale, and you may use the basins there.
Riham: When it is clean, bring it back to me and I will show you how to set the dye proper.

the basin until you find one that emotes:

in the basin. (with the soap on your cursor type

(or robe)

/robe
'You kneel at the basin and work the shirt against the soap-slick stone, beating and rinsing until the grime loosens and slips away in cloudy swirls.

Part 1: First Degree
Read Humble Note you start with as a new Monk Character:

Dear <Player>,

You are invited to come train at the School of the
Fourfold Path.

If you're not afraid to push your body to the brink
and test the limits of your endurance, deliver this
note to Chahaya Tam, one of the masters of our
school.

Bring nothing more than the clothes on your back
and your bare fists. The more calloused, the better.

The school is located in Twilight Harbor, directly
south of Saltbreeze Park. If you see elementals
floating about, you'll know you're close.

Train and Fight! Seek discipline! Always pursue
your highest self!
Hand Humble Note to Chahaya Tam
You gain experience.
Chahaya Tam takes the note from you, furrowing her brow.
Chahaya Tam: You wish to train with our order?
Chahaya Tam bows deeply.

Chahaya Tam: Welcome to the School of the Fourfold Path, where one can refine their body and mind, and seek a connection with the four elements. I am Master Chahaya Tam, I lead this order, alongside my husband, Tenebrim. You have done well to seek us out, as there are no greater adepts of the pugilist arts within this city than us.
Chahaya Tam reaches out, and clasps your shoulder, her grip tight, yet you can tell she is holding back some of her strength within her corded muscles.

Chahaya Tam: Let's get started. For your initial training, I would like you to approach and challenge some of our students to a sparring match. They will not hold back, and I do not expect you to, either. If they know you down, the match will be over, but you can return to spar later when you have honed your skill. If you have further questions about the matches, just ask about them. All of us in the order have had to pass through this trial by fire, so to speak.

Chahaya Tam: Wear your belt, so they know you as a fellow student, and speak to them to start sparring. Recover a training emblem from them. When you have bested three of our students, return to me, along with your belt. Tran and fight!
Chahaya Tam bows to you once again, clasping her fist in her open hand.
You receive Fourfold Sash from Chahaya Tam.
Hail a strong sparring monk and
s spar", then proceed to defeat 3 of them.
Loot Training Emblem from each corpse.
Hand all 3 Training Emblem and your Fourfold Sash to Chahaya Tam

Your faction standing with School of the Fourfold Path got better.
Chahaya Tam: Wonderful! Wasn't it an exhilarating experience? Do not worry, your bruises will heal in time.
Chahaya Tam clasps her hand against your back.
Chahaya Tam: Your first victories! I am proud of you and present you with your new belt, marking you as a member of the First Degree.
Chahaya Tam ties the sash around your waist, affixing a single seal to it.
Chahaya Tam: Wear it with pride,
Chahaya Tam: Now, go and get some training. Once you have a few more matches under your belt, and have spent time with your fellow adventurers, come to me for your next task.

Chahaya Tam: ! There you are.
Chahaya Tam: I see a few additional scars... you must have been out training. Good!
Chahaya Tam: We've been honing your physical prowess, but today, you're going to work on another side of yourself. Your mind needs to be one with your body.
Chahaya Tam: We need you to head into the sweltering heat of the Shaded Dunes and find the refreshing Waterfall of Serenity.
Chahaya Tam: Do you feel up to the task? Hand me your belt if so. I'll check it for wear and tear.
Hand your belt to Chahaya Tam.
Chahaya Tam smiles at you.
Chahaya Tam: I can see you've taken good care of it.
Chahaya Tam pats you on the shoulder and hands it back to you.

Chahaya Tam: Take this elixir and be on your way. Remember, this is a test of the mind, not the body.

Where to go:
Shaded Dunes is the next zone west of Night Harbor.
The waterfall is in an oasis looking area at the western side of the zone.
The easiest way to find it, is to follow the road from the zone almost to the next zone (Fallen Pass). You'll see the oasis on your left.
When you get to the right place alongside the water:
The serene waterfall gently flows down the dune into the oasis below. It seems to match Chahaya's description.
Drink the Elixir.
Note: You must stand on solid ground, if you are swimming the attacks will kill you.
Do not attack! Simply stand there. All damage will be "absorbed" and not hurt you.
a familiar shadow: Come on, hit me. You know you want to.

Your mind clears.
You are blinded.
You can see again.
You are blinded.
You can see again.
You are blinded.

Go back and hand the medallion together with your belt to Chahaya Tam.
Chahaya Tam beams with pride.
Chahaya Tam: Wonderful, trainee. You've manage to overcome your fears and focus your mind to the limit of its current capabilities!
Chahaya Tam: I'm truly delighted to award yo with the rank of third-degree monk!

Chahaya Tam: It's no small feat for a trainee to have such control, you should be proud of yourself.
Chahaya Tam: Now, be on your way... and keep training!
