parts.text: Sporeweaver Underveil is located in the mushroom cave close to Faelindral.
Sporeweaver Underveil: I welcome you to the depths of Sporehaven Karst, . Our myconids are of no threat under normal circumstances, though it appears something has tampered with the latest strain.

Sporeweaver Underveil: I cannot say for certain what is causing the aggression in our latest strain, but I do have my suspicion. They seem to get riled when the sun sets and a mysterious foam builds along the riverbanks of the Karst.

Sporeweaver Underveil: I have discovered traces of the mysterious foam caught in the gills of some of our myconid children, though I have not yet procured enough to get an understanding of what it truly is.

Sporeweaver Underveil: Should a myconid become enthralled by the substance, they soon begin sending out messages of warning through the nerve structures of their surrounding kin, riling them into a defensive frenzy.
Sporeweaver Underveil: I am loathe to ask this of you, stranger, but I am not strong enough to bring low any of my children. Would you be able to take a stand against my beguiled creations?
Sporeweaver Underveil lets out a sad breath, nodding in understanding.
Sporeweaver Underveil: Then I entrust the deed to you. Seek out my beguiled children here in the Karst; the bluecaps appear to be the most susceptible at night.

Sporeweaver Underveil: Cull what you must to procure a section of their gills that shimmers with traces of the prismatic foam. Bring what you find to me, so I can save what remains of our latest strain.
Sporeweaver Underveil lowers his head somberly.
Collect Prismatic Gills from a beguiled bluecap during the night and deliver them to Sporeweaver Underveil.
Need item verification along with quantity required for turn-in.
You gain experience.
Faction: Circle of Spores +
Faction: Naelira's Court -
Sporeweaver Underveil accepts the gills with a frown.

Sporeweaver Underveil: Such a waste of a beautiful strain. I understand why it had to be done, but this goes against the balance of the Weald. My poor children were never meant to be enthralled by something not of this world.
Sporeweaver Underveil: Which is precisely what this magic resembles... the machinations of the naiads. I had my suspicions, but this evidence you brought me confirms them.
Sporeweaver Underveil: They have tainted the river with their influence. To what end, I care not. I only ask, will you provide me the opportunity to avenge my fallen kin?
Sporeweaver Underveil clasps his hands to yours, placing a small glass phial into your palm as he stares intently at you.

parts.say: I will avenge your fallen kin.

parts.text: You receive Underveil's Phial from Sporeweaver Underveil.
Sporeweaver Underveil lets out a sigh of relief.
Sporeweaver Underveil: Thank you, stranger. Enter the domain of the naiads and use what force or guile is necessary to reach the pools that dwell within.

Sporeweaver Underveil: Rumors tell of their ability to enthrall beings of pure water. If these rumors hold true, I need you to collect at least four samples of this enchanted water so that I can study it and develop a countermeasure for my own creations.
Sporeweaver Underveil: Do this for me, and you will have the eternal gratitude of the Circle of Spores. I wish you luck, stranger.
Collect 4 Enchanted Water from a beguiled water elemental in the naiad cave upstream and combine them in Underveil's Phial.
After handing Sporeweaver Underveil the completed sample you receive Staff of Spores.
You receive Staff of Spores from Sporeweaver Underveil.
Need combined item name, along with relevant dialogue, exp, money, faction hits.

Find a skeleton named Bones in the Night Harbor Necropolis (Concourse of Souls). He is in the same room as Sekhmet who gives the initial Necromancer quest. The room is through the middle path when you enter from the courtyard.
Hail Bones. He is unable to talk, but will hand you Bones' Note of Tidings. The note mentions a list of necrotic procurement.
to Bones.
Return 20 Bone Chips, 1 Skeleton Jawbone, and the list of necrotic procurement
Receive Necrolyte's Pouch (4 slot small belt pouch), Note of Gratitude.
2nd list. Say "take the list of charred procurements.

quests.title: Necromancer Starter Quest (Night Harbor)
rewards: Symbol of the Concourse of Souls

parts.text: Part 1
Read Weathered Note you start with as a new Necromancer character:
You have been summoned to the Concourse of Souls.

Show this note to Marvion Hallows in the Concourse's library to begin your training.

The Concourse is carved into the mountainside of the necropolis. It is accessible through Sageside; simply head north before you enter Saltbreeze Park.

Or, if you're feeling daring, take the shortcut through the old cemetery outside the Black Feather Bazaar.

You may speak with a guard if you get lost; however, exercise caution, as some do not agree with our practices.

And try not to die. We have enough undead in the desert already.
Give Weathered Note to Marvion Hallows.

Marvion Hallows: Oh, a new student! This is worth the interruption, well, as long as you don't make a habit of it. I assume you'll be dealing primarily with Buckmarr, Sekhmet, or one of Exavius's people, as I am quite busy.
Marvion Hallows: Given the influx of new students, Sekhmet should be prepared for your arrival. Take your note to him. You'll find him below in the morgue.
Receive Weathered Note from Marvion Hallows.
You gain experience.
Part 2
Give Weathered Note to Sekhmet who is also in the Concourse of Souls.
Sekhmet smiles at you awkwardly, yet seems genuinely happy to meet you.
Sekhmet: Welcome to the Concourse of Souls! As the professor may have mentioned, I am Sekhmet. I will assist you in your studies.

Sekhmet: As you can see, we try to keep the morgues well-stocked to accommodate a broad varied range of study. Fortunately, Night Harbor is generous in its donations to our cause... the city produces a lot of dead.
Sekhmet sighs, and then perks up again.

Sekhmet: Buckmarr, our alchemist, asked me to gather some materials for him. I genuinely do not enjoy the outdoors, so perhaps you could assist with this? Take this jar and fill it with Incarnal Residue. Eight should do. Then bring it to Buckmarr.
Sekhmet squints and leans forward, as if expecting a question from you.
Sekhmet: You do know what incarnal residue is, do you not?
Receive Small Clay Jar from Sekhmet.
You gain experience.
Sekhmet: Excellent question! Incarnal residue is the name that Buckmarr has given a fascinating substance he is researching. He is very fond of giving things new names.

Sekhmet: The residue can be found on the bones of reanimated skeletons. Though Buckt disagrees, I believe it manifests most commonly when the skeleton's life, or more accurately, animating energy is drained from its corporeal form through necromantic magic.
Sekhmet: Keep that in mind.
Sekhmet: Good hunting, and do not forget to give the jar to Buckmarr once it has been filled!
Part 3
Combine 8 Incarnal Residue in Small Clay Jar to get a filled Small Clay Jar. Hand it to Buckmarr Gorstagg in the Concourse of Souls.
Newbie Note: if the jar is missing after hitting combine, check your tradeskill containers
Buckmarr Gorstagg stares at you with a puzzled expression.
Buckmarr Gorstagg: Ahh, you're new. I bet Sekhmet sent you out so he could continue to hide inside. Did he tell you that this was my discovery?
Buckmarr Gorstagg holds up the jar proudly.
Buckmarr Gorstagg: Well, it was. It's just one of many. I have a knack for alchemical advancement. One day, our modest college will be quite renowned at the rate I'm going.
Buckmarr Gorstagg fetches a simple robe with the guild's cred embroidered on its collar.
Buckmarr Gorstagg: Speaking of renown, you may wear this to formalize your association with our fine school.
Receive Black and Gold Robe from Buckmarr Gorstagg
Buckmarr Gorstagg: Now, if you'd like to assist me with another matter, read this list and return it to me along with the materials it describes. These items are vital to my research.
Receive Buckmarr's List from Buckmarr Gorstagg
Buckmarr Gorstagg pauses to stare at you in a more serious manner.
Buckmarr Gorstagg: Except for the pelt, that's a personal matter. I loathe wererats.
You gain experience.
Part 4
Turn in Buckmarr's List along with Wererat Pelt, Corrupted Heart, Ghostly Cloth Scrap, Vibroplasmic Residue
Buckmarr Gorstagg examines the pelt for a moment before throwing it over a collection of wererat heads.
Buckmarr Gorstagg: Well, I hope that one suffered.
Buckmarr Gorstagg returns his attention to you.
Buckmarr Gorstagg: Thank you for the materials. I'll likely need more assistance in the future, but in the meantime, familiarize yourself with the others you'll find here.
Receive Symbol of the Concourse of Souls from Buckmarr Gorstagg
You gain experience.
Part 1
Find the tunnel in the southeast corner of Underdocks. Soren Akedd is in the first room inside the temple.
Soren Akedd: You appear before me as you were in my nightmare, [Player].
Soren Akedd: Nightmares are visits from Ygorath, gifted upon the fearful of this land. It was my nightmare that called you here to begin his work.
Soren Akedd: He is the fear and the terror that opens our eyes.
A black bat screeches as it swoops in to attack Soren Akedd!
Soren Akedd: It is the work of trembling hands to raise both the living and the dead upon his altar. It is for their salvation as much as our own.

Soren Akedd: Many souls walk Eth-ur practicing feints of valor, but Ygorath's wisdom knows bravery to be a thin sheen upon a bottomless terror. We must usher them into his kingdom with right fear in their hearts.
Soren Akedd: This you must do, Necromancer, whether by sign or by sword. If you pass the test.

Soren Akedd: The rabble fear in their blood and their bones. Ours are borne by Ygorath. This is your test: take this Effigy to the chapel and make of it an offering. Place your effigy upon the altar and receive Ygorath's blessing. Return with what remains.
You receive Strange Effigy.
Soren Akedd: But I must warn you... cast your gaze downward and look not upon the visage of Ygorath.
Go to the chapel and type
near the altar.
As the effigy leaves your fingers, it turns to ash without flame.
You receive Offering Bowl.
Return to Soren Akedd and turn in the Offering Bowl.
Soren Akedd: Your eyes are open. Take this drape and rise a new servant of Ygorath.
You gain experience.
Faction: The Trembling Hand +
Faction: The Dreaming Dawn -
You receive Ragged Robe from Soren Akedd.
Soren Akedd: Now go, and do his work. I believe Abbot Harrow has tasks suited to an aspirant such as yourself. You may find him below.
Part 2
Head to the lower level of the building and locate Abbot Harrow.
Abbot Harrow rifles through a stack of manuscripts.
Abbot Harrow: Are you the new aspirant?

Abbot Harrow: Yes, you have that look about you. Like a beaten dog. You might even be commended for tucking tail in the master's temple, but you must learn to stand upright if you are to walk the path.
Abbot Harrow: Fortunate for you, I have a task suitable for a pup.
Abbot Harrow: Our work requires material. Test yourself against the risen dead outside the temple.
Abbot Harrow: Take this satchel and collect four femurs. Combine and deliver them to my pupil, Vryar.
You receive Femur Satchel from Abbot Harrow.
Abbot Harrow: He should be in the cemetery, where he communes with the dead.
Part 3
Kill risen skeletons outside the temple to collect 4 femurs. Place all four inside the Femur Satchel and combine them to create a Full Femur Satchel.
Find Acolyte Vryar in the cemetery and hand him the Full Femur Satchel.
You gain experience.
Faction: The Trembling Hand +
Acolyte Vryar: Ah, a delivery. Sister Morvea and I will put these to good use.
Acolyte Vryar scrawls a note in his journal and tears out the page.
Acolyte Vryar: Take this receipt and thank the Abbot for giving you this opportunity. Our paths will cross again.
You receive Delivery Receipt.
Return to Abbot Harrow and give him the Delivery Receipt.
You gain experience.
Faction: The Trembling Hand +
Abbot Harrow: I am glad to see you did not embarrass yourself today. There will be future opportunities.
Abbot Harrow: Until that day comes, heed the word of Ygorath.
Abbot Harrow sighs and hands you a book.
You receive Beaten Tome.
Part 4
Abbot Harrow: If you wish to make yourself useful, seek an audience with Lady Tabitha. You will find her in the laboratory upstairs.
Go upstairs to the laboratory and locate Lady Tabitha.
Lady Tabitha hums to herself.
Lady Tabitha: Oh, here's a new one. Who sent you to me? Or have you become a nuisance of your own volition?
Lady Tabitha: Indeed! Each somehow less promising than the last, it seems. No matter. If you can furnish the ingredients I require, I will endorse your aspiration.
Lady Tabitha: The embalmers keep me busy. Venture into the caverns beyond the Underdocks and fetch me as many spider eyes as this will carry.
You receive Deepweb Eye Bag.
Lady Tabitha: Undamaged, if you please.
Hunt spiders in the nearby caverns, place their eyes in the Deepweb Eye Bag, and combine to form a full bag. Turn the bag in to Lady Tabitha.
You gain experience.
Faction: The Trembling Hand +
Lady Tabitha: I thank you, Necromancer. The work continues. Give this letter to Abbot Harrow as a sign of your progress.
You receive Alchemist's Reference Letter.
Return to Abbot Harrow and give him the Alchemist's Reference Letter along with your Beaten Tome.
You gain experience.
Faction: The Trembling Hand +
Abbot Harrow unfolds the letter.
Abbot Harrow: You continue to make yourself useful. Hand me the alchemist's letter along with your tome of Ygorath, and I will augment its power.
Abbot Harrow: May the word of Ygorath guide you on the path.
You receive Well-Thumbed Tome.
Part 5
Requirement: Level 10
Abbot Harrow: Embalmer Tyriel has need of your services. Find him below.
Head downstairs to find Embalmer Tyriel.
Embalmer Tyriel: I have a task suitable for an aspirant who has mastered the gifts of Ygorath.
Embalmer Tyriel: Use your gifts to spread Ygorath's fear in the Deep.
Embalmer Tyriel: Take this and fill it with elder shadowbone marrow and the blood of Deepcut bandits. Three samples of each will suffice. And remember, they must die in fear.
You receive Collection Box.
Elder shadowbones spawn on the west side of the northern gate.
Deepcut bandits spawn on the east side of the northern gate.
Collect 3 Elder Shadowbone Marrows and 3 Deepcut Bandit Bloods, place them inside the Collection Box, and combine to obtain the Full Collection Box.
Return and give the Full Collection Box to Embalmer Tyriel.
You gain experience.
Faction: The Trembling Hand +
Embalmer Tyriel: Ygorath's gifts sustain us. Deliver these to Lady Tabitha upstairs to aid her work and our salvation.
You receive Full Collection Box.
Bring the Full Collection Box upstairs to Lady Tabitha.
Lady Tabitha: A delivery! Let's see.
Lady Tabitha opens the box and inhales deeply.
Lady Tabitha: How delightful. With this material I can distill the humors needed to brew our strongest potions. But I require another ingredient, still.
You receive Fearful Humors.
Lady Tabitha: An abomination has been sighted roaming beyond the Underdocks. Few aspirants who have tried to hunt the creature have returned, and they say it cannot know fear.
Lady Tabitha: Bring me the shriveled heart of this ghoul, as well as the fearful humors. See that you do not join your fallen brothers and sisters. My work must continue.
Hunt An Abominable Ghoul, which wanders near the elder shadowbones.
Note: He is immune to Fear, but can be Snared. Exercise caution as roaming around elder shadowbones can trigger additional adds; bring a group if necessary.
Loot the Shriveled Ghoul Heart and hand both it and the Fearful Humors to Lady Tabitha.
You gain experience.
Faction: The Trembling Hand +
Lady Tabitha: How unnatural.
Lady Tabitha: Thank Ygorath for your gifts. Present this letter to Tyriel, along with your tome of Ygorath.
You receive Tabitha's Letter.
Return to Embalmer Tyriel in the crypt. Hand him Tabitha's Letter along with your Well-Thumbed Tome.
You gain experience.
Faction: The Trembling Hand +
Embalmer Tyriel: You have earned the privilege to carry these sacred words. Perhaps the day will come when you can seek the lost manuscripts of Sakrel with the rest of your ilk.
You receive Oblate's Tome.
Part 1 - Prove Your Worth
Gatekeeper Nusder is located at the Red Mantle Keep entrance to the cemetery in Night Harbor.
Gatekeeper Nusder: Yes, what is it?
Gatekeeper Nusder: I'm responsible for the gate to Night Harbor's cemetery and the crypts within.

Gatekeeper Nusder: Don't get any ideas about sneaking in... diseased beasts linger beyond the main path during the day, and it gets significantly worse at night. It's a very dangerous place, not for the faint of heart.

parts.say: Why are there diseased beasts here?

parts.text: Gatekeeper Nusder: The place is cursed. It wasn't like that years ago, but it's gotten much worse, especially after sunset.
Gatekeeper Nusder: At night, the cemetery is full of undead creatures roaming the grounds, searching for poor souls to kill and haunt.
Gatekeeper Nusder: They're the restless remains of our ancestors. The catacombs are filled with unnamed folk... buried alive, executed, or thrown in like bones to the dogs.
Gatekeeper Nusder: The outdoor area beyond the bridge is the crypt. That's where the noble families are buried. All of them seem cursed to haunt the living forever, never able to find peace.
Gatekeeper Nusder: We're powerless to stop it, and Haradrel knows we've tried. Many good men and women were lost, and we've got nothing to show for it. Such folly!

parts.say: Maybe I can help stop it?

parts.text: Gatekeeper Nusder: Apologies, but I don't trust you to do anything but add to our troubles.
Gatekeeper Nusder: My duty matters to me, and without proof of your worth, I won't risk another life on this venture.
Gatekeeper Nusder may be referring to player level as 'proof of worth' here.
Need to verify - minimum starting level for quest.

parts.say: How can I prove my worth?

parts.text: Gatekeeper Nusder looks you over.
Gatekeeper Nusder: You at least look like you can hold your own.
Gatekeeper Nusder: There's one thing we've yet to try... analyzing the source of the curse. If we could figure it out, maybe we could strike at its source and get rid of it.
Gatekeeper Nusder nods at you.
Gatekeeper Nusder: Fine! Go and grab the diseased flesh of the beasts during the day. Fill this sack with ten samples so there's plenty to analyze.
You receive Empty Satchel from Gatekeeper Nusder.
Gatekeeper Nusder: If you can return to me still alive, we might be able to get the samples looked at in Sageside.
Gatekeeper Nusder looks at you sternly.
Gatekeeper Nusder: Let me make myself clear... do NOT linger in the cemetery after Eth has set. I don't want another death on my conscience!
The gates to the cemetery will close at sunset and re-open at sunrise. NPCs inside the cemetery become aggressive and higher level once the sun sets.
Enter the gate and kill a diseased bat or a catacombs rat and loot Chunk of Diseased Meat x10. The meat is NODROP and not guaranteed on every kill, so plan accordingly if grouping here.
After combining the meats in the Empty Satchel, you receive Fetid Satchel.
Give the Fetid Satchel to Gatekeeper Nusder.
Any exp hits? Faction hits?
Gatekeeper Nusder looks visibly relieved.
Gatekeeper Nusder: You had me worried. I'm glad you're still breathing!
Gatekeeper Nusder: ...And you've got the flesh we needed, well done.
Gatekeeper Nusder: Now, bring the satchel to my friend Liyna in Sageside. You'll find her in the Grand Library.
Gatekeeper Nusder: Ask her to take a closer look at the flesh and see if she can find anything.
Part 2 - The Source of Corruption
Find Liyna Esueiruc in the second floor (teleporter puts you on floor 3) of the Night Harbor library (which is due east from Gatekeeper Nusder, at the Spellbinders of the Spire).
Liyna Esueiruc continues reading her book, then lifts her eyes and furrows her brow.
Liyna Esueiruc: What's this you're carrying? I can sense something isn't right...
Give Liyna Esueiruc the Fetid Satchel.
Liyna Esueiruc drops the satchel out of shock.
Liyna Esueiruc looks at you, stunned, then picks the satchel back up with the tip of her fingers, handing it back to you.
Liyna Esueiruc: The smell... and the cursed energy emanating from this! What is Nusder getting himself into? This can't be good.
Liyna Esueiruc: Are you certain this is something you want to be involved in?
Liyna Esueiruc looks you in the eyes, finally giving you a nod.
Liyna Esueiruc: He must've seen something in you if he sent you to me.
Liyna Esueiruc concentrates and casts a spell.
Liyna Esueiruc: There, hand me the bag once more, I should be able to handle it without risk now.
Give Liyna Esueiruc the Fetid Satchel again.
Liyna Esueiruc looks at the contents with extreme focus and attention.
Liyna Esueiruc: An old scent... cursed magic from another generation. I'm not surprised it's coming from the graveyard.
Liyna Esueiruc murmurs something unintelligible.
Liyna Esueiruc: The result of an ancient form of necromancy... I'm sure of it.
Liyna Esueiruc: We need to dig deeper.
Liyna Esueiruc points in the direction of the cemetery.
Liyna Esueiruc: The diseased beasts are just a byproduct of what's really happening there. We need to find the source.
Liyna Esueiruc: Take this note to Nusder right away.
You receive Lightly Scented Piece of Parchment from Liyna Esueiruc.
Any faction hits? exp?
Return to Gatekeeper Nusder and hand him the Lightly Scented Piece of Parchment.
Gatekeeper Nusder: A note? Give me a second to read through Liyna's words.
Gatekeeper Nusder: Hmm... I feared she would say that.
You gain experience.
Any faction hits?
Gatekeeper Nusder sighs deeply before handing you back the note.
Gatekeeper Nusder: Are you sure you want to keep going?
Part 3 - A Sign of Necromancy
Gatekeeper Nusder: It's been a while since I've seen someone so eager to throw themselves into the maw of death.
Gatekeeper Nusder sighs with a slight grin on his face.
Gatekeeper Nusder: You remind me of my younger self. I'd be remiss not to give you a chance.
Gatekeeper Nusder: When you feel ready, head back into the cemetery during the day with a valiant group of adventurers and look for any signs of necromancy.
Gatekeeper Nusder: It won't be easy to find, but if you do, come back to me immediately with the note and proof of it.
You are to head back into the cemetery and find a Bloodied Engraved Rune.
Kill a pristine beetle, a sanguine bat, an old scarab, an ornate beetle, or other named that requires camping till it spawns at the top of the cemetery and loot Bloodied Engraved Rune.
Return to Gatekeeper Nusder and give him Bloodied Engraved Rune along with Lightly Scented Piece of Parchment.
Gatekeeper Nusder: What's this you've found?
Gatekeeper Nusder looks over the bloodied rune.
Gatekeeper Nusder: I'm not certain what it means... but then again, it's not something I've seen before. Let me quickly write to Liyna.
Gatekeeper Nusder: Here, take this note and the rune to Liyna right away!
You receive Simple Piece of Parchment from Gatekeeper Nusder.
Part 4 - Further Research
Return to Liyna Esueiruc and give her Bloodied Engraved Rune along with Simple Piece of Parchment.
Liyna Esueiruc snatches the note out of your hands and reads it through hurriedly.
Liyna Esueiruc looks at the bloodied rune, inspecting it from all angles.
You gain experience.
Any faction hits?
Liyna Esueiruc: An even stronger remnant of cursed magic... Now I'm sure of it. There's something, or someone, hiding in the cemetery, and they're doing more than just hiding.
Liyna Esueiruc: We need more clues, but the cemetery's beasts won't carry them.
Liyna Esueiruc looks at you intently.
Liyna Esueiruc: You know what this means, don't you?
Liyna Esueiruc scribbles something down and hands it to you.
Liyna Esueiruc: Please share this message with Nusder and see whether he's of a same mind.
Liyna Esueiruc: In the meanwhile I'll keep studying this rune and see if there's more we can figure out.
You receive Scented Piece of Parchment from Liyna Esueiruc.
Return to Gatekeeper Nusder and hand him the Scented Piece of Parchment.
Gatekeeper Nusder: I see how it is... so be it. We have no other choice.
Gatekeeper Nusder: I'm entrusting you with the task of finding more clues.
Gatekeeper Nusder hands you a tarnished old key.
You receive Key to the Night Harbor Cemetery from Gatekeeper Nusder.
Gatekeeper Nusder: You've earned yourself a key to the cemetery, but use it with the utmost care. Stepping foot in there at night will test your mettle, and your life will be at great risk!
Gatekeeper Nusder stares worriedly at the cemetery gates.
Gatekeeper Nusder: Haradrel be with you, adventurer. We're onto something...
To be continued, probably requires killing a noble skeleton, a bejeweled skeleton, a majestic skeleton or a crowned skeleton.
More details are required...
Prove Your Worth

parts.say: How can I prove my worth?

parts.text: to Gatekeeper Nusder.
Loot 10 x Chunk of Diseased Meat from a diseased bat or a catacombs rat.
Place 10 x Chunk of Diseased Meat (as a stack) in Empty Satchel and click Combine.
Give Fetid Satchel to Gatekeeper Nusder.
The Source of Corruption
Give Fetid Satchel to Liyna Esueiruc.
to Liyna Esueiruc.
Give Fetid Satchel to Liyna Esueiruc again.
Give Lightly Scented Piece of Parchment to Gatekeeper Nusder.
A Sign of Necromancy
to Gatekeeper Nusder.
Loot Bloodied Engraved Rune from a pristine beetle, a sanguine bat, an old scarab, an ornate beetle, or other named mob.
Give Bloodied Engraved Rune and Lightly Scented Piece of Parchment to Gatekeeper Nusder.
Further Research
Give Bloodied Engraved Rune and Simple Piece of Parchment to Liyna Esueiruc.
Give Scented Piece of Parchment to Gatekeeper Nusder.
Quest complete!
Part 1
Read Formal Note you start with as a new Paladin Character:

To whom it may concern,

The Wayfarers Hospice is in need of charitable souls who are gifted with a healing touch.

Please bring this note and your interest to Thibald
Burlond at the Hospice, located in the Travelers
Ward to the north of the city's Western Gate.

Should you find yourself lost, ask one of the guards.
They have likely received our treatment before.

May your journey be blessed.

-The Penitent Knights of the Hospice
Hand Formal Note to Thibald Burlond in the Wayfarer's Hospice north of the West Gate
You gain experience.
Thibald Burlond reads the note, then gives you a generous nod.
Thibald Burlond suddenly stands upright and straightens his tunic.
Thibald Burlond: Welcome to the Wayfarers Hospice. I am Grand Master Thibald Burdlond of the Penitent Knights of the Hospice.
Thibald Burlond: We accept all paladins who come to aid and maintain our order, no matter their background or faith.
Thibald Burlond pauses for a moment to assess you.

Thibald Burlond: This hospice is known to Night Harbor's citizens and authorities alike as a place of order and charity. Your faith and your history are of no concern, but do not besmirch our good name.
Thibald Burlond: Now, please deliver the note you just gave me to Master Fulton. You will serve his needs.
You receive Formal Note from Thibald Burlond.
Hand Formal Note to Trey Fulton
You gain experience.
Trey Fulton takes the note without reading it and wave you closer.
Trey Fulton: Our Grand Master is a loud enough fella, isn't he?
Trey Fulton: It's a pleasure to meet you and all that, but let's cut right to it, eh? We've got a lot of work ahead of us.
Trey Fulton: An increasing number of travelers are coming through our city gates having been wounded or worse. Most tell tales of Ashira ambushes or hordes of undead appearing in the night.
Trey Fulton leans closer to you and places something in your hand.
Trey Fulton: But before we send you to take on the night, I need you to show this coin to Ol' Grimsul at the inn just across the street. This will be your first big mission.
Trey Fulton winks at you.
You receive Penitent Knight's Coin from Trey Fulton.
Head to the Inn near the West Gate and hand your Penitent Knight's Coin to Halrinn Grimsul
You gain experience.
Halrinn Grimsul looks at the coin, then returns it.
Halrinn Grimsul: Well, it's good to see that the old cuss finally found his appetite.
Halrinn Grimsul: It looks like you've become his courier, brave knight.
Halrinn Grimsul: But first, you'll need to do the other thing he sent you here for.
Halrinn Grimsul smiles at you and places a filthy bag on the bar.
Halrinn Grimsul: As a brave defender of whatever faith you claim to follow, I'm sure my task is a trivial endeavor. I'll need you to kill two birds with one stone, so to speak.
Halrinn Grimsul: We're short on staff, so I'm stuck up here for a bit while grain beetles gnaw away at our supplies in the cellar. Also, our cook is running low on ingredients for the stew...

Halrinn Grimsul: You get it, right? Fill the bag with their legs and return it to me. Then you can go back to whatever brave deeds you thought you'd be doing. Just make sure those legs are intact and juicy looking.
Halrinn Grimsul laughs to himself as he wipes down the bar.
You receive Halrinn's Bag from Halrinn Grimsul.
Head behind the bar and head to the basement and kill a grain beetles until you receive 6 of them. Alternatively you can buy them.
Combine 6 of them in Halrinn's Bag ensuring they are not stacked. You will receive Bag of Intact Beetle Legs
Hand Bag of Intact Beetle Legs to Halrinn Grimsul
You gain experience.
Halrinn Grimsul whistles appreciatively and mock bows.
Halrinn Grimsul: Everyone, my brave defender has returned!
Halrinn Grimsul: I may jest, but... I do truly appreciate the assistance. Master Fulton's food is wrapped up and ready to go. Deliver it to my dear sir, before it gets cold.
Halrinn Grimsul: And no, don't worry, it's not the stew.
Halrinn Grimsul winks at you.
Halrinn Grimsul leans towards you, taking on a more serious disposition.
Halrinn Grimsul: Do see that he gets this and eats it. I'm glad he finally sent for something. I'll not have him waste away from worry.
Halrinn Grimsul: The situation with his son is unfortunate, and he's a good man. There's no telling what happened to his son. He was a paladin, like yourself.
Halrinn Grimsul: I'll not have him starve while waiting on word in the meantime.
You receive Food for Trey Fulton from Halrinn Grimsul.
Hand Food for Trey Fulton to Trey Fulton
You gain experience.
Trey Fulton takes the bundled food and sets it aside.
Trey Fulton: Thank you for this. I assume Halrinn put you to work for it.
Trey Fulton hands you a simple tunic bearing the guild's insignia.
Trey Fulton: Take this for your efforts.
Trey Fulton: It was good for you to meet, Halrinn. He may tend bar now, but he was formidable in his day. As were many of the people you'll serve here in the hospice and as part of our guild.
Trey Fulton: This place and our duty, is a constant reminder that time moves swiftly, eluding even the most fastidious grasp.
Trey Fulton shakes his head and looks up to meet your gaze.
Trey Fulton: Ah, look at me getting all morose. Don your tunic and explore the city. I have nothing for you now, but come back soon and we'll put you to work.
You receive Simple Penitent Knight's Tunic from Trey Fulton.
Part 2
Return to the Shaded Bloom Inn near West Gate and ask Halrinn Grimsul about Trey's son

Halrinn Grimsul: Master Fulton's son, Troy, went on an expedition to investigate the origins of the undead in our area and has yet to return. His son is an experienced paladin, but he's been missing for weeks.
Halrinn Grimsul sighs.
Halrinn Grimsul: Given all the kindness they showed my brother during his last days in the hospice, I'm compelled to assist however I can... But here I am, my adventuring days behind me.
Halrinn Grimsul pauses for a moment, then smacks the bar.
Halrinn Grimsul: I overheard a conversation last week between a few inebriated archaeologists from the Wyrmsbane site.
Halrinn Grimsul: They've been unable to explore the site too deeply due to increased undead activity, but they mentioned seeing what looked like signs of a recent and significant skirmish.
Halrinn Grimsul: It's not much to go on, so I haven't passed it along. I'd hate to worry Master Fulton without real cause. Please keep this between us, and deliver that food before it gets cold.
Head to the Tomb of the Last Wyrmsbane to search for clues regarding the whereabouts of Trey Fulton's son.
To complete this quest, you will need to gather three items and combine them:
Obtain the Tattered Field Pack from Dario Numas. (Note: This is a 2-slot container).
Obtain the Torn Cloak, a rare drop from a skeletal Archer or Skeletal Marksman.

Obtain the Engraved Coin located upstairs in the Tomb. Stand between the two blue-flamed braziers in the "Skull Wall" room until you see the message: "You notice a glimmer from a crack in the floor." Use the command
to retrieve it.
Combine the Torn Cloak and Engraved Coin inside the Tattered Field Pack to create Troy's Field Pack.
Hand Troy's Field Pack to Trey Fulton
You gain experience.
Trey Fulton abruptly straightens his posture, looking shocked.
Trey Fulton: By the Gods! This is my son's field pack. These items belong to Troy!
Trey Fulton: I'd heard rumors that he and his men entered the tomb, but now we have confirmation!
Trey Fulton: The initiative you've shown is only outdone by your heroism. Remove that trainee tunic and take this with my gratitude. You're clearly deserving of a more permanent role here.
Trey Fulton looks at his son's field pack.
Trey Fulton: He may have lost his gear, but he's still alive. I can feel it.
Trey Fulton: I'm going to speak with Grand Master Burlond about the appropriate course of action. In the meantime, please let me know if you see any signs of my son while you're beyond the gates.
You receive Penitent Knight's Tunic from Trey Fulton.
Part 3
Give 6 Tel Ekir Warrior Pelts to Brother Luka during the day.
You will receive a random piece of the Lunar Festival set.
The Tel Ekir Warrior Pelts can be obtained in Tel Ekir. Known sources include Ashir the Protector and an ashira warchief.
a wise elder is located in the large stone building just to the North of the West Bank in Night Harbor.
a wise elder: It's perilous to leave by oneself! Take this.
You receive a wooden weapon from a wise elder.
a wise elder looks pleased.
a wise elder: Also, take someone with you, a companion you can trust to guard your back. Your survival will depend on it.
Farmer Ammar is located at the farm just northeast of the caster tower outside of the North Gate of Night Harbor.
Farmer Ammar: Hello! It's good to see you.
Farmer Ammar: As you can see, we've been overrun by pests. Our loyal farmhand and I can barely keep up with these filthy interlopers.
Farmer Ammar: Care to help us out?
Farmer Ammar: Oh, Krivea's blessings upon you, friend!
Farmer Ammar: My wife, Fadila, is in the house. Bring her proof you've slain these pests... preferably something we can cook up.
Farmer Ammar: We'll reward you with what we can. We don't have much, but perhaps some of our supplies could help you on your journey.

parts.say: What sort of proof do you require?

parts.text: Farmer Ammar: Ah, looking for specifics? Fair enough.
Farmer Ammar: How about meat from the four-legged ones, eggs from the snakes, and legs from the beetles?
You are looking for any of the following drops:
Snake Egg
Scarab Leg
Fire Beetle Legs
Raw Rat Meat
Raw Jackal Meat
When you have acquired some proof, turn them in to Fadila back at the farm. She is located in the house behind Farmer Ammar.
You gain experience.
Fadila: Krivea's blessings for your assistance!
Fadila: It's not much, but please accept this gift in return.
You receive, at randomProbabilities: Torch 10%, Water Flask 45%, Ration 45%, a Torch, a Water Flask or a Ration from Fadila.

quests.title: Platinum Badge of the Living City Quest
rewards: Platinum Badge of the Living City

parts.text: Preparation
To receive the quest from Lieutenant Jarovik Holt you'll need Kindly + 1 yellows (20%) Bends Garrison faction.
You can raise the Bends Garrison faction via the quest: Riverbend Gang Wars Quest which requires turning in:
Bloodied_Allegiance_Cuffs
You can also raise Bends Garrison faction though killing within the bends.
Part 1 - Getting Ahead of the Problem
Lieutenant Jarovik Holt: You have gained my attention, Elementalist, I have a task that must be done, if you have the courage to see it through.
Lieutenant Jarovik Holt: The Ten Hooks and the Waterdogs have been a thorn in my side for far too long. Bring me the heads of the Brask brothers and Cormac Renshaw.
Lieutenant Jarovik Holt gives you a small bag with 3 slots, put the three heads in the bag then combine and hand over the bag.
Kill Vikar Brask and get the Head of Vikar Brask
Location 1 in the image above. He spawns in a small hut on top of the building.
Kill Darius Brask and get the Head of Darius Brask
Location 2 in the image above. He spawns in the top most building in the area above the book-cases.
Kill Cormac Renshaw and get the Head of Cormac
Location 3 in the image above. He spawns inside the boat.
Combine into Sack of Heads
Lieutenant Jarovik Holt reaches into the bloodstained satch and examines it's contents.
You receive 1 gold, and 50 silver from Lieutenant Jarovik Holt.
Lieutenant Jarovik Holt: You have done hte people of Night Harbor a great service on this, Maev, and you have earned my respect. Take this badge as proof of your bravery.
You receive Iron Badge of the City
Part 2 - The one that got away
Lieutenant Jarovik Holt nods at you.
Lieutenant Jarovik Holt: You have proven yourself, Name. Are you prepared for one final mission?
Lieutenant Jarovik Holt: I do not ask this lightly, but it must be done. Bring me the viper's head, Name. Bring me the head of Eamon Kassir.
Kill Eamon Kassir and loot Head of Eamon Kassir.
Location 4 in the image above. He spawns in a room at the very top of the structure near a table that has potions on it. Deceptive Trickster is PH
Return the head to Lieutenant Jarovik Holt
Lieutenant Jarovik Holt takes the head of Eamon Kassir and holds it aloft in the light.
Lieutenant Jarovik Holt drops the head on the ground.
Lieutenant Jarovik Holt: So it is done. I will have that thing piked on the gate for all to see. On my honor Name, we will finally purge Riverbend of these scum.
Lieutenant Jarovik Holt: You have my thanks. Present this commendation and your badge to Theodora.
You receive Jarovik's Commendation from Lieutenant Jarovik Holt.
Take your Iron Badge of the City and the Jarovik's Commendation to Corporal Theodora.
Corporal Theodora: You're one of us now, soldier. I know we'll do great things together.
You receive 2 gold from Corporal Theodora.
You receive Platinum Badge of the Living City from Corporal Theodora.

quests.title: Poacher's Knives
classes: ARC BRD BST CLR DRU FTR INQ MNK PAL RNG ROG SHD SHM SPB

parts.text: Ranger Rylin is located in the large treehouse in Keeper's Bight, located next to one of the internal stairwells.

Ranger Rylin: Greetings, . I am Rylin of the Ardent Keepers, sworn warden of Evershade Weald's ancient forests and surrounding lands. I have been sent here to root out the poachers who scar this land with their blatant disregard of the natural order. If you are willing to aid our cause, I have a reward selected by the High Keeper himself for your efforts.

parts.say: I am willing to aid your cause.

parts.text: Ranger Rylin: Your resolve honors our cause, . The poachers wield skinning knives etched with their foul mark. Bring me four of them as proof of your deed, and I shall reward your service. May the forests' will guide you.
You need to hunt poacher variants such as a poacher and collect 4 x Poacher's Skinner.
When you have collected 4 x Poacher's Skinner, give them to Ranger Rylin.

Ranger Rylin: You have done a great service for the Ardent Keepers and the Keepers Bight, Cilantro! The forest breathes easier thanks to your efforts. Now, take this bracer as a symbol of our gratitude and your bond to our cause.
You receive High Keeper's Vambrace from Ranger Rylin.
You gain experience.
Faction: Ardent Keepers +
Faction: Village of Penshaw +
Faction: Poachers of Calafrey -
Part of the experience in Glinting Hollow is becoming a test subject for the various concoctions on the 6th floor.
Locate and hail Veylith the Frosttongue.
Need directions to Veylith..
Veylith the Frosttongue: Consumption without understanding is death.
Veylith the Frosttongue: I will help you no further, are you willing to take the risk?

parts.say: I am willing to take the risk

parts.text: Veylith the Frosttongue: Take this and go.
You receive Mixing Satchel from Veylith the Frosttongue.
Use the /take Mushroom MUD command near various colors of mushrooms in the area to collect them.
Red Mushroom -- From the Green Wall Mushrooms
Green Mushroom -- From the Green Floor Mushrooms
White Mushroom -- From the White Floor Mushrooms
Black Mushroom -- From Gazer(drops 3) or a myconid prince(drops 2)
Any other colors?
Combine two mushrooms in your Mixing Satchel to create a potion with various effects.
Combinations
White || Red || Emberfrost Slurry ||
Green || Red || Blightflare Slurry ||
Black || Red || Cindermire Slurry ||
Red || Red || Flaming Slurry || Inferno (Fire Damage)
White || White || Paletwin Slurry || Shrink
Green || Green || Verdantsurge Slurry || Heal
UNAVAILABLE || UNAVAILABLE || Darkroot Slurry ||
White || Black || Greyash Slurry || Fae Blessing (Others can see with sense magic)
Black || Green || Mirebloom Slurry ||
White || Green || Wisproot Slurry ||
Are there any further dialogues depending on which potions are created?
More information required related to various potion effects.
Do various buffs unlock more content within the zone? E.g., does Greyash Slurry unveil a new NPC or area?
Part 1 - Quality Samples
Find Tust Brookturner, located at the Quarry in Sungreet Strand.
Tust Brookturner glances up past his worn, dusty spectacles.
Tust Brookturner: Ah! You're finally here. This is great news, great news indeed! You brought the quarry samples, I presume?
Tust Brookturner pushes his spectacles up the bridge of his nose.
Tust Brookturner: Oh, my mistake. I thought you were the laborer assigned to collect quarry samples for me.
Tust Brookturner: You'll do, though! All you need is a mining pick. You're familiar with mining, yes?
Tust Brookturner: Here, take this sack, fill it with quality samples, and bring it back to me for inspection. In return, you'll receive coin!
You receive Tust's Burlap Sack from Tust Brookturner.
Fill the sack with 8 pieces of Quarry Stone from mining in quarry.
Combine to create Full Burlap Sack.
Return to Tust Brookturner and hand him the Full Burlap Sack.
Tust Brookturner: Yes, yes! This will do quite nicely. Here's the coin that was promised.
You receive 3 copper from Tust Brookturner.
Any faction hits? EXP?
Part 2 - Ample Samples

Tust Brookturner: You seem quite skilled with a pickaxe. Some of the workers here mentioned seeing traces of exceptional minerals at the site. If you're interested in a bit of a challenge, I could use your help.

parts.say: I am interested in a bit of a challenge.

parts.text: Tust Brookturner: Good, good! Now, let me see... where did I put that list? Mrs. Pebblebank! Do you have the list of minerals I jotted down earlier?
Tust Brookturner: Ah, nevermind! Here it is.
Tust Brookturner: The ample sample list is as follows... four pieces of pyrite ore, three clear crystal shards, two smoky shards, and a flawless clear quartz.
Tust Brookturner: Place the minerals in this case and seal it, then bring the case and note back to me. A full case of minerals means a full payout in coin! Good luck!
Need item name and ID for the ingredient list.
You receive Tust's Display Case from Tust Brookturner.
From the Quality Quarry Stone nodes, mine the requested minerals
4 x Pyrite Ore
3 x Clear Quartz Shard
2 x Smoky Quartz
1 x Flawless Clear Quartz
Place each item in single stacks of 1 into Tust's Display Case and click Combine.
Missing combined item name and ID
Hand ?? to Tust Brookturner.
Tust Brookturner: Good... no, splendid work!
Tust Brookturner: Well then, a reward is in order. Take this as a token of appreciation from the Church of Trem.
You will randomly receive one of the following items as a reward:
Tust's Copper Earring=
You receive Tust's Copper Earring from Tust Brookturner.
Rope, Blessed, 50 Length=
You receive Rope, Blessed, 50 Length from Tust Brookturner.
Wand of Heal=
You receive Wand of Heal from Tust Brookturner.
Survey Pack=
You receive Survey Pack from Tust Brookturner.
You receive 4 copper from Tust Brookturner.
Any faction hits here?
Part 1 - Req. Lvl 1
Read Request for Aid you start with as a new Ranger Character:

The balance of the Weald is threatened and the natural
order disturbed.

Those with a connection to the lands and its creatures
are summoned to Rangers Rest upon Keepers Terrace.

To reach us, set out from the top of the Travelers Lift 
and venture past the inn, toward the Willows Whisper.
Ascend the ramp on the left to Traders Terrace, where
you will find the Rangers Rest across the span.

Any of the Defenders of Faelindral can offer directions if
asked.

When you arrive, deliver this pamphlet to Captain
Relgen Greenblade.

From there, your talents shall benefit the preservation of
all who call the Weald their home.

- High Keeper Caelen Stillbranch
Captain Relgen Greenblade waves you off with a dismissive gesture.
Captain Relgen Greenblade: I have no mind for idle talk, unless you've something important to share.
Hand in 1 x Request for Aid to Captain Relgen Greenblade.
You gain experience.
Your faction standing with Ardent Keepers got better.
Your faction standing with Fellstone Orcs got worse.
Captain Relgen Greenblade: Ah, a new volunteer? Let me get a look at you, then.
Captain Relgen Greenblade regards you with the emerald gaze of a veteran ranger, his rugged features stern and sharp. He nods after a quick appraisal and produces a small book for you to take.
You receive Ranger's Logbook from Captain Relgen Greenblade.
Captain Relgen Greenblade: You look like you'll do. I am Relgen Greenblade, Regional Captain of the Ardent Keepers, and it's my duty to safeguard our borders from all threats within and without.

Captain Relgen Greenblade: As the request mentioned, we're in need of fresh rangers who are willing to maintain a presence in Evershade Weald, and to that end, I would see that you're put to work immediately.
Captain Relgen Greenblade: Are you prepared, ranger?
Captain Relgen Greenblade nods curtly.

Captain Relgen Greenblade: Good. Being as fresh as you are, I'll not yet have you engage priority threats. Your first mission will be one of reconnaissance and familiarizing yourself with the forest's layout. Our rangers need to know their way around, after all.
Captain Relgen Greenblade: You'll investigate three locations within the Weald, then report your findings and any evidence you find in the logbook.
Captain Relgen Greenblade: If you can return with a full logbook of useful information, you'll have proven that you're worthy of being inducted into the Ardent Keepers as a formal initiate.

Captain Relgen Greenblade: As for the locations, you'll be reporting on the Whispering Pools, Sporehaven Karst, and a ruined archway that spans the border of Keepers Bight. You need only ask if you require further details on each of these locations.

Captain Relgen Greenblade: I'll remind you that you are to look closely at each site and report your findings. You are not there to take action. These places are still dangerous for a prospective ranger.
Captain Relgen Greenblade grimaces in disgust at the name, as though merely describing it is enough to revolt him.
Captain Relgen Greenblade: Devious naiads make the Whispering Pools their home. They reside behind the great falls of the river that splits the Weald in two.
Captain Relgen Greenblade: Be warned, the Fossergrim you'll encounter may be peaceful enough, but the nymphs who dwell further inside are known to possess travelers and keep them as playthings.

Captain Relgen Greenblade: Don't venture too deep inside. In fact, make your report from inside the cave's mouth, just past the threshold of the falls. I must know if there are any signs that they're attempting to breach their pact and leave the caves.

Captain Relgen Greenblade: It's my opinion that the fae in general cannot be trusted, even if bound to a pact. The naiads are no exception. Their mistress, Naelira, is bound to the pools of that cave, but I fear she wishes to expand her influence.
Captain Relgen Greenblade: Enough of the fae! Just speaking of them makes my ears burn. If you want to learn more about them, you should consult the Heartwood Archives.

Captain Relgen Greenblade: The Heartwood Archives is Faelindral's great library, kept by the Preservers. It's located just above the city bank. There's plenty to learn there for those who are so inclined.
Captain Relgen Greenblade: Sporehaven Karst is home to the Circle of Spores. They're a group of reclusive druids who dedicate themselves to the research and proliferation of fungi.
Captain Relgen Greenblade: Though normally quite harmless, their fungal research has a history of spreading infestations up into Faelindral, which we are then forced to cleanse.
Captain Relgen Greenblade: Venture beneath the city to the caves that have been carved out by the river's passage, and pray that there's no sign of their latest experiments growing out of control.
Captain Relgen Greenblade: If you do come across dangerous fungus, avoid it to the best of your ability while you search for evidence of the Circle's actions from the entrance of their domain.
Captain Relgen Greenblade: Disturbing rumors of the risen dead have made their way to Faelindral, particularly from the caravan route to the neighboring Keepers Bight.

Captain Relgen Greenblade: Venture south, away from the river, and follow the main road toward the Bight. Just before you reach the border, you should see the ancient archway of Calafrey beneath a foot bridge.
Captain Relgen Greenblade: See if you can find any evidence of an undead presence in the ruins, but don't engage them if the rumors prove true. Remember, you're only there to look this time around.
Evidence of Orcs
Look around the road near the ruined archway right before the zone-line for Keepers Bight using the MUD action

These great and ruined arches belonged to an ancient empire and served as a form of boundary that has long since fallen.
There are signs of caravans having crossed this threshold many times over, however a peculiar set of footprints catch your eye and warrant inspection.
Inspect the peculiar set of footprints using the MUD action

These footprints bear no resemblance to any hoof nor animal you’ve seen before, and follow an unorthodox step pattern that you cannot place.
They appear to lead back toward Faelindral before veering to the right, following a small path toward another set of ruins up the hill.
There is a large elderspire tree only a few steps away, between this location and the ruins, where you might get a safe view of what could be occupying the ancient, toppled structure.
Head to the elderspire tree to get a safe view using the MUD action

You hunker down near the roots of the elderspire and begin searching for the source of the footprints...
The trail leads to indications of undead infesting the ruins, their bone chips littering the ruin floor alongside numerous signs of adult wolves in the area.
Yet what draws your eye most is a second series of strange, alien footprints. These heavy prints stand out in stark contrast to the others.
Inspect the alien footprints using the MUD action

This second set of footprints was clearly made by a creature with significant bulk who stands on two feet. 
They do not appear to be wearing any sort of fashioned footwear, though you observe that they are supported by a set of only three toes. 
You know of only one creature that strides on two three-toed feet and could have made these impressions... orcs.
You receive Evidence of Orcs.
Evidence of the Nymphs
Behind the waterfall, at the entrance of the Fossergrim cave.

The continuous, thundering roar of the waterfall overwhelms all other sounds as it echoes back from deep within the cave that the naiads have claimed as their home.

Your eye catches sight of a series of wet, childlike footprints along the dampened stone... footprints that seem to beckon further inspection.

The footprints were freshly made, and nowhere near large enough to belong to one of the Fossergrim guarding the entrance.

It seems at least one nymph has recently been wandering out past the waterfall barrier, defying their bond. You decide to take this as evidence for your logbook.
You receive Evidence of Nymphs.
Evidence of Sporehaven
On the banks of the river that flows into the myconid cave

This damp and humid cave system proves to be the perfect breeding ground for fungus as made evident by its thriving myconid population. 
Along the banks of the gently flowing river you spy an odd, multicolored foam accumulating against the stone.

Closer examination of the foam reveals that it flows from further upstream before clinging to the edges of the rocky embankment. This could be a clue as to what's causing the local myconids to be acting so aggressively.
Touching the foam directly would not be wise, but perhaps you could rub a sample onto a page of your logbook.

You carefully rub a blank page of your logbook against the foam, smearing a small sample along it.The strange foam leaves a scintillating, multihued pattern across one of the blank pages.

It is so beautifully mesmerizing, and you find your gaze to be transfixed for a short time upon that single page...

Such an exquisite pattern...

You suddenly blink and snap back to your senses, tearing your gaze away from the page and quickly closing your logbook.
You receive Evidence of Sporehaven.
You receive Scintillating Page.
Combine Evidence of Orcs Evidence of Nymphs Evidence of Sporehaven Scintillating Page

Captain Relgen Greenblade accepts the logbook with a nod of gratitude. He flips through your reports, his brow arching slightly at the mesmerizing pattern splayed across one of the pages, though it seems to have no effect on him.
Captain Relgen Greenblade: An interesting method of procuring evidence, but I'll not scorn success. It seems my fears were not unfounded. I was right to send you to scout these locations.
Captain Relgen Greenblade: You've shown that you can traverse the Weald and return with useful information, and that's what we need in our rangers. Here, you've earned this.
Captain Relgen Greenblade unfurls a cloak fashioned from an enormous leaf and swoops it over your shoulders.
Captain Relgen Greenblade: A good cloak on your shoulders is one of the basic tenants of wilderness survival. As an initiate of the Ardent Keepers, you'll be outdoors rather often.
You receive Initiate Keepers Cloak.
Captain Relgen Greenblade: Which leads us to your next assignment, initiate. You've seen the state of things in the Weald. Are you ready to help clean it up?
Captain Relgen Greenblade: I'm glad to hear it. Take some time to familiarize yourself more with the forest, then check back and I'll have something for you.
Part 2 - Req. Lvl 3
Captain Greenblade: Greetings initiate, how fares the state of your cloak?
You should hand Captain Greenblade your cloak here.
Captain Greenblade: Im glad to hear it. You look as though you're familiar with the forest's trails by now. Allow me to see your initiate cloak one last time to make sure it's donned properly.
Captain Greenblade regards the state of the cloak and gives a satisfied nod before draping it back over your shoulders.
Captain Greenblade: Excellent. Your next task begins immediately, initiate. Take this satchel.
Captain Greenblade procures a small bag and tosses it into your hands.
Captain Greenblade: Carry yourself down to the forest floor and eliminate some of the threats that you witnessed, particularly the undead, the roaming fae, and the orcish threat.
"Gather two shattered skulls of the undead, two samples of dryad sap, and two belts from the Fellstone warriors. That should be sufficient evidence."
"Importantly, once you've gathered these items and combined them in the satchel, you will not bring them back to me."
"There is another captain that I want you to meet."
You receive a ranger's satchel.

Captain Greenblade:  You're to venture south to Keepers Bight with your full satchel, and head toward the village of Penshaw. Follow the edge of the forest and cross the river, you should come upon one of our camps.
"Once there, I want you to show the evidence of your encounters to the Keepers Bight regional captain, Syllisian Shadedglade."
"If he happens to be out on patrol when you arrive, perhaps one of the other rangers there can provide more information, should you present evidence to them."

"We need to know if there has been any sign of these threats spreading into, or coming out of, the Bight. Report back to me with any of your findings, and safe travels, initiate. Make sure to wear your initiate cloak so they know you're with the Ardent Keepers."
Collect, place in bag, combine, and turn in:
2x Shattered Skull
2x Fellstone Warrior's Belt
2x Dryad Sap
Go to Keeper's Bight, keep down the road until you cross a wooden bridge.
Shortly past the bridge is a small ranger camp.
Give Full Ranger's Satchel to Ranger Valegazer.
Ranger Valegazer regards your cloak with a nod and a smile.
Ranger Valegazer: Ah, what brings you to Keepers Bight, initiate? Do you carry news from the Weald?
Give Full Ranger's Satchel to Ranger Valegazer.
a Trunk Key
Ranger Valegazer inspects the evidence of your encounters and frowns, her long and thin ears drooping in response.

Ranger Valegazer: Undead of our ancestors in the Weald, as well as fae venturing out of their domain? This is disheartening news, but I can assure you they're not crossing the boundary from Keepers Bight, at least.
"In fact, the captain patrolled there recently. There should be some paperwork about it in his trunk. I imagine that's what Captain Relgen is looking for."
Behind him there is another tent with a "trunk" (it's like a crate)
Pick up the key and type
Type
Type
Type
You receive Lone Point Report.
Hand the key back to Ranger Valegazer
You receive Keepers Bight Report.
Return to Captain Relgen Greenblade in the Ranger's Rest
Give Lone Point Report and Keepers Bight Report. to Captain Relgen Greenblade.
You receive a Verdant Waistguard from Captain Relgen Greenblade.(belt).

Captain Greenblade: Return the belt to me after you've worked it in and I've had a time to speak with Caelen. Until then, you're free to explore the Weald and cull any threats. Be sure to keep that cloak as well, so others will recognize you as a Keeper.
Part 3 - Req. Lvl 5
Captain Greenblade: Good. It seems you're looking more comfortable in the garb of a Keeper.
Captain Greenblade: You'll require something with more protection than what an initiate cloak and a mere waistguard can afford you, if I'm to send you on your next task.

parts.say: What task are you sending me on next?

parts.text: Captain Greenblade: The first thing you're required to do is reinforce the initiate cloak you were given. An initiate keeps their cloak for life, but the standard variation will only serve you for so long.
Captain Greenblade: Bring your cloak to one of our senior trackers, Gareth Ashenpath. He should be outside the Rangers Rest and can guide you maintaining and improving your own equipment.
Step outside the Ranger's Rest and go to Gaereth Ashenpath.
Hand your cloak to Gaereth Ashenpath.
Gaereth Ashenpath: Let me guess, Relgen is delegating his responsibilities again? Doesn't surprise me.
Gaereth Ashenpath: The old man needs to spend more time down in the actual forest and less time berating potential rangers from the safety of the city, of you ask me.
Gaereth Ashenpath: Still, that doesn't mean I'm going to runaway an initiate like yourself. You're going to need to know how to enhance your cloak one way or another.
Gaereth Ashenpath: Yours in particular is in need of some real improvement.

parts.say: Oh jeepers, what improvement can we do?

parts.text: Gaereth Ashenpath: The flora of the Weald have been infused with magic over the course of many years. The preserved leaves we used aren't just protective, they're capable of adaption under the right circumstances.
Gaereth Ashenpath: The best way to improve your cloak, at least initially is to purposefully expose it to the same environmental effects that you wish it to protect you from. Make sense, right?

Gaereth Ashenpath: While you'll have to find ways of subverting every element at some point, for now, we'll focus on venom and poisons. The mountain snakes in the Bight and the vipers of Szuur can be deadly foes if they manage to inject you with some of their lethal venom.
Gaereth Ashenpath: You probably don't want to march all the way to the desert, though. Lucky for you, we have a critter on the forest floor than can you the proper... exposure.

parts.say: By golly, what critter is that?

parts.text: Gaereth Ashenpath: You've probably noticed out issue with the local drakeling population.
Gaereth Ashenpath: If left unchecked, they can overwhelm most of the Weald's younger fauna using their magical poison breath.
Gaereth Ashenpath: So what better way to expose you to poison than by having it breathe all over you, eh?
Gaereth Ashenpath grins.
Gaereth Ashenpath: Go cull some of the drakelings and expose that cloak of yours to their poisonous breath.

Gaereth Ashenpath: Bring me back at least two of their hides and four drakeling scales as proof that you've been out there fighting the good fight. Oh, and your initiate cloak of course. We'll see then if you've exposed it to enough poison for it to adapt.
You will need to collect 2 Green Drakeling Hide and 4 Green Drakeling Scale then return to Gaereth Ashenpath.
Hand to Gaereth your cloak, and the Drakeling parts.
Gaereth Ashenpath takes the drakeling parts and gauges the state of your cloak.

Gaereth Ashenpath: Granted the poison of a young drakeling is only so strong, but you also don't want to expose the cloak to too much and overwhelm it. You have to nurture it, just as you would an other plant of the forest.
Gaereth Ashenpath: I'll provide you with a salve that you can use to speed up the recovery process and lock in the magic of the drakeling's breath.

Gaereth Ashenpath: You can bring your cloak to a tanning vat to apply the salve. Make sure it's coated fully before returning it to me for inspection. You don't need to have any actual tanning skill, so don't worry about ruining your cloak.
He will give to you a Cultivating Salve and return your cloak.
Head to the tannery above the Blacksmith
Place the salve and your cloak in the tanning vat and press craft.
Return your cloak to Gaereth.
Gaereth Ashenpath checks over the cloak and offers a nod.
Gaereth Ashenpath: Good, see here? The fivers of your cloak are starrting to weave together stronger than they once were. It should be more resilient to poison in general.
Gaereth Ashenpath: This is just one of the many gifts that we've been given by the forests of Evershade, and why its so important that we protect our home. We help the land and it helps us in turn.
Gaereth Ashenpath returns the cloak to you, which looks to be developing a series of reinforced vines.

Gaereth Ashenpath: I'll teach you more about creating you own salve at a later time. For now, you should return to Captain Relgen and show him the cloak so he knows you're prepared for the next assignment. The salve should be set fully by the time you show him.
Gaereth Ashenpath: Oh, and here. Take this as a gift from me. A lot of rangers like yourself might find it useful out in the Weald.
Gaereth Ashenpath tosses you a small, glowing orb.
He gives you a Fire Beetle Eye (useful for Burning Embers spell if you don't have one already).
He gives you a Coated Keeper's Cloak.
Part 4 - Req. Lvl 8
Return your cloak to Captain Relgan Greenblade.
Captain Relgan Greenblade: With this you may be capable of an important assignment, initiate.

Captain Relgan Greenblade: We've recently received reports from the Wyrdguard scouts that orcs have encroached further into our territory than previously expected. As the protectors of our borders, this is an offense that we cannot ignore.

Captain Relgan Greenblade: The Wyrdguard have already involved themselves in the effort to cull the orcish presence, and the Keepers will not be far behind. We know they have trackers which they employ to hunt innocent caravans on the route to Faelindral.

Captain Relgan Greenblade: You're to hunt down their orc trackers before they manage to lay a finger upon an innocents. Eliminate as many as it takes to uncover who or what they might be reporting to, then bring back any evidence you find to me.
Kill Fellstone Trackers and bring him any Unintelligible Reports you find. You need bring only one.
Captain Relgan Greenblade frowns as he tries to make sense of the brutish orc script.
Captain Relgan Greenblade: This is utter nonsense to my eyes. Thankfully, there's a researcher who's currently attempting to decipher the orcish language.
Captain Relgan Greenblade: Bring the report to Researcher Fairgrove, who's likely poring over texts at the Heartwood Archives.
Captain Relgan Greenblade: Find out if she can glean any meaning from these accursed scribbles.
Researcher Fairgrove is found above the bank. Give her the report.
Researcher Fairgrove: O-oh, what's this? From an... o-orc tracker? Let me s-see what I can make out for you, K-Keeper.
Researcher Fairgrove produces a blank parchment and begins to cross-reference the orc report with a number of symbols she has mapped out across a series of leafscrolls.
Researcher Fairgrove murmurs softly to herself, her stutter seeming to vanish when caught in a moment of heavy concentration.
Researcher Fairgrove: Time... attack... orders. Foot-no, toes? Four. Four feet? Hmm... this is quite curious.
Researcher Fairgrove turns her attention back to you, blinking owlishly as her stutter resumes from where it left off.
Researcher Fairgrove: I, u-umm... I b-believe the report mentions something about an... an a-attack , and orders coming from s-someone names Fourth Feet? Or Four Toes.
Researcher Fairgrove: I think that F-four Toes makes the most sense, but then again... w-we're talking about orcs.
Researcher Fairgrove: Unfortunately that's a-all I can manage to decipher for now, but I... I hope that I was at least able to help in some regard, Keeper!
You receive Partially Translated Report from Researcher Fairgrove.
Return to Captain Relgan Greenblade and give him the Partially Translated Report.
Captain Relgan Greenblade: Hmm, four toes, you say? It's not much, but it does give me an idea.
Captain Relgan Greenblade: If they're taking orders from someone named Four Toes, that might be all the information we need to track them down.

Captain Relgan Greenblade: This would also serve a s good test of your abilities, Keeper. There can't be too many orcs within Evershade who have four toes, after all. Let's hope their naming conventions are as literal as they sound.
Captain Relgan Greenblade: You'll need this for your important mission, Keeper.
Captain Relgan Greenblade retrieves a small pouch and tosses it to you.
You receive Pouch of Scintillating Dust from Captain Relgan Greenblade.
Captain Relgan Greenblade: While eliminating orc leaders is always warranted, there are times when capturing an enemy alive is more beneficial in a prolonged battle.

Captain Relgan Greenblade: That powder I've given you was made from the mysterious foam you brought me during your initiation. You did well to bring me a sample. It has powerful hypnotic properties that we should be able to use to subdue the orc leader.
Captain Relgan Greenblade: The only snag will be searching for the right... opportunity.
Captain Relgan Greenblade: Even orcs must sleep, so I propose you uncover the location of this leader's camp and wait until nightfall to subdue the four-toed beast while it slumbers.

Captain Relgan Greenblade: Once within their territory, use your tracking skills to search for signs of an orc that has four toes. If you locate any such tracks, follow them to their source and inspect the region for any evidence of where they've made camp.

Captain Relgan Greenblade: It'd be wise to shroud yourself if you're to infiltrate the orc-controlled regions, though you'll have to avoid the undead presence if that the route you choose. They have sight for the soul rather than what's truly visible.

Captain Relgan Greenblade: Approach the camp during the night to catch the leader while they sleep. Pour the dust onto them, and with any luck, you should be able to silently haul them back here for questioning.

Captain Relgan Greenblade: If you lose or misplace the dust, you can ask me for more. If the orc proves to be resistant to the effects of the foam... you have my leave to eliminate them. Your life before theirs, Keeper.
Take the lift down to the middle of the map.

Go past the ruins, across the bridge, across the Elder Spire tree platform, down another bridge. Finally, turn right and go down until you encounter orcs. Once there, use Track to follow a trial of curious footprints to its end point. Once there,
These footprints differ from those of a typical orc, appearing to have four distinct toes instead of the usual three.
Now that you are able to distinguish them from the others, you see that they lead toward the base of the nearby ramp, ascending the cliffside.
Continue up the cliff side, turning to the right, and find an empty tent eventually.
around.
This simple campsite appears deserted, bearing remnants of a crude fire long since extinguished.
Wait until nighttime, then
around again.
Though well concealed atop the cliffs, you have managed to locate this crude campsite under cover of darkness.
You notice a slight stirring from beneath the a heavy pile of furs. It seems to be a slumbering orc who is not yet aware of your presence.

The wretched creature twitches beneath the furs as you examine it closer. It does not awaken, though you see it begin to grimace through clenched tusks. One of its feet emerges from beneath the furs, revealing a detail of great interest... four-toes.
Put the Pouch of Scintillating Dust on your cursor and
it on the /orc.
You carefully sprinkle the contents of the scintillating pouch over the orc's face. It recoils its snout as it unconsciously inhales the hypnotic dust.
Bewildered Gorakk Four-Toes seethes at you, ready to strike -- Would you like to die? You would almost certainly be defeated in battle.
The orc's eyes open groggily as it battles the effects of the dust, letting out a garbled groan as it gets to its feet and begins blindly swinging its arms!
Cons red to a level 8 ranger, unknown level, estimated at level 11 by others. Immune to snare. Kill it anyway.
Collect the Orc Commander's Head and return it to Captain Relgen Greenblade.
Captain Relgan Greenblade: It's unfortunate that you were unable to capture the commander alive, but this is still a great victory all the same.

Captain Relgan Greenblade: We'll have more opportunities to question the orc leadership and discover their true intentions in the future. For now, I award with this spear as a sign of your accomplishment.
Captain Relgan Greenblade: Carry it well, Almond, for you are an initiate no longer.
Captain Relgan Greenblade: You are a full and true Ardent Keeper!
You receive Reach of the Ardent Keeper from Captain Relgen Greenblade.

Part 1 - Req. Lvl 1
Read Notice of Recruitment you start with as a new Ranger Character:

Recruit:

You are to deliver this note to Fedamius Steele III
in the Steel Talons Garrison to begin your training.

He can be found observing the courtyard from his 
post on the wall above.

If you get lost, ask a guard. Any guard worth their
salt will know his name.

And be quick about it.

-Steel Talons Recruitment
Head to the Steel Talons Martial Academy on the Southwest side of Night Harbor and hand in your Notice of Recruitment to Fedamius Steel III
You gain experience.
Fedamius Steele III: What is it?
Fedamius Steele III stares at you for a moment before reading the note.
Fedamius Steele III chuckles.
Fedamius Steele III: Well, well... Foss has another aspiring Ranger on his hands. I wonder how long it'll be before he's out pulling you out of the sand?
Fedamius Steele III: The Rangers trained by the Steel Talons are the finest in the land, so you'll either become one of them or the next of your lot will use your corpse as a tracking exercise.
Fedamius Steele III: Now, take your note to Mister Dunestrider.
Fedamius Steele III: A skilled ranger needs no directions, so... you'll find him in one of the towers along the wall.
Fedamius Steele III gives you a smug look.
Bold textYou receive Notice of Recruitment from Fedamius Steel III.
Head to the top of the Wayfarer's Hospice north of the west gate and follow the top of the wall south until you find Foss Dunestrider above the west gate.
Hand him the Notice of Recruitment
You gain experience.
Foss Dunstrider takes the note without breaking his gaze on some figure in the distance.
Foss Dunstrider: A new recruit, splendid. I know you're new to Night Harbor, but I'm sure you'll come to love this city as I do.
Foss Dunstrider: I've got some time, and I know you have at least a little skill from your experience outside these walls. So, let's see you in action. Take this tunic and head back down there.
Foss Dunstrider picks up a dusty tunic from a small pile at his feet.
Foss Dunstrider: As a test of your fieldcraft, I want you to collect the following...
Foss Dunstrider: a natural light source, butchered from a proximal creature...
Foss Dunstrider: a reagent harvested from a bat that might help you avoid a fall...
Foss Dunstrider: a venom gland, carefully removed from one of the younger snakes below...
Foss Dunstrider: and a Multhele Root.
Foss Dunstrider: You'll find all of these just outside our gates, with the exception of the root.
You receive Steel Talon Trainee Tunic from Foss Dunestrider.
Part 2
Head down to the noob yard below and kill a snakes, a fire beetles, and a desert bats
Keep killing until you receive an Immature Snake Venom Sac, a Fire Beetle Eye, and a Bat Wing. Alternatively you can buy these.
Then, head to the docks just east of the garrison and pick up a bag of Multhele Root under one of the docks.
Then, return to Foss Dunestrider
Hand Foss Dunestrider the Multhele Root, Immature Snake Venom Sac, Fire Beetle Eye, and Bat Wing
You gain experience.
Foss Dunstrider: You looked good out there. And don't look surprised. Given that tunic, you weren't hard to track.
Foss Dunstrider looks at you and smiles.
Foss Dunstrider he looks at the items you handed him.
Foss Dunstrider: Excellent fieldcraft. A ranger's tricks of the trade mean the difference between life and death down range.
Foss Dunstrider: After watching you move around out there, you seem experienced or at least capable enough to assist me with a matter of personal interest.

Foss Dunstrider: The consensus in the garrison is that the Ashira are bothersome, but I think there's more to them than most assume. I think there's a sickness in them, but we've been unable to gather specifics. Maybe we can learn more by gathering information from other afflicted c reatures in the area.
Foss Dunstrider: I'd like you to carefully gather the blood of a diseased bat, rat, snake, and jackl. Seal the vials in this pack and return it to me when you're done.
You receive Small Test Kit from Foss Dunestrider.
Head to the cave entrance towards Wyrmsbane and kill a diseased bat, a diseased rat, a diseased snake, and a diseased jackal.
Keep killing until you receive: Diseased Bat Blood, Diseased Rat Blood, Diseased Snake Blood, and Diseased Jackal Blood

Combine the four bloods in the small test kit you will get a sealed pouch, take the sealed pouch to Foss Dunestrider and you will receive a note. Take that note and your Steel Talon Trainee Tunic to Quartermaster Obaid to hand in and receive Steel Talons Scout Tunic (3ac/5hp/1dex) as well as some exp.
Before entering the Bends portion of Night Harbor, climb the nearby gate stairs to find Lieutenant Jarovik Holt and Corporal Theodora. Holt is visibly distressed and requests you speak with Theodora.
Lieutenant Jarovik Holt frowns at you.
Lieutenant Jarovik Holt: Leave me be, citizen. Speak to my corporal, Theodora, if you want to make yourself useful.
Lieutenant Jarovik Holt: You will find the corporal in yonder hall. Move along now.
Corporal Theodora: Mind how you go, citizen. I cannot guarantee your safety if you enter the Bends.
Corporal Theodora: Riverbend is one of Night Harbor's oldest districts. It was once a vibrant fishing village and port of commerce, before the gangs took over.

Corporal Theodora: There are three rival gangs in the Bends... the Ten Hooks, the Waterdogs, and the Serpent Sashes. We've contained the worst of them within these walls, but I'm afraid Night Harbor won't know peace until we've exterminated their kind.
Corporal Theodora sighs.
Corporal Theodora: Now leave me to my work, citizen, unless you wish to aid our great city.

parts.say: I wish to aid our great city.

parts.text: Corporal Theodora: Know this, citizen, should you enter the Bends, you'll be met with violence. Meet with the Ten Hooks and Waterdogs in the dirty hovels they inhabit, and bring me proof of your valor. You'll be well rewarded.
Enter the Bends and begin killing the gang members residing there. These mobs will start non-KOS but will quickly become aggressive due to negative faction hits when killed.
Eventually, you will loot a Bloodied Allegiance Cuffs. Return to Corporal Theodora and hand her the cuffs.
Your faction standing with Bends Garrison got better.
Your faction standing with Cult of the Living City got better. " 1 full blue "
Your faction standing with Ten Hooks got worse. " 1 full blue "
Your faction standing with Waterdogs got worse. " 1 full blue "
Corporal Theodora: The streets are safer for your efforts, citizen.
You gain experience.
You receive 3 silver.
This can also be done with Dirty Pirate Earring which also drops from the local mobs and gives a small faction boost and 35 silver.
Sub-Quests

There are other notable named gang members directly inside the first area of the Bends, Karif Jamah, Tinka Roofstrider, Vikar Brask and Ratan. It is unclear if they have dialogue to continue this quest...
WATERDOGS
Ratan: Hail yerself, mate. Standin' around... have you not got a job to do?
Ratan: Ten Hooks are takin' liberties lately and we've given 'em enough chances. People don't learn if you don't explain it to 'em.
Ratan: Honest fishermen, so they say! As likely hook a fish as hook yer eyes out.
Ratan smirks.
Ratan: Those uppity thugs wear fancy cuffs like they're in a gentlemen's club or something. Bring me a pair and I'll give you a pretty penny.
Give Ratan two Bloodied Allegiance Cuffs
Ratan: It ain't pretty, but it does the job. Here you go, mate.
