TEN HOOKS
Karif Jamah grins.
Karif Jamah: Speak up, Human. These streets belong to the Ten Hooks. What's your business?
Karif Jamah: If your hands are idle, there's work that needs doing.
Karif Jamah: The Waterdogs have been useful to us, but they've become too bold.
Karif Jamah: Those pirates are fond of their jewelry. Collect four of their earrings and return them to me. Go now, remind them of their place.
Give Karif Jamah 4 Dirty Pirate Earring
Karif Jamah counts out each earring in the palm of his hand.
Karif Jamah: Four coins for four souls. Our family thanks you.
You gain experience!
You receive 50 silver from Karif Jamah. (Bugged? This is not "four coins" and very much not worth doing 50/4=12.5 silver per ring, whereas turning into the watch grants 35 silver each...)

Part 1 - Req. Lvl 1
Read Anonymous Letter you start with as a new Rogue character:

This letter reaches you not of insignificant reason. We have witnessed your ability to blend into the shadows and become as a leaf on a branch to those who tread past.

It was fated chance that you were noticed at all, and that is precisely why this missive finds you now. Your talents would be indispensable to Faelindral, so I would propose a meeting with Elyndiir Nightshade to discuss an opportunity to put said talents to the test.

Should this letter spark your interest, deliver it into the hands of the aforementioned within the Lambent Lantern. You can find it behind the bank, or by climbing the ascent opposite the Willows Whisper stage.

You can ask a guard for direction to the Lambent Lantern if required, but do not inform them of the reason.

Yours,
An Admirer
Give Anonymous Letter to Elyndiir Nightshade in the Lambent Lantern Inn. (behind Bank).
You gain experience.
Your faction standing with Lambent Wanderers got better.
Your faction standing with Fellstone Orcs got worse.
Elyndiir Nightshade perks a brow as she accepts the letter. While reading its contents, the corner of her mouth curls upward into a small smirk.
Elyndiir Nightshade: Looks like you were found out by Naery. Still, you seem to had made an impression on her, and that in itself is an accomplishment.
Elyndiir Nightshade: And now I'm to offer you a chance to prove yourself? I wish that girl would at least discuss things with me before sending prospects backstage. Here, take this.
Elyndiir Nightshade produces a sealed leaf scroll and holds it out for you with a dull expression.
Elyndiir Nightsade: You're really looking for an opportunity?
m always looking to exploit an opportunity!"
You receive note for Myrielle Softglade (Head to Traders District, Weapons and armor, inside on first level)
Elyndiir Nightshade: You can start by making your way to the Traders Terrace and handing this letter to Myrielle Softglade.
Elyndiir Nightshade: Foreign trade has slowed lately and that makes for bad business. If Myrielle has an idea of what might be wrong, you're going to help her get to the bottom of it.
Elyndiir Nightshade: When you're done, come fill me in on what you find. And avoid stepping onto the stage when you leave, or the bards will start giving me a headache.
You receive "Note for Myrielle Softglade" from Elyndiir Nightshade.
Part 1a - Find ingredients
Myrielle Softglade: Fair shades to you, Rogue. How did I know you were a Rogue? Ha, don't worry, I just have an eye for these things.
Hand her the note.
You gain experience.
Your faction standing with Lambent Wanderers got better.
Your faction standing with Fellstone Orcs got worse.
Myrielle Softglade accepts the letter with interest, giving you a polite smile before unsealing it and looking over the contents. She clears her throat and immediately lowers her voice.
Myrielle Softglade: Elyn sent you? No offense, but I was hoping she'd send one of her more experienced agents.
Myrielle Softglade: Ah, it's no matter. Here, take this. Maybe you'd be able to help with a little... experiment?
Myrielle Softglade offers you a small, nondescript jar with a corked lid.
You receive "Sample Jar" from Myrielle Softglade.
Combine the following in the Sample Jar:
2 Raw Bat Meat
2 Wasp Venom Sacks
2 Raw Wolf Meat
You craft Gruesome Sample Jar.
Sample Jar is consumed while crafting.
Part 1b - Ewww!
Hand Myrielle the jar.
You gain experience.
Your faction standing with Lambent Wanderers got better.
Your faction standing with Fellstone Orcs got worse.
Myrielle Softglade takes the jar, then immediately seems to regret her decision as she sharply turns her face away, holding the jar out and as far from herself as possible.
Myrielle Softglade: Wyrd's way, this is revolting! Quick, take it! Take it back!
Myrielle Softglade fumbles the sample jar back to you, nearly dropping it in the process.
Myrielle Softglade: Ugh! I'm just going to take your word for it that all the proper samples were inside the jar. Are you ready to meet my contact now?
You receive Gruesome Sample Jar from Myrielle Softglade.

Myrielle Softglade: Sylwine Brightspirit is a good friend of mine who's always looking for new reagents for her potions at the Well of Order. She said she'd be willing to take a look at anything that I brought her.
Myrielle Softglade: Of course, we don't really need any potions, but that's beside the point. If anything is wrong with those samples, she should be able to figure it out!
Myrielle Softglade: I just hope she doesn't mind the foul stench...
Bring to Sylwine Brightspirit located at Well of Order (inside Herbalism/First aid house)
You gain experience.
Your faction standing with Lambent Wanderers got better.
Sylwine Brightspirit accepts the jar with an arched brow, holding it up and swirling the contents. She inhales a sharp breath before turning back to you with a forced smile.
Sylwine Brightspirit: Myrielle sent you here with this, did she? Here, take it back for a moment. I'd like you to do something for me first.
Sylwine Brightspirit hands back the sample jar.
You receive Gruesome Sample Jar from Sylwine Brightspirit.
Sylwine Brightspirit: I want you to open that jar for me and take a good whiff. Really let is invade your nasal passage. Then, tell me what you think it smells like.
Sylwine Brightspirit folds her arms over her chest and watches you.
While holding the jar (on the cursor), type:
/open jar
You open the jar with a delicate pop of the corked lid. An ominous odor wafts from the mixture of fauna samples, and Sylwine nods at you expectantly.
You receive Foul-Smelling Jar.
Give the jar back to Sylwine Brightspirit
You gain experience.
Your faction standing with Preservers got worse.
Sylwine Brightspirit grimaces as she eyes the jar, involuntarily rolling her eyes. She reseals the lid and writes out a small receipt, which she slides over the counter to you.
Sylwine Brightspirit: Here's the receipt for the job. You can bring it back to Myrielle. This is going to take me a while, because of the contamination. That foolish girl...
You receive Gruesome Sample Receipt from Sylwine Brightspirit
Sylwine Brightspirit: She may be pretty and knows all the right words, but she's still two flowers short of a bouquet, if you catch my meaning.
Sylwine Brightspirit: In fact, you can tell her I said as much when you return to her!
Part 1c - Finishing up
Upon giving the receipt back to Myrielle Softglade
You gain experience.
Your faction standing with Lambent Wanderers got better.
Myrielle Softglade turns pale as she reads the obviously strong-worded language that was included in the receipt.
Myrielle Softglade: A-ah, I... I see. Ahem. Well, it seems that we may have to wait a while to find out the results. You've proven that you're capable of some simple tasks, at least!
Myrielle Softglade: Here's a note for Elyn at the Willows Whisper. I'm sure that she can find something to keep you busy while we wait on Sylwine's tests.
You receive Note for Elyndiir Nightshade from Myrielle Softglade.
Myrielle Softglade: I hope that she isn't too upset...
Upon giving Note to Elyndiir Nightshade
You gain experience.
Your faction standing with Lambent Wanderers got better.
Your faction standing with Fellstone Orcs got worse.
Elyndiir Nightshade skims over the note with a sharp eye, looking somewhat skeptical.
Elyndiir Nightshade: So Myrielle is having Sylwine run tests on some animal parts? I suppose that's one angle we hadn't considered.
Elyndiir Nightshade: We had you tailed during your journey to see how you'd perform. You're a little dull around the edges, but I feel like we could hone you into a fine agent.
Elyndiir Nightshade: Speaking of...
Elyndiir Nightshade extends her hand, then, with a quick flourish, reveals a small elven dagger seemingly pulled from nowhere. She offers it to you, hilt first.
You receive Lambent Prospect Dagger from Elyndiir Nightshade.
Elyndiir Nightshade: Any prospect of ours needs to be able to defend themselves. You earned it, but you could also earn a lot more. You interested?
You receive Lambent Prospect Dagger from Elyndiir Nightshade.
m interested!"
Elyndiir Nightshade: Hmm, not so fast. Why don't you get a little more practice with that dagger first? Come back and show me the blade once you've had a chance to put it through its paces.
Part 2 - Req. Lvl 4+
m still interested."
Elyndiir Nightshade: Glad to hear it. Though let me get a look at that prospect dagger of yours first to make sure that it's been properly worked in.
Give Lambent Prospect Dagger to Elyndiir Nightshade.
Elyndiir Nightshade grins knowingly beneath her cowl as she twirls the dagger expertly between her fingers, then offers it back to you, handle first.
You receive Lambent Prospect Dagger from Elyndiir Nightshade.
Elyndiir Nightshade: Looks sufficiently worked-in to me, prospect. Good.
Elyndiir Nightshade says,
I imagine this next task is going to require a lot more subtlety than the last, though. Another of our group, Ereldian Brambleshade, is keeping tabs on the faerie population to the north."
It's a difficult job to discern any sort of sense from such a chaotic group, but we have many who rely on us to piece that chaos into something more... comprehensible. Digestible, even."
I want you to head down the northern lift that leads into fae territory and meet with Ereldian. He should be posted in the area, and you're going to help him gather some information."
Keep in mind that we don't want to harm any of them if we can help it. Just show him your dagger to let him know that you're one of us."
Part 2a - Loud and Clear
Give Lambent Prospect Dagger to Ereldian Brambleshade. (He is at the base of the Pixie lift)
Ereldian Brambleshade nods thoughtfully, looking you up and down taking note of the dagger you carry.
Ereldian Brambleshade: Ah, so Elyndir finally found time to send me an assistant? I've been requesting aid for weeks and I'm at my wits end when it comes to these capricious creatures!
Ereldian Brambleshade sighs softly as he runs a hand through his long auburn hair. Somehow, he suddenly produces an item that resembles a small pipe and offers it to you.
You receive Eavesdropper Earring from Ereldian Brambleshade.
You receive Lambent Prospect Dagger from Ereldian Brambleshade.
Ereldian Brambleshade says,
If you're going to help me, you're going to need this. It's called an eavesdropper. It should allow you to listen : in on conversations that you otherwise wouldn't be able to.
Be sure not to lose it! If you do somehow misplace it, return to me and ask for a new one.
Go ahead and stick it in your ear... not too far, mind you, then activate it.
Once that's done, let me know when you're ready to hear the plan.
Right-click the earring (equip first if necessary).
Ereldian Brambleshade nods and takes a deep breath.
Ereldian Brambleshade: IS IT WORKING? CAN YOU HEAR ME?

Ereldian Brambleshade clears his throat, but to your ears, it sounds like thunder clapping inside your brain. Thankfully, he then lowers his voice to a whisper, yet you are able to hear him as though he spoke plain.
Ereldian Brambleshade says,
I shall take that as a yes. Apologies, I fear that some of the fae's... whimsical nature may be rubbing off on me due to my prolonged station here.
It is precisely for that reason that I have an offer for you, if you are interested.
m interested!"
Ereldian Brambleshade says,
There are two prominent fae in the area who Elyndiir wants you to spy on... Two fae who've been tormenting me for what feels like an entire age.
Lilika and Luonu Thinsticks are their names. They're a pair of vicious pranksters whose careless antics have taken the lives of more than a few travelers.

You're to find their dwelling along the cliffside, across the footbridge and past the ruins to the west. Then, wait until the cover of nightfall when the pair return home and use stealth with the eavesdropper to find out what they're plotting next.
Though, you could also find a more... permanent solution to their meddling, if you're willing?"
m willing. Sounds like fun!"
Ereldian Brambleshade says,

After you've listened in on their plans, if you manage to catch one of them alone, yo can always end their pathetic little life. I'll make it worth your while if you bring me one if their ridiculous acorn hats.
Otherwise, you can simply listen in on them and take your findings to Elyndiir at the Whisper. Though I promise you, no one would mourn the loss of either of those two scoundrels.
Think on it before yo depart, assistant. Oh, and be sure to keep this just between us. Elyndiir has too soft a heart for this sort of business.
Part 2b - Mischief
Go as directed, all the way to the circle of mushrooms at the end.
(If you do not have the earring activated:)
Muffled voices can be heard from within this tilted toadstool home. You make out what sounds like laughter and childish giggles, but the voices are otherwise too faint to understand.
(If you are not in stealth:)
Muffled voices can be heard from within this tilted toadstool home. They quiet as you approach, suspicious of lumbering footsteps nearby.
Otherwise:
You approach the toadstool home under the cover of darkness, coming close enough to make out what they are saying. The eavesdropper earring is working!
Lilika Thinsticks: Someone was out there... wasn't there?
Luonu Thinsticks: There's no one there, Lilika, look! Now tell me your idea!
Lilika Thinsticks: We can't be too careful with that Ereldian guy snooping around! You know he's just itching to punish us.
Luonu Thinsticks: You mean he isn't just itching from the glitter you slipped into his pants?
Lilika Thinsticks and her brother Luonu snicker to themselves.
Luonu Thinsticks: Now out with it! I'm dying to hear your plan!
Lilika Thinsticks: You won't be the only one dying! I noticed a weak spot in the cliffside near the road. Wouldn't it be funny if a whole caravan got trapped under a landslide?
Luonu Thinsticks: Oh, wow! Would they know it was us?
Lilika Thinsticks: They'd probably just blame those dumb orcs! They hate them a lot more than they hate us.
Luonu Thinsticks: It'd be even better if we could drop rocks on that Ereldian.
Lilika Thinsticks: You mean Smelldian?
Luonu Thinsticks snickers.
Lilika Thinsticks: Now take a nap! You spent the whole day drinking mushroom dew. I'm going to take a walk and check on that cliff.
Luonu Thinsticks grumbles and obeys his sister's wishes.
You quickly scribble down what you managed to overhear.
You receive Thinsticks Prank Plan.
Part 2d - Murder she wrote?
If you decide to kill Lilika Thinsticks:
Lilika Thinsticks: HEY, WHO ARE YOU?!
You gain experience.
Your faction standing with Citizens of Faelindral got worse.
Your faction standing with Court of Summer got worse.
Your faction standing with Court of Winter got better.
Lilika Thinsticks: I didn't... mean to...
--You loot Acorn Hat from Lilika Thinstick's corpse.--
Give the helmet to Ereldian Brambleshade.
You gain experience.
Your faction standing with Court of Summer got worse.
Ereldian Brambleshade lets out a loud guffaw as you show him the acorn hat, then breaks down into a fit of laughter that borders on maniacal.
Ereldian Brambleshade: Haha-ha! You've done all of the Weald a fantastic service for this!
Ereldian Brambleshade: That creature was nothing more than a conniving murderer. You've done the right thing. Perhaps I'll finally be able to sleep in peach tonight.
Ereldian Brambleshade: My thanks, friend. You'll go far if you keep this up. Here, take this.
Ereldian Brambleshade leans in close and presses a small ring into your palm.
Ereldian Brambleshade: You've earned it. Keep it close by. It may be of use to you in the future, should we require more of your... services.
You receive Loop of Shaded Vine from Ereldian Brambleshade.
Part 2e - Finishing up
Before running back:
Give Thinsticks Prank Plan to Ereldian Brambleshade.
Ereldian Brambleshade says,
Such a vile prank.
The fae ought to be purged from this world, and this is even more proof of that. Bring this information back to Elyndiir.
Perhaps it'll be enough to show her that we should be taking a more... direct stance against their antics.
You receive your items back from Ereldian Brambleshade.
Give Thinsticks Prank Plan, Eavesdropper Earring and Lambent Prospect Dagger to Elyndiir Nightshade.
If you just hand in the note:
Elyndiir Nightshade says,
I see you've got some information, but how did you come about it? Ereldian should have provided you with the tool necessary to obtain this.
If you hand in the note and earring:
Elyndiir Nightshade says,
Good, good. It looks like you did some excellent snooping out there.
Show me your prospect dagger as well, so that you can be properly compensated.
Otherwise:
You gain experience.
Your faction standing with Lambent Wanderers got better.
Elyndiir Nightshade says,
They're planning on causing a rock slide? Those Thinsticks are going too far this time. I'll send word to the Keepers to watch the hills for any trouble. You did good today, prospect.
We keep a tenuous peach with the fae, but their so-called pranks are growing more and more dangerous. It's why we have to keep one step ahead of them like this.
Elyndiir Nightshade draws a short blade, examining it closely before offering it to you alongside a sheaf of paper.
You receive List of Results from Elyndiir Nightshade.
Elyndiir Nightshade says,
In the meantime, you should take this opportunity to check in with Myrielle. Hopefully she's found something out about that slop she had you put together earlier.
You know the drill by now, yeah? Give her the note and return to me once you have something to show for it.
Also, don't lose the edge I've given you. You'll need it if you want to become a full Wanderer.
You receive Lambent Prospect Blade from Elyndiir Nightshade.
Part 3 - Req. Lvl 4
Give List of Results to Myrielle Softglade.
You gain experience.
Your faction standing with Lambent Wanderers got better.
Part 3a - Wolves
Myrielle Softglade says,
Oh! Welcome back, prospect. Are you as excited as I am to read over these results? You and I make a great team, uncovering the mysteries of the perilous roads!
Now, let's see here...
Myrielle Softglade unseals the note; a wide smile quickly spreads across her face as her gaze darts back and forth across the page, absorbing its contents.
Myrielle Softglade: Myrielle, concerning the samples you had delivered... blah, blah, blah... clear signs of contamination... ooh, that sounds ominous! ...Resulted in a failure on your part due to...
Myrielle Softglade slowly trails off as an embarrassed flush creeps up her cheeks. She clears her throat and immediately rolls up the note, sliding it behind her back.
Myrielle Softglade says,
You know what? Never mind those results! The animals you collected parts from were clearly not any real threat to merchant caravans.
Bats, wasp drones, and little wolf pups? Why, even I could handle creatures such as those! I've heard rumors of much stronger beasts that have been prowling the roadways.
Myrielle Softglade says,

The mature wolves in particular seem to be in a frenzy of late. I've been speaking to some of my trade partners, and apparently some rabid wolves have been causing an uproar along the road to Keepers Bight
Not only that, but there's also a large den of wolves near the Wyrdgate to the west that has been assaulting travelers!
I'm not sure which is worse, diseased animals or made ones, but we're going to have to do something about the wolves if we're to maintain our current trade routes.
Meaning, we're left with only one option...
Myrielle Softglade says,
I've heard Aerin Mossfang is particularly upset about the rabid wolves. She's sent a number of her beastmasters to sort out that particular issue.
That still leaves the made den of wolves to the west, however.
I'm sure the Ardent Keepers wouldn't like what I'm proposing, but we need a more immediate resolution to the current trade dilemma!
Wolf packs normally follow an alpha leader, right? It could be that the pack is simply following the whim of a mad leader to randomly attack traveleres.
So... I suggest you seek out the den and eliminate the pack's alpha. At the very least, it'll keep the wolves contained to the den until a more permanent solution can be discovered.
Bring me the alpha's fang when it's been dealt with.
Go to the wolf den on the west side of Evershade Weld and kill beguiled wolves to spawn A beguiled alpha wolf and loot its Alpha Wolf Fang.
Note that it is a rare drop off a fairly rare mob.
Give Alpha Wolf Fang to Myrielle Softglade.
Myrielle Softglade gazes down at the fang as her bottom lip begins to quiver.
Myrielle Softglade: What a horrible thing we had to do... you had to do. I'm so sorry, Villette.
Myrielle Softglade: May I see your blade as well as the fang? I want to offer a prayer to poor creature that lost its mind to madness.
You receive your items back from Myrielle Softlade.
You gain experience.
Your faction standing with Lambent Wanderers got better.
Your faction standing with Naelira's Court got worse.
Myrielle Softglade runs the fang along the edge of your blade as she closes her eyes, offering a s prayer.
Myrielle Softglade: Alashore, forgive us for being unable to protect one of the forest's mas souls. Their life had to be cut short in exchange for the lives of your servants.
Myrielle Softlade: The wasps, also.
Myrielle Softglade: Then there were those pups, too...
Myrielle Softglade clears her throat softly.
Myrielle Softlade: I, umm... I'm not particularly reverent. Are you? I'm sure the gods don't mind, since they're all sleeping anyway!
Myrielle Softglade quickly scribbles out a note and hands it to you, alongside your blade.
Myrielle Softglade: Take this note back to Elyn for me. We should hopefully be seeing a bit more trade with the roads kept clear. Thanks again for all your work, Villette!
You receive Lambent Prospect Blade from Myrielle Softglade.
You receive Scribbled Note from Myrielle Softglade.
Part 3b - Finishing up
Give Scribbled Note to Elyndiir Nightshade
You gain experience.
Your faction standing with Lambent Wanderers got better.
Elyndiir Nightshade takes the scribbled note and looks over it, then lets out a soft sigh.
Elyndiir Nightshade: I don't really agree with Myrielle's choice of action, but hopefully this sorts out our trade problem. Well done.

Elyndir Nightshade: I feel like you've dealt with enough of our more... interesting members, Villette. If you've stuck around with us for this long, then you can probably be trusted with some more involved work.
Elyndir Nightshade: Here, take this.
Elyndiir Nightshade retrieves a mask made of leaves and offers it to you.
Elyndir Nightshade: This may help you keep some anonymity during your next mission, though you may need to work on your skills before then.
Elyndir Nightshade: Return to me and show me that blade of yours once you've strengthened your technique enough to incapacitate a foe,
You receive Mask of the Forest Walker from Elyndiir Nightshade.
Part 4 - Req. Lvl 10+
Give Lambent Prospect Blade to Elyndiir Nightshade
Elyndiir Nightshade twirls the blade around her dexterous fingers and offers it back to you.
Elyndiir Nightshade: Looking good, prospect. Keep that blade close, as you'll be needing it.
You'll also want this parchment, assuming you think you have what it takes to look into a little quarrel we've been having with the humans."
You receive Blank Parchment from Elyndiir Nightshade.
You receive Lambent Prospect Blade from Elyndiir Nightshade.
Part 4a - Road Trip
Elyndir Nightshade: You may be familiar with the human village out in Keepers Bight known as Penshaw.
Elyndir Nightshade: They call it one of their kontors, or trade posts, which means there hav been a number of new trade deals offered by the factions of Night Harbor in recent days.

Elyndir Nightshade: While many of our dealings with the humans have been beneficial, there are still bad actors that have clearly tried to swindle us into abusive deals or find ways to take advantage of our natural resources.

Elyndir Nightshade: The Iron Emissaries in particular are an arm of the human race that is notorious for their greed. What I need you to do is travel to Penshaw and determine whether one of their latest trade envoys is legitimate.
Elyndiir Nightshade: There's one sure way that you'll be able to make that determination.

parts.say: What way will I determine that?

parts.text: Elyndir Nightshade grins, brushing an errant strand of her ebon hair back behind a long ear.
Elyndir Nightshade: You'll do what we do best, prospect. Spy.

Elyndir Nightshade: Rather than rouse suspicion by hailing every person you come across, I want you to venture into the village undetected and try to overhear any conversations regarding a new trade envoy from Night Harbor.
Elyndir Nightshade: The tavern might be your best bet, as that's where gossip can get a little more candid.

Elyndir Nightshade: If you manage to sniff out where this envoy is staying, you'll want to sneak into their dwelling and politely browse through their belongings without anyone noticing. It might be wise to wait until nightfall when they're asleep to do so.

Elyndir Nightshade: You're looking for any sort of paper trail. Ledgers, receipts, or anything of the sort to verify their trade dealings, Copy anything you find onto the blank parchment I gave you, then return it to me.
Elyndir Nightshade: Oh, and no violence, prospect. Not unless I determine that a message needs to be sent.

Travel to Keeper's Bight and go to the inn on the north side of town. You will find a sleeping emissary there at night and they despawn at 6am in the morning. Next to the sleeping emissary there is a chest.
Type
You quietly open the envoy's trunk. Within are a set of folded traveler's clothes and a leather-bound merchant's ledger.
Type

You quietly and carefully begin to peruse the contents of the merchant's ledger. Much of the documentation seems insignificant to you, but perhaps Elyndiir would be able to make more sense of it if you were to take a copy.
Type

You copy down as much information as you can onto the blank parchment. Once finished, you tuck the copy into your belongings and quietly close the trunk. The envoy continues to snore soundly, unaware of your presence.
You receive Copy of a Merchant's Ledger.
Part 4b - Reporting In
Give Copy of a Merchant's Ledger & Lambent Prospect Blade to Elyndiir Nightshade
You gain experience.
Your faction standing with Lambent Wanderers got better.
Elyndiir Nightshade takes a look over your blade before nodding in satisfaction and returning it to you.
Elyndiir Nightshade says,
Well done. You're becoming quite the asset, prospect. Let's take a look at what manner of trade this envoy was involved in...
Elyndiir Nightshade begins poring over the copy that was brought to her. Her sharp gaze narrows as it passes over a series of names you had copied from within the merchant's ledger.
Tsk... just wonderful. See these names here? Garrus and Wilna. They're known to be part of the group of poachers that have been giving the Ardent Keepers the run-around for quite some time.
It appears that our envoy friend has already been in touch with, and made deals with these scoundrels, and now they have the gall to bring trade offers to our doorstep?
I won't have it. Faelindral does not negotiate with poachers, nor those that profit from their murderous gains. I believe it's time we taught these Iron Emissaries a lesson.
You receive Lambent Prospect Blade from Elyndiir Nightshade.
Elyndiir Nightshade says,
That blade of yours will be the lesson, prospect. Perform this next task and I'll see that you're made into a full-fledged Wanderer.
Are you ready to hear the plan?
Part 4c - The Plan
m ready to hear the plan!”
Elyndiir Nightshade says,

By now, the envoy has already left Penshaw and made their way to the Hanging Gardens; that's the name of the treetop inn located on the eastern side of the Bight, past the valley that leads to Scarwood.
They'll be heading toward Evershade sometime during the early morning hours. It's on that route where you'll strike.

Be careful, though. There's a good chance the envoy will have strong escorts. If you wait for the right opportunity, you should be able to separate them from their guards using a well-timed sap or blow to the back of the head with the pommel of your blade.
Once your target is alone, strike hard and fast. Eliminate the scoundrel and bring me their full ledger so we can show the council just how untrustworthy these humans can be.
The emissary is level 15. They spawn by the treehouse in Keeper's Bight around 7am and walk to the Evershade Weald zone line. They are accompanied by two guards of higher level.
Give Bloodied Merchant Ledger & Lambent Prospect Blade to Elyndiir Nightshade
You gain experience.
Your faction standing with Lambent Wanderers got better.

Elyndiir Nightshade nods as she accepts the ledger and conceals the bloodied object inside of a ledger satchel. She then extends her hand toward you with a flourish and presents the hilt of an elegant elven stiletto.
Elyndiir Nightshade says,
You're proven and now blooded. In my eyes, you're a prospect no longer.
The Lambent Wanderers are an eclectic group, but we put the interests of Faelindral first and foremost, just as you did today.
This stiletto marks you as one of our agents. There may come a time when you're call upon for more assignments, but for now, you're free to make your own story.
Shades of the Weald watch over you. Thanks again.
You receive Lambent Stiletto from Elyndiir Nightshade.
Read Torn Note you start with as a new Rogue character:

Deliver this note to Sinastin Aspinleaf in Night
Harbor to begin your association with the
Lamplighters.

You will find him in the City Illuminators' Guild,
which is located on the edge of the Night Market.
The City Illuminators' Guild serves as a front fro
his operation there.

To find the market, enter the city and then keep
an eye out for a large archway containing what
appears to be a massive red gemstone.

If you can't spot what looks like the largest ruby
in the world, odds are you're not going to make a
good rogue.

If you get lost, ask a guard for directions to the
City Illuminators' Guild. But, it's prolly not wise
to ask where all the rogues are hiding. And it's
time for you to be wise. Otherwise Irfan will
leave you floating in the harbor.

Good luck with Sinastin's Crew.

You're going to need it.
Give Torn Note to Sinastin Aspenleaf.
You gain experience.
Sinastin Aspenleaf examines the note.
Sinastin Aspenleaf: Ah yes... welcome to my humble organization. The Lamplighters are honored to add such a...
Sinastin Aspenleaf looks at you for a moment and appears to think.
Sinastin Aspenleaf: ...wonderful find, such as yourself, to our roster.
Sinastin Aspenleaf: The note you just handed me means that, while you may be new, you're already trusted enough to start earning your keep.
Sinastin Aspenleaf snickered to himself when he said the word trusted.
Sinastin Aspenleaf: The courier I was going to send out today is no longer with us. So, please take list and read the names written therein. Let me know if you have any questions about these people.
Sinastin Aspenleaf smiles at you with a perfect, but unpleasant smile.
You receive Sinastin's List of Names Sinastin Aspenleaf.
Sinastin Aspenleaf: Now, show that note to Albrecht on the way out. He'll give you what you need.
Sinastin Aspenleaf: Once you have gathered all of our gifts, take the bag to Albrecht to inventory and bring the receipt to me when he's finished.
You are tasked with retrieving items from six NPCs across Night Harbor. Read Sinastin's List of Names and then give it to Albrecht in the next room.
Albrecht looks at the note and hands over a bag and several seal notes.
You receive Small Courier Bag from Albrecht.
You receive Sealed Note for Bakari from Albrecht.
You receive Sealed Note for Mafeed from Albrecht.
You receive Sealed Note for Dilshad from Albrecht.
You receive Sealed Note for Nerida from Albrecht.
You receive Sealed Note for Eilionoir from Albrecht.
You receive Sealed Note for Andreu from Albrecht.
Albrecht: Toss those sealed notes into the bag I gave you and don't try to open them. Nor should you open the packages you get in return. Nosey people don't fare well here.
Albrecht: Well, my new friend. I wish you the best of luck.
Albrecht: I hope you last longer than the last guy.
Albrecht: Oh, and here's your list of names back.
You receive Sinastin's List of Names from Albrecht.
Go and locate the following NPCs and retrieve the requested items.
Customs Inspector Bakari
Located in the Harbor by the Harbormaster Daoud.
Captain Eilionoir
Located in "The Changing of the Guard". A bar on the ramp down when leaving Sageside heading towards west gate. An off duty guard is outside.
You gain experience.
Captain Eilionoir takes the note and quickly places it out of sight under the bar.
Captain Eilionoir sighs with a frown.
Captain Eilionoir glances around before speaking.
Captain Eilionoir: There are a lot of new faces since my time in the City Watch. Some of them are taking a little longer to warm up to me, but soon I'll have another roster ready to go.
You receive Sealed Scroll from Captain Eilionoir
Captain Eilionoir: Now drink this and get out of here before anyone gets suspicious.
You receive Twilight Bay Rum from Captain Eilionoir
Nerida Thinblade
Located in the "Spirit Tap," a bar in the Black Feather Bazaar (in the Necropolis area).
Hand Nerida Thinblade the Sealed Note for Nerida.
You gain experience.
Nerida Thinblade reads through the note, then tosses it under the bar.
Nerida Thinblade smiles at you wickedly, her eyes briefly wide with amusement.
Nerida Thinblade: Well, that contained an interesting enough proposition.
Nerida Thinblade: Give this to your master, he'll be happy I got it back in one piece. Make sure it arrives that way.
You receive Small Wrapped Box from Nerida Thinblade
Nerida Thinblade: And, my new friend, here's a drunk for the walk back.
You receive Black Feather Whiskey from Nerida Thinblade
Dilshad Abolfazl
Located in the Tannery.
Guard Andreu
Overlooking the Naval Shipyard (near the garrison) during the day.
Hand Guard Andreu the Sealed Note for Andreu.
You gain experience.
Guard Andreu glances around and quickly tucks the note into his tunic.
Guard Andreu motions for you to lean closer.
Guard Andreu stubly slips you a key.
You receive Small Iron Key from Guard Andreu
Guard Andreu: Now piss off.
Maheed the Butcher
Located in the Night Market.
When you have collected all six items combine them inside the Small Courier Bag. Turn in the combined Small Courier Bag to Albrecht.
You gain experience.
Albrecht dumps the bag's contents on the table and opens the packages.
Albrecht: One hand. Check. Wait.. is the tattoo..
Albrecht turns the hand over.
Albrecht: Oh! There it is. Check.
Albrecht: A bar of gold...
Albrecht weighs the gold.
Albrecht: Check.
Albrecht examines Nerida's package.
Albrecht: Umbral transducer. Good to see you again. Check.
Albrecht scans Eilionoir's scroll.
Albrecht: Well that means a change of plans, but... guard schedule. Check.
Albrecht dumps the contents of Bakari's pouch.
Albrecht: Oh my!
Albrecht holds a red gem up to the light.
Albrecht: Rubies, Check.
Albrecht reaches for the key, but appears to swap it with a key he had hidden in his palm.
Albrecht shifts his eyes to you for a moment, before looking back to his ledger.
Albrecht: The tower key. Check.
Albrecht: Well, it looks like everything is accounted for. Take the receipt to Sinastin... and keep your mouth shut.
You receive Albrecht's Receipt from Albrecht.
Give the receipt to Sinastin
Sinastin takes the receipt and reads it carefully.
Sinastin Aspenleaf: Well it looks like we've received everything we expected. I trust that everything went smoothly.
Sinastin Aspenleaf: I'd like for you to deliver the list to Irfan. You probably saw him on the way in.
You receive Sinastan's Note from Sinastin Aspenleaf

Sinastin Aspenleaf: If you're unfamiliar with our formidable friend... well, to put it simply, he's an avatar of violence. He may not be as sneaky as some of the others, but he is absolute in his loyalty.
Sinastin Aspenleaf: Irfan is not 'sneaky peaky' like you and many others within our organization. Irfan is an avatar of violence. But, he is absolute in his loyalty.
Sinastin Aspenleaf: ...And loyalty is a good trait to have around here. I'd advise against crossing me.
Sinastin Aspenleaf stares at you coldly for a moment, then suddenly smiles.
Sinastin Aspenleaf: Off with you, then! You don't want to keep Irfan waiting... he isn't known for his patience.
Give the note to Irfan Raz, located right outside the Illuminators' Guild.
Irfan Raz glances at the list and then tucks it away.
Irfan Raz: You'll need this, so hang on to it.
You receive Irfan's Dagger from Irfan Raz
Irfan Raz: Sinastin needs you to do three things for him.
Irfan Raz: If you are caught by the guards, you'll not speak of this work. If you do, we will know. Understand?
Irfan Raz looks at you with a vaguely threatening expression.
Irfan Raz: I'll take that as a yes. Bring this parchment to Stumpy at one of his posts in the market. He has the first job for you.
You receive Irfan's Parchment from Irfan Raz.
Irfan Raz: When you're done, return to me my dagger to me, along with proof you have completed the task.

Give Irfan's Parchment to Stumpy the Whistler, standing by the cobbler in the Night Market. He can also be in the left stall when entering Night Market from the west bank. Rumor is he roams at times. Be sure to look around the bridge to Twilight Harbor as you leave the South East corner of Night Market.
Stumpy the Whistler looks at the writing on the parchment, then shakes his head with a sigh.
Stumpy the Whistler pulls out his quill and begins to sketch something.
Stumpy the Whistler shows you a crude drawing of the god Haradrel and a dagger prying a gem from its face.
Stumpy the Whistler points at the drawing, then to you.
Stumpy the Whistler scribbles a new image of a small tower on top of what looks like the Steel Talons Garrison.
Stumpy the Whistler continues drawing, this time of a building with the words Sproggets' Adventuring Goods.
Stumpy the Whistler finally jots down a picture of a grappling hook on the parchment's corner, then tears it off.
Stumpy the Whistler hands it to you and motions for you to give it to Sproggets.
You receive a Piece of Parchment from Stumpy the Whistler.
Give the Piece of Parchment to Sproggets Bedsprings, located in the shop next to the northwest entrance to the Night Market.
Sproggets Bedsprings glances over the illustration of the piece of parchment.
Sproggets Bedsprings purses his lips, then sighs deeply.
You receive Worn Grappling Hook from Sproggets Bedsprings.
Sproggets Bedsprings: Okay, I'll give you the goods. But you didn't get it from me.
Sproggets Bedsprings: I'm neutral in all of this... just an innocent gnome trying to earn some coin.
Sproggets Bedsprings: Do you even know how to use this thing? Look for a good place to climb, throw the grappling hook, then climb. That's all there is to it. Look, throw, and away you go.
Sproggets Bedsprings: Now, out with ya! ...But maybe bring it back when you're done with it.
Go to the Steel Talons Garrison onto the roof of the southern structure overlooking the west gate newbie yard. There is a small tower-like section with no roof.
at the base of the tower for the message,
You feel you could climb this wall with the proper equipment.
While holding the grappling hook
You begin to ascend the wall...
After a few brief seconds you will see
You reached the top of the wall.
Drop down into the tower.(DONT drop into room below until you
) You will see a statue below you. While holding your Irfan's Dagger type
You pry the bloodstone free from the statue.
You receive Haradrel's Bloodstone Eye
Your faction standing with the Priests of Haradrel got worse.
Give the Haradrel's Bloodstone Eye and Irfan's Dagger to Irfan Raz.
Irfan Raz rolls the gem around in his hand and almost appears to smirk.
Irfan Raz: Let's hope you didn't just catch notice of the God of War.
Irfan Raz: For your next job, pay a visit to Whispering Wallace at the Shaded Bloom Inn. He'll be drinking there at night. Show him my dagger so he knows I sent you.
You receive Irfan's Dagger from Irfan Raz.
Irfan Raz: And like before, return with my dagger and proof of your deed.
Give Irfan's Dagger to Whispering Wallace.
Whispering Wallace looks around quickly and motions for you to speak softly.
Whispering Wallace: I've gathered word that Pasha Patrice has a special guest at her compound. The guest is an emissary from Tarellon who's travelling through Night Harbor under Patrice's protection.
Whispering Wallace: Let's just say it would be very embarrassing to her and her operation if this guest winds up dead.
Whispering Wallace: They've given the emissary a room for the night on the second floor of the compound, just past the room where our fake 'Pasha' likes to hold court toward the end of the day.
Whispering Wallace pauses for a moment and looks at you, as though realizing something.

Whispering Wallace: You're new, so you may not know about the compound. It's in the eastern corner of the market. On the right as you're leaving, just before the bridge. Sometimes Stumpy posts up across from it.
Whispering Wallace: The boss is pissed that she set up shop so close to us, so he'll be happy when you pull this off.
Whispering Wallace: You'll probably want this dagger back. When the job's done, return it to Irfan with proof of the deed.
Whispering Wallace: Good hunting.
You receive Irfan's Dagger from Whispering Wallace

Go to the compound described to survey the area and plan your attack. On the west side of the building, you will see a fountain. The attack must happen at night ( between 3a.m. and 6a.m.) when the emissary is in her room. You will need to jump across from a nearby 2nd floor building to get access. You can get on top of the city wall from behind the bathhouse. Run on the wall towards Night Market. When you see the fountain on your left, the building you're looking for will be next. Jump down from the wall on to the closest building. Jump the gap over to the 2nd floor of the Claw Compound. Find the emissary's room behind a closed door. Kill an emissary and loot her Fine Leather Courier Bag and return it along with the dagger to Irfan Raz.
Irfan Raz takes the bag and almost seems to chuckle.
Irfan Raz: The last job is from me. There's a camp of smugglers along the coast to the west of here.
Irfan Raz: You'll find a man named Toma there. He's in charge. He needs to die. I want the ring he wears as proof.
Irfan Raz deftly flips his dagger back to you.
Irfan Raz: You might find this handy once again.
You receive Irfan's Dagger from Irfan Raz.
Recommended level: 7-8 - Go to Shaded Dunes along the coast to the smuggler/wererat camp and kill Toma the Two-Faced and loot Toma's Signet Ring. Turn ring and Irfan's Dagger into Irfan Raz.
Irfan Raz: You got the rat man's ring! His death will show the rest of Vermahn's crew whose territory they're in... not that his thrall has much choice in the matter.
Irfan Raz spits.
Irfan Raz: Take these to our little bookkeeper upstairs.
Irfan Raz: Don't neglect to slide him my dagger... point first.
Irfan Raz laughs.
Irfan Raz: So he knows I sent you.
You receive Haradrel's Bloodstone Eye, Toma's Signet Ring, and Fine Leather Courier Bag from Irfan Raz..
Take these to Albrecht who is just upstairs from Irfan Raz.
Turn in Haradrel's Bloodstone Eye, Toma's Signet Ring, Irfan's Dagger, and Fine Leather Courier Bag to Albrecht.
You gain experience.
Albrecht looks over the items as you set them on the table.
Albrecht: You can have this one back. I don't know where he finds all of them...
You receive Irfan's Dagger from Albrecht.
Albrecht picks up the bloodstone with a pair of jeweler's tongs.
Albrecht: You can never be too careful with defiling the likeness of a god.
Albrecht drops the bloodstone into a black box and tucks it away.
Albrecht unlocks the emissary's bag with a small key, then looks inside.
Albrecht: Well, several people will be upset to see the emissary dead... including our little pretend Pasha. But that's her problem to deal with now.
Albrecht: Good work. She's almost as hideous as some other people I know.
Albrecht stiffens up, realizing what he just said out loud.
Albrecht quickly glances over toward Sinastin's room.
Albrecht shakes his head, refocusing on his task, then picks up the ring.
Albrecht: Filthy business, this lot. Like a nest of vipers and rats, constantly biting each other.
Albrecht: Well, here you are. Take this receipt to Sinastin.
You receive Ring Receipt from Albrecht.
Albrecht motions for you to lean close.
Albrecht: You seem decent enough. Take this note to Elmswood at the Spirit Tap. If I'm not wrong about you, you might want to hear what he's got to say. If I'm wrong, we never spoke.
You receive Albrecht's Note from Albrecht.
Albrecht: Wrap things up with Sinastin first, then go to the Spirit Tasp before you do anything more for him. You'll understand more when you speak to Elmswood.
First, take the Ring Receipt to Sinastin Aspenleaf in the next room. It gets you experience and Lamplighter's Ring.
Second, take the Albrecht's Note to Elmswood at the Spirit Tap in the Dark Bazaar.
You gain experience.
Sinastin Aspenleaf scans the receipt, then looks at you.
Sinastin Aspenleaf: Very well done. I see you brought back one of the rat's rings, too.
Sinastin Aspenleaf: Did you keep the finger you found it on? ...Actually, never mind that. Here's a nicer ring for your troubles. It would seem that you're a Lamplighter after all.
You receive Lamplighter's Ring from Sinastin Aspenleaf.
Sinastin Aspenleaf: Which means... I've got another job for you. Take this bag. There are a few things I'd like you to retrieve for me.
You receive a Black Leather Courier Bag.

Sinastin Aspenleaf: The tomb just outside of town is said to contain a wealth of interesting artifacts. I've learned that one of our rivals, Jamee Langris, is attempting to recover an amulet for a client of his. It supposedly allows the wearer to commune with spirits.
Sinastin Aspenleaf: The previous amulet bearer entered the tomb to speak with a certain female spirit... but she put a quick end to him. Find her, and I bet you'll find the amulet.
Sinastin Aspenleaf: The other thing I need can be found at the archaeological site in Shaded Dunes. I'm very curious about the activities of the head researcher there... a fellow named Aashir.
Sinastin Aspenleaf: Sneak into the site after dark and see if you can find his documentation. He's bound to have a journal or something similar to log their findings.
Sinastin Aspenleaf: On that note, I've heard that a group of cultists has been poking around there lately. Don't let them get to it first.
Sinastin Aspenleaf: Place both items in the bag and bring it directly to me. Don't involve Albrecht this time.
Elmswood can be found at the Spirit Tap in the Dark Bazaar just to the left of Nerida.
Elmswood rubs his thumb across the surface of the note and smiles.
Elmswood: Well then... the dwarf has finally gathered some courage.
Elmswood: He sent you to me... to betray his master. How do you feel about that?
Elmswood squints at you for a moment.
Elmswood: If you don't like it, you'd be wise to keep your mouth shut. Sure, you could rat the dwarf out to Sinastin, but you'd be a food to think he won't suspect you too.
Elmswood: But... if you're interested in running with a less 'despicable' crew, then take this note to the fishing camp just outside the city. Someone will meet you there at midnight.
You receive Albrecht's Note from Elmswood.

Take Albrecht's Note to the fishing village inside the Shaded Dunes near the young crocodiles. The village is south of Night Harbor, along the waters edge. Give the note to Selyst Surecoin when she spawns exactly at 12am game time.
Selyst Surecoin rubs the tips of her fingers across the note.
Selyst Surecoin: Elmswood said he was sending someone... and the note is real enough.
Selyst Surecoin: We run with Tinka Roofstrider's crew. She despises Sinastin, so the bag he gave you and the items he wanted in it... we want them.
Selyst Surecoin: That pointy dung pile of an elf won't be too pleased if you do this for us, so you'd better think carefully about it.

Selyst Surecoin: If you choose to run with us, you'll have a bounty on your head as well... and I'm sure you've seen what Irfan and the other Lamplighters are capable of. Hells, you've likely had to do some of it yourself.
Selyst Surecoin: So, ask your questions now. If you decide to move forward with us, fetch the items and bring me the bag.
Selyst Surecoin: You know when and where to find me.
Need more information. Split factions and possibly KoS to Rogue's guild if this path is followed?

Recommended level: 15 - Enter Tomb of the Last Wyrmsbane and head down to High Marshal Fionna. Fionna is the spirit that Sinastin Aspenleaf references. Kill Fionna and obtain the Engraved Amulet. The amulet is an occasional dropped item and it is the first item needed. For the second item, you will need to kill a cultist and collect a 6-slot Aashir's Journal, and 6 Aashir journal pages:
Aashir's Journal Page 4
Aashir's Journal Page 17
Aashir's Journal Page 37
Aashir's Journal Page 42
Aashir's Journal Page 70
Aashir's Journal Page 76
The cultist can be found at night near the Ancient Crypt entrance or under a hidden tunnel beyond the farm just outside of North Gate Night's Harbor.
Combine the 6 Aashir Journal pages in the Aashir's Journal. It will turn into a completed Aashir's Journal.
Combine both the completed Aashir's Journal and the Engraved Amulet into the Black Leather Courier Bag and it'll turn into a completed Black Leather Courier Bag.
Turn in combined Black Leather Courier Bag to Sinastin Aspenleaf
Sinastin Aspenleaf: Fantastic Work.
Sinastin Aspenleaf smiles broadly while looking at the amulet.
Sinastin Aspenleaf: This will certanly leave Langris in a bind. It's not often that he fails to fulfill a request... pity.
Sinastin Aspenleaf: As for the journal, I look forward to seeing what opportunities it has for us.
Sinastin Aspenleaf: For now, take some time off. You've earned it, and... you've pleased me.
You receive Mark of the Lamplighters from Sinastin Aspenleaf.
Alternate Hand combined black leather bag to Selyst Surecoin.
Selyst Surecoin: Well, well... for better or worse, it looks like you've got a new crew to meet! We've got a couple of safehouses in the Bends.
Selyst Surecoin shrugs.
Selyst Surecoin: Sure, it's a little dangerous there for outsiders, but it's fun once you know your way around.
Selyst Surecoin: Take the bag to Tinka. She'll be expecting you. You'll find her observing the courtyard, just inside the main gate to Riverbend.
You receive Black Leather Courier Bag from Selyst Surecoin.
Selyst Surecoin: Oh, and just so you know, you made the right choice.
Take Black Leather Courier Bag to Tinka Roofstrider.
Tinka Roofstrider: We were hoping you'd make the right choice. Welcome to the crew!
Tinka Roofstrider: I'll have something you can help with soon. In the meantime, if Sinastin gave you one of his gaudy rings, hand it over and we'll give you something classy.
Tinka Roofstrider: Otherwise, feel free to poke around and meet the crew.
Hand Tinka Roofstrider Lamplighter's Ring
Tinka Roofstrider: Yep, that's the one. Trashy, isn't it?
Tinka Roofstrider pockets the ring.
Tinka Roofstrider: Here, this is much better.
You receive Roofstrider's Ring from Tinka Roofstrider.
Hult Beetlewrangler is located in the rear of the Sojourner Camp in Night Harbor. He can wander a short distance from his tent throughout the day.
Hult Beetlewrangler: Woah, ho there, adventurer. Ya lookin for work or wares? No matter, ol' Hult's got somethin for ya either way.

Hult Beetlewrangler: Well, well... maybe Hult's got the things ya need. Nanny Shrew always said, 'Hult, of all the Shrewfolk, ya've got to be the most industrious an' entrepreneurial of the lot... and most handsome too.
Hult Beetlewrangler: Well maybe not that last past anyway. Maybe not any of it.
Hult Beetlewrangler: Anyhow, ya musn't leave town in just yer drawers. How would ya like ol' Hult to make ya some fine accessories?

parts.say: I would like you to make me some fine accessories.

parts.text: Hult Beetlewrangler: Them ugly green scarabs out there in the dunes have mighty tough shells, they do. I can make ya a breastplate, greaves, helm, boots, and shield. Just ask ol' Hult how.
Scarab Breastplate

parts.say: How do you make the breastplate?

parts.text: Hult Beetlewrangler: For the breastplate, Hult'll need three scarab shells, three scarab legs, and a scarab thorax plate.
Hunt a dunes scarab and loot 3 x Scarab Carapace, 3 x Scarab Leg, and 1 x Scarab Thorax Plate.
Hand these items to Hult Beetlewrangler.
You gain experience.
Hult Beetlewrangler: Here ya go, boss.
You receive Scarab Breastplate from Hult Beetlewrangler.
Scarab Greaves

parts.say: How do you make the greaves?

parts.text: Hult Beetlewrangler: For the greaves, Hult'll need two scarab shells and two scarab legs, and a scarab elytron plate.
Hunt a dunes scarab and loot 2 x Scarab Carapace, 2 x Scarab Leg, and 1 x Scarab Elytron Plate.
Hand these items to Hult Beetlewrangler.
You gain experience.
Hult Beetlewrangler: Here ya go, boss.
You receive Scarab Greaves from Hult Beetlewrangler.
Scarab Helm

parts.say: How do you make the helm?

parts.text: Hult Beetlewrangler: For the helm, Hult'll need two scarab shells and one scarab leg.
Hunt a dunes scarab and loot 2 x Scarab Carapace and 1 x Scarab Leg.
Hand these items to Hult Beetlewrangler.
You gain experience.
Hult Beetlewrangler: Here ya go, boss.
You receive Scarab Helm from Hult Beetlewrangler.
Scarab Boots

parts.say: How do you make the boots?

parts.text: Hult Beetlewrangler: For the boots, Hult'll need one scarab shell and two scarab legs.
Hunt a dunes scarab and loot 1 x Scarab Carapace and 2 x Scarab Leg.
Hand these items to Hult Beetlewrangler.
You gain experience.
Hult Beetlewrangler: Here ya go, boss.
You receive Scarab Boots from Hult Beetlewrangler.
Scarab Shell Shield

parts.say: How do you make the shield?

parts.text: Hult Beetlewrangler: For the shield, Hult'll need one scarab shell and one scarab leg.
Hunt a dunes scarab and loot 1 x Scarab Carapace and 1 x Scarab Leg.
Hand these items to Hult Beetlewrangler.
You gain experience.
Hult Beetlewrangler: Here ya go, boss.
You receive Scarab Shell Shield from Hult Beetlewrangler.
Hunt level 3+ a dunes scarab for the required parts. You may also find scarab parts for sale from shady vendors and blacksmithing vendors if sold by other players.
Gathering Scarab Parts
Loot 9 x Scarab Carapace
Loot 9 x Scarab Leg
Loot 1 x Scarab Thorax Plate
Loot 1 x Scarab Elytron Plate
