Quest Complete!
Part 1 - Req. Lvl 1
Read Weathered Note you start with as a new Shadow Knight character:

Take this note to Exavius Deathwhisper in the
Concourse of Souls to begin your training.

The guild hall can be found within the Necropolis
District.

You'll find it if you proceed through the Sageside
District towards Saltbreeze Park. If you get to the
Tannery, you've gone too far.

Or if you are very daring, there's a shortcut 
through the old cemetery outside of the Black
Feather Bazaar. This will lead into the Necropolis
District.

If you get lost, ask a guard. They are often helpful
with directions.

And try not to die. We have enough undead in the
desert already.
Give Weathered Note to Exavius Deathwhisper.
Exavius Deathwhisper: Welcome. We are looking to expand our ranks, but expect to be vetted.
Exavius Deathwhisper: You'll need to prove to be a value beyond just your capability to survive the desert and deliver notes. Your loyalty will be tested.
Exavius Deathwhisper: Night Harbor is far more than what shows on her surface. You'll see in due time and we'll learn the durability of your resolve.
Exavius Deathwhisper: Take your note to Brazzic, downstairs in the sleeping quarters. He'll get you started.
You gain experience.
You receive Weathered Note from Exavius Deathwhisper.
Brazzic Durraim: Well? Out with it.
Brazzic Durraim: ... and if you think I mean your tongue, my response will be painful.
Give Weathered Note Note to Brazzic Durraim who is also in the Concourse of Souls.
Brazzic Durraim: Well, you made it. Our people have been watching you. Appears you're more "knight" than "shadow" for the time being. And to be fair, friend, you don't look like much of a knight.
Brazzic Durraim: But at least you arrived, and I guess that counts for something.
Brazzic Durraim: We're going to get straight to business. Let's see how you operate.
Brazzic Durraim: Deliver the note to a gentleman named Noel Klares. Bring back whatever he gives you.
Brazzic Durraim: The bag is to be filled with shattered femurs from the bone piles you saw stumbling around out in the desert. Do you have questions?
You gain experience.
You receive Sealed Scroll from Brazzic Durraim.
You receive Black Leather Bag from Brazzic Durraim.

Go out into the yard in front of the Concourse of Souls and hunt a rotting skeleton until you have 6 Shattered Skeleton Femur. Combine them inside the Black Leather Bag from Brazzic and receive a Bag of Femurs.

Locate Noel Klares in the Wayfarers Hospice in Night Harbor and give him the Sealed Scroll. (find guard tower, go up, back inside 2nd floor, find ramp, go up, he's on the roof). *** Warning. The guards will assist him if they are nearby. It is recommended to pull him to a safer area where guards will not patrol.
Noel Klares: Who sent you?! What do you know of us? No matter, I'll deal with you myself!" He Will attack, Kill him.
Noel Klares: You've come to confront me? Don't you know who I work for?
Noel Klares: ... they ... they will ... find you.
Loot Noel Klares' Ring from Noel Klares.
Return to Brazzic Durraim and give him Bag of Femurs and Noel Klares' Ring.
Brazzic Durraim: Bravo! Our people say you performed well. And the fact that you're here now and not locked in prison, means that you've got a bit of a shadow to your knight after all.
Brazzic Durraim: Feels good to do bad things to bad people sometimes, eh?
Brazzic Durraim: As master Hallows was kind enough to establish this wonderful college from which we now operate, we in return, provide services to his necromancers and faculty.
Brazzic Durraim: Please take the bag over to Buckmarr Gorstagg, the head alchemist. He'll make use of it's contents.

Brazzic Durraim: Your next task will involve his favorite abomination. Return to me after you've assisted him with it. Then, maybe you can take a little break and peruse some of this fair city's night life.
You receive Bag of Femurs from Brazzic Durraim.
Part 2 - Req. Lvl 8 or 5 if you have a group for Wererats
Buckmarr Gorstagg looks up from his work.
Buckmarrgorstagg: It's extremely important that my work not be disturbed. What is it?
Hand him the Bag of Femurs
You gain experience.
Buckmarr Gorstagg opens the bag and examines the contents.
Buckmarr Gorstagg: Yes, this will do. Thank you.
Buckmarr Gorstagg removes a bladed weapon from a black silk bag.
Buckmarr Gorstagg: Please take this weapon. I'm experimenting with coating in an attempt to see if it will cauterize certain wounds in a manner suitable for my needs.
Buckmarr Gorstagg: There's rumored to be a camp deep along the coast of Shaded Dunes that's utilized by wererats posing as smugglers. Or wererat smugglers. Or some such nonsense.
Buckmarr Gorstagg: Use the blade to sever their whiskered heads and return them to me. Bring me at least four.:
Buckmarr Gorstagg pauses for a moment.
You receive Silver Edged Blade from Buckmarr Gorstagg.

Buckmarr Gorstagg: If you feel like they should be made to suffer, please by all means, but do take care not to mention this to Master Hallows. He worries about the attention your people draw to our work here.
Buckmarr Gorstagg returns to his work.
Part 3 - Req. Lvl none(?) just a turn in for part 2 above
Hand Buckmarr Gorstagg 4 Wererat Head and the Silver Edged Blade.
You gain experience.
Buckmarr Gorstagg lines the heads up and stares at them.
Buckmarr Gorstagg: Well, I do hope they suffered. I would have taken my time with them.
Buckmarr Gorstagg pokes one of the heads.
Buckmarr Gorstagg: The wounds look promising. I'll need to examine them more in detail, but I'm sure my blade performed as planned.
Buckmarr Gorstagg hands you a concoction filled vial.
Buckmarr Gorstagg: Please give this to Brazzic for me. I'm sure Master Deathwhisper is awaiting its delivery.
You receive Small Brown Vial from Buckmarr Gorstagg.
Buckmarr Gorstagg: I may have other work for you later. But for now, that is all
Buckmarr Gorstagg returns to poking at one of the heads.
Part 4 - Req. Lvl none(?) just a turn in for the tunic reward
Hand Brazzic Durraim the Small Brown Vial
You gain experience.
Brazzic Durraim looks at the vial and frowns for a moment.
Brazzic Durraim: Buckmarr should know better than to give this to just anyone, but you seem to be ingratiating yourself well enough. I assume he refrained from describing its contents, yes?
Brazzic Durraim appears to scan your face for clues.
Brazzic Durraim: I'll take that as a "no." Good.
Brazzic Durraim: You're doing good work so far. I think you'll fit in just fine here. Take this and then take some time to go explore the city. It's more of a hunting ground than it looks.
Brazzic Durraim: Just be careful of some of the darker corners. You've still got some learning to do yet, "shadow knight."
Brazzic Durraim hands you a tunic.
You receive Gold Trimmed Black Tunic from Brazzic Durraim.
Brazzic Durraim winks at you.
Brazzic Durraim: Come back later and I'll likely have some new work for you.
Part 1 - Req. Lvl 1
Read Weathered Note you start with as a new Shadow Knight character:
NEEDS TEXT.
Hand Weathered Note to Soren Akedd.
Soren Akedd: You have done well to come when called, [Player]. This is the House of Ygorath, which you may call home, if you are deemed worthy to carry out his work.
Soren Akedd: You appear before me as you were in my nightmare, [Player].
Soren Akedd: Nightmares are visits from Ygorath, gifted upon all the fearful of this land. It was my nightmare that called you here to begin his work.
Soren Akedd: It is the work of trembling hands to raise both the living and the dead upon his altar. It is for their salvation as much as our own.

Soren Akedd: Many souls walk Eth-ur practicing feints of valor, but Ygorath's wisdom knows bravery to be a thin sheen upon a bottomless terror. We must usher them into his kingdom with right fear in their hearts.
Soren Akedd: This you must do, Shadow Knight, whether by sign or by sword. If you pass the test.

Soren Akedd: The rabble carry fear in their blood and their bones. Ours are borne by Ygorath. This is your test: take this effigy to the chapel and make of it an offering. Place your effigy upon the altar and receive Ygorath's blessing. Return with what remains.
Soren Akedd: But I must warn you... cast your gaze downward and look not upon the visage of Ygorath.
Go next door to the temple of Ygorath, hold the effigy in your hand (left click on it) and use the mud command
to receive an offering bowl. Go back to Soren and hand in the offering bowl.
Soren Akedd: Your eyes are open. Take this drape and rise a new servant of Ygorath.
You receive Worn Cassock from Soren Akedd.
You gain experience.
Part 2 - Req. Lvl 1
Soren Akedd: Now go, and do his work. If you would prove yourself a belted knight, report to Father Fyod upstairs.
Go upstairs onto the balcony [left of center when facing the yard from inside] and hail Father Fyod.
Father Fyod scoffs.
Father Fyod: What are you supposed to be?
Father Fyod: How convincing.
Father Fyod guffaws.
Father Fyod: Stand to it, then. You're a sorry sight, but I've seen worse. Do you wish to become a servant of the Trembling Hand, the chosen of Ygorath?.
Father Fyod: Very well. As knights of the temple, our fears guide but do not govern us.
Father Fyod: You will go to the rafters above the citadel. It's infested with vermin. Fill this sack with their tails as testimony to your constitution.
Father Fyod: You'll return, or you'll die.

Go up the lift to the mining camp and traverse out onto the rafters that are above the citadel. Kill a rafter rat (not the diseased ones) until you have 4 tails; fill the bag and combine for a bag of rafter rat tails. Return to Father Fyod.

Father Fyod: Do not take pride in acquitting yourself of this task. You've proven only that you're not vermin. Whether you have the mettle to stand as a true knight of this temple remains to be seen. But you've earned the right to this blade.
You receive Initiate's Dull Greatsword from Father Fyod.
Father Fyod pauses.
Father Fyod: ... A right which can be revoked.
Part 3 - Req. Lvl 5
If you go back to Fyod too early:
Father Fyod: I do not require your assistance at this time, fledgling. Return when you're stronger.
At level 5:
Father Fyod: If you'd like to be of use, go and find Lady Tabitha in her laboratory and see that she has what she needs.
Go back to the entrance to the temple. Lady Tabitha's lab is up the ramp on the right, and a door on the right of that hallway.
Lady Tabitha hums to herself.
Lady Tabitha: Oh, here's a new one. Who sent you to me? Or have you become a nuisance of your own volition?
Lady Tabitha: Indeed! Each somehow less promising than the last, it seems. No matter. If you can furnish the ingredients I require, I will endorse your aspiration.
Lady Tabitha: I brew many potions your kind rely on, Shadow Knight. Venture into the great cavern and fetch me as many myconid caps as this will carry.
You receive Myconid Cap Bag from Lady Tabitha.
Lady Tabitha: I prefer the larger ones.

Go out the north gate of Underdocks and kill Myconid Gatherer and Myconid Truffian - fill the bag with 8x Myconid Cap (not Decomposed Myconid Cap) and combine. Turn the combined item back in to Tabitha.
Lady Tabitha: I thank you, Shadow Knight. The work continues. Give this letter to Father Fyod as a sign of your progress.
Go back to Father Fyod and turn in the letter.
Father Fyod unfolds the letter.
Father Fyod: Adequate. That's what she wrote.
Father Fyod grumbles to himself.
Father Fyod: Better than the last one, to be fair. Hand me the alchemist's letter along with your initiate's sword, and I'll grant you a more capable blade.
Hand both the letter and your Initiate's Dull Greatsword to Fyod.
Father Fyod: Wield this in Ygorath's name. Now leave me be.
You receive Initiate's Greatsword from Father Fyod.
Part 4 - Req. Lvl 13
If you go back to Fyod too early:
Father Fyod: You're still too weak to call yourself a knight.
If you are the required level:
Father Fyod: Your blade has seen some use, then. Report to Father General Lorak.
Father General Lorak is in the center room overlooking the yard, first left after you leave Father Fyod
Father General Lorak: I see you carry a blade of the chosen. It is but one instrument of fear. Tell me, have you yet learned to inflict fear on the living?
Father General Lorak: The ability to strike fear into the heart of our enemies is the first lesson any true knight of Ygorath must learn. You must carry out a simple task for the temple.
Father General Lorak: Slay the Deepcut bandits who encroach upon our territory. Collect the blood of those who die in fear and return the samples in this bag.
You receive Blood Bag from Father General Lorak.
Father General Lorak: Now go.
Part 1 - Preserve the Balance
Read the Folded Leafscroll that you start with as a new Shaman Character in Faelindral.

Do you hear the whispers through the boughs?
           Yes, this is because you Listen.

   Do you hear the whimsy hidden in the fae's wisdom?
           Yes, this is because you Listen.

Do you hear the songs of our history yearning to be told?
           Yes, this is because you Listen.

We invite you to learn from these whispers at the 
Balanced Branch lodge.

To reach us, set out toward the Willows Whisper and
ascend the ramp on the left to Traders Terrace. Once 
there, traverse the lone bridge and you will find us across 
from our Ranger cousins. Any of the city guard can 
provide further direction if required. 

When you arrive, present this note to our Listener 
mentor, Varilis Thornvine.

                                        Eraeldor Lowmist,
                        Elder Whisperer of the Preservers
Head to the Shaman Guild (the Balanced Branch, follow signs or review Faelindral map).
Give Folded Leafscroll to Varilis Thornvine.
You gain experience.
Faction: Preservers +
Faction: Fellstone Orcs -
Varilis Thornvine cracks open a well-wizened gaze as you offer him the scroll, which he accepts at the pace of an old treant.
Varilis Thornvine: The whispers of your arrival have reached my ears well before this scroll ever did, young shaman.
Varilis Thornvine: I have been preparing for you. Here, please accept this mortar and pestle. You will need it for your first task.
You receive Old Mortar and Pestle from Varilis Thornvine.
Varilis Thornvine: Old forces threaten the balance of the Weald and beyond. The fae grow restless and resentful. The spirits of the dead find no rest.

Varilis Thornvine: We must do what needs be done to preserve the balance, young one. My old bones are not up to this task, but perhaps a young listener such as yourself could quell some of these... disturbances.
Varilis Thornvine: You should start with the undead that have begun to crawl out from long forgotten places.
Varilis Thornvine: Gather four chips of their bones, along with two of their skulls. Crush them within your mortar and return the dust to me.
Varilis Thornvine: The spirits of young adventurers, or those long since left behind, disturbed of their rest.
Varilis Thornvine: Beneath our forest once stood an empire, of which the fallen are all too willing to rise.
Varilis Thornvine: That of the Calafrey Conglomerate, which ruled before even my time.
Varilis Thornvine: The Heartwood Archive could teach you more, if you are interested.
Return to the newbie area and kill a rotting skeleton until you get 4 x Bone Chips and 2 x Shattered Skull. Combine these in the Old Mortar and Pestle.
You craft Mortar of Bone Dust.
Return to Varilis Thornvine and give him Mortar of Bone Dust.
You gain experience.
Faction: Preservers +
Faction: Fellstone Orcs -
Varilis Thornvine carefully reaches out to collect the mortar of ground up, chalky bone dust. He carefully pours the dust into a small pouch, whispering out soft unheard words as he does.
Varilis Thornvine: Well done, young Listener. These spirits can now return to the rest that they rightly deserve.
Varilis Thornvine: For this, you deserve to be recognized as a novice of our order, and so I shall present to you this hoop.
Varilis Thornvine: Our task is not yet complete, however. It is not just the spirits of the dead that are crying out, but those of the living as well.
You receive Novice Hoop of the Listener from Varilis Thornvine.
You receive Pouch of Bone Dust from Varilis Thornvine.
Part 2 - The Malicious Faerie
Varilis Thornvine: You shall take what remains of those who were scorned and have them reveal the source of the wolves' agony. Can you hear their cries?
Varilis Thornvine: The mournful howls of the Weald's wolves haunt my dreams of late. More of their number fall to savagery and madness by the day.
Varilis Thornvine: I have altered the bone dust that you collected, so that it may cling to the dismal agonies of woeful spirits.
Varilis Thornvine: There is a wolf pack amongst the western cliffs whose cries concern me most. Locate and scatter the dust at the entrance of their den to reveal the source of this dismay.
Varilis Thornvine: Throw, or simply pour out the contents of the pouch. It should make no difference. Once revealed, you must confront the spirit and, if need be, cleanse it. Do you understand?
Varilis Thornvine: Good. You may wish to conceal yourself from the gaze of any wolves who have fallen to madness, as they can be vicious foes.
Varilis Thornvine: Return to me with anything that you uncover, along with your novice hoop. You may also return and ask me for more dust, should you lose what you have.
If you run out of dust and need more...
Varilis Thornvine: Very well. Be mindful of where you choose to scatter it, young Listener, as well as what threats iy may reveal.
You receive Pouch of Bone Dust from Varilis Thornvine.
Go down the Pixie Lift (Fungi lift) and turn left. Head past the druid ring, fungal ring, cross the bridge, and pass through the ruins.
Down the hill from the ruins you will spot a cave, which is the aforementioned wolf den.
Be mindful of a beguiled wolf spawns in the area, as these are high level and aggressive. Invisibility may be useful here.
Stand in the entrance of the cave and
to verify you are in the correct location:
The den appears to house some local wolves, with traces of bone and viscera lying alongside dozens of heavyset prints and matted clumps of fur.
Pick up the dust on your cursor and type
As you scatter the bone dust around the den, you hear a surprised sneeze nearby. The outline of a small, invisible winged creature suddenly appears in the deluge of chalky dust!
a mischievous faerie: Achoo! Ahh! Oh no-no-no! It was just a prank, I promise!
a mischievous faerie (level 2) will spawn. Kill the faerie and loot Strange Toadstool.

To avoid agroing the nearby a beguiled wolf spawns, run back towards the ruins as the faerie will eventually path towards them. When the faerie is a safe distance from the cave, engage in combat with it.
Upon attacking the faerie..
a mischievous faerie: Ow, hey! It was just a gaff! They actually only ate three people, honest!
Upon slaying the faerie..
a mischievous faerie slumps to the ground with a pathetic wail.
a mischievous faerie: How could a prank... go so wrong...?
You loot Strange Toadstool from a mischievous faerie's corpse.
Return to Varilis Thornvine and hand him your Novice Hoop of the Listener as well as the Strange Toadstool.
You gain experience.
Faction: Preservers +
Faction: Fellstone Orcs -
Varilis Thornvine furrows his already well-weathered brow as you present the toadstool to him, alongside your novice hoop.
Varilis Thornvine: So the fae have had a hand in this? Their antics grow bolder by the day, despite our tenuous agreement.
Varilis Thornvine: You were not wrong to mete out punishment for the imbalance they caused. I would say you deserve this.

Varilis Thornvine proceeds to whisper something into the small hoop, as though it were an ear yearning to hear one of his tales. He smiles softly and offers the hoop back to you, now empowered further by the spirits.
You receive Apprentice Hoop of the Listener from Varilis Tornvine.
Varilis Thornvine: Well done Listener. Though now we must see about this strange toadstool. Perhaps it can tell us a clue.
Varilis Thornvine: A pact was made with the fae long ago. They would teach us the means in which to restore our forest, and in exchange, we would grant them land of their own here in Evershade.

Varilis Thornvine: Of course, the fae are always looking for means to expand their reach and propagate more of their influence onto the land... through pacts, trickery, or, in some cases, magical beguilement.

Varilis Thornvine: Yes, it is an unfortunate truth that we as Preservers must help navigate. Not all fae are hostile or malicious, but those who cross the line of dominating the freedom of others must be punished for it.

parts.say: What clue does the toadstool tell us?

parts.text: Varilis Thornvine slowly brings the toadstool up toward his elongated ear, as though listening to murmurs that only he could hear.
Varilis Thornvine: Tell me, young Listener, do you hear the whispers?
Part 3 - Spore Druids - Req. Level 4
You must be at least level 4 to progress past this part.
If you are level 3 or below...
Varilis Thornvine shakes his head back and forth in a languid motion.
Varilis Thornvine: I do not believe you truly hear them just yet. Return to me when you have more experience among the spirits of the Weald, then inquire again if you are ready to hear the whispers.
If you are level 4 or above..
Varilis Thornvine: I believe you will be capable of hearing a great many things before long, young one. Not just from toadstools, but from all manner of objects in which the spirits reside.

Varilis Thornvine: Even from objects that have been with you from the near beginning. Please, allow me to see your apprentice hoop so that I may listen to all it has experienced in your journey thus far.
Hand Varilis Thornvine your Apprentice Hoop of the Listener.
Faction: Preservers +
Faction: Fellstone Orcs -
Varilis Thornvine takes your hoop and brings it close to his own ear. He nods along with it thoughtfully, as it seemingly tells the Elder Whisperer of your travels.

Varilis Thornvine: An interesting journey you have taken to get here. Your hoop is excited to experience more, so I shall return it to you. Be sure to hold onto it so it can take in more of your continued story.
You receive Apprentice Hoop of the Listener from Varilis Thornvine.
Varilis Thornvine: You will also need to bring this toadstool with you for your next task. We are now being whispered toward a group who lives reclusively among the roots of Faelindral.
Varilis Thornvine: Tell me, young Listener, do you know of the Circle of Spores?
You receive Toadstool Box from Varilis Thornvine.

Varilis Thornvine: They are a cloistered cult of druids who have a strong connection to fungus and mushrooms. If there are any within the Weal who would be able to tell us the source of this strange toadstool, it would be them.
Varilis Thornvine: I have safely packed the toadstool within the box I provided you. Deliver it to a member of the Circle of Spores, who seclude themselves beneath Faelindral in Sporehave Karts.
Varilis Thornvine: I know not the name of the particular druid who may be able to help us, but the Circle are not unwelcoming of guests. Their experiments on the other hand...

Varilis Thornvine: You should be strong enough to call upon the spirits to conceal yourself. If the Circle's experiments have gone awry, as they are known to, it may be prudent to learn such a spell before departing.
Varilis Thornvine: Spirits watch over you, young Listener.
Travel under Faelrindal into the Spore Caves along the stream. If going at night, make sure to invis, or else the sporelings will gank you, then find Sporeweaver Underviel.
BEWARE A NUMBER OF SPORELINGS PATH RIGHT PAST THE NPC, DO NOT RISK CONVERSATION WITHOUT INVIS/HIDE HANDY!!!
Hand in the Toadstool Box.
You gain experience.
Faction: Preservers +
Faction: Circle of Spores +
Sporeweaver Underveil carefully examines the contents of the box you offer him, pursing his lips in thought. He meticulously removes the toadstool before returning the empty box to you.
You receive Empty Box from Sporeweaver Underveil.

Sporeweaver Underveil: Hmm... this is quite the interesting specimen that you have brought me, shaman. I can tell at a glance that is has been manipulated by a magical force, not unlike our own myconids.
Sporeweaver Underveil: Though I could not tell you much more without a thorough examination. Perhaps we could come to an agreement?
Sporeweaver Underviel looks at you expectantly.
Sporeweaver Underveil: I am looking to produce a new strain of fungus that is far more robust than previous generations.
Sporeweaver Underveil: To further my research, I need some components from out in the Weald. If you can gather them for me, I will look further into the origins of this toadstool for you.
Sporeweaver Underveil: Does that sound acceptable?
Sporeweaver Underveil bows his head politely, a faint glimmer reflecting from his shaven scalp.
Sporeweaver Underveil: Then we have an agreement. You can use the empty box that you brought the toadstool in as a container. It seems sturdy enough.
Sporeweaver Underveil: All I require are the scales of green drakelings, along with some wax from wasp workers. Five of each should suffice for my needs.
Sporeweaver Underveil: By the time you return with the box filled and sealed, I should have some more answers for you regarding this mysterious toadstool.
Go collect 5 Green Drakeling Scales from a green drakeling, and 5 Wasp Worker Wax from a wasp worker.
Combine 5 stacked scales and 5 stacked wax in the Empty Box to create the Box of Scales and Wax. Then return to our friend Underveil.
Upon handing in the box:
You gain experience.
Faction: Preservers +
Faction: Circle of Spores +
Sporeweaver Underveil examines the contents of the box with a satisfied nod, retrieving the strange toadstool and exchanging it for the materials you collected. He then returns the box to you.
You receive Resealed Toadstool Box from Sporeweaver Underveil.
Sporeweaver Underveil: You return at a most fortuitous moment, young shaman. I have just finished my examination of the toadstool and I must say, the results are quite intriguing.

Sporeweaver Underveil: You also have my gratitude for your efforts in procuring these components. Drake scales and wax are notoriously resistant to fungus, which shall aid my endeavors to strengthen our strains.
Sporeweaver Underveil: Though I imagine you must be curious to hear the results?
Sporeweaver Underveil: The toadstool by itself is not so significant; rather, it is the odd hex that seems to be afflicting all of its contained moisture.
Sporeweaver Underveil: This hexed moisture makes its way into the numerous spores released by the toadstool, and once a great number of these spores are taken into the lungs... well...
Sporeweaver Underveil: The victim is afflicted with a terrible malady that assaults the mind directly, causing hallucinations, emotional strain, and potentially even madness.

Sporeweaver Underveil: I daresay that whoever conjured such a hex has a sinister imagination. Though, it would appear the moisture is the key to all this, as it is what drips with malice. A malice that feels all too familiar to me...
Sporeweaver Underveil: I hope this was as much help to you as your efforts were to the Circle of Spores. Thank you once more, friend.
Part 4 -
Return to Varilis Thornvine and hand him the resealed box.
You gain experience.
Faction: Preservers +
Varilis Thornvine: Your return was whispered to me, young Listener. As was the conversation you had with the Sporeweaver.

Varilis Thornvine: It seems that moisture is the key to what has been ailing the great bears, yes? If our clues are to be the fae and moisture, then there is only one possible direction to look toward next.
Varilis Thornvine: Though that direction must wait for now. I must confer with the spirits on this matter, but you have the thanks of the forest, along with my own, for all that you have uncovered.

Varilis Thornvine: Take this headdress so that you might be protected from any intrusions into your own mind. It may prove useful, should this path lead us toward those capable of causing madness and grief.
You receive Spirit-Blessed Headdress from Varilis Thornvine.

Varilis Thornvine: When you feel you are ready to confront this threat to the Weald, bring me your apprentice hoop while donning the spirit-blessed headdress. I would hear from them both to gauge your capabilities regarding our next task.
Hand Varilis your earring while wearing the new headpiece.
Varilis Thornvine carefully cradles the hoop next to his own ear, closing his eyes and nodding along wordlessly to silent whispers.
(At level 4)
Varilis Thornvine: It appears you have more to learn before I can entrust you with your next task, young Listender.
Varilis Thornvine: Return and present me your hoop once you have learned how to effectively dispel harmful magics, and the next task is yours.
You receive your items back from Varilis Thornvine.
(At level 8)
Varilis Thornvine carefully cradles the hoop next to his own ear, closing his eyes and nodding along wordlessly to silent whispers. He smiles and presents it back to you.
Varilis Thornvine: It appears the spirits vouch for your capabilities, young Listener. As such, I am confident I can entrust you with the next task.
You receive Apprentice Hoop of the Listener from Varilis Thornvine.
Varilis Thornvine: As you already know, spirits of the Weald are succumbing to a terrible malady of the mind.

Varilis Thornvine: From the myconid creatures of the Circle of Spores to the bestial spirits of the great wolf packs, it seems any who settle themselves close to the banks of the river are prone to bouts of inexplicable madness.
Varilis Thornvine: This, I believe, is being perpetrated by the naiads of the Whispering Pools.
Varilis Thornvine: The naiads have long since been bound to the Whispering Pools. They are forbidden from leaving, due to a pact with the Queen of the Winter Court herself.
Varilis Thornvine: Though being bound does not mean the naiads are without their own ambitions.
Varilis Thornvine: Many of them yearn to be free of the Whispering Pools, and this latest act of whimsy is likely an attempt to expand their means without breaking the terms of their pact.
Varilis Thornvine: If we are to do something to counteract the ploys of the naiads, we must first understand what sort of enchantments they are dispersing into the Weald's waters.

Varilis Thornvine: I advise you to seek out Laenyth Windharp of the Lambent Wanderers. She is their tale keeper, and the bards are known to study and even conduct performances that mimic the alluring call of a siren.

Varilis Thornvine: If any in Faelindral would know of water nymph enchantments, it would be them. Show her your hoop to present yourself as a Preserver, then glean what you can about the magics of the naiads. Return to me with anything you manage to uncover.
Off we go to the bard guild (Aka the Lambent Lantern)!
You will find our gal on the first floor in the bard side of the lantern. It's up the ramp across from the stage. Hand your hoop to Laenyth Windharp.
Laenyth Windharp regards the hoop with a smile before offering it back to you.
Laenyth Windharp: Ah, to what do I owe the pleasure of this visit, apprentice? I'm fond of Listeners joining me for a tale. You lot are remarkably attentive to our stories.
Laenyth Windharp: Is there anything in particular that you wish to hear about?
Laenyth Windharp: The naiads? I'm quite familiar with their tale, as young bards are often stricken by their songs... competitively or otherwise.

Laenyth Windharp: They're a beautiful people, if not prone to wickedness and uncaring whimsy. Their songs can flow as gently as a stream or crash with the cacophonous roar of a waterfall, as befits their mood.
Laenyth Windharp: Do you wish to hear what's known of their Mistress Naelira, or are you more interested in their siren's song?

Laenyth Windharp: The siren's call... it's a popular and powerful technique capable of fully capturing a person's attention. They're also prone to suggestion while captivated, turning a once alluring song into a dangerous one if used with ill intent.

Laenyth Windharp: Many of the faerie courts are impressive singers in their own right, though the naiads' sirens occupy a league of their own. Did you know a voice can carry over great distances when delivered across a span of calm water?
Laenyth Windharp: The sirens utilize their affinity with water to naturally enhance their own voices, so a mere conversation can cause one to become enraptured if they're not careful.

Laenyth Windharp: Some also believe the naiad sirens are capable of singing into the currents of flowing water, so their voices can reach those downstream. I personally don't believe such a thing is possible... unless you believe the old rumors.
Laenyth Windharp: The naiads have remarkable voices, though even with their affinity for water, they cannot sing with their full cadence while submerged in the very pools they call home.
Laenyth Windharp: A voice, no matter how strong, would be drowned out by the flow of a river as it crashes against the banks and weaves its way through rock and reed.

Laenyth Windharp: However, there were rumors of a technique one could use to protect a song on its journey through a perilous river. Something to enshroud it is a pocket of air, such as... a bubble or river foam.
Laenyth Windharp: I've made notes on such a theory before. Now where did I...
Laenyth Windharp searches through her belongings before a moment of recognition strikes her. She then withdraws a section of leafscroll.
Laenyth Windharp: Ah, here they are! These notes cover the methods one might use to enhance a siren's call. You're more than welcome to them, should the Perservers have use of my old theories.
You receive Laenyth's Theories from Laenyth Windharp.
Return to Varilis and hand him the theories.
Varilis Thornvine: I see that you do not return empty-handed, young Listener. Let us see what knowledge Laenyth has documented regarding the magic of naiads...
Varilis Thornvine carefully and slowly peruses Laenyth's notes. His elderly lips purse in interest at some points while frowning at others, accentuating his already weathered features.
Varilis Thornvine: Voices carried through bubbles or foam... quite curious, indeed. Could the naiads be sending their very voices through the currents of the river using this method?
Varilis Thornvine: You must investigate this for us, . Your talents should allow you the means to sense magical influences upon the world, if you have studied your scrolls.
Varilis Thornvine: I bid you venture out to the very end of the river, furthest from the Whispering Pools, to the crest of the mighty waterfall that spills out into the Twilight Sea.

Varilis Thornvine: Use your spell to sense magical flows and determine whether the naiads' enchantments have extended so far out from their domain. Should you discover enchanments at the falls, take a sample of the water using this flask and return it to me.
You receive an Empty Water Flask from Varilis Thornvine.

From the Noob Lift take a right. At the fork in the road take the right side. Run south west until you get to where the river falls off the edge of the map. That's the crest of the water fall (the wolf cave is on the cliffs across the river for reference). Stand on the bank just to the right of the rocks (north of them) with your feet in the water.
You must have either the Ancestor's Eye or Ancestral Wisdom buff.
The enchantment's effects are faint this far from the Whispering Pools, but they remain present within the flowing waters and long the banks.

You carefully scoop your flask through the water, collecting a sample of it and much of the foam. The miniscule bubbles produce a soft, haunting melody that attempts to invade your mind, but whispers from your headdress block out the instrusive sounds, allowing you to regain your composure.
Part 5 -
Return to Varilis Thornvine and hand him Filled Water Flask
Varilis Thronvine: A curious thing, this sample you have brought me. Even while contained, I can hear the intrusive melodies that are bound within.
Varilis Thronvine: This is a disturbing revelation. If the naiads have somehow found a way to carry their voices down the span of the entire river, it threatens the very balance of the Weald.
Varilis Thronvine: We must take action to purge this enchantment before more minds are drawn into madness.

Varilis Thronvine: Take this sigil. young Listener. You will need it to fashion a totem that can be used to cleanse the waters of the naiad's influence. It is but one component of this specific recipe.
You receive Sigil of Purging from Varilis Thornvine.
Varilis Thronvine: To fashion the totem, you will need to acquire some fine wood for the base. Four timber should be enough. If you have a talent for logging, you may find some in Keeper's Blight.
Varilis Thronvine: While in the Blight, you will also need the skins of four serpents that roam the fields. The serpent's flesh is well suited for warding away moisture.
Varilis Thronvine: Lastly, you will need something from the river water that is both born from it, but also immune to a siren's song. I believe Selstie Kelp will serve the purpose well.

Varilis Thronvine: Scour the river's floor here in Evershade for at least two strands of kelp, then fashion everything together along with the sigil of purging at one of the carpentry tables on Traders Terrace.
Varilis Thronvine: Worry not if you are unskilled with such labors, the totem need not be a masterpiece. Return to me with your crafted totem, and I shall guide you further.

Go collect 2 Selstie Kelp, 4 Fine Wood, and 4 Bight Serpent Skin. The wood is from Lumberjacking in Keepers Blight. This is also where you will find Bight Asp, which is soloable with your new level 8 spells. Alternatively you can buy it from the tanner in the town there, Tessa Kentwell, if other players have sold some to her for 6cp a piece at the time of this writing.
Combine the 10 items above along with your Sigil of Purging at a carpentry table to create Fashioned Totem of Purging. Then return to Varilis Thornvine and hand Fashioned Totem of Purging to him.
You gain experience.
Faction: Preservers +

Varilis Thornvine looks over your work with a pleased, serene smile. He raises the totem into the air and beseeches the spirits of the forest to empower your creation. This time, you begin to hear the murmurings of a response through the boughs of the trees, and your totem takes on weathered appearance.
Varilis Thornvine offers the empowered totem to you.
Varilis Thronvine: Take this totem to the top of the falls, which cascade over the Whispering Pools the water nymphs call their home.
Varilis Thronvine: Invoke the totem's powers to purge the waters of the enchantment. But be warned, the naiads will not appreciate us denying them their amusement.
Varilis Thronvine: If you are challenged, then do what you must to restore balance to the Weald. Should your totem lose its potency, return it to me and I will do my best to empower it once more.
Varilis Thronvine: Spirits watch over you, young Listener.
You receive Empowered Totem of Purging from Varilis Thornvine.
Part 6 -
(The enemies for this part of the quest con red and yellow at level 8)

Head over to the Kennel Lift and ride it down. Walk east through the ruins and across two bridges, then make an immediate left to the waterfall. Stand at the edge of it and right-click your Empowered Totem of Purging to start the event.
Delugia Coldsong emerges from the waterfall as if stepping through a doorway.
Delugia Coldsong: You will not defile our waters with your horrid magics, mortal! Our voices shall spread across all rivers, in the name of Mistress Naelira!!
Delugia Coldsong (click for fight details) will spawn and immediately start attacking you. She was stuck in the wall when I fought her and I had to move away to get her to out.
You gain experience.
Faction: Circle of Spores +
Faction: Fossergrim -
Faction: Naelira's Court -
Delugia Coldsong: H-how could you... a mere mortal...
Delugia Coldsong falls to the ground, her body slowly dissipating back into the waters.
Once you defeat her, loot the Coldstone Shard and return it to Varilis Thornvine.
Varilis Thornvine shivers visibly as you offer him the coldstone, though he refuses to accept it alone.
Varilis Thornvine: It seems that you have had to confront a particularly vile spirit, young Listener. Your efforts are already being felt throughout the Weald.
Varilis Thornvine: Return to me the expended totem, the coldstone, and your apprentice hoop. I would hear all three of their tales of your triumph this day.
You receive you items back from Varilis Thornvine.
Hand Varilis all 3 items.
You gain experience.
Faction: Preservers +
Faction: Naelira's Court -

Varilis Thornvine carefully clutches the coldstone with one hand, while your hoop remains in the other. He brings both items up to either elongated ear and soon begins nodding along with their supposed tales, which you feel you may begin to perceive.
Varilis Thornvine: It appears that this Delugia Coldsong was driven by a desire to appease her Mistress Naelira. So much so, that she would risk breaking the pact they made with the fae courts.

Varilis Thornvine: It did not matter which minds she was forced to break, so long as her voice could reach out to someone capable of freeing them from their bond. A tragic tale, if also misguided and malevolent.

Varilis Thornvine: Already the spirits of the river and those surrounding it sigh out in relief at her passing. You have restored balance to the Weals, and for that I recognize you as an accomplished Listener, Chamois.
Varilis Thornvine offers you a simple leaf pulled from his silvered hair.
Varilis Thornvine: Bring this to the Elder Whisperer, Eraeldor Lowmist. He shall already know its meaning.
You receive Weathered Leaf Token from Varilis Thornvine.
Turn around and go in the building. Give your Weathered Leaf Token to Eraeldor Lowmist.
You gain experience.
Faction: Preservers +
Eraeldor Lowmist: The promising apprentice makes their appearance at last. It was heard, and it is now known.
Eraeldor Lowmist: We have you to thank for calming the spirits of the waters and all those who are fed by its life.
Eraeldor Lowmist: Only one who truly listens could have heard the cries and comforted the daunted.
Eraeldor Lowmist: You are a true preserver of the balance, deserving to bear the symbol of such.
Eraeldor Lowmist: My gift to you, Listener Chamois.
Eraeldor Lowmist produces a folded bundle of fine cloth and leaf, offering it to you with a serene smile.
You receive Robes of the Listener from Eraeldor Lowmist.
You receive Hoop of the Listener from Eraeldor Lowmist.
Part 1 - First steps of being a Shaman
Read Hastily Scrawled Note you start with as a new Shaman Character:

On a sheet of parchment, you hastily wrote down the fading vestiges of a disturbing dream, as follows:

I found myself standing in a vast, open field, the sky as golden as the endless wheat around me. The setting sun gave way to an unblinking eye, which blinded me, yet allowed me to see more than I could before. What could it all mean?

Make haste to the Seekers of the Lost Eye, there, they will help you make sense of this unusual dream.

The Seekers are located within Saltbreeze Park, central to the city and right below the Great Guild Hall.

If you're feeling lost out there, remember this:
our sun, Eth, rises in the East and sets to the West, and the Twilight Bay is always to the South. Need help beyond that? Just ask a guard. They'll often be able to assist with directions.
Give 'Hastily Scrawled Note' to Errol Shrewtender.
Errol Shrewtender pauses, taking the note into his hands.
" A strange dream you've had and you've been sent here? Hmmm."
Errol Shrewtender studies the note carefully, before looking up to you.
"Yes, this is quite an unusual dream. However, it is not something to be afraid of."
"You have a gift, ."

"You possess the ability to peer into the looming darkness, a power not known by many, and fewer still learn to harness it. Do you wish to harness your power, ? It is a grueling path, but one which will bring you insight into the true nature of Eth-ur."
Errol Shrewtender produces a small pouch and tunic, before handing them to you.

"It's not much, but here is your guild tunic, marking you as an Initiate in the Seekers of the Lost Eye. And here is a spirit pouch. I was given one as an initiate myself, many years ago. Bring it to Masoumeh, and she will give you your first task."
You receive Uncured Spirit Pouch from Errol Shrewtender.
You receive Seekers of the Lost Eye Tunic from Errol Shrewtender.
Errol Shrewtender smiles, before turning away, ignoring you.
Stop here to keep the Pouch as a free four slot bag. Once you do the next step it becomes unusable as a bag.
Give the Uncured Spirt Pouch to Masoumeh Akhtar.
Masoumeh Akhtar looks down at the pouch in your hands, before gasping.
"Oh! You must be , the one with the strange dreams. Yes, welcome to our order!"
Masoumeh Akhtar gives you a warm smile, though something is clearly on the young woman's mind.
"It is custom for all shamans inducted into the order to begin preparations for their Becoming Ritual."
"That pouch of yours contains some very special magic, and with the proper reagents, you can begin to prepare for your ritual."

"You will need to collect some moondew moss, a fire beetle gland, and two chips of bone from an animated undead. Place them inside your pouch and crush them together to combine them, and then bring it back to me."
"If you have any trouble finding any of the items, don't hesitate to ask. Good luck, ."
Masoumeh Akhtar smiles at you, bidding farewell.
Collect 2 Bone Chips from skeletons, 1 Fire Beetle Gland from fire beetles, and 1 Moondew Moss.
The Moondew Moss is found at a well outside the West gate of Night Harbor (during the night cycle).
Finding the Well:
Leave Night Harbor from the West Gate.
Continue walking forward and slightly to the left.
Once you locate the small ruins with the Shifty Gnome, continue further West (towards the green tower in the distance.)
The well is behind a ruined wall nearby to the Shifty Gnome.
Once near the well, type
the well will respond: "You see an old well. Its crumbling exterior betrays its age, and it appears to be as old as the rest of the ruins nearby."
Type
and you will receive Moondew Moss.
Single stack those four items into the Uncured Spirit Pouch, it will turn into Shaman's Fiery Base.
Turn into Masoumeh Akhtar.
"Oh! Wonderful, it looks like you've successfully made the base for your ritual."
Masoumeh Akhtar smiles at you fondly.
"I remember when I was preparing for my ritual... anyhow, there's a little something else that needs to be done before the base is ready."

Masoumeh Akhtar takes out a small bottle, uncorking it and letting out a few drops of a strange, crimson liquid. Upon contact with the acidic base, it begins to foam, and she hands your pouch back to you. You notice the leather is somehow sturdier because of the trial it has just endured.
You receive Cured Spirit Pouch from Masoumeh Akhtar.
"Take this pouch over to my father, Eskander. He will tell you what to do next. Good luck, initiate. May the spirits bless you.
Masoumeh Akhtar bows towards you respectfully.
Part 2 - Craft the Potion
Requires Level 4
Go two levels upstairs and find Eskander Akhtar.
At level 4 you can hand him the Cured Spirit Pouch and continue the quest.
Eskander Ahktar: ...Ah, a new initiate, I see. You need a task from me?
Eskander Akhtar frowns, before suddenly letting out an exasperated sigh.
Eskander Akhtar: Very well. Harvallen Root, gather one and bring it back to me.
Eskander Akhtar waves his hand dismissively turning his gaze back to the city.

Harvallen Root drops off An ashira shaman in Shaded Dunes. They do not drop in Sungreet Strand, but can also be obtained from A shady peddler in the Night Market at night or by saying "root" to Herbmonger Nabiah and completing her task.
Hand him the Harvallen Root and he responds (this step may not be necessary):
Eskander Akhtar: You have the root? Good, now hand me your pouch as well.
You receive your items back from Eskander Akhtar.
Hand the Harvallen Root and Cured Spirit Pouch to him together and you receive Purified Entheogenic Powder and he responds:
Eskander Ahktar: Hm, you've done well initiate. It has been ground to a powder and purified. You are now almost ready for your Becoming Ritual. There are a few more components needed.
Eskander Akhtar: I'll keep your pouch for now and prepare it for the Becoming Ritual.
Eskander Akhtar: The ritual is a harrowing experience, and I am ill to suggest it to an unseasoned shaman such as yourself.
Eskander Akhtar: If you believe yourself ready, bring your powder back to me and we'll discuss next steps.
Requires Level 8
At level 8 hand him the Purified Entheogenic Powder and he responds;
Eskander Akhtar: Ah yes. The final step of your becoming ritual.
Eskander Akhtar crosses his arms.
Eskander Akhtar: I suppose you're ready. Take your powder to Errol, he will tell you what to do next.
Eskander Akhtar: What are you standing around for? Begone already!
Hand the Purified Entheogenic Powder to Errol Shrewtender and he responds:
Errol Shrewtender Takes your powder from you, holding it in his hands gingerly. He unfolds the package, taking a sniff. After a moment, he nods.
Errol Shrewtender: This is good. Very good, I expect nothing less from Eskander's teachings.
Errol Shrewtender takes a breath, giving you a single nod.
Errol Shrewtender: Very well.
Errol Shrewtender: For your final task, you must prepare the last of the materials needed for your Becoming Ritual.
Errol Shrewtender closes his eyes, taking another deep breath.

Errol Shrewtender: Your Becoming Ritual signifies the final rite of passage, and completes the last step of your initiation. However, the materials for the ritual are difficult to come by, and you will face many dangers.
Errol Shrewtender: We need you to acquire a Duskglow pod, grave dust, and a deepgloom mushroom." Errol Shrewtender says, "Masoumeh can help you find those, ask her for the details.
Errol Shrewtender fishes around in his pocket.
You receive Order for Selenite from Errol Shrewtender.
Errol Shrewtender: Take this order to her, we need this fulfilled for the last material, the selenite crystal powder.
Errol Shrewtender: Once you have acquired all the ingredients, return them all to me and I will mix them for you.
Errol Shrewtender: Good luck!
You receive your items back from Eskander Akhtar.
Hand the Order of Selenite to Masoumeh Akhtar (next to Errol Shrewtender) and she responds:
Masoumeh Akhtar takes the note from you.
Masoumeh Akhtar: Ah! Yes, please go speak with Foreman Stonehammer at the old Quarry in Sungreet Strand. He can provide you with the selenite powder.
Masoumeh Akhtar purses her lips.
Masoumeh Akhtar: He's kind of an ass, though, so if he gives you a hard time...
Masoumeh Akhtar sighs.
Masoumeh Akhtar: Just do what he asks.
You receive your items back from Eskander Akhtar.
Asking Masoumeh Akhtar about the ingredients Errol Shrewtender mentioned gives clues to their whereabouts.

Masoumeh Akhtar: Duskglow pods are aquatic plants that thrive in heat, they can be found in the Shaded Dunes, but only at night. You should look for them where there's an oasis with glowing water and nobody around to disturb them.
Masoumeh Akhtar: Grave Dust... you can find something like that deep in the Tomb of the Last Wyrmsbane.
Masoumeh Akhtar looks over to you.
Masoumeh Akhtar: Please be careful. It is a dangerous place. I would look for the dust in a room where revered skeletons are interred.
Masoumeh Akhtar: Good luck!
Masoumeh Akhtar: The Ashira are known for harvesting the deepgloom mushroom deep in Tel Ekir, but I can't imagine them wanting to trade it to you...
Masoumeh Akhtar: They enjoy a lot of humidity, maybe they'd sprout next to a waterfall?
Details:
Duskglow Pod (say
at the oasis north of the Caves of Irem (There WAS NOT a sound of a bard song or chimes)) Can't be collected before lvl 8
Deepgloom Mushroom (say
in the cave behind the waterfall (There is a sound of a bard song or chimes))
Grave Dust (say
in one of the side cutouts leading up to the bone construct (There is a sound of a bard song or chimes))
Foreman Stonehammer
Location Details:
In Sungreet Strand, at the Quarry, on a platform in the North west corner, with Sister Elara.
Foreman Stonehammer: Aye, I see ya there traveler. What buisness do ya have at the quarry? Make it quick, I don't have all day.
Pass him the :Order for Selenite
Foreman Stonehammer: I'd be glad t' give ya yer powder... but first ya gotta do somethin' for me.
Foreman Stonehammer: One of those damn goblin sneaks made off with my favorite canteen! If ya get it back for me, I'll give ya yer powder.
Foreman Stonehammer: Oh, don't look at me like that! Yer lucky I'm even handin' it over!
Battered Canteen Can be found as a drop from a goblin sneak nearby (level 8-10)
Handing in just the Battered Canteen:
Foreman Stonehammer snatches the canteen from your hands.
Foreman Stonehammer: Wait a sec! Didn't you have an order to give me?
Handing in the Battered Canteen and the Order for Selenite:
Foreman Stonehammer snatches the canteen from your hands while the order falls to the ground.
Foreman Stonehammer: Hot damn! You just saved me from gettin' an earful from the missus!

Foreman Stonehammer fishes through his pockets for a moment, discarding a wad of lint, an unidentifiable hairball, and a few pieces of paper. Finally, he retreives a small cloth bag and wipes away a greasy substance from it onto his sleeve.
Foreman Stonehammer: Here ya go! No takebacks!
Foreman Stonehammer grins broadly.
You gain experience.
You receive Powdered Selenite from Foreman Stonehammer
Once you've acquired all the ingredients hand them back to Errol Shrewtender and he responds:
Errol Shrewtender: This is very good progress.
Errol Shrewtender combines the material in a pouch, creating a slurry of sorts.
Errol Shrewtender: Here, take the slurry I just made out of the ingredients you gave me and mix it inside your pouch with the purified powder, this'll be the base of your elixir.
Errol Shrewtender shakes his head, his expression sullen.
Errol Shrewtender: Unfortunately, there isn't anything we can do beyond this for now.

Errol Shrewtender: Not until we get our Ancient Urn back that is. It's been a part of the guild since before it's founding, you see, and it's necessary for the final preparation step of your Becoming Ritual.
Errol Shrewtender: Once you feel ready, show me or Masoumeh your elixir and we will share more details with you.
You gain experience.
You receive Shimmering Slurry and Blessed Spirit Pouch.
Combine: Shimmering Slurry and Purified Entheogenic Powder inside the Blessed Spirit Pouch to create Muddy Elixir of Becoming
Part 3 - Retrieve the Urn
Hand Muddy Elixir of Becoming to Errol Shrewtender

Errol Shrewtender: To move forward with the Becoming Ritual, we must find the urn. Our members have been searching desperately for it, investigating thieves and the like, but I have a feeling you might have better luck.
Errol Shrewtender: Please speak to Masoumeh and ask her about the urn, she should have further details.
Hand Muddy Elixir of Becoming to Masoumeh Akhtar
Masoumeh Akhtar: Oh, yes, you have the elixir but our ancient urn is gone...
Masoumeh Akhtar presses her fingers together, fidgeting slightly.

Masoumeh Akhtar: It was unfortunately stolen a few nights ago. Old Mother Roshan overheard the name of one of the thieves - a graverobber by the name of 'Ariblast' - but that is all we have to go on. Perhaps if you poked around in the yards surrounding the city, you might be able to find out more.
Masoumeh Akhtar frowns.
Masoumeh Akhtar: I wish I had more to go on... Good luck.
Spoiler Details:
Ariblast the Wicked in Tomb of the Last Wyrmsbane drops the Ancient Painted Urn
Handing Errol Shrewtender just the Ancient Painted Urn.
Errol Shrewtender holds the urn joyfully, as a smile emerges on his lips.
Errol Shrewtender: You got it back! We owe you a great debt!
Errol Shrewtender bows to you.
Errol Shrewtender: I require the elixir as well. Please hand me both items and I will proceed.
Handing Errol Shrewtender the Ancient Painted Urn and the Muddy Elixir of Becoming.
Errol Shrewtender holds the urn joyfully, as a smile emerges on his lips.
Errol Shrewtender: Most excellent indeed! Now we can proceed with the ritual.
Errol Shrewtender carefully places the urn on the ground and pours the elixir into it. He begins to mutter what sounds like a hymn, and the faintest tingle runs up your spine.
Errol Shrewtender hands the elixir back to you with a beaming smile.
Errol Shrewtender: Now you're almost ready to walk your waking dream.
Errol Shrewtender: The final step involves your elixir and your pouch. Hand them to me, and I will finalize the ritual preparations!
You receive Bubbling Elixir of Becoming from Errol Shrewtender.
Handing Errol Shrewtender the Blessed Spirit Pouch and the Bubbling Elixir of Becoming.
Errol Shrewtender pours a mysterious liquid onto the spirit pouch, which flows down it and drips into the eilxir.
Errol Shrewtender: Now your pouch is cleansed and your elixir is purified!
Errol Shrewtender smiles at you warmly.
Errol Shrewtender: Walk your waking dream by drinking the elixir, then the Becoming Ritual will be complete! Don't be scared now... stand proud and tall!
You receive Awakened Spirit Pouch from Errol Shrewtender.
You receive Purified Elixir of Becoming from Errol Shrewtender.
You gain experience.
Your faction standing wiht the Seekers of the Lost Eye got better.
Upon consuming the Purified Elixir of Becoming

A burning surge floods your chest. Fear, fire, and the weight of past failures crash over you. It feels as though you are teetering on the edge of an abyss, consumed by everything you have tried to forget.
A voice stirs from within, urging you not to be afraid. Pain and failure are your teachers. You push forward, and the haze lifts. Your feet move again, and the salty sea breeze fills your nostrils.
Entering Shaded Dunes.
Loading, please wait...
You have entered Shaded Dunes.
Part 1 - First steps as a Rot of Gorm Shaman
Read Moldy Note you start with as a new Shaman Character:

It is time for you to accept the gifts of the 
Rotfather.

Come to the Rotten Hollow to learn the ways of 
plague and pestilence. Seek the Rot of Gorm in the 
cavern west of the palace.

                                       Picci M.
Give 'Moldy Note' to Picci Manifold.
You gain experience!
Your faction standing with Rot of Gorm got better.
The Rotfather beckons and here you are. His blessing, your gift, is a kindness. What life is worth living without decay and death? You and I are bound to this fate. Bear this drape in his honor.
You recieve Shredded Cloak from Picci Manifold.
Part 2 - Uncovering the blight
Hail, Picci Manifold
Picci Manifold: There are a great many problems to solve before the Rotfather takes us. Will you aid me with my research?

Picci Manifold: The flora and fauna of the Deep are connected in ways that cannot be easily perceived. The myconids are of great interest to me, you see. They may hold the key to spreading the Rotfather's joy to the farthest reaches of Eth-ur, even into lowest abyss.
Picci Manifold: I need you to conduct an experiment.
Picci Manifold: Take this balm and look for the little myconids withing this cavern. The sporlings. Use it on the sickly ones. It is kind of a medicine.
Picci Manifold: Return to me with four spore samples from these myconids. If you run out, return the empty jar to me and I will replenish it.
You receive Putrid Fungal Balm from Picci Manifold.
Use the Putrid Fungal Balm (4/4) on a sickly undercap.
They will attack you.
Loot Blightspores.
Return 4 Blightspores to Picci Manifold

Picci Manifold: How curious. The spores are more resilient than I expected. A blight is spreading among the myconids, but it is not our doing. We will need to study this further if we are to shape the undercaps to our purpose. False plagues are not to be tolerated.
Picci Manifold frowns.
You receive Petrified Undercap Stem from Picci Manifold.
Part 3 - Gather the Specimens
Requires Level 5
--Step 1--
Picci Manifold: Your spear is unfinished, fledgling. Will you help me continue my research?
Picci Manifold: The myconids have a unique connection with the natural flora of the Deep. Like their fungal cousins, they are tethered together. They feel, think, act in unison.

Picci Manifold: The blightspores we have collected only tell us that something is changing, but we need to look deeper. Fill this sack with six mycelium roots from mature undercap specimens. Do this, and I will grant you the mycelium bonding threads you need to fashion your plaguespear.
You receive Mycelium Sack from Picci Manifold.
Gather Undercap Mycelium Root from undercap mushrooms and combine them in the Mycelium Sack.
Return to Picci Manifold.
Picci Manifold: Have you found the mycelium roots I asked for, shaman?
Give the Full Mycelium Sack to Picci Manifold.
You gain experience!
Your faction with Rot of Gorm got better
Picci Manifold: Magnificent. I can learn much from these. Undercap mycelia have special bonding properties. Take this refined mycelial thread. You will need it to assemble your spear.
You receive Mycelial Bonding Thread from Picci Manifold
Picci Manifold: Wrap the mycelial threads around your shaman's staff. They should form a strong, living bond.
Right click the thread, it will transform your Petrified Undercap Stem into a Mycelial Staff.
--Step 2--
Picci Manifold: Your spear remains unfinished, (your name). Help me with one for task and I will provide the spearhead you need.

Picci Manifold: For all the myconids have in common with ordinary fungi, they are unique. They are individual. I need the preserved brain of an infected myconid. No lesser specimens will suffice. You must find a myconid whose entire being has been consumed by this blight.
Picci Manifold: Place the brain in this jar. It must be submerged in embalming fluid.
You receive Specimen Jar from Picci Manifold.
Take a hunting party out of the North Gate and travel East and find the tunnel that leads to a blight consumed mushroom patch.
Collect the Blightspore Brain from a mindless blightspore, semi-rare spawn. This item is NO RENT.
Purchase Embalming Fluid from Telar Nur'gta in the Underdocks.
Combine the Blightspore Brain and the Embalming Fluid in the Specimen Jar to create the Preserved Specimen.
Return the Preserved Specimen to Picci Manifold.
You gain experience!
Your faction standing with Rot of Gorm got better.
Picci Manifold: Splendid, most splendid. What a peculiar sample it is! I will begin my experiments right away.
Picci Manifold: Oh, yes. I almost forgot. You'll be needing this to assemble your spear. This spearhead was carved from the remains of a massive beetle. Go now, (your name). Spread his gifts!
You receive Jagged Chitin Spearhead from Picci Manifold.
Right-click the Jagged Chitin Spearhead to attach the spearhead.
You Receive Mycelial Spear.
Locate Polietta Two-tone, who spawns in Evershade Weald during the day up on the hill near the Fae Guardians.
Polietta Two-tone: Warm days to you, large-large one! What brings you-you to the toadstool of Polietta? Are you seeking some pixie-pixie glitter, yes-yes?
Polietta Two-tone: Yes-yes! Polietta does have-have much glitter to spare, if one is willing-willing to perform for her a simple favor-favor!
Polietta Two-tone: The large-large one has seen the many-many-eyed ones skittering up and down the tree-trees of late, yes-yes?
Polietta Two-tone: Widows I hear-hear them being called, yet Polietta has never-never seen a single husband. The eyes, though! Polietta has-has seen the eyes.
Polietta Two-tone: Eight eyes is simply too-too many, I say-say! Proper tings have two-two eyes, one-by-one and not four-by-four!
Polietta Two-tone: You'll bring-bring back to Polietta six of these eye-eyes, so that they're properly down to two-two like things should be-be!
Polietta Two-tone: Six eyes for glitter-glitter is a fair and good trade-trade. No more, no less-less. No hatchling eyes, either! The bigger-bigger ones are best.
Hunt a black widow and an elder widow until you have collected 6 x Widow Eye.
Hand 6 x Widow Eye to Polietta Two-tone.
You gain experience.
Faction: Court of Summer +
Faction: Court of Winter -
Polietta Two-tone: Oh, how lovely-lovely! Eight eyes down to two-two, just how things should be-be.
Polietta Two-tone: Many thanks-thanks for your favor, large-large one. Here's some of Polietta's famed glitter-glitter!
You receive Pixie Glitter from Polietta Two-tone.
Pixie Glitter is used for Bard Starter Quest (Faelindral).
A priest of the Matswar is located at the Temple of the Matswar, which is in The Necropolis of Night Harbor.

parts.say: Hail, a priest of the Matswar.

parts.text: a priest of the Matswar: Hail, friend. I am but a humble priest of the Matswar, offering service in his name.
a priest of the Matswar: With the Matswar's blessing, I am able to retrieve long-lost corporeal forms from his realm.
a priest of the Matswar: Shall I call forth your expired corpse, or do you require some other assistance?

parts.say: What other assistance can you provide?

parts.text: a priest of the Matswar: I am able to bind your soul to this location and honor the exchange of icons from other temples.
a priest of the Matswar: Many priests will trade icons of their gods in exchange for offerings. These icons may be exchanged for various services.
a priest of the Matswar: For example, if you were to take an icon of the Matswar to the Temple of Relle, the priest there would bind your soul to their temple in exchange.
a priest of the Matswar: Once bound to a location, the Matswar will safely guide your soul there should it depart from your body.
a priest of the Matswar: If you would like me to bind your soul, I must first ask that you bring me an offering. A stack of bone chips will suffice.
a priest of the Matswar: In return, I will exchange the offering for an icon of the Matswar. The icon can be exchanged at any temple to bind your soul there.
Collect 20 bone chips from rotting skeletons found throughout Night Harbor, then return to a priest of the Matswar and hand them in.
a priest of the Matswar: Your gift honors our temple and pleases the Matswar. Take this icon in exchange for your service.
You receive Icon of the Matswar from a priest of the Matswar.
This quest is repeatable.
Intro
Speak to a master blacksmith in Night Harbor, who only appears at night (despawns at 6 AM in-game time).
a master blacksmith: Good evening to you, . I can tell by those shoulders that you've swung y our fair share of smithing hammers. Perhaps you'd like to help me with an experiment?
a master blacksmith: During the day, I've been studying the origins of magically reinforced metals, meeting with the local enchanters, and perusing the library in Sageside.
a master blacksmith: Well, perusing as much as I'm allowed to, seeing as I'm not enrolled there.
a master blacksmith: Based on what I've managed to learn, it seems that most enchantments can be strengthened if the caster imbues a portion of their own essence into the metal itself.
a master blacksmith: That got me thinking of those recently discovered ruins...
a master blacksmith: Wormsfood? Wurmsbite? Something like that. Either way, I've heard there are some powerful spirits within those ruins!
a master blacksmith: Seeing as they must have been there for hundreds of years, I often wonder what I could do with the spiritual essence of such timeless foes.
a master blacksmith: If you find yourself within that tomb of... Wordsthane, I'd be grateful if you'd let me borrow a small portion of any spiritual essence you come across.
Go to the Tomb of the Last Wyrmsbane and retrieve Spectral Essence
Part 1: Spectral Bar
Hand in the Spectral Essence to a master blacksmith.
a master blacksmith: You actually found some! You've my gratitude, . Now, let's see what we're able to accomplish with this lingering soul...
a master blacksmith: Oh, now that is a surprise! The copper has hardened considerably. This essence is truly potent, . I feel like you could make some powerful equipment using this method.
a master blacksmith: Here, take the remaining essence. Why don't you give it a try yourself?
a master blacksmith: See if you can fashion a bar using the essence, some enchanted copper, and flux. Show me the results of your handicraft.
Go to a smelter, and use one Enchanted Copper Bars, one Spectral Essence, and one Flux to craft the Spectral Bars.
Hand in the Spectral Bar
a master blacksmith: I'd call that a resounding success, wouldn't you, ?
a master blacksmith: Something like this is quite special, and I'd be remiss to let you fashion something out of it using crude leathers or cheap padding.
a master blacksmith: You should speak to some of the other master artisans in the city and see if they have any ideas for high-grade components that would complement this new alloy.
a master blacksmith: You'd do well to inquire about particularly sturdy leather for the straps, and some high-quality cloth for any interior padding.

a master blacksmith: Once you've found suitable components, see about fashioning a breastplate from this special alloy. Only the most protective of pieces should be used for something so rare, don't you agree?
a master blacksmith: Take care now, , and may Sorophal's spark illuminate your craft.
Part 2: Sturdy Leather Straps
Speak to Leatherworking Trainer.
m looking for sturdy leather."
Leatherworking Trainer: You're looking for particularly sturdy leather? Hmm... Well, of all Szuur's beasts, I'd say the crocodiles have the sturdiest hides in the area.
Leatherworking Trainer: Though, there's one especially nasty brute with a hide ten times as thick as the others!

Leatherworking Trainer: Ol' Chompers, they call it. Last I heard, it wanders the beaches of the Shaded Dunes, taking a bite out of anything it sees. Though, I'd hate to work a hide like that without the proper treatment.
Leatherworking Trainer: That's a question for the tanner. Chompers' hide is sure to make some quality leather, but I'd show it to them first before you try and trim it down to size.
Leatherworking Trainer: ...That is, assuming you actually manage to bring down the beast!
Go hunt Chompers in Shaded Dunes. Loot Chomper's Hide.
Hand in Chomper's Hide to Tanning Trainer.
Tanning Trainer: Chompers' hide! You actually managed to bring it down? I'm impressed, !
Tanning Trainer: Look at this hue! The thickness of the scales is unlike anything I've seen. You would need a very potent solution in order to treat a hide like this properly.
Tanning Trainer: Hmm, something of this size and quality would need to use alum. It's derived from alunite ore, so you would need to find an alchemist capable of breaking it down for you.
Tanning Trainer: Or you could always do so yourself, if you've the skill. Some alum combined with resin would yield a powerful enough solution to treat something this exquisite.
In a mortar and pestle, combine two Alunite Ore to make Alum.
In a cauldron, combine 5 Alum and 5 Resin to make Alum Solution (Alchemy, Trivial: 25)
Combine Chomper's Hide and Alum Solution in a tanner to create Hardened Crocodile Leather (Tanning, Trivial: < 55)
Hand Hardened Crocodile Leather to Tanning Trainer
Tanning Trainer: By the grace of Sorophal, what an impressive piece of leather you've managed to get hold of!
Tanning Trainer: A skilled leatherworker could use this to create components of very high quality. They'd be highly sought after by the smiths in the market, that's for certain!
Put the Hardened Crocodile Leather in a Leatherworking Kit crafting 3 Hardened Crocodile Leather Straps(Leatherworking, Trivial: < 80)
Part 3: High Quality Padding
Go speak to Master Tailor Sansha near the North Gate.
Master Tailor Sansha: Greetings, friend. Have you come to practice your weaves?
Master Tailor Sansha: A coarse plant-based thread would clash terribly with this fine silk, so it would be ideal to find a material of similar origin for the stitching.

Master Tailor Sansha: I have heard that the farmers in the Strand use lesser spider silks for many of their fabrics. Perhaps a suitable thread could be made from common silks found in that area. You will have to determine that for yourself, however.
Master Tailor Sansha: At the very least, I would be sure to have confidence in your skills before attempting such a project. Butchering such fine fabric would be simply heartbreaking, after all!

parts.say: I am looking for high quality cloth.

parts.text: Master Tailor Sansha: I have received a number of high-quality silks from adventurers in the past. If I recall, they said that they found them in a Tel Saman crypt, out in the Shaded Dunes.
Master Tailor Sansha: What they brought me was clearly from the smaller arachnids, but I cannot help but wonder what the matriarch of such a brood is capable of weaving.
Master Tailor Sansha: Typically, the largest of the spiders produce the finest and sturdiest threads. I would love to see an example one day.
Go to Infested Crypt in Shaded Dunes and kill a crypt broodmother to loot Dreadweave Silk.
Hand in Dreadweave Silk to Master Tailor Sansha.
Master Tailor Sansha: Oh, what a wonderfully robust weave! One could certainly use such silk to create a most comfortable material, resistant to wear and stains.
Master Tailor Sansha: To speak nothing of its breathability and moisture-wicking properties! These are highly sought-after traits for clothing hear in Szuur.
Master Tailor Sansha: Even the blacksmiths would adore such silk for padding their heavy armor. Though, it may require something different to hold a proper weave.
(Part 3 to be continued)
