Part 1 - Req. Lvl 1
Read Torn Note you start with as a new Spellblade character:

Seek out Jaffar Jhaym in the Spellbinders Spire. It is located in Night Harbor's northeastern district of Sageside. You can often find him in the Spire's observatory.

You will need to use the translocation devices below the wizards' tower to reach the academy grounds. Don't be alarmed.

Your interest in advancement as a Spellblade is well served by Master Jhaym's tutelage. He is both quite accomplished and well regarded within Night Harbor.

Good luck!
Give Torn Note to Jaffar Jhaym.
You gain experience.
Jaffar Jhaym examines your note and then smiles broadly at you.
Jaffar Jhaym: Very well met! Welcome to the Spellbinders Spire!
Jaffar Jhaym: While I will not be training you myself, I'm always excited to meet one of our new Spellblades!

Jaffar Jhaym: I am sure we will get better acquainted in the days to come, but for now, you will be under the tutelage of Master Njau Hansou. You likely passed him in the training yard on your way up.
Jaffar Jhaym: Take your note to Njau, he will know what to do from there.
You receive Torn Note from Jaffar Jhaym.
Jaffar Jhaym bows slightly with a smile.
Give Torn Note to Njau Hansou.
Njau Hansou nods at you in a welcoming manner.
Njau Hansou: I take it you've spoken to Jaffar already... wonderful! Let us start then.
Njau Hansou: We will test your proficiency with the most basic weapon infusion... the arcane infusion. This task will serve several purposes, though.

Njau Hansou: As you likely know, we at the Spire investigate the misuse of magic in Night Harbor... but there is also a form of Corruption at play in this entire region of Azuur. We wish to learn more.

Njau Hansou: You are to take this bag, fill it with the remains of the undead you find in the desert and then seal it. Should you correctly infuse your weapon, the remains you find shall bear the charred makings of a successful strike.
You receive Njau's Bone Bag from Njau Hansou.
Njau Hansou sends you off with a sharp nod.
Kill skeletons outside the gates of Night Harbor (or in the Concourse of Souls) for Scorched Skeletal Remains.
Option: Since you cannot advance to next step until you are much higher level, you could skip the combine and keep the handy 6-slot bag until you are ready to continue.
Combine 6 Scorched Skeletal Remains within the Njau's Bone Bag to acquire the Bag of Scorched Bones
Give the Bag of Scorched Bones to Njau Hansou
You gain experience.
Njau Hansou nods in an appreciative manner, while through the bag.
Njau Hansou: This is excellent work. I can tell your proficiency with a blade leaves nothing to be desired. You are a welcome addition to our ranks.
Njau Hansou: Please deliver the bag to Buckmarr in the Concourse of Souls. You will find it in the necropolis to the west of here. It is rather hard to miss its ominous green glow...
You receive Bag of Scorched Bones from Njau Hansou.
Njau Hansou smiles.
Njau Hansou: Buckmarr can be somewhat irritating, but I trust him. So, please bring me any updates he may have for us.
Give the Bag of Scorched Bones to Buckmarr Gorstagg
You gain experience.
Buckmarr Gorstagg looks through the bag, then at you.

Buckmarr Gorstagg: Well, these are interesting scorch marks. I suppose that's what you people are in the habit of doing. However, I find it interesting that both of our guilds are in the business of keeping magical things in check for the city, yet take such wildly different approaches.
Buckmarr Gorstagg thinks for a moment.

Buckmarr Gorstagg: If the council put me in charge of running things, I'd likely have a much more efficient solution for dealing with the use of magic, etcetera, etcetera. But... I'm too busy for that anyway.
Buckmarr Gorstagg: Speaking of which, please take this research back to Njau. He's bound to be impressed by my conclusions. And don't let that nosy librarian see it. He's a pest.
You receive Buckmarr's Research from Buckmarr Gorstagg.
Give Buckmarr's Research to Njau Hansou
You gain experience.
Njau Hansou unfurls the scroll and quick reads over it, pausing a moment to quickly glance around.
Njau Hansou: Thank you for bringing me this.
Njau Hansou: Your next tasks will be in support of Petra's Inquisitors. They have been assigned to investigate a group of smuggler's at a camp far west of here, along the shores of Shaded Dunes.
Njau Hansou: If you observe any of her trainees doing anything out of the ordinary, please report it directly to me. Do not speak to anyone else.
Njau Hansou: You will, of course, be there for legitimate reasons. Engage the smugglers cautiously, but aggressively. Use overwhelming violence in every engagement.
Njau Hansou: I believe them to have a logbook in their possession. Please return it to me intact.
Njau Hansou: This is not all, however. Are you ready to learn of your other tasks?
Njau Hansou: Wonderful.

Njau Hansou: I also need you to investigate an ashira camp on the way to the smugglers. I have heard reports that they are attempting to raid the smugglers' camp... I am interested in their intentions. Please bring me any evidence you find.
== Njau Hansou glances around before continuing.
Njau Hansou: Again, if you see any inquisitors engaging in suspicious activities, please make note of it. I know it is unlikely, but...
Njau Hansou: ...Do not misunderstand, the inquisitors are our allies. We have received reports that cultists ambushed several of Petra's recruits in the city, which has caused such suspicion.

Njau Hansou: When you are walking about, keep an eye out for movement in the shadows. Should you discover any of these cultists, engage them immediately. It would be of great interest if you could recover anything that might hint at their origins.
Njau Hansou: Keep in mind, this task is separate from your work at the camps.
>> See Cultists in Night Harbor
Part 2 - Req. Lvl 5
I did not take any notes or screenshots on exactly what the items are called below. If anyone can get those details please edit them below. *added correct damaged logbook name
Kill an ashira raider in Shaded Dunes and loot missing logbook pages 1-6
NOTE:The raiders spawn at the middle oasis camp, they share a spawn with an ashira warrior and an ashira shaman, so you'll need to kill them for a chance at a raider spawn.
Watch out for the nearby an ashira spearfisher and the invisible an ashira ambusher. They are higher level and much more dangerous.
Kill Toma the Two-Faced in Shaded Dunes and loot *Smuggler's Damaged Logbook
NOTE:The smuggler's camp can be found on the far South-West side of Shaded Dunes. Follow the water to a small river and it's across the river.
At night the smugglers despawn/respawn as wererats.
The logbook is a 6-slot container
Combine the six logbook pages in *Smuggler's Damaged Logbook to create *Smuggler's Logbook
Return the Smuggler's Logbook to Njau Hansou
You gain experience.

Njau Hansou: This is fantastic work. It is interesting that the Ashira were only able to escape with a few pages. Though, perhaps that is all they were looking for. We will focus on what is said on those pages when we analyze this.
Njau Hansou: If we find the Ashira knowingly took those specific pages, then that may also give credence to the idea that they are a more intelligent race than we’ve assumed.
Njau Hansou: I may have to explore that idea more later.

Njau Hansou: For now, take this. The wand I just handed you is a Wand of Spectral Sharding. Stow it somewhere safe and ask me about it, and I will tell you how it is to be used in your next assignment.
You receive Wand of Spectral Sharding from Njau Hansou.
You have to ask Njau about the wand to get the next dialogue. This may be an optional step
Njau Hansou: Great. The wand is to be used against four specific ghosts found within the depths of the Tomb of the Last Wyrmsbane, which is located at the excavation site just west of the city gates.

Njau Hansou: While engaged with these ghosts, you can use the wand to crystallize some of their spectral essence. This is essentially trapping a tangible piece of them in our Material Plane for use in analysis.

Njau Hansou: Bring me a shard from each of the following ghosts - High Marshal Fionna, Lieutenant Gregan Snyde, Jakob Geffrey, and Timmon Bell. Return their spectral essences to me along with the wand I just gave you.
Njau Hansou: Do take care. Little is known about the tomb, and it is very dangerous. Do not go alone.
Loot Crystallized Shard's from High Marshal Fionna, Lieutenant Gregan Snyde, Jakob Geffrey and Timmon Bell in Tomb of the Last Wyrmsbane
NOTE:You have to click each ghost with the Wand of Spectral Sharding in order to get the Crystallized Shard to drop
Return the four Crystallized Shard and the Wand of Spectral Sharding to Njau Hansou
You gain experience.
Njau Hansou: Your work has been extraordinary. We will send these shards to be analyzed immediately.
Njau Hansou: For now, please take some time to recover from your adventures. Go into the city and explore. Enjoy some food and drink. Perhaps watch a performance from the Azure Veils.
Njau Hansou: Take this for your efforts. We will speak again soon.
You receive Spellbinders Blade Talisman from Njau Hansou.
This quest starts at the conclusion of the Ail'Vorith Starter Quest after you receive your Obsidian Shackle.
Laren Drin'dar is located in the Foreign Quarter of Ail'Vorith.
Laren Drin'dar: It is time for you to serve your kin, Ranger. Will you heed the call?

Laren Drin'dar: Your oath compels you. Yet a willing servant is a welcome soldier in the legions of Vael'xirith. Deliver this letter to Lord Glaeron in the hall of House Vael'xirith. He will know what to do with you.
Lvl 14+
Glaeron Kes'tel is located House Vael'xirith in Ail'Vorith.
Glaeron Kes'tel: I have a task for you, Ranger, if you are keen for goblin-hunting.

Glaeron Kes'tel: One of our caravans was ambushed by goblins, who now encroach upon the borders of our city. THe beasts were repelled, but some escaped with treasures bound for Ail'vorith, among them four precious gemstones. Their transgression must be punished.
Glaeron Kes'tel: Find the goblin-camps and recover our gems. Leave none alive.
Go and slaughter goblins in their camps until you find all four: Pilfered Topaz, Pilfered Ruby, Pilfered Sapphire, Pilfered Emerald. Give these to Glaeron.
You gain experience.
Your faction standing with House Vael'xirith got better.
Glaeron Kes'tel: You have done a great service to your people, Almond, and earned a bow befitting a Ranger of Vael'xirith's legion.
You receive Legion Recurve from Glaeron Kes'tel.
Glaeron Kes'tel: Sharpen your skills in the Deep, Ranger. Every soldier will be needed in the wars to come.
Talk to Senior Apprentice Syrsil in the Inn's tavern. She asks for a package belonging to her master, which she says was stolen by bandits.
The item that completes the quest is Vharkith's Order -- a wrapped bundle that smells faintly of brimstone (confirmed in game, 6 Oct 2026).

The bandits are the Deepcut -- the thieves named in Mining Picks for Hull and The Small Problem of Deepcut Arsonists. The item page records the drop from Belot, a named Deepcut bandit, in the Underdocks; it also drops from the Deepcut at North Gate East.
To hand a quest item to an NPC, place it on your cursor and click on the NPC.
Thanetal is found in the Foreign Quarter of Ail'Vorith.
Is Deep Common language required??
Thanetal: I don't have much time. I have to deliver these samples quickly.
Thanetal: However, I am very thirsty.
Thanetal: The samples? They are from the deep gnome encampment.
Thanetal: I am delivering them to the Foreign Quarter for study.
Thanetal: Tell you what. I'm so tired of running this route.
Thanetal: And they probably have more than enough samples.
Thanetal: If you want, I will trade the samples for one Deep Beer and ten silver pieces.
Where is Deep Beer purchased?
Hand Thanetal 1 Deep Beer and 10 silver pieces.
Thanetal: Nice trade!
You receive Sample of Mind Control Substance from Thanetal.
You receive Sample of Mind Control Substance from Thanetal.
You receive Sample of Mind Control Substance from Thanetal.
You receive Sample of Mind Control Substance from Thanetal.
You receive Sample of Mind Control Substance from Thanetal.
You receive Sample of Mind Control Substance from Thanetal.
Thanetal quickly opens the beer and slams it down.
Thanetal: Delicious Thanks.

Need all dialogues as well as more information on the fights themselves, how the turn-ins work, etc.
Details
In order to reach the arena, the only known way is to loot a Gilded Claw Compound Key through killing any of the claw members at the compound.
The entrance to the arena is behind the compound in the image above to the left, down a ramp to a locked door.
Once in the locked door there will be patrols that are aligned with the Claws roaming the halls.
In the locked door, there is a room to the right with an oddly colored wall that can be walked through.
It is safe to explore this area as all the NPCs are on the claw faction, aside from the slaves.

In order to start the arena you need to be AMICABLE to The Gilded Claws. This can be accomplished by killing many of the smuggler and bandits in the desert region. This includes smugglers in Fallen Pass, Shaded Dunes, and Sungreet Strand.
Arena Notes
Shortly after a fight is started Ringmaster Vorn typically despawns with a 50 minute respawn timer.
When handed a note to spawn an encounter, Vorn stays available for a little while, making it possible to hand in multiple notes.
If you are on the same tier of fight, the encounter needs to be defeated before the next person can spawn the same encounter.
Different tiers can be started at the same time, be sure to have the correct person loot the proof of kill.
The Fights
An Angry Goblin || Fighter || Green at 37 || No Money
A Madman || Fighter || Green at 37 || 10 copper
A Beefy Dwarf || Fighter || Green at 37 || 50 copper
A Nasty Halfling || Fighter || Green at 37 || 1 Silver
Ashira (?) || Fighter || Assumed to be level 30 || 3 Silver
Bergil & Bargil || Bergil: BeastmasterBargil: Cleric / Paladin || Assumed to be level 30 || 5 silver, Mask of the Gladiator
Coglee || Elementalist || Assumed to be level 35 || 1 Gold, Faceguard of the Gladiator Upgrade to mask (when handed in After handing in the Note and Ear)
Oger || Monk || Assumed to be level 40 || No Money, Claw of the Gladiator (Requires at least level 36 to get - Arena Master will not accept the turn in until then)
Nedar Darwish || Necromancer || Assumed to be level 45 || No Money, Gilded Claw of the Gladiator Upgrade to Claws (when handed in After handing in the Note and Ear)
Kragg, Snaggle & Grizzle || Kragg: FighterSnaggle: ArcherGrizzle: Shaman || Assumed to be level 49 || Unknown
More info is required...
This is the second part of the Underdocks Starter Quest for Beastmasters and Fighters. The dialog before this is the end of part 1.
Gunder Dinnig: It has happened before. Come now, there is work to do, stripling.

Gunder dinnig: Aye, there are domestic matters we might resolve to our profit. The Delvestone Mining Company quarrel with the Deepcut bandits in Darrowdwell. The company is ill-equipped to protect their interests, but their pockets run deep.
You receive Empty Overseer Bag from Gunder Dinnig.
"There is a standing bounty for the heads of A Deepcut overseer. Fill this bag and earn your share. Send them packing!"<br
Gunder Dinnig belches.
You receive Empty Overseer Bag from Gunder Dinnig.
Collect 6 Deepcut Overseer Head, place them in the Empty Overseer Bag and click combine to create Full Bag of Overseer Heads.
Hand in the Full Bag of Overseer Heads to Gunder Dinnig
Your faction standing with The Descendian Order got better.
Gunder Dinnig Unfastens the Bag.
Gunder Dinning: Gruesome work, Player Name. Would that you had a sharper blade... yet a crown hewn is a copper earned. Bring this to Elara, the pay-master, along with your ring.
You receive Deepcut Overseer Bounty from Gunder Dinnig.
Take the Deepcut Overseer Bounty to Elara Venn in the bounty office beneath the quartermaster.
Elara Venn: You acquit yourself well, Class. Here is your coin, and a signet that might serve you better.
You receive Polished Iron Ring from Elara Venn.
You recieve 10 silver from Elara Venn.
All classes are able to complete this quest, but only NEC / SHD can use the Bloodied Bone.
Everett Graves is located in the Necropolis of Night Harbor. Everett is in the main room just as one enters the Concourse of Souls.
Everett Graves: Welcome to the Concourse of Souls. Are you a believer?

Everett Graves: Then you shall serve, acolyte. I need your assistance with an investigation. One of our new apprentices has gone missing, but his undead servant was seen wandering near the excavation site, just outside the Western Gate.
Everett Graves: I want you to find and destroy it. Bring back any evidence that you discover.

Head to the Tomb of the Last Wyrmsbane and locate an escaped minion. The minion spawns within a room near the main entrance of the dungeon that contains several upright and open tombs which are embedded in the walls.
A good way to know if you are near the right room is to look for a cracked wall with a hole in it. This wall is just outside the room in which the quest NPC can be found in.
an escaped minion DOES have a placeholder.
When you've located an escaped minion, kill it and loot Bloodied Human Head.
Return to Everett Graves in Night Harbor and give him the Bloodied Human Head.
Everett Graves: That poor sap. I told him to summon weak minions until he learned to control them. What hubris he showed, trying to charm the dead so young.
Everett Graves pulls a bloodied bone from Ayvin's brain matter.
Everett Graves: Take this. It was enough to kill Ayvin, so it might prove some use against your enemies.
You receive Bloodied Bone from Everett Graves.
You gain experience.

quests.title: The Small Problem of Deepcut Arsonists

parts.text: Hail Guard Darek
Guard Darek says Hello adventurer. Could you help us with a small problem that recently developed?
Guard Darek says The Deepcut arsonists are starting fires that they cannot control. So many mushrooms have been burned down and one of the fires even threatened this gate!
Guard Darek says Can you help?
Guard Darek says Wonderful! Take this box and gather up six accelerants from the arsonists. Once you have collected enough, combine them in the box and return to me for your reward.
You receive Small Storage Box from Guard Darek.
Kill a Deepcut arsonist to collect 6 Vial of Flammable Oil. Arsonists are an uncommon spawn in the Deepcut mining cave, and the oils are an uncommon drop from them.
Combine the 6 oils within the box to craft Box of Oils.
Turn in the box to Guard Darek.
Guard Darek says Thank you for your service on behalf of the Underwatch.
Your faction standing with The Underwatch got better.
You receive 1 silver from Guard Darek.
This quest starts by looting an Unusual Jackal Pelt from an ashira shapeshifter.
Warning, this is not repeatable, so if you lose the ring ... you're boned. " Cursed-Sage "
Part 1 - The Pelt
Inspecting the Unusual Jackal Pelt directs the player to interact with someone familiar with pelts.
Seek out Leatherworker Haiat at the Tannery near West Gate in Night Harbor and hand him the pelt.
Leatherworking Haiat: These markings are typical for ashira leather. What's made you curious about it, friend?
Leatherworking Haiat: Ashira are known to shapeshift into jackals, their animal form, so to speak, which is probably how you came by it.
Leatherworking Haiat: You seem surprised. Don't believe old me? Show the pelt to a seasoned bard, they can tell you more tales about the ashira folk.
Leatherworking Haiat: Or if you don't want it, we'll take it off of your hands for a few copper. They're tough and make for a solid base to work with!
You receive Ashira Pelt from Leatherworker Haiat.
Seek out Jalwa Noor in Glimmermoon Hall (The Bard's Guild in the Night Market) and hand her the pelt.
Jalwa Noor: An ashira's pelt? Mayhaps you could tell me why you're showing me this?

parts.say: I wish to learn more about the tales of the ashira folk.

parts.text: Jalwa Noor: The ashira are a race of jackalweres, indigenous to the deserts and foothills of southwestern Aêthoril. They've inhabited these dunes long before us, wanderer.
Jalwa Noor: They live harmoniously with nature and loathe the unnatural. In times past, our kin were both at war with and friendly to each other.

Jalwa Noor: Trade with them was once common, but of late, you don't see them interacting with the people of Night Harbor anymore. For reasons unknown to me, they've grown wary of us and mostly retreat to their home deep in the gorges of Ain Golot.
Jalwa Noor: A shame, truly. Their race is as ancient as the stars themselves, and their abilities are equally extraordinary.
Jalwa Noor leans closer, as shadows from the torchlight dance across her face.

Jalwa Noor: Oh yes... the ashira have mastered the mystical art of shapeshifting. It was bestowed upon them through the Yowling, a spiritual heritage passed down from their revered ancestors. With a whisper to the wind and a call to the wild, the ashira can transform, taking the form of jackals or even... that of a human.

Jalwa Noor: Rumors abound of ashira hiding their true form beneath a veneer of human flesh, weaving through the throngs of cityfolk... even here in Night Harbor. So perfect is their mimicry that one might never know the person beside them is not of human kin.
Jalwa Noor lowers her voice to a reverent hush.

Jalwa Noor: But heed this tale well, for the Yowling is no mere parlor trick, It's the echo of their lineage, a bond with the primeval forces that crafted the very essence of our world. To witness an ashira shift is to gaze upon the ancient dance of spirit and flesh, a secret rite as old as time itself.
Jalwa Noor: As keepers of this world's ancient tales, some bards hold the secret of a rare chant learned from times of mistrust, one that forces an ashira back to their true form.
Jalwa Noor lets out a sorrowful sigh.
Jalwa Noor: Alas, the chant is not known to me, only to the most gifted of bards. My muse and lifelong partner, Alisar, was one of them.

Jalwa Noor: Alisar was a wonderful musician and storyteller. Many moons ago, I couldn't help but fall deeply in love with his beautiful soul. We wed not long after and voyaged across the continent together.
Jalwa Noor: Unfortunately... he is no longer with us. He took his instruments and musical sheets with him to the grave.
Jalwa Noor shakes visibly as her voice cracks.
Jalwa Noor: His last voyage took him to the Tomb of the Last Wyrmsbane. He fought alongside his companions to recover a unique pipe organ that had been lost deep below the sands.
Jalwa Noor gazes into the distance, lost in memories long past.
Jalwa Noor: I've never heard, nor seen him again since...
Jalwa Noor whimpers quietly as a solemn tear runs down her cheek.
Jalwa Noor: If you dare tread the cursed halls of the tomb to reclaim Alisar's belongings, I'll be in your eternal debt. IF the chant you seek is among them, I'll teach it to you as payment.
Part 2 - The Lute

In Tomb of the Last Wyrmsbane take the hidden path (not the hidden path leading to Ancient Crypts) in the builder room across from Quartermaster Boothroy, and drop down onto the terrace with the pipe organ in the chapel. - Overlooking Timmon Bell spawn location in the chapel. With your back to Bell,
at the organ then proceed to the cobweb corner to the right and ahead and
. If a player recently already picked it up, it may take a few minutes for it to respawn.
You receive Broken Lute.
Return Broken Lute to Jalwa
Jalwa Noor: You... have returned from the shadowed depths of the tomb, bearing treasures long mourned as lost...
Jalwa Noor trembles with reverence as she receives Alisar's lute, with the musical sheets hidden inside.

Jalwa Noor: In these strings and parchment, the spirit of Alisar Noor dances once more. You've brought back more than just keepsakes, you've restored the echoes of a love that time itself could not silence. Thank you, kind adventurer.
Jalwa Noor sifts through the musical sheets and gently removes one, her gaze meeting yours.
Jalwa Noor: Listen closely playername.
Jalwa Noor raises her voice in song, reciting words long lost with a tone of gratitude and rememberance.
Jalwa Noor: This is the chant you seek. I'll transcribe the words onto parchment for you. Recite them faithfully to activate its intended use... but use it with the utmost care.
Jalwa Noor: A word of warning... I don't know how the ashira will react if you disrupt their shapeshifting. Be careful.
You receive Ancient Chant from Jalwa Noor.

Find Mayana in Saltbreeze Park. Note: Mayana must be alone out of sight of other NPCs for the chant to work. She paths between three locations and it will not work if she is standing at the sojourner campfire or the pool of water by the monk trainer.
Inside the park, try to click the Chant. It'll either work or give an emote.
You begin casting Ancient Disrupting Chant.
You purge Mayana with a magical chant. (Human Form)
Mayana: What have you done, biped?! My form...
Mayana glances around nervously, then takes a combative stance.
Mayana: State your intent, quickly! are you friend or foe?!
Mayana growls at you.
Mayana: You would keep my identity a secret? Why?
Hand Ancient Chant to Mayana.
Mayana immediately tears up the chant, then lightly bows her head with apparent relief.
Mayana: It is unexpected... but I cannot deny this show of trust.
Mayana: Please, take this as a token of our mutual understanding.
You receive Ashira Pack Ring from Mayana.
Mayana: I cannot leave the city due to... obligations. My pack is at great risk, both from folk in Night Harbor and within our home in Tel Ekir.
Mayana assumes her human form once more.
Mayana: Will you assist us where we suffer most?
Mayana: Those crazed goblins who call themselves the bloodynose clan have invaded our home in Tel Ekir. They only seek to slaughter us and summon the unnatural.
Mayana: Please... help us protect the Life Font and drive them out. It would ease our spirits' burden.
Mayana: If you do this, bring me any goblin ear (Bloodynose Goblin Ear) and heads (Bloodynose Goblin Head) you take. The pack will reward you for proving your worth to us.
Mayana: And be sure to wear the ring when you bring them to me, so that I may see your conviction to our cause.
Part 3 - The Goblins
You can now bring Bloodynose Goblin Ear and Bloodynose Goblin Head to Mayana for experience and faction.

It looks like the next steps are to gain enough faction (completed at kindly 2) that you can get to Seeress Hamana in Tel Ekir. She's located at the back of the zone up near the Guardian of the Life Font.
You need to collect Head of General Overlord Bloodynose and turn it in, along with your Ashira Pack Ring to receive Refined Ashira Pack Ring.

When you go up to the area above the waterfall where Seeress Hamana is, do NOT venture very far into the wooded area! There are wisps that will agro, and the Ashira will all assist them, even if you have maximum faction. Just sneak in along the right wall to Seeress Hamana, do the turn in and skedattle out of there!
part 4 - Fallen Pass
after receiving the ring..
Seeress Hamana: The pack cannot thankyou enough. This will give our young ones much-needed respite.
Seeress Hamana: you Honour the pack.
Seeress Hamana: A most urgent matter has reached my ears. Will you lend us a hand once more?
Seeress Hamana: Fallen Pass is home to the wretched. These monsters are poisoning our lands and need to be stopped.
Seeress Hamana: put an end to their evil deeds. We would be eternally indebted to you.
Obtain Hidden Note from Overseer Shuk'Naru
obtain Sealed Note from Qassem Brolt
hand both into Seeress Hamana
she then asks for the ring (you must have it with you)
receive Delicate Ashira Pack Ring

Part 1 - Rope for the Job
You can only engage in the quest dialogue after reaching level 15 or higher.
You may first find Tig Pebblebank at the quarry of Sungreet Strand.
Tig Pebblebank: No, Mr. Brookturner. Give me a moment and I'll help you look for it.
Tig Pebblebank sighs, looking visibly stressed.
Tig Pebblebank: What? Oh! Hi there. I'm Lead Measurer Tig Pebblebank.
Tig Pebblebank: I'm sorry about all that. We've been really behind lately with all the delays.
Tig Pebblebank: Don't get me started. The foreman should have secured the site, and our camp should have been set up days ago.
Tig Pebblebank shakes her head.
Tig Pebblebank: Safety is a high priority for us, we must be allowed to do our delicate work unhindered!
Tig Pebblebank: Now, I must check our equipment and send word to the Church of Trem about what's missing. Someone else will have to take the measurements... there's just too much to do.
Tig Pebblebank: Part of our charter as representatives of the Measure is to map an exact layout of the quarry. It's a complicated process to complete, but it starts off simple enough.
Tig Pebblebank: First we find the surface area of the plot for the purchase records, then we measure the overall volume to determine how much stone has already been excavated.
Tig Pebblebank: If I weren't so busy, I'd make these measurements myself, but...
Tig Pebblebank sighs.
Tig Pebblebank: If only I had an apprentice...

parts.say: I am interested in being your apprentice.

parts.text: Note that if you're not level 15, the conversation stops here after a few sentences. Need Dialogue
If you are level 15+...
Tig Pebblebank: You're interested? I could field commission you as an apprentice in service of the Measure. It would be an official errand!
Tig Pebblebank stares into your eyes intently, as if searching for something.
Tig Pebblebank: There's one condition though... it would require you to take an oath. Are you willing?
Tig Pebblebank: If so, I'll swear you in and you can get started immediately. You'll be paid, of course, as befitting a junior member of the Measure.
Tig Pebblebank: Good! Then place your hand over your coin purse. Yes, just like so.
Tig Pebblebank places her hand over her coin purse.

Tig Pebblebank: Do you, by the stars that guide us and the sands beneath our feet, under the watchful eye of Trem, god of trade and tradesmen alike, pledge your time and work to the Guild of the Measure?
Tig Pebblebank: Do you promise to chart the unknown with clarity and precision, mark the borders, and endeavor to uncover the secrets of the land?
Tig Pebblebank: Do you vow to uphold the truth in all your measurements, honor the trust placed in you, and serve with diligence and integrity?

Tig Pebblebank: Do you swear, as long as the sun rises and sets, and by the grace of Trem, to remain steadfast and true, to become a beacon of knowledge, and a protective curator of all tools loaned to you for an assigned task?
Tig Pebblebank smiles and raises her eyebrows.
Tig Pebblebank: This is the part where you say I do.
Tig Pebblebank: With this oath, I bind your spirit to the Measure and the service of Trem, for now and forever, until the terms of your commission have ended.
Tig Pebblebank presents you with a metal disk.
You receive Lead Disk of the Apprentice from Tig Pebblebank.
Tig Pebblebank: This disk represents your apprenticeship with the Measure. You'll make good use of it, I'm sure.
Tig Pebblebank: Alright then, that's settled. For your task, I have just about everything you need, with the exception of rope.
Tig Pebblebank: Go to Night Harbor and visit the Night Market. There's a general store there owned by Sproggets Bedsprings. Tell him I sent you.
Tig Pebblebank: We need ten hemp ropes at fifty length each. He should have it in stock. Bring me the ropes and we'll get started.
Travel to Night Harbor and visit the Night Market. You can find Sproggets Bedsprings inside one of the building just to the left as you enter the Night Market from West Gate.
Sproggets Bedsprings: Heyo! Looking to get into some adventuring? Take a look at my wares.
Sproggets Bedsprings: Oh she did, did she? What does she want this time?
Sproggets Bedsprings: Rope you say. Well, I do have rope for sale, but I'm guessing you're seeking the Guild of the Measurer's standard discount.
Sproggets Bedsprings: Fine. Two silver coin and you can have ten ropes of fifty length. I'll even throw in a small field pack to carry them in.
Sproggets Bedsprings: Just give me the coin when you're ready. I'll set them aside until you return.
IMPORTANT - Do NOT purchase the rope from Sproggets. Simply take 2 silver from your inventory and hand it to Sproggets.
Sproggets Bedsprings: Good doing business with you! May Trem's fortune find you.
Sproggets Bedsprings retrieves a small field pack from behind the counter and hands it to you.
You receive Small Field Pack of Ropes from Sproggets Bedsprings.
Travel to Sungreet Strand and return to Tig Pebblebank.
Hand Small Field Pack of Ropes to Tig Pebblebank.
Tig Pebblebank: Excellent! Let me prepare the rope for you.
Tig Pebblebank pulls out the ropes one by one and ties them together end to end, creating one long rope.
Tig Pebblebank stretches the rope from foot to head, marking it with knots, and repeats the process until she reaches the end.
Tig Pebblebank: Here you go. One knotted rope at about five hundred length. This should be long enough to do the job.
Tig Pebblebank: Now, make some room in your pack because there's quite a few items you'll need for the task. Let me know when you're ready!
You receive Rope, Knotted, 500 Length from Tig Pebblebank.
Part 2 - It's actually quite large!
Tig Pebblebank: Good! Here's the survey form to fill out. Use your apprentice disk to mark down any measurements you've taken.
You receive Tig's Survey Form from Tig Pebblebank.
Tig Pebblebank: Also, this is a surveying book written by yours truly. You'll find it useful.
You receive The Joy of Surveying from Tig Pebblebank.
Tig Pebblebank: And here's an advanced book on surveying.
You receive Advanced Surveying Volume I from Tig Pebblebank.
Tig Pebblebank: I know this is a lot of information, but I believe in you. You're also the only one who can do this right now... so there's that too. In Trem we trust, as I guess we must!
Tig Pebblebank: For your first task, you'll need to find the surface area of the quarry. The books cover this, so I wont bore you with the details.
Tig Pebblebank: Seek out the markers at the quarry. They've got bright green cloths on them so they should be easy to see, but you might need to take a closer look to see the numbers on them.
Tig Pebblebank: Look for marker number one. Secure one end of the rope there, then stretch it all the way to marker two.
Tig Pebblebank: Take the first measurement and bring it back to me to check your work.
Markers 1 and 2
Need to verify if Tig's Survey Form auto-updates as you capture measurements.
Read over The Joy of Surveying, as it will provide instructions on how to capture measurements and how to identify piton objects in-game.
You now have to locate the various pitons around the quarry and use MUD commands with your Rope, Knotted, 500 Length to capture measurements.
Location 1 is at the south eastern corner of the Quarry along the rim (Left of the ramp in and out).
When you are at a given location, hold Rope, Knotted, 500 Length on your cursor and use the MUD command
to attach the rope to the marker.
You tie one end of the rope to the marker one.
This updated the rope to Knotted Rope Tied to Marker Two
Location 2 is at the south western corner of the Quarry along the rim (near the ramp in and out of the quarry).
You tie the other end of the rope to the second marker.
You carefully count the number of knots between the first marker and second marker.
After a few moments you have counted a total of 240 knots, each marking a length. You quickly make a note of this upon the parchment.
Travel back to the piton locations and use the MUD command
. The final result should be a Rope, Knotted, 500 Length in your bags and not another named rope.
You untie one end of the rope from the first marker.
You untie one end of the rope from the second marker.
Return to Tig Pebblebank and hand in the updated Tig's Survey Form as well as Rope, Knotted, 500 Length.
If you forget to undo the rope with the MUD Command
you are met with the following:
Tig Pebblebank looks you over and scratches her head.
Tig Pebblebank: Where's the knotted rope? Did you know that you left some rope attached to a marker?
Tig Pebblebank: You must untie the rope from the marker and bring it back with you.
Tig Pebblebank: Go ahead. I'll be here when you return.

Special Note: If you need to zone from aggro after taking off just one part of a rope, you can zone back and just take the other part off. You will not need to start over. This may be helpful for the last part if you are solo (w/ no FD) - since putting on and taking off the rope drops invis.
Markers 2 and 3
Tig Pebblebank looks over the survey and nods.
Tig Pebblebank: This is a good start. You just need one more measurement and we'll have what we need to figure out the area.
Tig Pebblebank hands back the survey form.
Tig Pebblebank: Now, go back to marker two and get the length from marker two to marker three. Once you've written down the length, bring the survey back to me to check.
Location 2 is at the south eastern corner of the Quarry along the rim (near the ramp in and out of the quarry).
When you are at location 2, hold Rope, Knotted, 500 Length on your cursor and use the MUD command
to attach the rope to the marker.
You tie one end of the rope to the marker two.
Location 3 is at the North Eastern corner of the Quarry along the rim (Follow the rim North of the ramp in and out towards the Glass Flats zone).
You tie the other end of the rope to the third marker.
You carefully count the number of knots between markers two and three.
After a few moments you have counted a total of 416 knots, each marking a length. You quickly make a note of this upon the parchment.
Travel back to the piton locations and use the MUD command
. The final result should be a Rope, Knotted, 500 Length in your bags and not another named rope.
You untie one end of the rope from the second marker.
You untie one end of the rope from the third marker.
Return to Tig Pebblebank and hand in the updated Tig's Survey Form as well as Rope, Knotted, 500 Length.
Markers 4 and 5
Tig Pebblebank looks over the survey and smiles.
Tig Pebblebank: Great! You have the measurements needed for the area. Now, we need to get the measurement for the volume.
Tig Pebblebank hands back the survey form.
Tig Pebblebank: Go find markers four and five and measure the distance between them. After you've written down the length, bring the survey back to me to look over.
Tig Pebblebank: After this measurement, you won't need the rope anymore. Hand that in too when you're done.
Location 4 and 5 are just north of the middle of the quarry. Look for the highest point. When you are at location 4, hold Rope, Knotted, 500 Length on your cursor and use the MUD command
to attach the rope to the marker.
Location 4 can be easily done through invisibility unless a cinder herald is roaming, his agro radius is massive.
You tie one end of the rope to the fourth marker.

Location 5 can be a challenge. The path up can be traveled invisible and is generally free from kill on sight mobs. At the top there are 4 goblins around the the marker that will agro when you place the rope.
If you are doing the quest at level 15, these goblins will be deep red. You can agro them and train them around if you need, but remember you need to place and then return to TAKE back the rope.
You tie one end of the rope to the fifth marker.
You carefully count the number of knots between markers four and five.
After a few moments you have counted a total of 42 knots, each marking a length. You quickly make a note of this upon the parchment.
Travel back to the piton locations and use the MUD command
. The final result should be a Rope, Knotted, 500 Length in your bags and not another named rope.
You untie one end of the rope from the fourth marker.
You untie one end of the rope from the fifth marker.
Return to Tig Pebblebank and hand in the updated Tig's Survey Form as well as Rope, Knotted, 500 Length.
Part 3 - Math? I hate math
You receive Tig's Survey Form from Tig Pebblebank.
Tig Pebblebank: You have the lengths! Great! I hope it wasn't too difficult.
Tig Pebblebank puts the knotted rope back into her field pack.
Tig Pebblebank: Now, all I need to do on my end is verify the form. The results are, honestly, as I expected.
Tig Pebblebank writes something on the form and hands it back to you.
Tig Pebblebank: We're not done though. The surface area needs to be added to the form. Based on your measurements, I know what the area is... but do you?
Tig Pebblebank: Consider this a test of your skill, apprentice. Think carefully about the answer and take your time to get it right. Once you've got it, tell me your answer.
Tig Pebblebank: Or, if you just want to be done with the survey, you can hand me the form and go.
Review Advanced Surveying Volume I provided by Tig Pebblebank earlier in the quest.
This book provides the basic mathematical formulas to calculate the correct answer to Tig's question.
Inspect Tig's Survey Form for the values captured by your measurements.
For this question, Tig wants the surface area, noted as A = L x W.
In Tig's Survey Form, this should equate to A = Length 1 x Length 2.

parts.say: The surface area of the quarry is 99,840.

parts.text: Tig Pebblebank: Well done, that's correct!
Tig Pebblebank: If you don't mind, I'll jot that down on your form.
Tig Pebblebank snatches the form from your hand and quickly scribbles down the answer, then promptly returns it to you.
Tig Pebblebank: There, now you have the area of the quarry filled in.
Tig Pebblebank: I must say, I'm impressed with your skill so far. Advanced surveying concepts don't come easily.
Tig Pebblebank: I wonder... do you happen to know the last measurement, the volume of the quarry? Tell me, and we can finish this form properly.
Tig Pebblebank: Once again, this is quite an advanced surveying technique. If it's too much for you, you can hand me the form and go. I'll understand.
For this question, Tig wants the volume, noted as V = L x W x H in Advanced Surveying Volume I.
In Tig's Survey Form, this should equate to V = Length 1 x Length 2 x Length 3.

parts.say: The volume of the quarry is 4,193,280.

parts.text: Tig Pebblebank: Trem's fortune favors you, my apprentice! That is correct!
Tig Pebblebank: Hand me the survey. Let us put an end to this task.
Give Tig Pebblebank your completed Tig's Survey Form.
Tig Pebblebank takes the note from you and scribbles down a few more words.
Tig Pebblebank folds up the survey and tucks it gently into her robe, smiling.
Tig Pebblebank: This will be a great help to not only the Measure, but also to Trem's faithful.
Tig Pebblebank: Please take this as thanks for your efforts. Rest well, knowing you've served a higher purpose this day. Trust in Trem.
You gain experience.
You receive The Measure Stick from Tig Pebblebank.
Your faction standing with Congregation of Trem got better.
Your faction standing with Citizens of Night Harbor got better.

quests.title: Underdocks Starter Quest
classes: Archer Beastmaster Elementalist Enchanter Fighter Ranger Wizard

parts.text: Part 1 - Deep Beetles - Req. Lvl 1
Read the Recruitment Notice you start with as a new Archer, Ranger, Enchanter, Beastmaster or Fighter characters.

Calling all hot-blooded--

MEN-AT-ARMS,
SORCERERS,
HUNTERS,
and OLD DOGS.

--be you unemployed, dispossessed, or outlawed.

The DESCENDIAN ORDER holds muster in the Underdocks, EASTERN DISTRICT. Pass inspection for steady work.

GOOD PAY.

Marshal Harding
Ensure your language settings are set to Common Tongue, Marshal Harding cannot understand Deep Tongue as of 2026-09-10.

Take a lift down to the Underdocks Citadel. Then, head east to the Eastern District. You will need to swim across or wait for the raft. Climb the staircase immediately across from the raft docking location to find Marshal Harding and hand him your Recruitment Notice.
You gain experience.
Your faction standing with The Descendian Order got better.
Marshal Harding looks you over.
Marshal Harding: You can read this, then? You look like you crawled out of a gutter. Have you come to serve in the Order?

parts.say: I have come to serve in the Order

parts.text: Marshal Harding waves the leaf of paper in your face.
Marshal Harding: The Descendian Order. I pray you fight better than you read, if you wish to earn your keep.

parts.say: I wish to earn my keep

parts.text: Marshal Harding laughs.
Marshal Harding: As a scullion, no doubt, by your dress.
Marshal Harding rummages through a crate and hands you a shirt.
Marshal Harding: It could do with a wash, but at least you might seem to be a page rather than a pauper. Can you fight, then?
You receive Musty Tunic from Marshal Harding.
Marshal Harding: I'll have the truth of it. Fill this satchel with the shells of deep beetles.
Marshal Harding hands you a threadbare sack.
You receive Beetle Shell Collection Bag from Marshal Harding.
Marshal Harding: Do not return if this task is too great.
Facing Northwest, follow the tunnel out of the Eastern District to the Underdocks wall where you can begin hunting a deep beetle.
Collect 6 Deep Beetle Carapace, place them in the Beetle Shell Collection Bag and click combine to create Full Beetle Shell Collection Bag.
Part 1 - Notes & FAQ
2026-09-11 as a level 3-4 Archer, this took ~50 beetle kills over about two hours killing every low level mob in sight. Drop rate is about 5% but seems slightly better for the higher level beetles.
Hand in the Full Beetle Shell Collection Bag to Marshal Harding
You gain experience.
Your faction standing with The Descendian Order got better.

At this point depending on your class he will tell you to take a note to one of a few different NPCs. As a beastmaster or fighter it will be Gunder Dinnig, as an archer or ranger it will be Simrut the Green. As an enchanter, elementalist, or wizard the next step is at Maude Astarace.
Marshal Harding: An adequate performance for a scullion. Bring this letter to Simrut, the hunter. He will decide what becomes of you.
Or
Marshal Harding: An adequate performance for a scullion. Bring this letter to Gunder Dinnig, who will put you to work.
Or
Marshal Harding: An adequate performance for a scullion. Bring this letter to Maude Astarace. She will judge your worth.
You receive Note from Marshal Harding.
Simrut the Green is a goblin standing near some tall stones next to the Archery range.
Gunder Dinnig is a halfling located just up the stairs nearby.
Maude Astarace is a gnome located in the building next to the quartermaster.
Hand the correct NPC your Note
You gain experience.
Your faction standing with The Descendian Order got better.
Simrut the Green: Hrum! Is it a hunter? Yes, yes. You get a hunter's ring.
Or
Gunder Dinnig: A new one, fresh from the field then!
Gunder Dinnig sniffs

Gunder Dinnig: Not so fresh as I would have liked. We will have to get that sorted. Accept this ring as a token of your service. Take care not to lose it, lest our comrades mistake you for a poor grotto bandit.
Or

Maude Astarace: A new recruit! I hope you will live a little longer than the last one. The marshal is not always the most discerning fellow. Never mind about that. Take this ring and assist me with my reearch
You receive Hammered Iron Ring.
This ring will have a different stat depending on your class, and the follow up quest will also vary.
Part 2 for Archer/Ranger - Wererats - Req. Level 5
After receiving your Hammered Iron Ring, Simrut continues talking...
Simrut the Green: Have you seen the rats?
Simrut the Green: Rats! Sneaking, snarling, killing! Hunt bandits, they says. Hunt rats, I says! Riddrick is gone, They took him, I says. I knows. The rats. Big rats. Will you hunt?
Simrut the Green: The scout. He hunted the rats, too. Will you hunt?
Simrut the Green: Yes, yes. Good. Hunt rats, find Riddrick!
If you ask Simrut about the aforementioned bandits, he has this to say:
Simrut the Green: Deepcuts, the deep cutters.
This may be a breadcrumb tie in to the Deepcut Bandit Bounty quest.

You will need to head back the tunnel to the newbie hunting area. You are looking for Wererats, which have a rare chance of dropping Riddrick's Ring. You can find them by following the North wall out of the newbie gate until you find their encampment. You will likely need a party as the Wererats cluster in groups consisting of fighters, shamans and archers.
Hand Simrut the Green Riddrick's Ring.
You gain experience.
Your faction standing with The Descendian Order got better.
Simrut the Green: Riddrick's ring! Hrum. No, no. It won't do. No.
Simrut the Green: It won't do, >! But it is proof. Give these to the lordling, Vosirek. The council must listen.
You receive Riddrick's Ring from Simrut the Green.
You receive Simrut's Report from Simrut the Green.
Facing the same direction as Simrut the Green, head up the stairs towards Gunder Dinnig, walk through the Archer / Ranger building, and you will see Sir Vosirek.
Hand Simrut's Report and Riddrick's Ring to Sir Vosirek.
You gain experience.
Your faction standing with The Descendian Order got better.
Sir Vosirek shakes his head.

Sir Vosirek: The latest victim of Simrut's obsessions, I see. He knows the council will not approve of this. Riddrick has likely deserted, or else died senselessly pursuing this folly. There is no coin to be had in rat-hunting.
Sir Vosirek tears a page out of Simrut's report and scrawls a note on the back.
Sir Vosirek: You have my sympathy, >. Give this to the paymaster along with your guild signet ring.
You receive Scrap of Paper from Sir Vosirek.
Sir Vosirek: You'll find Elara downstairs.
Head downstairs to find Elara Venn.
Hand the Scrap of Paper and your Hammered Iron Ring to Elara Venn.
You gain experience.
Your faction standing with The Descendian Order got better.
Elara Venn shakes her head.
Elara Venn: Oh, Urzebol take Simrut's rats. But you followed orders, and there are always opportunities for those who follow orders. Take this ring.
You receive Polished Iron Ring from Elara Venn.
You receive 10 silver from Elara Venn.
Part 3 for Archer/Ranger - Riddrick - Req. Level 8+
Return to Simrut the Green and Hail him.
Simrut the Green: Hrumm. No help from council, no. Must find Riddrick.

parts.say: But Riddrick is dead. We found his ring!

parts.text: Simrut the Green: Not dead, I says. Lost his ring, not dead. The rats have him!
Simrut the Green grins at you.
Simrut the Green: Find Riddrick!
At this point, you are on the search for Riddrick the Cursed, a rare wererat spawn. You will need to be level 12-14 and you may need a group to successfully find and put an end to Riddrick.
Upon killing Riddrick the Cursed, loot Riddrick's Head and return to Simrut the Green.
Hand Riddrick's Head to Simrut the Green.
Missing dialogue here...
You gain experience.
Your faction standing with The Descendian Order got better.
You receive Ratkiller from Simrut the Green.
Part 2 for Enchanter/Elementalist/Wizard - Deepcut Miners in Darrowdwell Mines - Req. Level 4+
After receiving your Hammered Iron Ring, ask Maude about her research...
Maude Astarace: The Delvestone and Deepcut quarrel over rocks, and I wish to know why. Their petty conflict is our good fortune, since the mining company will pay us to reclaim their crystals.
Maude Astarace: Venture into the Darrowdwell mine about the citadel and fill this box with crystals from the Deepcut miners.
You receive Empty Crystal Box from Maude Astarace.
Maude Astarace: In truth, I care not how you acquire these crystals.
Hand in the Full Box of Crystals to Maude Astarace
You gain experience.
After receiving Full Box of Crystals, Maude Astarace continues talking...
Maude Astarace opens the box and rummages throught it.
Maude Astarace: What is this?
Maude Astarace: These are not diamonds, nor sapphires, nor even jaspers. Lusterless rocks, all!
Maude Astarace: I suppose you have earned some coin for your part. The Miners can have their rocks, but something is amiss. Take this to the paymaster along with your guild signet.
Hand in the Darrowdwell Crystal Bounty to Elara Venn at the Bounty Building nearby with your Hammered Iron Ring
Your faction standing with The Descendian Order got better.
Elara Venn unfolds Maude's report.
Elara Venn: A contract fulfilled. The Delvestone appreciate your work, Class, even if the sorceress does not. Here is your share, and a signet befitting your place.
You receive Polished Iron Ring from Elara Venn.
You recieve 10 silver from Elara Venn.
Part 3 for Enchanter/Elementalist/Wizard - Deepcut, Delvestone, Darrowdwell. - Req. Level 8+
Return to Maude Astarace and hail her.
Maude Astarace: I do not believe for a moment that the Delvestone would spill their blood or their coin for those worthless rocks. I require your assistance once more, Player Name.

Maude Astarace: I must have a sample of whatever mineral lies at the heart of this territorial squabble. Deepcut, Delvestone, Darrowdwell. These are insignificant. Find the thing they fight and die for.
Maude Astarace: Do this, and I will reward you personally.

You are looking for a Faintly Glowing Crystal (you only need one) from a Deepcut Miner ( Level 10+ ) in the North Mines. The North Mines can be reached by exiting the North East gate then head kinda like north east of that and to the back of the zone.
There are tents of deepcut ( not miners ) outside so you'll know you are in the right place. There are higher level bigger mushroom people in the general area too.
Return to Maude Astarace and give her the crystal.
to be continued
Part 2 for Beastmaster/Fighter - Deepcut Overseers in Darrowdwell Mines - Req. Level 4+
After receiving your Hammered Iron Ring, ask Gunder Dinnig about work...

Gunder Dinnig: Aye, there are domestic matters we might resolve to our profit. The Delvestone Mining Company quarrel with the Deepcut bandits in Darrowdwell. The company is ill-equipped to to protect their interests, but their pockets run deep.
Gunder Dinnig: There is a standing bounty of the heads of Deepcut overseers. Fill this bag and earn your share. Send them packing!
Gunder Dinnig belches.
You receive Empty Overseer Bag from Gunder Dinnig.
Collect 6 Deepcut Overseer Head, place them in the Empty Overseer Bag and click combine to create Full Bag of Overseer Heads.
Hand in the Full Bag of Overseer Heads to Gunder Dinnig
Your faction standing with The Descendian Order got better.
Gunder Dinnig Unfastens the Bag.
Gunder Dinning: Gruesome work, Player Name. Would that you had a sharper blade... yet a crown hewn is a copper earned. Bring this to Elara, the pay-master, along with your ring.
You receive Deepcut Overseer Bounty from Gunder Dinnig.
Elara Venn: You acquit yourself well, Class. Here is your coin, and a signet that might serve you better.
You receive Polished Iron Ring from Elara Venn.
You recieve 10 silver from Elara Venn.
Part 3 for Beastmaster/Fighter - More business with the Deepcut - Req. Level 8+
Return to Gunder Dinnig and hail him.
Gunder Dinnig: There is more business with the Deepcut.
Gunder Dinnig: The bandits have an encampment, a mine where the Delvestone dare not go. My peers wish to rout the blaggards, claim their quarries, and lease them to fill our coffers.
Gunder Dinnig: But we must exercise caution. I have a new assignment for you.

Gunder Dinnig: Find their lair, Player Name, and take no quarter. You may claim a bounty for every six hands of the bandits you slay. Bring them to the clerk, Traven, and he will see that you are paid. But that is not your task.

Gunder Dinnig: I wish to know who is behind this sordid outfit. If we are to extend our reach father into the Deep, we must know. Bring me any evidence you can find, however insignificant it might seem to your eye.
Travel to the Deepcut bandit camps which can be found if you keep going east a little way in the Underdocks newbie yard and slay them until you acquire a Dull Coin. Bring this coin back to Gunder.
Gunder Dinnig squints his eyes at the coin.
Gunder Dinnig: One of the bandits carried this? It is an elvish coin, though I do not recognize the sigil. Should it belong to one of the great houses...

Gunder Dinnig: There is no contract fulfilled nor bounty to collect for your work today, Player Name, but you have earned a measure of trust. Take this token to Hargrul in the citadel. He is an old friend of mine, and a blacksmith of formidable skill.
You receive a token from Gunder Dinnig.
Take the token over to the blacksmith shop in the citadel and give it to Blacksmith Hargrul.
Blacksmith Hargrul holds the token up to the light of the forge.
Blacksmith Hargrul: Hmm, 'Tis my token.
Blacksmith Hargrul looks you up and down..
Blacksmith Hargrul: I haven't a blade suited to a young Class such as yourself. But a skullcracker will do.
You receive Hargrul's Skullcracker from Blacksmith Hargrul.
Blacksmith Hargrul: If ye cannot wield it, return it to me to receive a smaller battle hammer.
You now have the option to trade it for a one-handed weapon.
Blacksmith Hargrul: Haven't the strength, I see. Perhaps it's meant for a more capable Class.
You receive Hargrul's Tenderizer from Blacksmith Hargrul.
Head to Layla Faraj in Glass Flats. Layla is located at the Pyrmos Mercenary / Salt Gatherer camp near the Sungreet Strand zoneline.
Layla Faraj: Sweltering days and frigid nights here in the flats, my friend. I'm fortunate that the salt gatherers have spared me a tent in exchange for my services.

Layla Faraj: I'm a Sojourner of the Crow Clan and an alchemist by trade. I've been able to provide various tinctures and poultices to the workers while I remain here. Though admittedly, they seem to favor my Viper's Kick more than anything!
Layla Faraj: Viper's Kick is the name I've given to a potent shot of liquor I produce using just enough viper toxin as to not be... fatal.
Layla Faraj: It gives you a swift kick in the mouth before making it go numb from the toxin's effects.
Layla Faraj: If you care to try it, I can make you a shot with some Black Feather whiskey and a Szuurian viper venom sac.
Kill a Szuurian viper and loot Szuurian Viper Venom Sac.
Travel to Night Harbor and find Nerida Thinblade at The Spirit Tap bar in the Black Feather Bazaar. Purchase Black Feather Whiskey for 2 silver pieces.
Give 1 x Szuurian Viper Venom Sac and 1 x Black Feather Whiskey to Layla Faraj.
Layla Faraj: Oh, perfect! Just a moment...
Layla Faraj carefully extracts just enough venom as to not be dangerous, depositing it into the whiskey and giving it a swift stir.
Layla Faraj: Here you are! This is sure to keep you warm on a cool night in the flats.
You receive Viper's Kick from Layla Faraj.
You gain experience.
Faction: Citizens of Night Harbor +
Ingredients
Purchase 1 x Black Feather Whiskey for 2sp from Nerida Thinblade in Night Harbor.
Kill a Szuurian viper in Glass Flats until you loot 1 x Szuurian Viper Venom Sac.
Brewing
Head to Layla Faraj in Glass Flats. Layla is located at the Pyrmos Mercenary / Salt Gatherer camp near the Sungreet Strand zoneline.
Give Layla Faraj 1 x Black Feather Whiskey and 1 x Szuurian Viper Venom Sac.
Quest Complete!
Notes
2 x Viper's Kick are used in the quest A Sweet Treat.
This quest starts with hailing Guard Atep.
Guard Atep: Citizen, I am offering bounties for various targets of opportunity. Are you interested in hearing about them?
Guard Atep: I currently have a bounty for Ashira.
Guard Atep hands you a wanted poster.
You receive Wanted: Ayip and Yapala from Guard Atep

WANTED: Dead or Alive


Ayip and Yapala of the Ashira

and killed innocent civilians long enough. Their

last known location was near the hidden entrance

to Tel Ekir, found in the Shaded Dunes.


Bring their heads to Guard Atep.

This quest begins in the Underdocks upper city district by talking with Draznax. Draznax is located in the center of the mercenary camp, near the wagons on the southern east portion of the upper city.
Draznax: Hey! Welcome to Ruff's Fight Club.
Draznax looks around timidly.
Draznax: I'm the assistant to the assistant, which makes me pretty important around here. I'm tasked with keeping things orderly, safe and secure. But we have a rat problem...
Draznax grins and looks over his shoulder quickly.
Draznax: I can't even think straight with all the chittering coming from the rat's complex down the block. The wererats came over here and attacked us. Tried to steal our food and booze!
Draznax: It's time to send them a message... a deadly one! Go find the rats and chop off their heads. Bring those back to me for your just rewards.
Draznax would like you to hunt some wererats and return a Severed Wererat Head. Note that this is different from the Night Harbor Shadow Knight quest item Wererat Head.
The closest Wererats are in a building on the southwest side of the upper city. These Wererats con red to a level 4 as of 2026-09-11.

Wererats can also be found in the newbie hunting area below the Underdocks. The easiest Wererats are level 5-8 and drop heads at a roughly 30% drop rate as of 2026-09-11. Heads are non-unique and tradable, and likely used for faction grinding.
Hand in Severed Wererat Head one at a time to Draznax.
You gain experience.
Your faction standing with The Fight Club got better.
You receive 50 copper from Draznax.
Draznax: Great job! That'll teach those vermin their place.
As of 2026-09-11, a Deep Elf Archer received 1 blue bar of faction with The Fight Club per head turn-in.
As of 2026-10-03, reward appears to be changed to 50c instead of 1s.
All dialogue is missing from this quest.
There may be breadcrumbs from Tessa Kentwell informing the player to find Poacher Wilna.
Poacher Wilna is one of three named poachers that can spawn in the bear caves in Keeper's Bight.
Kill Poacher Wilna and loot Wilna's Ring.
Give the ring to Tessa Kentwell in the Kentwell Tannery in Penshaw Village.
You receive Ring of Consequences from Tessa Kentwell.
You gain experience.

Part 1 - Req. Lvl 1
you will need 2 snake skins if you want to get them before you start **
Read Carefully Rolled Note you start with as a new Wizard Character:

Student <Player>,

You have been enrolled in the introductory course 
at the Chartered Academy of Arcane Inquiry.

Diligently report to the admissions officer — Olvin
Viscus — to complete the application process.

The Academy is located in the heart of Sageside, in
the northeastern part of the city. The floating 
wizard tower is your destination. Take the
translocation devices to enter.

Please do not tarry in your visit; knowing how to 
manage your newfound powers is of the utmost
importance.

Signed,

— High Doctore Jabir Il-hamar
Head to the wizard tower in the north eastern corner of Night Harbor and Turn in your Carefully Rolled Note to Olvin Viscus
You gain experience.
Olvin Viscus peers at you over his thick spectacles.
Olvin Viscus: No, I am not interested in buying an — Oh, a new student? Well, give it here, then!

Olvin Viscus: Welcome to the Chartered Academy of Arcane Inquiry. I am Olvin Viscus, head administrator of the Academy. I am sure you are eager to learn your first spells, but first, you must introduce yourself to the staff here.
Olvin Viscus reaches into his desk and pulls out a long scroll of parchment, then takes a leather folio and places the scroll inside. He thrusts it into your hands.

Olvin Viscus: All five heads of the various schools must sign off on your application before you are formally inducted into the school. They can be found within the Academy grounds, the Grand Library, or elsewhere in Sageside if they are not in their offices. Make haste, get all five signatures, and bring your prospectus back to me. Hurry now, !
You receive Academy Prospectus from Olvin Viscus.
You receive Academy Folio from Olvin Viscus.
Olvin Viscus: Our halls are home to some of the most ardent researchers of mystical lore in Szuur—no, in all of Aêthoril!
Olvin Viscus bows slightly as he begins his spiel.

Olvin Viscus: Our illustrious head doctore is none other than Jabir Il-hamar, Doctore of the School of Elemental Mastery. He can be found atop our tower, looking out over the city when he is not busy in his office.
Olvin Viscus: Next is the Doctore of the School of Celestial Investigation, Adimah Starseeker. She typically works in the orrery, but if she is not there, she may be out doing her research.

Olvin Viscus: Doctore Rallin Wizzentrop is the head of the School of Aberration Research. He can usually be found within the tower itself, accompanied by his wonderful dragon companion. Though we haven't been seeing much of the latter lately, he often sends the creature out on errands.
Olvin Viscus pauses to take a deep breath before continuing.

Olvin Viscus: Doctore Veygen Antorious can be found within the tower. This maverick of the School of Aethernautical Exploration often has his head in the clouds, but that is not a bad thing. He is a skilled airship pilot and even possesses the power to travel to other planes. His ability is not to be taken lightly.

Olvin Viscus: Finally, you can find Doctore Lanna Invintoria in the Grand Library. She was originally an honored guest from Calafrey, but she decided to join our school! She teaches Humanoid Studies and is a skilled linguist, anthropologist, and historian.
Olvin Viscus claps his hands, feeling accomplished.
Olvin Viscus: And those are the wonderful heads of our five schools.
Veygen Antorious
Head up the tower and hand your Academy Prospectus to Veygen Antorious
Veygen Antorious inspects the form, then looks you over with a stern gaze.
Veygen Antorious: Hmm...
Veygen Antorious strokes his beard as he appraises you.

Veygen Antorious: Yes, I think you'll do. Allow me to sign your form, but know that I expect great things from you—as I do from every prospective student of the Academy. You're a little older than some of the other novices, but I expect you'll catch up in your studies quickly.
Veygen Antorious signs your form with the flick of a quill.
Veygen Antorious: I suppose congratulations are in order. Let's hope that the other faculty heards are in agreement with my choice.
Veygen Antorious smiles at you warmly.
You receive Academy Prospectus from Veygen Antorious.
You receive Veygen's Prospectus from Veygen Antorious.
Jabir Il-hamar
Head further up the tower and hand your Academy Prospectus to Jabir Il-hamar
Jabir Ilhama smiles takes the letter from you, grasping it in his spindly fingers.
Jabir Il-hamar: Ah, I see. A new student wishes to enroll in our illustrious Academy.
Jabir Ilhama strokes his long beard, carefully looking over you.

Jabir Il-hamars ays, "If you wish to join our ranks, I don’t want any sort of whining, complaining, or any other such nonsense. Such trifling gives me a headache, and if you are half as wise as you’re expected to be, you will know that being a pain to me in particular is a poor decision for a student."
Jabir Ilhama sighs, shaking his head. He takes out a long quill, along with a piece of parchment, writing out a statement, before signing both papers, handing them back to you.
Jabir Il-hamar: Do not make me regret allowing you into this Academy.
Jabir Ilhama watches you closely as you leave.
You receive Academy Prospectus from Jabir Il-hamar.
You receive Jabir's Prospectus from Jabir Il-hamar.
Adimah Starseeker
Head to the bottom of the tower and take the teleporter to the Library. (Inside the Grand Library entry floor, on the left side upon entry.)
Hand your Academy Prospectus to Adimah Starseeker
Adimah Starseeker holds up a finger as she continues to read her tome.
Adimah Starseeker: Hold.
Adimah Starseeker does not look up from the pages.
Adimah Starseeker furiously writing something down in her notebook before finally meeting your eyes. She snatches the paper from your hand quickly.
Adimah Starseeker: Ah, so you wish to join our academy.
Adimah Starseeker looks you over for a moment as she places the prospectus on her desk. She takes one of her notebooks and passes it to you.
Adimah Starseeker: Bring this to my adjunct, Domas. You can find him tending to the orrery. He should return my prized quill to you. Bring it back to me, and I will sign your prospectus.
Adimah Starseeker immediately returns to her work, brushing the prospectus aside on her desk.
You receive Adimah's Notebook from Adimah Starseeker.
Head back to the top of the wizard tower and hand Adimah's Notebook to Domas Starseeker
Domas Starseeker flips through the book's pages.

Domas Starseeker: Ah, I see you've spoken with my mother. Very well... I take it she wants her quill back, yes? She left it in one of the other notebooks she gave me, you see. She tends to use them as bookmarks.
Domas Starseeker quietly tuts.
Domas Starseeker: Well, here's the quill. Hopefully, she'll be happy with it. And tell her to get some rest; she's always staying up too late.
Domas Starseeker shakes his head with a sigh.
You receive Golden-Feathered Quill from Domas Starseeker.
Return back to Adimah Starseeker and hand her the Golden-Feathered Quill.
Adimah Starseeker holds up a finger, once again nose-deep in her tome.
Adimah Starseeker: Hold.
Adimah Starseeker sharply glances to your hands.
Adimah Starseeker: Ah, my quill. Wonderful.
Adimah Starseeker takes the quill in a surprisingly slow and gentle manner.
Adimah Starseeker: Hm, Domas cleaned it for me. I should reward him for that.
Adimah Starseeker: Ah, right! Your prospectus! Here you are.
Adimah Starseeker: Now, if you'll excuse me, I have a lot more work to do.
You receive Academy Prospectus from Adimah Starseeker.
You receive Adimah's Prospectus from Adimah Starseeker.
Rallin Wizzentrop
Head back to the tower and hand your Academy Prospectus to Rallin Wizzentrop
Rallin Wizzentrop takes your prospectus, stuffing it into his pocket.
Rallin Wizzentrop: Yes, yes, a work order... Tell Hamsar I've already completed his special item.
Rallin Wizzentrop waves his hand dismissively towards you, before hand you a small wooden box.
You receive Delivery for Hamsar from Rallin Wizzentrop.
Head back to the library and hand the Delivery for Hamsar to Hamsar
Hamsar perks an eyebrow as he takes the box from you. Propping up the lid, he peeks inside before his expression lights up.
Hamsar: Oh, I see. Ya brought this from Rallin. Wonderful! I’ve been waiting all month fer him to fix this fer me.
Hamsar adjusts the toolbelt around his waist, then notices you still standing there.
Hamsar: Oh, he kept yer prospectus? That’s unfortunate fer ya… I’ll make sure t’write something on this here receipt.
Hamsar scribbles on the scrap of paper before handing it back to you.
Hamsar grins broadly with sparkling teeth.
Hamsar: Good luck, newbie!
You receive Hamsar's Receipt from Hamsar.
Return to Rallin Wizzentrop and hand him Hamsar's Receipt

Rallin Wizzentrop takes the receipt from you. He looks over it, adjusting his thick spectacles, before reaching into his pocket, pulling out a now grease-stained prospectus. He wordlessly stamps it, and, along with what seems to be a pre-signed form of acceptance from his department, passes both to you.
You receive Academy Prospectus from Rallin Wizzentrop.
You receive Rallin's Prospectus from Rallin Wizzentrop.
Lanna Ivintoria
Head to the Library to hand your Academy Prospectus to Lanna Ivintoria
Lanna Ivintoria takes the prosepctus from you ginerly, looking over it, before she nods.
Lanna Ivintoria: Ah, very well, you wish to study at our Academy?

Lanna Ivintoria: I will sign your prospectus, but I require proof of your arcane prowess. Bring me two snake skins. I require their use in one of my experiments. Any snake you find around Night Harbor will do. Do this, and I will provide you with a signature.
Lanna Ivintoria hands you back the unsigned prospectus.
You receive Academy Prospectus from Lanna Ivintoria.
Head out the North Gate of Night Harbor and kill a snakes until you receive two Snake Skins.
Alternatively you can buy these.
Return to Lanna Ivintoria and hand her your two Snake Skins.
Lanna Ivintoria examines the skins carefully.
Lanna Ivintoria: Wonderful, wonderful, they are in fine condition. Yes, this will do. Very well, here is your signed prospectus, as promised.
You receive Lanna's Prospectus from Lanna Ivintoria.
Becoming a student
Combine all 5 notes in to the Academy Folio as well as the original Academy Prospectus to receive the Complete Academy Prospectus.
Hand the Complete Academy Prospectus to Olvin Viscus
Olvin Viscus thumbs through the folio.
Olvin Viscus: Ah, splendid! I take it you had no difficulty receiving signatures from our illustrious staff?

Olvin Viscus pulls out a large, ornate brass stamp that, after whispering a few arcane words, glows hot in his hand. He places a cold piece of wax on the closed folio, then presses it shut with the red-hot seal. The wax bubbles for a moment before settling, leaving the crimson seal of the Academy in its place.
Olvin Viscus: Please, , take this to our headmaster. I am sure you know who he is by now, he did have to sign one of your forms after all. Do not tarry!
Olvin Viscus sends you off with a little wave.
You receive Approved Academy Prospectus from Olvin Viscus.
Head up the tower to Jabir Il-hamar and hand him the Approved Academy Prospectus.
You gain experience.
Jabir Il-hamar takes the folio from you, inspecting the seal, before quickly leafing through it.
Jabir Il-hamar: Very well. It’s all here, it seems. Your diligence has paid off, for you are now a Grade 0 Student at the Chartered Academy of Arcane Inquiry.
Jabir Il-hamar waves his hands, and a scarlet robe, perfectly sized for you, appears in your arms.
Jabir Il-hamar: Wear it with pride, . Now, go and practice your magic. Once you have learned a few more spells, return to me, wearing your robes, and I will offer you your first assignment.
You receive Academy Student's Robe from Jabir Ilhamar.
Part 2 - Req. Lvl 4
Once you are level 4, go back to Jabir Il-hamar and hail him. Must be wearing "Academy student's robe".
Jabir Il-hamar strokes his beard as a worried expression crosses his face.
Jabir Il-hamar: I'm afraid I have bad news. A few days ago, one of your fellow students was sent to the Tomb of the Last Wyrmsbane... but he has yet to return.
Jabir Il-hamar: Viridon is his name... he's an experienced student.
Jabir Il-hamar: Please go out there, find him, and bring him back to us safely. It's advisable that you take companions with you.
Head to Tomb of the Last Wyrmsbane, the Scorched Academy Folio is a random drop off skeleton mobs in the tomb.
Return to Jabir Il-hamar
Turn in Scorched Academy Folio to Jabir Il-hamar.
Jabir Il-hamar: A folio from our academy? Why are you...
Jabir Il-hamar looks at you in shock.
Jabir Il-hamar: No, this cannot be! Are you telling me this belonged to Viridon?
Jabir Il-hamar mutters in disbelief, thrusting the folio back into your hands.
Jabir Il-hamar: This is dreadful news! I hope no ill has befallen him. We must investigate... will you help me?
Jabir Il-hamar: Thank you, player
Jabir Il-hamar: Please bring Viridon's folio to Liyna in the Grand Library. She'll analyze it and help us find a lead. Go at once!
Head to the Grand Library and seek out Liyna Esueiruc who is on the lower floors.
Turn in Scorched Academy Folio to Liyna Esueiruc.
Note: I got the following upon handing the folio over...
Liyna Esueiruc looks at the folio, then back to you.
Liyna Esueiruc: A folio? I'm not one of the Academy's Doctores.
Liyna Esueiruc hands back the folio.
You receive Scorched Academy Folio from Liyna Esueiruc.
...so, I repeated the hand-in and it advanced..
Turn in Scorched Academy Folio to Liyna Esueiruc.
Liyna Esueiruc pulls a loupe from her pocket and inspects the folio.
Liyna Esueiruc: There's odd traces of runic charring on this. It looks like whomever was carrying it was hit by a necromantic spell.
Liyna Esueiruc: You've done well to stay out of trouble. Ask Jabir for a just reward.
Liyna Esueiruc: I still need more time to investigate, but when you see Jabir, please hand him this message from me.
Liyna Esueiruc: We'll speak again, student. Fear not, we'll get to the bottom of this.
You receive Small Note from Liyna Esueiruc.
You gain experience.
Return to Jabir Il-hamar and turn in your Small Note from Liyna.
You receive your items back from Jabir Ilhamar.
Jabir Il-hamar looks at the folio as his spectacles slide down to his nose.
Jabir Il-hamar suddenly drops the folio in shock.
Jabir Il-hamar: Yes... right... of course.
Jabir Il-hamar: Student... thank you... We'll investigate your findings. Please do not worry yourself with it any longer.
Jabir Il-hamar: You've earned yourself a reward. Pick up the folio, would you? And hand me your robe as well, I have a new one for you.
Turn in your Academy Student's Robe and Small Note to Jabir Il-hamar .
Jabir Il-hamar takes your old robe and quickly swaps it with a new one.
Jabir Il-hamar: You deserve this, Player.
Jabir Il-hamar pats you on the shoulder.
You receive Gilded Academy Student's Robe from Jabir Ilhamar.
Jabir Il-hamar: Return to me after you've studied a while longer.
Part 3 - Req. Lvl TBD (above 16)
If still too low of level, Jabir Il-hamar will ask you to return when higher level:
Jabir Il-hamar: Player, I have important news to discuss with you, but you must continue your studies. Speak with me after training a while longer.

Read the Recruitment Notice you start with as a new Wizard character:

Calling all hot-blooded--

MEN-AT-ARMS,
SORCERERS,
HUNTERS,
and OLD DOGS.

--be you unemployed, dispossessed, or outlawed.

GOOD PAY.

Marshal Harding

Your faction standing with The Descendian Order got better.
Marshal Harding looks you over.
Marshal Harding: You can read this, then? You look like you crawled out of a gutter. Have you come to serve in the Order?

parts.say: I have come to serve in the Order

parts.text: Marshal Harding waves the leaf of paper in your face.
Marshal Harding: The Descendian Order. I pray you fight better than you read, if you wish to earn your keep.

parts.say: I wish to earn my keep

parts.text: Marshal Harding laughs.
Marshal Harding: As a scullion, no doubt, by your dress.
Marshal Harding rummages through a crate and hands you a shirt.
Marshal Harding: It could do with a wash, but at least you might seem to be a page rather than a pauper. Can you fight, then?

Marshal Harding: I'll have the truth of it. Fill this satchel with the shells of deep beetles.

Head to Maude Asterace. She is in the building to the left of Quartermaster LLarne above the bounty office.
Hand in the Note to Maude Asterace

Maude Asterace: A new recruit! I hope you live a little longer than the last one. The marshal is not always the most discerning fellow. Never mind about that. Take this ring and assist me with my research.
You receive Hammered Iron Ring from Maude Asterace
Maude Asterace: The Delvestone and Deepcut quarrel over rocks, and I wish to know why. Their petty conflict is our good fortune, since the mining company will pay us to reclaim their crystals.

This quest involves talking to Matheus Griswald found within the cave that the Tomb of the Last Wyrmsbane resides in. Matheus Griswald when shown armor tokens, which the player can receive from named mobs within the tomb, will inform the player on how he can restore them. These armor tokens are turned in for their respective armor types & slots alongside Chipped Star Rose Quartz for cloth armor, Chipped Jasper for leather armor, Chipped Amber for chain armor, and Chipped Fire Opal for plate armor. It is unknown if faction with the Easthymn Freebooters influences your ability to turn in the tokens, however, this faction raises while killing most mobs found within the tomb.
Hail, Matheus Griswald

Matheus Griswald: Hail, adventurer. The name's Matheus Griswald, of the Easthymnite Freebooters. I head up this dig site. My crew was searching for long lost relics, but our excavation has fallen into peril.

Matheus Griswald: There are many ancient relics within the tomb. Some of which may even be of value to you. If you help us destroy the monstrosities inside, you will earn the favor of the Freebooters. And with that, can come many benefits.
Matheus Griswald: We know that the ancient armor of the fallen Wyrmsbane still lies within. If you bring it to us, along with certain gems, we can help you restore it.
Matheus Griswald: Are you looking to restore cloth, leather, chain or plate?

Matheus Griswald: Bring me pieces of the old ancient cloth armor, along with the corresponding amount of Chipped Star Rose Quartz. I'll restore waist and wrist armor with one Chipped Star Rose Quartz, feet and hands with two, shoulders and head with three, legs with four, and chest with five.

Matheus Griswald: Bring me pieces of the old ancient leather armor, along with the corresponding amount of Chipped Jasper. I'll restore waist and wrist armor with one Chipped Jasper, feet and hands with two, shoulders and head with three, legs with four, and chest with five.

Matheus Griswald: Bring me pieces of the old ancient chain armor, along with the corresponding amount of Chipped Amber. I'll restore waist and wrist armor with one Chipped Amber, feet and hands with two, shoulders and head with three, legs with four, and chest with five.

Matheus Griswald: Bring me pieces of the old ancient plate armor, along with the corresponding amount of Chipped Fire Opal. I'll restore waist and wrist armor with one Chipped Fire Opal, feet and hands with two, shoulders and head with three, legs with four, and chest with five.

parts.say: Where can I get Chipped Star Rose Quartz

parts.text: Matheus Griswald: You can find from miners, or mine it yourself from Copper Veins.
